0.Content: Hunter, you're just in time.

1.Content: The howling of fierce beasts seem to be coming from those abandoned ruins; I sense that these hunting grounds were home to evil sacrificial rituals.

2.Content: If the ritual is allowed to finish, beasts will make their way to Esperia!

3.Content: We can never condone such evil! Hunt these beasts, stop the ritual, and return these hunting grounds to the dust where they belong!

0.Content: Hunter, you are now a supporting role. These roles provide tactical support for hunters who are fighting.

1.Content: Battles on the hunting grounds change rapidly. You need to analyze the situation and provide timely strategic advice and morale support to your hunters.

2.Content: Although you can't fight the enemy yourself from a support role, the tactical advice you provide your hunters will be key to victory!

3.Content: When the Hunting Squad you support has their Squad Level increased, you will receive Support Rewards.

0.Content: <text|Thank the fates. It's always good to see you arrive here safely, warrior from afar. Finally, some good tidings.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|I believe you know, but due to the rampant volatile energy present here, the slightest misstep will trigger the collapse of the Temporal Rift, and none on Esperia shall be spared.|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|That also leads us to our next point... We cannot directly intervene here.|emblem_yellow_20>

3.Content: <text|Warriors, please do not panic. It is for precisely this reason that Ansiel created the Temporal Beacon. It will help you navigate safely through this turmoil.|emblem_yellow_20>

4.Content: <text|However, time is not particularly abundant, so I entreat you to go with our blessing and destroy the perpetrators destroying the space-time stability.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Warriors from afar, thank you for your commitment. Through your efforts, the Temporal Rift recovered much stability.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|Yet, Ansiel believes that if he can step into further uncharted lands, even more instability can be eliminated.|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|Naturally, now this place has been stabilized considerably, we can intervene in space-time to a greater degree, thus we can bestow upon you more powerful blessings.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|There is one slightly more worrisome matter. Word reached me that warriors have stumbled upon a peculiar place in which they've seen Hypogeans.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|The Temporal Rift is a land of chaos, it is only natural the destructive Hypogeans would be inclined towards it, not wanting to pass up on a good time.|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|I just fear the Hypogeans' wiles may have already seduced someone...|emblem_yellow_20>

3.Content: <text|Lailah, dear sister. That's why we're here. It is our duty to guard Esperia and resolve discord.|emblem_yellow_20>

4.Content: <text|Surely we ought to be providing our valiant, diligent warriors with a place of rest and refuge now, no?|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|According to Ansiel and Orthros' findings, this temporal turbulence was born of Orthros' pursuit of Zolrath, is that right?|hero_dialog_tip_1>

1.Content: <text|Repeatedly tampering with the flow of time, breaking it and mending it, resulted in a chain reaction. Such an outcome surprises no-one.|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|But had Orthros not given chase, Zolrath would have had a vastly more profound and far-reaching impact on Esperia after tampering with time as he pleased.|emblem_yellow_20>

3.Content: <text|I understand, dear brother.|emblem_yellow_20>

4.Content: <text|Long-suffering hero, my apologies for not noticing your arrival sooner.|emblem_yellow_20>

5.Content: <text|Please, accept this. I hope that the blessings bestowed upon you will serve you well in your journey.|emblem_yellow_20>

6.Content: <text|I'm sure you heard the conversation between my brother and I just now. If you have also encountered such a place, please do all in your power not be compelled by the Hypogean.|emblem_yellow_20>

7.Content: <text|They are beings who bring chaos and mayhem, even if they entice you with favors, it is only to wreak further havoc.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Near-victorious hero, thank you for your enduring commitment.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|Your hard spent efforts in restoring balance to the Temporal Rift, as well as inflicting considerable losses on the Continuum Stalker and its minions, have paid off. Stability has returned.|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|Just look at the unique chaotic landscape outside, I suspect it will recover in no time.|emblem_yellow_20>

3.Content: <text|Of course, we will remain vigilant until true stability sets in.|emblem_yellow_20>

4.Content: <text|Offering those heroes who are still contributing and striving here a place where they can rest in comfort and be at ease.|emblem_yellow_20>

5.Content: <text|May the fates forever favor you, dear hero.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Even in the final moments, take nothing for granted.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|This is the blessing granted to you, we'll take care of the rest.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Well-traveled hero, this is the blessing bestowed upon you.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|As darkness and chaos persist, I hope you will deliver light and a bright future.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Ahhh, yet another warrior has appeared.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|Check out that senselessly wary demeanor... it's so inviting.|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|As much as I want to play with you, I just don't have the energy right now.|emblem_yellow_20>

3.Content: <text|This time, I'll give you a little present. But you know, it's a little disrespectful for you to come here empty-handed like this.|emblem_yellow_20>

4.Content: <text|You're not ready? Then I'll only take |emblem_yellow_20><text|{0}|infinite_npc_room_red_20><text|% health and |emblem_yellow_20><text|{1}|infinite_npc_room_red_20><text|% Energy from you, just as a keepsake for when I miss you.|emblem_yellow_20>

5.Content: <text|Heh heh, I believe we'll meet again, you have to come back and play with me some more.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Oh my, we meet again, my dear warrior. Thanks to you, little old me can finally have another chat with you.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|It must be tough running errands for those guys over there, although you can't truly die in a place like this, you know?|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|What's with that expression? Are you genuinely not in the least bit curious about the appearance of the chaos here?|emblem_yellow_20>

3.Content: <text|I reckon, those guys over there are going to pin the blame on us, wouldn't you say?|emblem_yellow_20>

4.Content: <text|Heh heh, don't worry, I'm not that petty. Why not consider joining us. I can give you better stuff.|emblem_yellow_20>

5.Content: <text|Naturally, just as always you'll have to exchange |emblem_yellow_20><text|{0}|infinite_npc_room_red_20><text|% health and |emblem_yellow_20><text|{1}|infinite_npc_room_red_20><text|% Energy with little old me.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Was the stuff you got last time good? Little punishments, you say? Just some little pranks, that's all.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|Besides, doesn't it add a little spice to our relationship?|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|Come have some fun with little old me, I can make it more worth your while than those guys.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|You're back again, my little warrior, have you been considering things carefully?|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|You know that only chaos can truly give rise to ultimate joy. Is what I give you not much better than the stuff those pompous justice-seekers give you?|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|Don't pay any mind to those so-called "curses". In any case, you should be more than this, should you not revere power?|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|Hmm? Choosing to come here even though the conclusion is already foregone? Heh heh, if only all the little tykes were just like you.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|Betrayal cuts both ways, one day it will be your head on the block.|emblem_yellow_20>

2.Content: <text|If that's still what you want, then little old me is all ears.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|This was great fun, I'm sure we'll meet again.|emblem_yellow_20>
<text|It's a small price to pay for such a big reward.|emblem_yellow_20>

1.Content: <text|More... I need more...|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: <text|A blessing from Talene, The Rising Phoenix.|emblem_yellow_20><changeLine><text|This flame cannot be extinguished.|emblem_yellow_20><changeLine><text|All scum shall be incinerated.|emblem_yellow_20><changeLine><text|Heroes never die.|emblem_yellow_20>

<text|A blessing from Flora, The Serene Promise.|emblem_yellow_20><changeLine><text|Fa-la-la fa-la-la, hope is blossoming.|emblem_yellow_20><changeLine><text|Life pours in and spreads its warmth.|emblem_yellow_20><changeLine><text|Amidst the chaos, light can shine a new.|emblem_yellow_20>

<text|The flags are swaying and the trumpets are sounding low.|emblem_yellow_20><changeline><text|Bearing divine intent, one is entrusted with vocation. |emblem_yellow_20><changeLine><text|From here, warriors will embark on a journey of no return.|emblem_yellow_20>

The first day of heavy snowfall marks the celebration of the Midwinter Festival. People prepare well in advance for the festivities. However, this year the snow came sooner than earlier years, catching people unawares. The Empire has issued an urgent call to arms, and the major guilds are springing into action to save the Midwinter Festival.

1.Content:
People are working every spare moment but it is still not enough. There are so many incomplete tasks: gathering firewood, creating ice sculptures, delivering letters, collecting fruits, hunting... Lucky for them the beasts have stepped up and these reliable creatures are organizing into special teams and ready to work their hardest! All they ask for in return is a small reward from the guilds. They may prove to be the best help in times of need.
As for what reward they seek... It is said that the beasts' favorite treasures are contained in Wreathz's rucksack. It's time to teach this scoundrel a lesson!

0.Content: Time for a joyous celebration!

1.Content: Tap to collaborate and speed up the completion of the celebration cake!

2.Content: <text|As much as I want to play with you, I just don't have the energy right now.|emblem_yellow_20>

3.Content: <text|Fancy a gift? I've got of plenty of goodies that you warriors would love.|emblem_yellow_20>

4.Content: <text|But in exchange, I'll take something from you too... Oh hang on, that's a pretty important souvenir.|emblem_yellow_20>

0.Content: You're awake? Count yourself lucky. You could've been eaten by a shark.

1.Content: The ship sank, but we made it to shore. We've gotta find a safe foothold fast, or we'll be slaughtered.

0.Content: There's a city up ahead, but it's teeming with thieves. Alright, let's muster some courage and drive them out!
This is our siege weapon! Tap it to deploy your team—there's no time to waste!
Your siege weapon has arrived! Now get in there and fight! Tap the city to view the battlefield details.
Preparations for battle seem to be underway at the capital. Go and see what you can do!
Teams will lose Morale after every battle, depending on the outcome. Once Morale reaches zero, the team will be forced to return to the camp and rest.
Hey, adventurer! See those dark clouds over the battlefield? The weather's about to change!

1.Content: Don't underestimate this kind of thing. Battlefield weather can drastically change the course of a battle!

0.Content: A rainstorm's on its way! I hate rainstorms!

1.Content: The roads get covered in water and mud, so your wheels can get stuck and keep you from moving.

0.Content: The rainstorm's finally passed... Wait, what's that?!

1.Content: Not good! It's a flood! Let's hope our city walls can withstand it!

0.Content: Congratulations, adventurer! You've finished your basic training! Now it's time for you to enjoy the battlefield!
Once the Siege Phase starts, you can tap a city to view the details of any battles between your League and others. Take a look!
Red marbles are enemy teams, while blue marbles are teams belonging to your League, and yellow ones are your teams.
Eh? A portal? Nice! From what I know, there's gotta be something good in there! Let's get to work!
I never knew there was a place like this on the island... Hey, look! That's the treasure we're looking for right over there! Doesn't look like we're too welcome here though...
Hmph! Those guards are trying to look tough, but we can cut through them like paper! Destroy them! Charge!!!
This dump of a place is full of nasty miasma... But don't worry, I brought special torches that'll get rid of it! These torches will be refreshed from time to time, so use them freely!
Heh! Nobody can stop us now! It's time to search for treasure, everyone!
Whoa, there's so much treasure! We've got all the most valuable stuff here, so let's go and sweep the next spot!
No wasting time, folks! More treasures await, so keep moving!
Hey! Sailor! Look at that cloud! See the light churning inside it? That's an old omen... a rainbow's on its way!
When the rainbow shows tomorrow, it's bound to bring good luck!
Well I'll be! You've struck gold—it's the legendary Lucky Rainbow!

1.Content: I've been at sea for years and only seen it a handful of times.

0.Content: Hah! And it's more than just pretty skies. Once the rainbow resonates with your resource zone, today's harvest will be doubled!
Tch! Fog's rolling in... nothing I hate more when sailing.

1.Content: You'd better listen close! There are plenty of dangers in misty waters!

0.Content: Oh, I nearly forgot! Some towns will fall under the fog and enter a Mist Shroud.

1.Content: While their vision's blocked, we can sneak into nearby resource zones... and "borrow" a few things.

2.Content: We'll pocket a little extra and throw a wrench in their own production. Why not, eh?

0.Content: Alright, enough chatter. Let's move before the fog lifts!
Hey, you're the league leader, aren't you? Then keep your ears open!

1.Content: A league only grows strong through the hard work of its members. Those who give their all deserve recognition.

0.Content:
Once the second phase, Border Skirmish, begins, you'll be able to personally grant merits to outstanding members.
But spots are limited, so don't go handing them out like treats. If everyone gets one, it won't mean a thing!

1.Content:
With each new phase, the number of merits refreshes.
I'm not keeping count for you, so check the top-right corner if you forget.

2.Content: Now go! I know you'll drive your members to fight even harder!

0.Content: Short on Army Units? Here are all the ways to get more soldiers. Let's get to work!
Hey, wait! Don't you think the convoy feels a little... empty?

1.Content: A siege can't be done with just a few of you!

0.Content: I've recruited some capable hands. Select a team and it'll auto-fill with Army Units.
Hey, that "scrap metal" we picked up from the ruins? Turns out it's a medal from a legendary demon hunter!

1.Content: The power sealed inside is incredible... the moment I held it, it felt like my whole body was on fire!

2.Content: With this, our firepower on the battlefield will reach a whole new level!

0.Content: You've cleared so many missions. Great work! The Bounty Hunters Guild now authorizes you to take on Aberrant Threats.
Aberrant Threats refresh every day. Complete star-rated challenges to earn generous rewards!
Different types of Aberrant Threats have different difficulties and award different star counts. Let's see if you can claim them all!
Kid, your magic is... quite something!

1.Content: Don't call me "kid". Now watch me... annihilate these Hypogeans!

0.Content: Whoa, impressive! I underestimated you. Would you like to join us in clearing out demons?

1.Content: Sounds fine... but don't slow me down.

0.Content: Hmm, that's strange. Here come some tough guys...
Hey, kid! Don't wander into such a dangerous place!

1.Content: The stone walls here are enchanted, so normal weapons are useless on them. Step aside and let me handle this!

0.Content: Search this direction for clues. Time's running out, so let's hope she can hold on!
Don't forget, complete all stages in order to claim the final reward chest!
Commander, we have just received news from one of our scouts.

1.Content: A blaze burns fiercely within the Bastion of the Elements, preventing safe passage through it. The cause of the blaze still remains unknown.

2.Content: We don't have time to go around the blaze. We'll find out who or what caused it and extinguish it we must. We must pass through, there's no other choice.

0.Content: Perhaps it was one of the elemental orbs that caused the blaze. We must get to the bottom of it.
The fire seems magical in nature. I am unable to extinguish it.
The Orb of Water looks to have been destroyed! I wonder, could this be the cause of the blaze?

1.Content: Using the divine light's power, I should be able to restore it to its original state.

2.Content: Please, do what you must.

0.Content: I have restored the orb!

1.Content: The fire is weakening. It should be safe enough to pass through the Bastion of the Elements.

2.Content: But yet it still burns... meaning there is something else afoot.

0.Content: The Orb of Fire looks peculiar.

1.Content: I fear it has been tainted. I sense a demonic presence emanating from within it. This is undoubtedly the cause of the blaze.

2.Content: Killing the demon that corrupted the orb should restore it to its original state.

0.Content: I see no change in the orb. It seems that only weakening the demon is not enough. It must be slain.

1.Content: It can't have gone far. We should search the vicinity for it.

0.Content: The orb has been restored to its former self. The blaze rages no more.
I feel revitalized! It would seem that just by coming in contact with the orbs is enough to strengthen us. A blessing from Dura herself.
We've been blessed by all four of the orbs.

1.Content: I feel strange magical fluctuations emanating from that direction, as if something is revealing itself to me.

0.Content: Legend has it that the forest was created to hide one of Dura's artifacts.

1.Content: Dura's artifact you say? Let's keep on searching and see if the legend is true. That artifact would definitely help us in our fight against these ungodly demons.

0.Content: Traveler, are you a friend of the forest? Let's test your mettle.

1.Content: If you can defeat me using more than 3 Wilder heroes, you will have earned the forest's respect.

0.Content: The formation you used to defeat me with was unable to earn the forest's respect. The hidden path remains closed.
You are a true ally of the forest. You have earned the forest's respect. A hidden path has now been revealed to you.
The brush here is too thick to cut through. We can't go this way.

1.Content: It appears every time we engage in combat that certain places become overgrown with vines.

0.Content: We're too late. The path that leads to the artifact has become overgrown with vines.

1.Content: We should choose a path with fewer enemies. Maybe then we can make it through to the artifact before its path becomes overgrown.

0.Content: This necklace, it's one of Dura's artifacts.

1.Content: It should help us to better fight against those demons.

0.Content: Blast! The city has been captured!

1.Content: We cannot let it be desecrated. Soldiers, advance! Purge the city of these wretched demons!

0.Content: Thank Dura! I cannot express my gratitude enough, Commander.

1.Content: No, I should be thanking you, Captain. You and your men fought valiantly. Leave the rest to me.

0.Content: I still have some fight left in me yet, Commander. There are others who are more urgently in need of your assistance.

1.Content: The city should have received more military supplies by now. I fear that our supply wagons have come under attack.

2.Content: If you venture northwest of the city, you may be able to save the supply wagons before there's nothing left to save!

0.Content: Thank you, Commander. I am truly in your debt.I hope these supplies will be of some use to you.
No.. no.. the end has come too soon...
If I'm not mistaken, this is the graveyard that Kaz entered.

1.Content: That girl, she never listens to me! She could be in real danger this time.

0.Content: Huh?! What is this? Wh—
I didn't think you'd be able to catch up with me.

1.Content: You're lucky you're still alive to be caught. If we were any later, there might've been nothing left of you to catch.

2.Content: I suppose you're right. I guess I might as well join you on your way back.

3.Content: But,

4.Content: I have to find the artifact so that Larin can prove to the elders that the artifacts actually exist!

5.Content: Kaz! Come back!

0.Content: Young heroes, you have passed our test. Please receive our blessings.
Hah, you finally made it!

1.Content: Relax, I'm fine. A clever huntress never falls for the same trap twice.

2.Content: Kaz! Behind you!

3.Content: Whew, what a thrill! That has to have been the final trial which was talked about in the legend, right?

0.Content: Those things were pretty strong. Surely they weren't the "power" that Larin was referring to when he spoke of the artifacts?
What's that sound?

1.Content: An entrance in the mountain has opened up! And there looks to be a path we can take through it.

2.Content: Woah, that light, it's so brilliant. So this is what Larin spoke of!

3.Content: Don't be too hasty, Kaz. Things aren't always as they appear to be.

0.Content: Haha! Now Larin can prove himself to the elders. The artifacts are real! I can just imagine their faces when they hear the news!

Commander, our scouts have already located the enemy's high command. They're currently north east of our current location. It is the royal command's wish that we meet with the enemy on the battlefield

1.Content: The northeast? But... why... in that wasteland...?

0.Content: Surrender, and maybe we'll let you live.

1.Content: Surrender? Haha! How naive! Just look around you!

0.Content: We're completely surrounded, Commander.

1.Content: There are no enemy generals here. We've fallen right into their trap!

0.Content: Please, help us! These vicious Maulers have surrounded our village.

1.Content: Leave it to us. We'll drive the surrounding invaders away.

0.Content: Commander, reports still show that there are still pockets of resistance in the village's vicinity.
You can now rest assured. We have completely driven away all of the nearby enemies.

1.Content: I am truly in your debt! I know of a few lesser known roads you may take. I hope this knowledge will be of some use to you.

0.Content: This is the enemy's granary. If we can disrupt their supply lines it may turn the tides of the war.
No matter how many enemies we slay, there are countless more to take their place. It seems impossible to make any headway here.
We're completely surrounded, Commander.

1.Content: There are no enemy generals here. We've fallen right into their trap!

2.Content: Great fortune! The road that the villager told us of earlier will allow us to avoid the surrounding enemies.

0.Content: It seems most of the enemy forces may have been used in the ambush, perhaps the blockaded road is no longer impassable?

1.Content: There's only one way to find out. Let's try to break the blockade again.

0.Content: Are these the ancient ruins?

1.Content: Yes, ancient texts tell us that knowledge of the great war is stored here. There is a lot to be learned in a place like this.

2.Content: Perhaps we can find some clues here that will lead us to the secrets of eternal life.

0.Content: Look, the stone pillar to the south has been lowered.

1.Content: It seems we have awakened the ruins' protector.

0.Content: It seems we have awakened the guardians of the ruins. I suppose we'll have to deal with them.
Hahaha! At last! I have found the blood ritual! This is the key to eternal life that I've been searching for.
May the faithful Thelarion, master swordsman and founder of the Dusk Patrol rest in peace.

1.Content: Here lies the stoic Ilydent, master of magic and pursuer of truth. May his spirit protect these lands forever more.

2.Content: Here rests Elreth The Defender. May he be forever remembered for his great deeds within the forest. May all who visit this sacred land receive his blessing.

3.Content: Touching this gravestone removes any curses that affect Intelligence-based heroes.

4.Content: Touching this gravestone removes any curses that affect Strength-based heroes.

5.Content: Touching this gravestone removes any curses that affect Agility-based heroes.

6.Content: Strange stone slabs block the way forward. You can vaguely make out what is written on them. It seems to be an ancient text which refers to the Dusk Patrollers.

0.Content: I will discover the secrets that lay within, and nobody will stop me!

1.Content: It is an honor to serve by your side. This "realm" has many hidden dangers.

2.Content: The platforms here periodically vanish into thin air, you must tread carefully.

3.Content: I appreciate the warning, but I've already died once. Now, hurry and activate this.. "divine realm".

4.Content: … … *chants*

0.Content: Hypogean soldiers lay in wait in this area, waiting to pounce on any innocent travelers that pass through this part of the forest so that they can be used as a sacrificial offering to their leader, Kane.

1.Content: We must find the demons' leader and eradicate him before he becomes fully awakened!

0.Content: This magical symbol is seemingly able to raise the magical bridges within the forest.

1.Content: But each time we step on these symbols, it strengthens their leader. We should tread carefully as to avoid unnecessarily stepping on them more than we need to.

0.Content: Blast! We've fallen into a trap. The enemies have set up an ambush. We'll have to break through them if we want to continue!
The powers from the magical symbols have given their leader too much strength! We'll have to give it all we've got if we want to win this fight!
Demons are about to invade, but fighting them would mean using all of our factional forces in a deadlock.

1.Content: All factions on the island are restrained. We must use force to break free of this deadlock...

2.Content: When attacking each garrison, avoid enemy fronts and strike their weak spots. It's crucial that we restrain the enemy to win this battle.

3.Content: Perhaps this flag will be of some use to you.

0.Content: Three quests are unlocked daily for the first 5 days of bootcamp. Players will be rewarded for all of the quests they have completed.
Celestial heroes count as heroes from any faction (except Hypogeans) when calculating factional bonuses.

1.Content: Hypogean heroes do not count toward factional bonuses, but grant bonuses depending on how many Hypogean heroes are deployed:

0.Content: Mortals fear only one thing and that is death! I hope you're prepared to embrace it. Hahaha!

1.Content: You have earned my king's approval. You may continue on your way, mortals.

0.Content: By the divine light! Your prowess in battle showed me that you are worthy of the light.

1.Content: May the Divine Light shine upon your path.

0.Content: I have fought alongside my mentor for many years but have yet to taste defeat, until today.

1.Content: It would seem we have met our match. I have brought shame upon our names. I will continue to hone my skills and become stronger than ever!

0.Content: Are these colored seals the portals talked of in legend?

1.Content: Indeed they are. They are all inter-connected in some way.

2.Content: Make a note of everything we come across. They may give us some clues.

3.Content: We need to learn how these seals work, otherwise our efforts will be for nothing.

0.Content: Continuous fighting in such an environment is taxing on your heroes' bodies. Your heroes will lose health and energy after every battle.

1.Content: It's advisable to avoid any fights if your heroes are in a bad condition to minimize casualties.

0.Content: Praise Dura! An oasis in the desert! Your heroes can drink from the watering hole to restore their health and energy. It can even bring back the dead!

1.Content: This wasteland is sure to have other watering holes scattered throughout it. The watering holes will be crucial to making it across desert alive.

0.Content: There was once an ancient civilization located here. The civilization is now buried deep underneath the desert sands, but perhaps its possible to unearth some of its ancient relics.

1.Content: The chaotic forces that inhabit this land have turned it into a dusty, barren wasteland. The scorching heat makes it extremely unbearable for those that venture here.

2.Content: What's worse is, our water supplies are all gone. We must try to find another watering hole while we continue on our search for the ancient treasures.

0.Content: These mountains are said to be closely guarded by "The Order of the Sun."

1.Content: They must be protecting something of great value. Let's investigate.

0.Content: We have defeated the last of the order. The protective enchantment placed on the pillars' has been removed. Let's see what they were hiding.
I've seen these levers before in "The Ancient Ruins." Perhaps they were created by the same craftsman?

1.Content: Maybe the method we used in "The Ancient Ruins" will also work here too!

0.Content: I am free! My hellfire will turn these woods into ashes!

1.Content: Oh no.. what have we done? We have unleashed an ungodly demon into our world. Perhaps the ocean altar can help us extinguish the trees he has set ablaze.

0.Content: Praying to the water elemental at this altar seems to have extinguished the fire. If we encounter anymore fires we should come back here and re-awaken it.
Ahh!! This dratted fire has singed my whiskers! I'd better get out of here while there's still a chance!

1.Content: One of our scouts has been scared off by the fire! We need to move with more caution in the future.

0.Content: You finally made it here! It's about time! I've uncovered the location of a hidden portal. Let's see where it leads to.
Who's there?! Oh.. it's you. I was starting to think you weren't coming!

1.Content: Apologies, the blaze slowed our movement. Curse the gods! Could this vile place be the demon's lair?

2.Content: You are correct. But you must be cautious, this vile creature will not die, no matter how many times you strike it down.

3.Content: You're just in time. Quickly, keep the demons busy, I have a plan that might just work!

0.Content: Hehe, look what I've found! Maybe we should give these demons a taste of their own medicine by using this fire altar to set them ablaze!?
This smoke is suffocating me, I've gotta get out of here.
There is no better place to sleep than the woods! Nobody had better wake me from my slumber!
A blaze?! I cannot let my home burn to the ground. I shall summon a large wave to extinguish the blaze!
Two of our scouts have been scouting the area and are awaiting our arrival. We need to rendezvous with them quickly.
Where's my backup? They better get here soon!
It's best I stay hidden until my companions arrive. I wonder where they are?
We need to make haste, it would seem we aren't the only ones in these woods.
As expected! This demonic creature keeps resurrecting itself! What's taking him so long? We'd better stay here and halt the demon's advance.
What in the blazes! This demon keeps coming back to life! It would seem it has something to do with the vile, tainted land here.
Legends' Championship Champion

1.Content: Legends' Championship Quarter Finalist

2.Content: Legends' Championship Final 64

0.Content: Cannot move again today. Please try again tomorrow.
Two portals! But one of them appears to be very dangerous.
This place is too hot!! It's like a furnace in this place! My whiskers barely survived the burning woods, I doubt they'll fare very well here either!

1.Content: Relax, little brother. We'd better move quickly or we'll burn up in this place.

0.Content: Huh?! What a strange place. Just now I was burning up… and now my paws are freezing off!

1.Content: It is indeed an unsual place but we can't give up on the treasure that is hidden here.

2.Content: Yes that's right!! Treasure! Treasure! Let's go!

3.Content: Hey, wait for me!!

0.Content: Look, over there! There seems to be some treasure hidden near the mountain! Let's drill our way through to it *rizzz*. Drat! The icy rock is too hard to drill through!

1.Content: Forget it! We'll have to find another way through to it. There's no way you're going to be able to drill through that.

2.Content: *Glaring at treasure* My baby, I will soon be with you! Just hang on!

0.Content: Wait a minute! Do you smell that? Something doesn't seem right. Perhaps theres more to this area than meets the eye?

1.Content: What are you on about? Stop dawdling! Let's get a move on.

2.Content: There really is something unusual here. You know me, my instincts are always right!

3.Content: Of course there's something unusual here! This whole place is unusual! Your brain seems to have gotten frostbite! *pulls Vurk by tail*

4.Content: Stop pulling me! My legs are perfectly fine!

0.Content: Do you see what I'm seeing? A hammer! Think it will be of any use?

1.Content: Perhaps it'll be strong enough break through the molten rock that's blocking our path!

2.Content: Wait a minute… I believe this icy hammer is the reason the land here is frozen… just maybe there's another hammer similar to this causing the other area to burn up!?

3.Content: Seems like the cold hasn't completely destroyed your brain. Let's get looking for the other hammer!

0.Content: Those guys were pretty tough, but I knew they wouldn't be able to defeat us!

1.Content: Let me see if there's anything of value on the bodies. *Rummages through bodies* What's this?

2.Content: Let me take a look! Looks like a treasure map to me… but it's unclear… too much blood.

3.Content: This part of the map looks familiar. Looks like we already passed that spot earlier! If it wasn't for you always telling me to hurry up we'd already have found it!!!

4.Content: Alright, you've made your point! But what exactly could be over there?!

0.Content: Great, another hammer! Praise the gods!

1.Content: Well don't just stand there! Help me lift it, it's not light you know!

2.Content: Coming! Hehehe! With this hammer nothing will get in our way! There must be more treasure to be had, surely!

0.Content: This is the place! I can already smell those wretched demons. Looks as if we'll hit the jackpot this time.

1.Content: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. We must move with caution, this is, after all a peculiar place.

2.Content: But we shouldn't move too slow! Otherwise we're sitting ducks!

0.Content: What's this?

1.Content: Hmm, it would seem this structure is a type of magical "Jump Gate".

2.Content: So how do we use it?

3.Content: Well, it seems we've already activated this Jump Gate. If we want to get back to the most recently activated Jump Gate all we need to do is find a Jump Gate Entrance.

4.Content: Great, and then we can travel between the two locations as much as we please?

5.Content: Unfortunately not. These types of structures only allow the travelers that enter through Jump Gate Entrances to return to the Jump Gate that is currently active.

6.Content: If my instincts are right, there are more of these Jump Gates scattered throughout this place.

7.Content: However, I believe there can only be one active Jump Gate at any given time.

0.Content: Watch out! The ground has collapsed down on itself! Good job we're both pretty quick on our feet, that was a close one.

1.Content: Look! The ground over there is floating! A new path has emerged, great!

2.Content: But we have no way of getting back to where we came from!

3.Content: Not necessarily. Don't you remember? We activated a Jump Gate. As long as we can find a Jump Gate Entrance we'll be able to get back to the active Jump Gate.

0.Content: Is this one of those "Jump Gate Entrances" you were talking about?

1.Content: Correct.

2.Content: Well, let's give it a go!

0.Content: Wooh, we're back! That was pretty scary, why did the Jump Gate Entrance fall apart after we used it?

1.Content: Jump Gate Entrances can be pretty weak if they're old. The older ones that aren't well maintained are unable to withstand the bending of space and will fall apart like you just saw.

0.Content: What a dark and gloomy place. Unfortunately our path has been blocked by that giant barrel. We need to find a way to destroy it or we'll die down here!

1.Content: Don't worry, old friend. See that turret? That's a great dwarven fire turret.

2.Content: It's capable of firing great magical fireballs. We'll blast that barrel into smithereens!

0.Content: Another turret. This old mine seems to have several of them scattered throughout it. However, this turret doesn't seem to be working.

1.Content: How do we get it working?

2.Content: Simple! It just needs fire. Just aim the previous turret at this one, fire and hey presto, job done.

0.Content: I don't doubt your skill in battle my friend, but I don't think we'll be able to defeat these enemies. They look far too powerful for us. Let's think of another way.

1.Content: I think you may be right! Us dwarves are fierce warriors,

2.Content: but I don't think even we would be a match for them! Let's find another way.

0.Content: Voyage of Wonders

1.Content: Epic battles and great riches await you

2.Content: The Forgotten Mine

3.Content: There's something going on in the distance! Tap the arrow and let's investigate!

0.Content: Voyage of Wonders is now open! Let's take a trip on the hot air balloon.
Although this adventure's enemies may be strong, do not fear! Enemies here will not grow in strength. If you are struggling you can level up your heroes and try again!

1.Content: Also, enemies have the chance to drop powerful relics which possess their own special and powerful effects when combined together. Adventurers, combine your relics carefully!

0.Content: I will discover the secrets that lay within, and nobody will stop me!

1.Content: It is an honor to serve by your side. This "realm" has many hidden dangers.

2.Content: The platforms here periodically vanish into thin air, you must tread carefully.

3.Content: I appreciate the warning, but I've already died once. Now, hurry and activate this.. "divine realm".

4.Content: … … *chants*

0.Content: Greedy mortals! I see what your hearts desire! Your hunger for treasure is insatiable!

1.Content: I can help you find the treasure your hearts' desire. I can make you all rich and famous. You will be heroes...

2.Content: But first you must save a village that was set ablaze by roving bandits over a century ago. By saving the village, both fame and fortune will be yours.

3.Content: You shall go down in history as heroes... as legends.

0.Content: Head back into the past. Go! Become the heroes that you were meant to be.

1.Content: Do not be afraid of becoming trapped in the past. I have placed several time portals in the past. You can choose to go back and forth between the past and future as you please.

2.Content: However... remember, changing the past will also change the future.

0.Content: Vicious bandits are preparing to attack the village. What you do to the bandits is your decision.

1.Content: Just remember, every action you make will change the course of history.

0.Content: Ignorant fools! Why do you use such extreme methods? My meticulous plan is now ruined thanks to your carelessness!
Look, over there! Treasure!
But wait... There's no possible way for us to make it over there! This place is rife with ravines and treacherous terrain! Well, I guess that's the end of that.
Not so hasty, brother. Let's explore the area some more. You never know, we might get lucky.
Hey, look! some kind of switch. Who knows, using it might get us one step closer to the treasure!

1.Content: Your curiosity might get us killed! What if it's a trap?

2.Content: Now's not the time for caution. Someone else might get their grubby mitts on our treasure if we wait any longer!

0.Content: Drat! Now we're trapped here!

1.Content: Always a pessimist! Look at what we're standing on. It's a portal. This will get us out of here in no time!

0.Content: See? I told you so.

1.Content: There are lots of portals here. We just have to figure out how to put them to good use.

2.Content: If I'm not mistaken, these types of portal are one-way only, they seem to be linked by their color. We should find different colored portals and give them a go!

0.Content: If I'm not mistaken, these types of portal are one-way only, with the sun portals being directly linked to the moon portals. They also seem to be linked by their color.

1.Content: We should find different colored portals and give them a go!

0.Content: We're nearly there, Isabella. All we need to do is pass through this valley and we'll be home. Vedan won't have even realized we were gone.

1.Content: Wait a minute. I can sense many souls.

2.Content: The lost souls of the dead that still remain here are mentioning unfound treasures, hidden deep within the valley somewhere. If we're able to find the treasure, Vedan will most certainly be pleased.

3.Content: Good idea, little sister. Let's deal with these troublesome minions first and then find the treasure. We'll be home in no time.

0.Content: Look, some kind of portal. It'd be nice if it could take us straight home.

1.Content: *Listens Intently* Oh... is that so? Wow!

2.Content: The souls told me that this is an ancient battleground. These cannons were manifested by their own hatred. They have great power and may even be used to destroy objects which block the way.

3.Content: It seems these portals were also left here after the battle ended. I hope they're still working.

4.Content: The souls said that these ghostly cannon balls can traverse the portals, providing the colors of the balls match the portals.

5.Content: Each portal is linked to another designated portal, just like Count Vedan's portals. However, the only difference is these portals are able to move on a track.

6.Content: Also, some portals are situated upon the tracks, meaning using the two levers beside the tracks can alter the portals' locations.

7.Content: Alright, let's give it a shot.

0.Content: Did the souls mention where the treasure was? I feel like I'm lost.

1.Content: I predict we're getting close now. Perhaps they're behind that barrel?

2.Content: Let's start looking for the treasure, anyway. It's often where you least expect it to be.

0.Content: The area is teeming with enemies. Be ready to fight at any given moment, Silvina.

1.Content: Ready, my lord.

2.Content: But let's not forget the main reason we're here. The Lightbearers have many valuables stashed away in their camp. Take whatever magic trinkets you like, but I'll be taking everything else back with me to the Eldritch Council.

0.Content: My lord, a pillar blocks the way.

1.Content: The pillar seems to have the same symbol as the lever to the east has. There must be a connection between the two.

0.Content: There are levers scattered throughout this whole area. Do you see any gateways that can be opened?

1.Content: This is the simplest form of magic, my friend. Certain colored levers have a connection with other certain colored pillars. These levers appear to have the symbols of Lightbearer sorcery on them, which means they can definitely be used more than once.

2.Content: In other words, pulling this red lever will lower the red sun pillar to the west, but will simultaneously raise the red moon pillar as a result? I think I understand.

0.Content: These cannons are deadly! They must be old, because firing them causes them to explode! We should use them sparingly.
The cannon ball hit its target but had no effect.

1.Content: Thanks to your great idea we've wasted the only chance to fire this cannon. My lord, we should've lowered the pillar first and then shot at the barrel behind it to free our path.

2.Content: Hmm, we'll find another path. There must be more than just one way out of here.

0.Content: Great! It seems cannons are pretty good at blowing up our enemies.

1.Content: I think you're far too cautious, my dear Kelthur. Silvina alone could've decimated those enemies without breaking a sweat. We've just lost our only chance to blow up the barrel.

0.Content: The barrel has been pulverized. We can finally get out of this place.
One must approach with caution, these soldiers look very well-equipped. If we fight, we may lose.

1.Content: There are only two ways to get into the Lightbearer's camp. We can either go through the enemies ahead, or enter from the south.

0.Content: Light guide our way! Give us strength to fight against the darkness!
I... I can't hold them back any longer... go, quickly... inform... Estrilda.
What a nuisance. These things keep blocking the way.

1.Content: Hmm... we need to think of a way to destroy them.

0.Content: The southern entrance isn't well fortified, we shouldn't meet much resistance there.
The cannon ball hit its target but had no effect.

1.Content: Thanks to your great idea we've wasted the only chance to fire this cannon. My lord, we should've lowered the pillar first and then shot at the barrel behind it to free our path.

2.Content: Hmm. I suppose we're stranded then. Next time, we must lower the pillar first before firing!

0.Content: Ah... how I miss this place. We shouldn't have left here in such a hurry!

1.Content: I just know some of my old possessions are still here somewhere. Well, I'd better get started!

0.Content: So, it would seem our old encampment has some new inhabitants and they're making full use of it! They've even taken control of our powerful energy towers!

1.Content: Dwarven engineering is quite ingenious! These towers use ice and fire as their main sources of energy and cannot be switched off. I'm surprised they're still working after all these years!

2.Content: Hmm.. I remember one of my old comrades telling me something...

3.Content: That's it! I remember him telling me that the only way to disable a tower is to fire one type of elemental energy tower at the other type of tower.

0.Content: Mortals, always consumed by their festivals!

1.Content: Well, considering it's winter, how about I heat things up a little?

0.Content: By the light! The Hypogean has set the pine trees alight, blocking the way. We must extinguish the fires in order to gain safe passage.

1.Content: See that snowman? In dwarven mythology, snowmen are said to contain the spirits of the pure. Their main purpose is to keep the peace in the winter months. Perhaps they can help our cause?

0.Content: You didn't appreciate my gift? How ungrateful! Well, I hope that you enjoy your next gift!
It looks to be some type of arcane frost switch. It has the power to turn water into ice while the mechanism is pressed.

1.Content: So, we must keep standing upon it for its effects to keep working. If we step off it, the ice will melt back into water again.

0.Content: Hail to you, champions. You have passed the trial of fire. I will join your cause. I will help you on your quest to reopen the roads you seek to travel upon.
*singing* Ah, what is this place? The snow reminds me of a classic tune I wrote long ago.

1.Content: Angelo, how're you able to sing in these circumstances!?

2.Content: We'd better get through here pretty quickly, otherwise dad won't be pleased with us! We can't be late for the party.

3.Content: You are right! *continues singing*. Hey, what's that sparkling in the distance? You're the clever one, Rowan.

4.Content: Woah! Looks like something good to me! You know, I think we'd ought to take a proper look around here. Just to be sure.

5.Content: If we're late home... I'm sure dad will understand.

0.Content: Huh, what's this red drum thing with a fuse on it?

1.Content: Smells like gunpowder. The shape, the color, I've heard of these things described in songs sung about the eastern lands. Apparently they're used to scare away terrible beasts and are generally used at the end of the year.

2.Content: They're quite easy to use, all you need to do is light them, cover your ears and run!

3.Content: Lighting the fuse was the right thing to do!

0.Content: The nearby giant snowballs have been flattened by the explosion! We can now get to the treasure!
Those things look dangerous. Setting them off would definitely cause a chain of explosions!

1.Content: I guess we'll just have to find out.

0.Content: Angelo, look! More treasure! But we must do as the tome instructs, otherwise, we can't gain entry to it.
So strange, Ulmus. It's spring, isn't it? Why do I see all this ice and snow?

1.Content: Tasi, look yonder.

0.Content: Arden was right. Someone must have opened the arcane seals binding the ice elementals.

1.Content: Their rapacious ways have transformed the land. Flowers no longer bud, nor trees grow, nor can any creature live here.

0.Content: You must drive the ice elementals back into the binding seal to limit their powers.
He seems to be snoring… the elementals have such plain, barren dreams. There's nothing there except ice and snow. It's chilling.
Ice elementals hate fire above all else. They only need to sense the slightest hint of a flame, and they will surely charge at it with abandon.

1.Content: You could use that to draw them into the seal.

2.Content: Ulmus, don't you know a thing or two!

3.Content: Haha, you can't teach an old dog new tricks. It's time, Tasi. We'd best act.

0.Content: Alas, it's not working. You've got to draw him into the seal.
Ulmus, we did it! The field has him. It's working!

1.Content: Not so fast. Look.

0.Content: If I'm not mistaken, the elementals' release might have something to do with that shadowy figure...

1.Content: If it was on purpose, he must be held responsible for the environmental destruction that has caused!

2.Content: Yes, Tasi. Whoever it is... must be taught a lesson.

3.Content: I can already smell the fresh air. Now let's finish this and clear the way for Spring's return!

0.Content: Gloomy.. dark.. you don't think these woods are haunted do you?

1.Content: *SQUAAAWK*  Ahhh! What was that? Oh.. just a little birdy.

2.Content: What ARE you worrying about!? You know the scarier a place is, the more gold there usually is! Just have a sniff!

3.Content: You smell that? That, my brother, is the most beautiful scent in the world. That's the smell of gold! Let's get to work!

0.Content: Hmm... I knew it couldn't be this easy. It seems we might have a little problem on our hands.

1.Content: Huh?

0.Content: You see the cannon over there? Well the platform it's on is in a "raised" state.

1.Content: It must be lowered to the ground before it can be fired.

2.Content: Ok.. so that means..?

3.Content: In other words, if the cannon isn't fired while in a "lowered" state, the cannon ball won't hit its target and travel through the portal.

4.Content: I'll never understand how've you survived this long. Honestly!

5.Content: Got any bright ideas?

7.Content: Use that brain of yours, brother. Otherwise, we'll be stuck here, unable to get our paws on that precious gold...

0.Content: We finally made it up. This place is really high... how are we going to get back down?

1.Content: Look over there, it's a one-way portal.

0.Content: When the time comes we'll be able to make a hasty escape through it with all of our riches! Hehehe!

1.Content: So, what are we waiting for? Let's sniff out that gold!

0.Content: Missed! You'd better lower the cannon first and try again.
It would seem the dwarves were here at one point.

1.Content: I would say they were definitely here. But it must've been some time ago.

2.Content: Oh? So, do you think they'll have left any of their precious wealth behind?

3.Content: Raine... We're only passing through!

4.Content: You know I get through gunpowder fast... and it ain't cheap!

5.Content: True, I suppose.

0.Content: Woohoo!

1.Content: Seems like there must be more than just the one road that's blocked.

2.Content: Let's keep on looking for more of these small road!

3.Content: You got it!

0.Content: So, the drunkard back at the tavern wasn't lying after all! This place really does exist!

1.Content: I've got a good feeling about this place. I can only imagine how many treasures are awaiting us! Let's get to it!

2.Content: Not so fast. This isn't a place where you can just go on a rampage.

0.Content: Move too fast and those energy beams will slice you right in two.

1.Content: Drat! There doesn't seem to be any way to turn off those energy towers.

2.Content: Over there! There seems to be something valuable over that way. But we're stuck here...

3.Content: Hmm... didn't the man in the tavern also mention something about beam refractors?

4.Content: The dwarves invented a way of splitting an energy beam into multiple beams! Ingenious!

5.Content: If I'm right, if we use the Ice Beam, we'll be able to——

6.Content: We'll be able to counteract the Fire Beam? That's gotta be it!

0.Content: Look! What's this?

1.Content: A two-way teleportation portal?

2.Content: Correct. By using it we'll be able teleport back and forth, avoiding the energy beams. Once we've teleported over, we can access the triangular-shaped rail tracks.

3.Content: Seems that the treasure is just one step beyond our grasp.

4.Content: Come on, Fawkes. We've nearly uncovered the answer to this whole puzzle!

0.Content: It's stopped snowing.

1.Content: They really thought they could lose us that easily? How naive!

2.Content: Those cretins think that they can survive by hiding from us? Ha! Laughable!

0.Content: .....You've managed roll the snowball off of the cliff, Ferael!

1.Content: Sorry, my finger slipped! It seems we might have to raise the platform below first, and then retry rolling the snowball.

2.Content: Must I always remind you? This is an important mission we're on!

0.Content: These guys are too tough. We've got no chance. Let's think of a better way. Maybe we can come back later.

1.Content: I suppose they'll get to live a little bit longer.

0.Content: I hear a noise not too far in the distance.
The platform has been lowered? Interesting.

1.Content: You've found the way to beat the enemies. Great job, Ferael.

2.Content: Enough blabbering. We've already wasted enough time as it is!

0.Content: Another day, another treasure! Is that how the saying goes? Well, let's get to work!

1.Content: Hang on! I've got a question.

2.Content: Why am I always teaming up with you? I always have to share the goods with you. I'd be better off on my own...

0.Content: This darned thing is too complicated! It makes me want to pull my fur out!

1.Content: I must've tried more than thirty times to operate the darned thing!

2.Content: If it wasn't for the treasure, I'd have blown these tracks to smithereens!

3.Content: Relax, brother. It's not that complicated. Let me show you how it's done. All we need to use is our surroundings.

4.Content: For example, just look at the four portals nearby!

0.Content: Easy!

1.Content: And you were wondering why you're always teaming up with me!?

2.Content: Mhmm. This was just a one-off. Call it luck, if you must!

0.Content: The enemies ahead are probably pretty powerful.

1.Content: You're not wrong! Use your Iron-Jaw beast to charge them. I'll be right behind you!

3.Content: Kidding! We're brothers after all. I'll be right there with you. In times of need, you can count on me!

0.Content: Time is my domain. Yet these pathetic mortals still dare to enter my domain?

1.Content: You stand no chance. All your efforts will be for nothing!

0.Content: Do not fear, mortal. The abyssal lord may be a powerful adversary, but your faith is strong enough to overcome all evil. I believe in you.

1.Content: Drive evil out of the settlements. Free the innocent townsfolk from evil's grasp. By freeing them from evil you will have earned their trust which will provide you with Blessed Essence. With enough Blessed Essence you will then have the power to unlock Blessed Relics.

2.Content: Use the power vested in Blessed Relics and Blessed Essence to repel this evil scourge.

0.Content: The locals here don't seem to be very welcoming. We'd better not disturb them too much.

1.Content: My brethren, you are too kind. The demons thrive here because the locals allow them to do so. The locals were foolish. They couldn't see the demons for what they really are.

2.Content: Cultists are harboring the demons in the town to the south.

0.Content: There is a secluded path, hidden by the brush, not too far from here. It'll give us access to the town.
At the very north you'll find the center of Evercrest town. That place is also a den of evil.

1.Content: There's a hidden path that can lead us through the woods. We can follow it north.

0.Content: Is this the center of Evercrest? Seems like the demons have already had their way with it.

1.Content: If we attack too rashly right now, it may not end well for us.

0.Content: Mortals always talk about what they regret. But when given the chance, they always choose to make the same mistakes over and over again.

1.Content: Weren't you curious about what happened to Evercrest? I'll send you back in time. You may see for yourselves.

2.Content: This was all your choice. Now you'll be able to witness firsthand the "evil" destruction you caused (Time portal emerges from the ground).

0.Content: Bang!—— So that's what perfection sounds like!

1.Content: I can hear your mind's voice. I know just what you are thinking! I'm looking forward to our next meeting.

0.Content: Wait... this seems to be a portal. I suppose we have no other choice but to use it. Perhaps it will take us out of here.
We're too late. The demons have gotten here before us. Their destructive powers are horrifying.

1.Content: I can still smell the blood and guts in the air. We must tread carefully.

0.Content: Another two that I shall devour!

1.Content: (Bellows a sickening roar)

0.Content: Quickly! Hide!
My brethren, I've been waiting for you for some time now.

1.Content: Forgive me. You are?

2.Content: I'm a soldier that is stationed close to the nearby town of Evercrest. News of the sacrifices happening in the town reached my regiment quickly, thus, I was sent here to aid you.

3.Content: I had heard you had some trouble getting here. I was beginning to think you might not have made it.

0.Content: Now what? The switch is broken.

1.Content: Looks like we could be stuck here. D-d-demon! The demon has discovered us! I can sense it getting closer.

0.Content: *Hiccup*

1.Content: Rigby, old chap! Are you sure the ingredients for your new recipe are hidden in this place?

2.Content: *Hiccup*

3.Content: C'mon old boy, that's enough drink for now. We might get trapped in this place!

4.Content: Ahh! I can't die just yet! I've gotta become the richest boy in Esperia first!

5.Content: I can't die in this... stinky place!

6.Content: Calm down, Rowan! I remember seeing a huge battering ram not too far away.

0.Content: You did it, Rowan!

1.Content: The giant ball has crushed the blockade!

2.Content: Well, it would seem luck is on our side today!

3.Content: It would appear the tales of the war were true. There's still a lot siege equipment scattered around this area. I think we could put them to good use.

0.Content: *Crash* (The sound of metal on metal echoes throughout the valley)

1.Content: Ouch! My ears!

2.Content: Ughh... what's happening?

3.Content: Are we home yet?

4.Content: Rigby, you've finally woken up!

5.Content: You boys are capable explorers! I've spent all these years going it alone. It's about time someone else took the reigns for a little while!

6.Content: Rowan! I've got a daughter called Dolly! How about I introduce you both!? She's a little older than you but I'm sure she'd love to meet you!

7.Content: Meet.. me?

8.Content: .....Are you still drunk, Rigby?

0.Content: ... The ground is rumbling!

1.Content: What in the blazes is going on?

2.Content: The ground before us has given way! I guess we won't be going this way any more.

3.Content: We'll have to find a different way of getting over there.

0.Content: That has to be the last obstruction, surely?

1.Content: We'd better think of a way to clear it then!

2.Content: If you want to taste my most exciting drink to date, you'd better figure a way of getting us out! No pressure!

0.Content: Commander Hogan, I'm afraid the riflemen only have enough ammunition to last seven days. When will the next supply cart arrive?

1.Content: I've just received news that something may have happened to the cart.

2.Content: I'm preparing a team to investigate the issue. I want you to join.

0.Content: That's our supply cart.

1.Content: The rail track ahead has been broken. That must be why it has stopped here.

2.Content: We must brook no delay. We'll need the help of the dwarves if we're going to safely transport the goods.

0.Content: The cart must have arrived at its final destination before we're able to open it and claim what's inside.

1.Content: But to reach its final destination, the cart must first pass by two platforms.

0.Content: The closest platform to here is Platform 1. If we want to ensure the cart arrives there, we must make sure that track that leads there is intact.
If anything obstructs the cart, it will stop the cart from moving.
Now we need to make it to Platform 2.
Using the control level beside the cart will allow the cart to start moving again.

1.Content: But before we start the cart, we should first fix the track.

0.Content: If the cart gets stuck and needs to be reset, you can press "Reset" to send it back to its starting point.
It won't take me more than a minute to deal with you lot.
Let me bleed you dry!
This is my hunting ground.
My bone spike will wait for the opportune moment to take your life.
The Arena of Trials is now available for {0}! Let's go!

1.Content: Welcome to the Arena of Trials! There are a total of 12 battle stages to get through. Achieve victory and claim rewards from each stage as you progress.

2.Content: Once you've completed all stages, you may claim the final reward, the Arena of Trials reward chest.

3.Content: All enemies will be reset every time you enter the Arena of Trials.

4.Content: Make use of other heroes to set up a formation around your designated hero and then begin your first battle!

0.Content: Don't forget, complete all stages in order to claim the final reward chest!
Congratulations, champion. You have passed the final trial and may claim your rightful rewards.
Tap Arena of Trials
Phew... The storm's finally passed. Antandra, is that the place?

1.Content: Yep. That's Windfall Gorge.

0.Content: It's surrounded by perilous peaks, you'd never find a way in by ordinary means.

1.Content: Thankfully, we can use this 2-way portal to nab the final treasure!

0.Content: So you're saying we can use this portal to reach the final frontier?

1.Content: Yep, but it hasn't been activated yet.

2.Content: First thing's first, we're going to have to activate these 4 energy runes around it.

0.Content: To charge The Silent Hope, activate the crystals that color match with the surrounding runes.

1.Content: Some of these runes are still inactive and we're running out of time, let's take this chance before the next storm sets in!

0.Content: The Thaumatic Orb can convert both fire beams and frost beams.

1.Content: Don't forget that, it could come in handy later.

0.Content: We can now take the portal to Windfall Gorge.

1.Content: Time's running out, let's hurry!

0.Content: Wait. Any farther and we'll be entering the Black Woods.

1.Content: These tracks on the ground are fresh. Whatever that "thing" is, it's gone into the woods.

2.Content: The Black Woods are permeated by the stench of death. The thing on your left hand is having a reaction! That does not bode well for us.

3.Content: We must brook no delay. That hideous creature has already caused too much death and destruction.

0.Content: These areas have been polluted by the power of death. They call them "Spectral Wastes". Living beings like us are unable to traverse such areas.

1.Content: Do you think that "thing" scurried into the Black Woods because it knew we'd be obstructed by these Spectral Wastes?

2.Content: That crafty thing! So, what now?

3.Content: There is a way, but it'll be a little tricky.

4.Content: A long time ago, in order to prevent the undead encroaching on the King's Land, many temple clerics, righteous warriors, were sent here from the Temple of Light, but it was at a great cost.

0.Content: Divine Beacons are leftover remnants from that great conflict. Illuminating these beacons cleanses the afflicted areas known also as the Spectral Wastes.
Light energy can be transferred via the runic path on the ground. But first, we need to open the energy valves so that energy can pass the path.

1.Content: Uh... well, I'll leave the big brain stuff to you.

0.Content: Success! The Spectral Waste has been cleansed. It would seem that these demons are no match for the power of the Divine Light.

1.Content: But we must remember. If the Divine Beacon's light is extinguished, the afflicted land will return.

2.Content: Let's go.

0.Content: This area has been completely cleansed of Spectral Wastes.

1.Content: We can now venture further into the woods. That thing keeps getting away from us. This time, we'll pay him a visit and send him back into the dirt!

0.Content: To illuminate a Divine Beacon, both blue and red light energy must be fed into it.

1.Content: This is red energy, its red light energy can be transferred into Divine Beacons.

0.Content: This is blue energy, its blue light energy can be transferred into Divine Beacons.
General, the forces on the frontline are running critically low on supplies. We must get these carts to the frontline.

1.Content: Agreed. However, our first priority is to get the carts out of this desert.

2.Content: This region is rich in minerals. The carts would deliver the minerals, stopping at several stations along the way. The resources would then be smelted down and made into weapons.

0.Content: This barrier is called a "Safety Gate".

1.Content: This region's vast resources are incredibly important to the empire, thus, the dwarves built these safety gates.

0.Content: This is a "Checkpoint". Each "Safety Gate" is equipped with a "Checkpoint". All checkpoints have pressure sensors on them.

1.Content: Carts that are carrying cargo must pass through all of the preceding checkpoints before the "Safety Gate" barrier will open to let the cart through.

2.Content: Understood. Let's get to the closest station first and reassess the situation.

0.Content: Soldier, we've already arrived at the third station. Loading of the additional resources has been completed.

1.Content: Great! With a little more persistence the cart will be out of here in no time.

0.Content: The cart has successfully arrived at its destination. We owe it to the dwarves for getting us out safely.

1.Content: We can now also open the reward chest on the cart. As for this metal ore, it can be used to forge weapons...

2.Content: Let me deal with the ore. New weapons shall be forged. The frontline forces will put them to good use.

0.Content: The cart has not passed through all checkpoints. It cannot pass through the Safety Gate.

1.Content: If the cart gets stuck and needs to be reset, you can press "Reset" to send it back to its starting point.

0.Content: If anything obstructs the cart, it will stop the cart from moving.

1.Content: If the cart gets stuck and needs to be reset, you can press "Reset" to send it back to its starting point.

0.Content: What is this place?

1.Content: Damn... another detention room. Ha! Those old cronies think they can trap me? We'll see about that.

2.Content: I've been recently developing a special type of fire magic. All I need is some combustible material and I can set this room ablaze with a quick fireball.

3.Content: *Ominous Whispers* That's right! Show them what real power is. Show them your fire and fury!

4.Content: *Meekly* Hurry... Wake up, Mirael...

0.Content: Uh... wait a sec.

1.Content: Seems I burned something that I probably shouldn't have.

0.Content: Just wait... I'll burn this whole academy down to the ground!

1.Content: Oh what a glorious dream this is!

2.Content: Who are you? I've never seen you in the academy before...

3.Content: *Meekly* Mirael, you have to stop. If you continue down this path, your mind will be destroyed!

4.Content: Whose voice is that? Do I know you?

5.Content: Causing more trouble again, little red head? All this fire was your doing? Aren't you afraid of getting burned?

6.Content: I'll catch you and teach you a lesson! Why do you keep appearing?!

7.Content: What is that incessant noise!?

8.Content: You are no good. Get out of my sight, or I'll burn you too!

0.Content: Lieutenant Commander Morvus, the mineral ore used for processing the ammunition is prepared and ready to go.

1.Content: Noted, soldier. The marksmen on the frontline are already in short supply as it is. It is imperative that this cargo is delivered swiftly to its destination.

2.Content: Men, our cargo must be transported through the desert, meaning it's going to be a long and potentially dangerous route. The utmost cautious must be taken. Let's get to it!

3.Content: Yes sir!

0.Content: We must persevere. Our destination is close by.

1.Content: This material can not only provide our weapons with ammunition, it can also be used to upgrade our weaponry. After the last few scrapes with the Hypogeans, the army is looking to upgrade its armaments.

2.Content: So we must persevere, our brothers on the frontline are depending on this shipment.

0.Content: Commander Hogan, the shipment and all of its contents have arrived on schedule.

1.Content: Good work. You came through for us, Morvus.

2.Content: It's too early to thank me yet, let my dwarven smiths get to work on upgrading this equipment first. After the upgrades, these weapons will make short work of those monsters.

0.Content: Dwarves set up different colored platforms on the tracks.

1.Content: Carts can only stop at platforms of the corresponding color, otherwise they will reset, returning to the previous platform.

0.Content: We're here.

1.Content: We can enter the Grottoes from here.

2.Content: The mages of The Order of the Sun once came to these meandering grottoes, long before us, seeking lost magic.

3.Content: ...and only one of them returned alive.

4.Content: So, I fear that finding and eliminating that "terrifying monster" the survivor spoke of will be no mean feat.

5.Content: Indeed. The path through the terrain looks be entirely indistinct, paths fragmenting off hither and thither. Quite how the deceased mages reached such depths, I can't fathom. We'll have to take things slowly, step by step.

0.Content: This is?

1.Content: We've been teleported.

0.Content: This is a "Teleport Hub." The mages probably left it behind.

1.Content: The "Teleport Hub" can push out the "Teleport Exit". If the "Teleport Exit" meets an obstruction, it will come to a halt.

2.Content: Making use of this feature, we can reach places we couldn't before.

3.Content: Right. They must've used these magical devices to navigate the rugged caves, eventually reaching the depths.

4.Content: Let's watch our step.

5.Content: Indeed.

0.Content: ...An ambush. We're surrounded.

1.Content: Too strong!

0.Content: There's an evil residing in this gloom... I can feel it growing stronger and stronger, a suffocating Hypogean essence.

1.Content: I sense it too, there's something... Watch out! It's coming!

0.Content: This is the Realm of Denial. Spirits that have forgotten who they are roam here.

1.Content: They're stuck here because of an obsession they have that lingers from their time amongst the living. Caught in limbo, between life and death... It's really quite pitiable.

2.Content: Tonight is the Noctis Animarum, the one night of the year that the Realm of Denial is open to Esperia, the only chance for us to help those lost souls.

3.Content: Come, let's guide these lost spirits, help them break free of their entrapment.

0.Content: Let's begin with this unfortunate soul. It has lost all of its memories, acting only on whatever obsessive compulsion drives it.
We can lead it to that high plane, where the Realm of Denial merges into Esperia.

1.Content: The spirit can pass through the cross-over point, reaching the place where its obsession peaks. It seems to be projecting the image of a ruined house. This spirit must be concerned for its relatives, this must be its former home, back from when it was a living being. Our task now is to guide the spirit home, but it may be a complicated task.

2.Content: Get your brain in gear, little brother! See those Pumpkin Candy Cans?

0.Content: In life, this spirit clearly had an attachment to candy! We can just fill empty ones with candy, and using it as bait, lure the spirit step by step!

1.Content: Consistent contact with objects can jog a spirit's memory, so perhaps it will be able to recall its past.

0.Content: The air suffused with lingering death pervades the Noctis Animarum, awakening the dead that seek to be free of their eternal rest. The road has been blocked by the "Hands of Evil Spirits". We can't go this way.

1.Content: Is there no way for these deceased to exonerate themselves?

2.Content: Unfortunately, they are entirely lost, they recall nothing of themselves and are now spirits of irredeemable evil. There's nothing we can do.

3.Content: As deities, there is much we can do to resolve worldly troubles, but for the pain of these lost and wandering souls, we can merely watch.

4.Content: I understand the helplessness. As much as we are divine, we are not omnipotent. There are many who need our help in this world, yet still so little we can do. Let's do our utmost to help as many as we can! Now, we must resolve the immediate issue.

5.Content: Look over there! There's an "Exorcism Seal". As long as the seal has been triggered, the "hands of evil spirits" will be temporarily suppressed.

0.Content: Look! A candle!

1.Content: We can light it. Oh? The spirit seems to be afraid of the light! It'll actively avoid the candle light. We can use this to usher the spirit to wherever we want it to go.

0.Content: There's a strange door here. We have to think of a way to open it.
The gate won't open until we've guided the spirit into position on the high plane in front of the house and completed the object of the spirit's obsessions.
The way to the Candy Can has been blocked by a lever, the spirit is unable to reach it. The lever must be adjusted for the spirit to gain access.
Vurk, lend me a hand. The Iron-jaw's got its foot stuck.

1.Content: Pee-yew! What a smell...

2.Content: I can't... I can't... I'm exhausted.

3.Content: Come on, brother! We've still got some distance to cover. We're miles away from the center of the marshland.

4.Content: Hold on a little longer, Skreg. We'll get through this marshland, then find the island to the south. It'll all be worth it. Just wait and see.

5.Content: That simple huh? So, why does it feel like I've been going round in circles for an eternity?!

0.Content: Hey, this old temple relic is pretty useful. Success!

1.Content: What are these things?

2.Content: The demon hunters called it a.. Divine.. Tower..? Beacon? Anyway, last time I secretly watched them use it and copied what they did.

0.Content: What's this?!

1.Content: *Rubs Eyes* Am I seeing things? There are two different colors on this pad.

0.Content: Done! We can now go this way. No place nor treasure is ever too far out of Vurk's grasp!

2.Content: Well, that may be so, but this place really does stink! I bet you my left arm that there are more than just a few corpses under those aquatic weeds.

3.Content: What does that tell you? Must be some good treasure if so many are willing to die for it!

4.Content: There's no time like the present! Great riches await! Hehehe!

5.Content: Wait for me!

0.Content: See that purple guiding-line, adventurer?

1.Content: Impossible! I've never seen such a strong "Soul Bond" before.

2.Content: Destiny has bound them together. Their bond gives them great power, but also an unforeseen weakness.

3.Content: Destiny dictates that if one of the evil creatures is slain in combat, the other evil being which is soul bound to it shall be dealt a heavy blow, eviscerating half of its life force.

4.Content: This is the heavy price of "Soul Bonding". Adventurer, this may be our chance to seize the day.

5.Content: Knowledge is power, and with that in mind, we shall drive evil from this land.

0.Content: We're here. This is where the souls of all fallen Dwarven warriors come to rest. We call it the "Bridge of Souls".

1.Content: The legendary resting place of the dwarves. Who would have thought evil would take root here so quickly?

2.Content: Don't trouble yourself, leave it to me, Commander. I will make sure the ashes of my fallen brethren reach their final resting place.

3.Content: We've fought side by side hundreds of times, you've never let me down once. I cannot let you down now.

0.Content: In order to protect our sacred land and the dignity of our fallen, we created a system of levers.
Illuminating a Dwarven Beacon causes a corresponding platform to drop, and a piece of the Bridge of Souls to rise.

1.Content: Once all Dwarven Beacons have been illuminated, the Bridge of Souls may be traversed.

0.Content: Our path is blocked by a laser beam and there doesn't seem to be any clear way forward.

1.Content: I know you'll think of a way. It's what you do best.

2.Content: Well, since we have no way of moving around the laser, we'll have to make the laser move for us.

0.Content: All of the Beacons have been illuminated. The Bridge of Souls is now completely raised.
May you rest well, my brothers.
Master, I've found it. It's here.

1.Content: The twister is out of control, it's enraged. I'm having difficulty establishing a connection with it. Elemental twisters are tricky to communicate with.

2.Content: Lorsan, we need to activate the Wind Altars. By harnessing the power of nature, we can guide the twisters to a safe place.

3.Content: But Master, if we move a twister, it will destroy everything in its path. Animals, trees, mountains, none will stand a chance!

4.Content: I see no better alternative. Lorsan, let the creatures of the forest know about the impending danger. Tell them to stay far out of the twisters' way.

5.Content: Yes, Master. I shall return as soon as I can.

6.Content: *Ahem* Off you go, now.

0.Content: Master, the twister has moved.

1.Content: Good job, Lorsan! Let's keep on guiding the twisters. The twister in this region needs to be weakened a further 2 times in order for it to be calmed.

2.Content: Not only are we able to calm the tempestuous twisters, we are also able harness their power to clear a path to the next region.
