0.Content: The twister in the previous region is now calmed. We need to make haste and deal with the twister in this region.

1.Content: Master, leave it to me.

2.Content: Once activated, although the Wind Altar will draw the twister towards itself, the Wind Altar will also be destroyed as a result.

3.Content: So, you must pay attention to the order in which you activate the Wind Altars. We need to minimize our losses and make the most of the situation.

0.Content: This is the last and most complicated region.

1.Content: Finding the best route will not be easy. Lorsan, you are the Wind Whisperer. Listen to it, let it talk to your heart.

2.Content: I understand, Master. I will do my best. I shall not disappoint you.

0.Content: Make haste. These gifts contain presents and food. We must ensure they reach the warriors on the frontlines.

1.Content: I get it. A warrior needs food, clothing and medicine, but what's with the toys?

2.Content: How are toys supposed to help us win the war?

3.Content: These brave warriors were once children, you know? They also deserve some fun!

4.Content: I don't really get it, but alright. This dopey deer isn't too familiar with the surrounding area, it's bound to get lost quickly.

5.Content: Hey, it's not dopey, it just lacks... experience. We'll have to help it. The warriors on the frontline are eagerly awaiting us.

0.Content: Ringing the bell will make the deer pull the sledge forward, but the deer is quite a stubborn creature, it'll only walk on snowy or icy ground, and it prefers to travel in a straight line.

1.Content: So, you're saying it's dopey...

2.Content: Hey, it's still learning okay? Don't you remember how you felt when you first joined the Dusk Patrollers!?

3.Content: Alright, alright, you've made your point!

0.Content: There's a fence blocking the way.

1.Content: If this clumsy deer isn't careful it'll smash its head into it.

2.Content: See that snowman?

0.Content: Well, they're able to fire massive snowballs that will make short work of any fences, and can also block off certain passageways.

1.Content: With the help of the snowmen, we'll be able to guide the deer forward.

0.Content: Drat! The path ahead is obstructed by two ponds. The sledge can't make it through.
These ponds are receptive to magical powers. There should be two Frost Levers nearby that can freeze them. Let's find them.

1.Content: The deer will only pass over frozen Elevator Platforms, so, we must plan our route carefully.

0.Content: Lyca, you look even more bedraggled than this dopey deer. When was the last time you got some rest?

1.Content: When I was still a little fawn!

2.Content: ...Are you not tired?

3.Content: Growing up means we have to shoulder many responsibilities, and as Dusk Patrollers, we often have to shoulder more than the average person.

4.Content: Many innocent souls reside within the Dark Forest. There's still a war going on, until that changes, we have no right to say we're tired.

5.Content: But in times of hardship, a little enjoyment is necessary, don't you think? Taking a moment to unwind is the best way to alleviate the great pressures that bear down on us.

6.Content: Alright, you can stop your preaching now! You take a rest on the sledge for a while. Leave it all to me!

0.Content: Lyca, look, up ahead.

1.Content: Zzzz

2.Content: Huh? All that twittering must have tired her out.

3.Content: Well, looks like it's just me and you now, you dopey deer.

0.Content: Reporting, Commander! The loading of the minecarts is complete. Everything is in order and ready to go on your command.

1.Content: Good. Let's get going.

2.Content: By my estimates, it'll take three days to reach our destination. If luck is on our side, we might be able to rendezvous with Commander Hogan before he sets out.

3.Content: I'll leave the minecarts in your capable hands. If things get tricky, I'll be around.

4.Content: Yes, Commander!

0.Content: This task is a little unlike other tasks.

1.Content: See there? This railroad has several pairs of blue and red Checkpoints and Safety Gates on it. To open a Safety Gate of a certain color, a minecart must first pass through all Checkpoints of the same corresponding color.

2.Content: Also, in order to initiate the next phase of the journey, the two minecarts must have both reached their corresponding platforms first.

3.Content: Understood.

0.Content: Dwarves set up different colored platforms on the tracks.

1.Content: Carts can only stop at platforms of the corresponding color, otherwise they will reset, returning to the previous platform.

0.Content: Good job. I'll leave the rest of the operation to you, Officer.

1.Content: Thank you, Commander. This load is destined for the rear base camp, and contains imbued ore. This type of material is able to greatly bolster the military's power. The King's men rely heavily upon it.

2.Content: So, that's what this stuff is? Heh. Technology these days! It's progressing so fast... or maybe I'm just getting old.

3.Content: Although supplies are of great importance, they cannot completely determine the final outcome of a battle. A battle's final outcome is down to the soldiers' morale and bravery. This is something Commander Hogan taught me. Commander, I'd also heard many great stories about you, while on the frontline.

4.Content: Once upon a time, yes. But that was long time ago. Let's keep pushing ahead. It's been too long since I've seen my old friend, Hogan.

0.Content: Old friend! You're later than I was anticipating.

1.Content: Commander Hogan!

2.Content: We had some minor setbacks on our way, but not to worry everything is sorted now. But... why are you still here? Shouldn't you have left by now?

3.Content: My friend, why, we've been waiting for you! Our regiment is lacking an excellent sharpshooter such as yourself!

4.Content: And here I was thinking I'd be getting some well-earned rest with an old friend after this ordeal.

5.Content: *Strokes Blunderbuss* The Royal Dwarven Marksmen are always ready to fight for the empire! Just say the word!

6.Content: I sure do miss the smell of gunpowder!

7.Content: Leave the sentimental words for later! I'm depending on you to take out more than just a few enemies!

0.Content: Stick close to me, don't get lost, Pippa.

1.Content: You got me out of my nest for this— Huh... where are we?

0.Content: What is this place? *sniffle* I feel all warm and fuzzy. *Achoo!*

1.Content: Shh! Pipe down will you? We're in someone's dream. This dream is full of unknown dangers.

2.Content: The reason we're here is to take this dream owner's mind treasures.

3.Content: Treasures? Take? Tasi, are we here to steal things?!

4.Content: Uh.. well.. I wouldn't exactly call it stealing. Although they're called "Mind Treasures", they don't actually exist. They are purely overflowing desires of the mind.

5.Content: So, we're the good guys?

6.Content: What?! Of course we are!

0.Content: See that portal? Through that portal is where dreams reside.

1.Content: But before we enter the dreamworld, we need to find more people to help us.

0.Content: Within the dreamworld I saw a terrible machine at the edge of the Dark Forest. It was terrible. Many trees were decimated, even the 389 year old pine to the southwest met its end.

1.Content: *Shocked* Ahh!? 389?! Old Uncle Piney?! That's my home!

2.Content: Don't stress. The root of this calamity resides within the dreamworld. Sometimes things that occur within the dreamworld become reality.

3.Content: There's still time to stop it all.

0.Content: Tasi, where's this "Mind Treasure" we need to find? *Adjusts Spectacles* I can't see anything here.

1.Content: If it were so easy to find it wouldn't be called a "treasure". Look at that.

3.Content: That there is a nightmare. Perhaps vanquishing it will give us some clues to the treasure?

4.Content: So what are we waiting for?

5.Content: Wait just a minute.

0.Content: What's the matter?

1.Content: Our presence in the dreamworld has been detected. Anything harmful we may do will trigger the dream's self-defense mechanism, which will cause the dream to seal itself off.

2.Content: We need to find the "Aspirations" that are scattered throughout the dreamworld, before we're too late.

3.Content: Only by collecting enough Aspirations can we fully understand the dreamworld owner's intentions and prevent its collapse. This is the best way to find the treasure.

4.Content: Got it!

0.Content: Looks like a child's journal. The handwriting is scribbled messily.

1.Content: Could this terrible dream be that of a child's?

0.Content: Oh, what a poor thing.

1.Content: Oh indeed. When I was at the Astral Academy people often mocked me. They called me a ball of fur with a stick.

2.Content: Personally, I think mankind is stupid, they are always doing things to hurt each other.

3.Content: Raku would always write to me, consoling me. He told me I'd be the greatest mage the world has ever seen. If only this poor child had a good friend like Raku...

4.Content: Let's see if we can find any more of the child's aspirations. We still don't know who he is. If it is indeed a child, then they're very mature for their age.

0.Content: It would seem the dream's host has a lot of negative emotions within his mind. The dreamworld could collapse at any moment.

1.Content: Let's get on with it!

0.Content: Terrifying. The host seems to have been completely corrupted by money.

1.Content: No wonder I saw the forest in ruins. He wants to profit at its expense!

2.Content: Tasi, we have to stop him. For my home, for Old Piney!

0.Content: Once the assembly line is finished and the machine is ready to go, I'll be filthy rich!

1.Content: Is he the dream's host? I didn't think he'd be so small...

2.Content: Don't call me small!

3.Content: Why you little rascal! You want to chop down the forest! You want to hurt Old Piney!

4.Content: How shortsighted you are! It's just a small sacrifice. Don't tell me you don't like the look and feel of gold?!

5.Content: Tasi, if you don't stop this kid, I will!

0.Content: So smooth... so shiny... it's a giant golden egg!

1.Content: Uh... why on earth would his mind's treasure be an egg?

2.Content: Who knows! Just help me lift it!

0.Content: Huh?! What is this place?

1.Content: So, the greedy boy has woken up? You're in a dream!

2.Content: Woken up?? Dream??

3.Content: (Tasi and Pippa explain everything)

0.Content: I.. how.. how could I dream of such vile things? No gold or silver in the world is worth more than mother nature. How could I ever dream of harming the Wilders' home?

1.Content: I'm Rowan. Are you both Wilders? It just so happens that I have some Oakenfell artwork. I know you Wilders are good with art. Wanna see?

2.Content: Tasi, is this the same boy from the dream? Red hair, freckles and a duck. It's him, right?

3.Content: Humans are complicated creatures. Existing in an environment full of greed, jealousy and hate for long periods of time can erode their minds and change their very essence.

4.Content: These changes can often happen in an instance. Just within the dreamworld, people rarely have any qualms about fulfilling their desires.

5.Content: It looks like the dream's host has fully recovered.

6.Content: I'd say our time was well spent.

7.Content: I don't know what you're saying, but I can see you're both happy!

8.Content: Whatever the occasion is, why not buy something to celebrate it?

9.Content: You, my furry friend! This hat suits you quite well, wouldn't you say? How about these spectacles? It's all yours, half price just for you!

10.Content: ....Half price?? Now that's hard to resist....

0.Content: What do you want to find? Dwarven stout? The dwarfs' rye stout has been hard to acquire since the city of Maldan fell.

1.Content: Rye stout is good, but the dwarfs are known for more than just that! A cold climate means a strong, hot spirit!

2.Content: You mean a secret recipe of some sort? Everyone in the city wants to know how brewmasters find their ingredients. Can you tell me?

3.Content: Haha! If it were that easy, everyone would be a brewmaster. Maybe one day— What's that I can smell? So fragrant!

0.Content: It would seem we've got our work cut out. Hmm, what's that? It looks well-crafted, looks like the work of the dwarfs.

1.Content: Maldan was a fortress city after all, so it's not too strange to see some dwarven contraptions within the Frozen Prairie.

2.Content: But who'd want to use them to protect a cellar? Are the gods playing a prank on us? I would hazard a guess that the land here has changed a lot in recent years.

3.Content: We might be trapped, good job The Frozen Mother has ushered in winter. Luckily the ice can give us another way forward.

0.Content: Looks like we can use this thing to our advantage. All we've gotta do aim at that big contraption ahead.

1.Content: It would seem that the water orbs fired by this Steam Cannon can be turned into ice blocks. We can use the blocks of ice to block the beam, and then continue on our way.

0.Content: Look, that ice block smashed into the ice shelf. That's some really tough ice.

1.Content: The newer ice is softer, thus, has no effect on the older, harder ice.

2.Content: Blocking the beam should be enough. We just have to make sure we don't block the path ahead.

0.Content: Master Brown, look! A barrel!

1.Content: Let me have a look. Hmm, it's empty. I can't smell anything coming from it.

2.Content: What a shame!

3.Content: Hah! You young'uns sure do give up easily! It's just a minor setback. We'll blow this barrel to smithereens!

4.Content: Do you often have many setbacks?

5.Content: Why of course! It's not easy making good brews! My spirit isn't broken so easily.

6.Content: Sometimes it's easier to cut your losses than to blindly persevere.

7.Content: Some people say I'm a fool for going to such lengths, but perhaps only a fool is capable of making such good brews?

8.Content: Hmm...

0.Content: This is the last one. There's nothing wrong with your sense of smell, is there?

1.Content: You're starting to make me nervous!

2.Content: I'm gonna open it.

3.Content: Open it! It's time to get drunk!

4.Content: Uh.. this is red wine?

5.Content: Seems this isn't the lost brew we were looking for.

6.Content: What makes you say that?

7.Content: It's the wrong vintage. Why do you seem more disappointed than me?

8.Content: Because I was hoping for a new business opportunity. You forget I'm a merchant after all!

9.Content: You're a crafty one! Well, your hopes have been dashed.

10.Content: I initially felt disappointed, but I think it's not been a bad adventure, apart from the cold, that is.

11.Content: Do you have any sugar on you? Put some cinnamon and sugar in the wine.

12.Content: Like this? Looks good.

13.Content: It is, but I can't have too much of it. It's still too early in the day!

0.Content: Before us is the Ice Elemental responsible for this frozen nightmare.

1.Content: The sprouting crops have all been killed off by the cold snap, all the livestock frostbitten. If this carries on, even the hardiest of dwarves won't make it to Spring.

2.Content: So here we are, ready to bring an end to the danger this terrible Ice Elemental presents.

3.Content: I reached out to my teacher at the Astral Academy, and with their aid, laid out a matrix that can reverse elemental flow.

0.Content: The Ice Elemental just needs to be drawn into it, and it will be eliminated.

1.Content: But, isn't your relationship with your teachers kind of shaky? Are you sure they really want to help you?

2.Content: It's more than a little 'shaky'... They say I'm a stain on their pristine teaching careers. Yet, in the face of such a chilling nightmare, they were willing to lend a hand.

0.Content: The Ice Elemental will instinctually leap towards sources of heat, so we can take advantage of this to lure it into the matrix.

1.Content: My mentor gave us a few mystical creations from far off lands, they're called Firecrackers. There's also some special braziers, too.

2.Content: With the explosive firepower of our dwarven cannons, we can light the braziers from far away, creating a heat source that will lure in the Ice Elemental.

0.Content: Right, so would you mind explaining what the deal is with this protective shield?

1.Content: Well... It's for safety. When I was a student, I once accidentally set off a few firecrackers, it caused a bit of a ruckus. After that incident, the mages invented this protective shield to prevent such accidents in the future.

2.Content: This contraption can even block cannon balls! Are you sure it was just a 'bit' of a ruckus?

3.Content: There's nothing to fret about. We can bypass it simply by controlling the corresponding levers to shut it down. However, there is still one problem...

4.Content: There's six shields in total here, of which three are open and three are closed.

5.Content: My teacher provided three sets of levers that are interlinked. Pulling one set will cause a change in the other two sets and their corresponding shields.

6.Content: Basically, it's impossible for all shields to be closed at once, there will always be three that are open.

7.Content: ... do you magic folks always go to such ridiculous lengths?

0.Content: The Ice Elemental has been destroyed, I can practically hear Flora laughing!

1.Content: Spring! Spring is coming!

0.Content: We have been guarding this place for the past year.

1.Content: There has been so much misfortune, so many terrible things happened. We lost many friends, too. We're exhausted, we need to find a new guardian for this coming year.

2.Content: It has been revealed to us that the new guardian should be a steadfast, fearless bull hero of the Maulers. It is hoped that under his protection, Esperia shall pierce through the cloud and fog, and sweep away the murky haze.

3.Content: Bring him to us, pass our trial, and the treasure we have hidden shall be yours.

0.Content: The Arena of Trials is now available for {0}! Let's go!

1.Content: Welcome to the Arena of Trials! There are a total of 6 battle stages to get through. Achieve victory and claim rewards from each stage as you progress.

2.Content: Once you've completed all stages, you may claim the final reward, the Arena of Trials reward chest.

3.Content: All enemies will be reset every time you enter the Arena of Trials.

4.Content: Make use of other heroes to set up a formation around your designated hero and then begin your first battle!

0.Content: You may make use of your guild mates' heroes to defeat the phantoms within the Arena of Trials.

1.Content: You will be undertaking 5 battles in a row.

2.Content: You can adjust the level of your enemies.

3.Content: Defeat enemies and overcome your limits, reach the higher echelons of the leaderboard!

0.Content: Big bro, I bet there's something good here!

1.Content: Look around, everything's smooth and shiny!

2.Content: I feel like... there's something about this place... Hey! Wait up!

3.Content: I'll wait ahead! You know how it goes! First come, first served!

0.Content: What's this?

1.Content: Drat! I'm unable to shake off this ominous feeling I have.

2.Content: Vurk, is this the wrong place? I have a really bad feeling about this you know!

3.Content: Wrong place? No no no, this is the right place.

4.Content: This place is remarkable! I reckon we can make a pretty penny with the treasures we find here!

5.Content: For sure, but only if we make it out alive.

0.Content: What else is there to think about? This way!

1.Content: I can see something sparkly over there!

2.Content: No no no, let's go the other way!

3.Content: Trust me, Vurk! I have a hunch there's great treasure hidden in the other direction!

5.Content: You always say that.

0.Content: Noooo! I can't believe I trusted you again!

1.Content: You said go this way! Now look... a broken stone gate is blocking the way. What now? Turn back?

2.Content: Why are you asking me? Can't you see I'm thinking?

3.Content: Figure out a way to open the gate.

0.Content: Skreg, you're a genius! You're the smartest of the litter! Besides me, of course!
My goodness, I never thought we'd get so far!

1.Content: This should be the last spot. *Glances around* Shall we split up?

2.Content: Whoever finds the treasure keeps it?

3.Content: Deal.

4.Content: Deal.

0.Content: Oi! Over here, yeah, here! I reckon you look capable, fancy a little work?

1.Content: I got a sweet deal here, you'd have to be (lowers voice) a total fool to pass this up. If it weren't for the fact I've been stuck here two days, you might not have come into such luck!

2.Content: Oh? Not bad, you know your stuff! These goods are indeed from the Savannah, but the price of this stuff in the Empire... Heh heh, well, it is what it is. If you go through the forest, perhaps that won't be the case.

3.Content: Ah well! That's not important. All you need to do is stand at the fence and pass things over. The guards are braindead, they won't come near you unless you attempt to illegally cross the border.

4.Content: No need to fret. The state of the world right now isn't great, but it's a good time to make money and get rich. You could say I'm an old hand in this line of work, and there hasn't been much else going on for a while now. With my experience and your skill, what have we got to lose?

5.Content: I wouldn't recommend taking on the guards. Just bring the goods to the Mauler's border, let them see your face and that's it! The waiting is enough for them, so as soon as they see you they'll do an exchange. They know the drill, you just bring the exchanged goods back.

6.Content: I'm meticulous in my dealings, you can relax in the knowledge you'll be amply rewarded... So you in? It's surely a gift you can't refuse, so how about it? Worth it, no?

0.Content: Show your entry permit, please.

1.Content: Apologies, my weary friend, but we're under martial law. No one comes in without a permit.

0.Content: Oh! I know some of these letters! "H-E-R"! ... "M-E-"! "M-O"! Umm...

1.Content: Thanks for teaching me! "Hero"? What's a "hero"?

0.Content: We said we'd meet here! He's already five minutes late for our date, how dare he keep a lady waiting for so long!?

1.Content: Making a lady wait like this is just not right, don't you agree? He never cared about our date to begin with!

2.Content: That's it, I'm leaving. From this moment on, I swear, he shall never see me again!

3.Content: Unless... No, no! Never again!

0.Content: My daughter is very smart, but very mischievous... though that's not a shortcoming. In fact, as a father, I thinks it makes her even cuter.

1.Content: Every day she goes off alone to play who-knows-where, it's such a headache... Well, it's nothing to worry much about. After all, this town is small and the neighbors always keep an eye on her, but some days she'll come home long after dinner has gone cold.

2.Content: Food's ready now, I have to go out and find her.

0.Content: Where do you think this is, "dear friend"? Can you guess? This isn't the first time we've met.

1.Content: No need to trouble yourself over it. It's only natural that I would know a great deal more than you do. Look here, you shouldn't feel out of place, after all, you've not moved an inch! No thanks necessary, soak it all in, as much as you want!

2.Content: Yes, take it all in... Do you like this future? Hahaha!

0.Content: What do you think? Enjoying this little excursion through time?

1.Content: You want to change the future? Hahahahaha... Yes, you're all the same; self-righteous with an inferiority complex... All wanting to change the future you know will come, no matter what that may be. All seeking a momentary relief, insatiable and always wanting more.

2.Content: Covetous. Deceptive. Hypocritical. Duplicitous and cruel... The lot of you. Even with a path opened to you, how far can you really go?

3.Content: Very well, powerless mortal... Go and face your fate!

0.Content: Why is this permit so tattered? ... It's certainly genuine, but there are stains all over it. Is it yours?

1.Content: Is that so...? You've had it rough. Alright then. But remember, It's certainly safer in here than out there.

0.Content: Get lost, there's no place for you here.

1.Content: Begone! We've nothing to say to you. Enough of your nonsense, take a long walk off a short pier, or my hand will be forced!

2.Content: Hawwwwk-spit!

0.Content: Hey! Are you the merchant? Lower your voice... (Waves through the fence)

1.Content: You brought it! Mhmm, good good, stunning, she'll surely like... Ah, er, it's definitely suitable.

2.Content: Don't mock me. Here, take this, a token of my thanks. A pretty penny, for sure.

0.Content: Thanks for coming all this way... It's absolutely divine. Human women have such nimble fingers, our craftsmanship simply cannot compare.

1.Content: My child will soon be of age, I wish to give him a fine suit. Going to Mutt'Heer town in torn up rags is unthinkable.

2.Content: If there's any extra I'll make a little something for his father, too.

0.Content: Would you like to rest for a spell? There's hot soup and a steaming bath here.
The situation is quite volatile... isn't it? Thank you, you really are too kind.
Ah! There must be some misunderstanding? ... No, stop!

1.Content: Why... I can't think of a single thing I've done to offend anyone! Oh my... Stop beating! Stop!

2.Content: My family and I have an honest business here, we've never been involved in anything shady! Why...!

3.Content: Alright I'm going! ...Savages.

0.Content: The history of the Northern Altar is incomprehensibly long. It can only be opened by a one-of-a-kind Blessed Relic... It's a shame no one knows where that relic happens to be.

1.Content: If it were to be opened, perhaps it could bring the young leader to his senses... Yes, yes... Look here, the forest looks like it's been carved into two territories, two states. In actual fact, it's a buffer zone.

2.Content: At the very least, it will make those other youngsters he leads reconsider their actions before they commit atrocities against the residents. Perhaps there's still enough time.

3.Content: Well, young'un, do you believe in fate? Cause and effect, endless cycles... Perhaps it's all fate. Perhaps every bloodstain is self-inflicted.

4.Content: Maulers used to be human, but sadly, humans couldn't stand them, just as humans cannot stand themselves. It's impossible for Maulers to love humans, just like humans cannot love others.

0.Content: You're asking how to get through the forest? Hmm... I reckon my old bones can probably help you out.

1.Content: There are two ways we can go about this. The first way is to pray to the forest for a blessing and be given passage through. The second way... Well, you'd be on your own.

0.Content: The forest has blessed you, kind child. The forest shall shelter you in the near future.
This is exceptional! See, you could do this with your hands tied, right? The quality, the luster... my my my.

1.Content: Oh, here's your reward! What's with that expression? I'm losing out by giving you this, you know!

2.Content: I don't believe you wouldn't at least give it a shot. Can't do it, huh?

1.Content: You may pass.

0.Content: (Talking to himself) ... Disgusting... What should I do... Shut up... Stop messing with my judgment!

1.Content: ... (a spate of mumbled, incoherent babble)

2.Content: Who is it? Ah! But how?! ...Humans!

0.Content: Oh dear... Would you look at that, the poor lad is dead.

1.Content: Ridiculous mortal, are you still so clueless?

2.Content: Calculating? Oh please, only you mortals are calculating of one another, tormenting each other only to be hoisted by your own petard.

3.Content: Look again at the fruits of your labor, this future you have wrought! Hahahaha!

0.Content: Hush! ...Hide yourself! Where were you, little one?! ...Don't utter a sound...

1.Content: We've lost so much already... I can't lose you, too...

2.Content: I got a plan, ma. I found a... tough, heavy blanket. It'll hide our toes!

3.Content: Back when I played hide and seek with papa and Bow-wow, Bow-wow would only find papa if his toes weren't hidden... Uh!

4.Content: ... (sobbing)...

5.Content: Someone's coming! Quickly ma, hide!

0.Content: Don't come any closer! Don't you dare hurt my ma!

1.Content: No! Don't touch her! How many have to die before you'll be satisfied!?

2.Content: ... Are you human?

3.Content: I'm so sorry, traveler... those heinous Maulers have put the fear of death in us all...

4.Content: Don't believe him! Those beasts already murdered everyone! Ma, you said so yourself, we're the only ones left! There's no way he's human!

6.Content: We hail from the west, and now, there's no difference between here and there... it's all gone.

7.Content: The Maulers destroyed our homes, killed everyone...

8.Content: They said it was revenge for their mighty leader...

9.Content: But we're human! What do we know of those savages!

10.Content: Stop this nonsense!

11.Content: It's not nonsense! Surely... There has to be someone to avenge us! When I'm grown up, I'll do it!

0.Content: However can I thank you? ...To even find us such good shelter...

1.Content: ... It's truly astonishing, like it's got everything. We can really live here.

2.Content: Don't say such things, it's already more than enough. Are you sure... it's alright for us to use it?

3.Content: Thank you so much, Traveler. You're too kind.

4.Content: ...I'm sorry for what I said.

5.Content: I hope we meet again... By then, I'll be all grown up! I'm going to be just like you!

6.Content: ... And then, I'll be able to make it up to you!

7.Content: Stay safe.

8.Content: Stay safe.

0.Content: Good... Even more offerings... Even more power! Rush even faster toward destruction!

1.Content: Humans? Hahaha... Doomed race. What do you want to do?

2.Content: Whatever you planned to do, it's too late, there's no way to stop it now. Just as I mind-controlled that Mauler leader in the beginning, even if you have as much integrity as he did, it's all the same to me - you're just food. My food.

3.Content: Oh, your luck is somewhat better than his. At the very least, you won't die in mysterious circumstances, hahahaha!

0.Content: Hahahaha... You reckon you've won, human?

1.Content: Ah... The scent of terror, despair, loathing, hatred... Truly fascinating. Just like a snowball, it only takes a single downward roll to trigger an unstoppable avalanche. Ah yes! Those Maulers worship me, praise me, why do you think that may be?

2.Content: The avalanche has already begun! Even if I bow out now... I'll be back soon!

3.Content: We'll meet again, dear... human.

1.Content: ... Hmm?

0.Content: When I was young, I was cheated by many unscrupulous human merchants. I'd laugh and smile as they ripped me off.

1.Content: How else do you think I ended up with my wife? Hehehe!

0.Content: Excuse me, can you tell me how to say these words?

1.Content: Friendship? Then it ought to say partners, no wonder "Brotherhood" is written here.

2.Content: Ah, I have a friend. His ears are different than mine, and he has a funny tail...

3.Content: How is that weird? I think he's super cool!

0.Content: Make him send me something, it's been ages! Geez!

1.Content: He's been like this for as long as I've known him, how could I be so blind as to choose such a man as my husband!

2.Content: Er, have we met somewhere before?

0.Content: My daughter is smart and well-behaved. I reckon she's inherited it from her grandfather, because she doesn't get it from me or my husband.

1.Content: There are only a few places she likes to go, so we always know where to find her when it's time to call her in for dinner.

2.Content: Oh! It's nearly dinner time, I have to go and ask hubby what he'd like to eat.

0.Content: Weary traveler, do you... You!! How can you dare to show your face here?!

1.Content: Don't feign ignorance! I could never forget your face!

2.Content: Get lost! You're not welcome here, make no mistake!

3.Content: ... It's him! That's the one, my leopard friend! Don't let him get away!

0.Content: Alright, let's get this roof properly nailed on! Guys, come give me a hand!

1.Content: No problem, man. You've worked hard, why not go meet the boss for a drink a bit later?

2.Content: Sure! I'm telling you, why not just wait for spring and then move with your family to the city? My folks have an empty house available right now, you know.

3.Content: I... Thank you!

0.Content: Ah, my weary child.

1.Content: You've surely experienced a great ordeal on your journey. You've encountered many hardships and made all kinds of difficult decisions.

2.Content: Perhaps you've been misunderstood, perhaps you've been made to suffer.

3.Content: Sometimes, there are words filled with distress, and sometimes, there are no words at all. On this lonesome journey, one can only sigh in the golden silence, before once again taking those tales and locking everything away together inside one's heart.

4.Content: But here you are, at long last. To be at such peace is indeed extraordinary.

5.Content: You're such a good kid, young'un... Rest now, sleep well.

6.Content: Bless you.

0.Content: A young human merchant? How did you get into the village... huh?

1.Content: What's happening... Ah!!

0.Content: Oh! Just in time! Help me figure out what to write in this love letter...

1.Content: I'm worried no one is discussing... Hey!! You-

0.Content: Huh? How did humans enter our village? Are you a guest?

1.Content: How could you! ...It hurts...

0.Content: Humans again... Just how far will you go to persecute our people?

1.Content: ... Ugh.

0.Content: Why are you looking for me so doggedly? I'm just an ordinary merchant, that's all.

1.Content: You said, "Whether or not they're merchants isn't important, you're just looking Maulers, nothing more"? Hahahaha...

2.Content: Hahahaha... Yes, I'm laughing at you. How could I not find this hilarious?

3.Content: Alright. Even if I can't muster the strength to beat you, at least there will be no words left between us. Just do it.

0.Content: Great work, foolish human. I even want to offer you applause.

1.Content: Hardly surprising. You've always been such creatures. Hypocritical and shallow, behaving selfishly on the one hand, whilst vainly fighting for your good reputation.

2.Content: What does that say about you?

3.Content: Thanks to you, I'm a step closer to a captivating future!

4.Content: But look at you, look at all of you. Perhaps I don't need to lift a finger for that future to arrive... You call it... fate!

5.Content: As for you, at least you're a real "hero", are you not?

6.Content: You've already done enough, "plenty". Hahahahaha...

0.Content: Ah! I remember you! You're a "hero"!

1.Content: Hm? ... You're not? I don't know what you mean.

2.Content: I should go home when it gets dark, but lately, it's always dark.

3.Content: Daddy said not to worry, but I can smell the changes in the forest air. It's turned just like auntie Sharley's rotten cheese.

4.Content: Can you smell it?

0.Content: It's you! Kind traveler! Want to rest? There's hot soup... What are you intending to do?
... Pfft! Hahahaha! You really gave me a start!
Is that so... Really? My poor young'un, there's really no turning back for you?
Amazing!
Are you insane! Why do you want to kill people! Have you forgotten who you are?!
She's got a point there though, right?

1.Content: I've unleashed a psycho, hahahahaha!

0.Content: Eh? Pappy said children shouldn't take such dangerous stuff... 'Cause they might hurt someone...

1.Content: Just like it's hurting me... Pappy... It hurts so much...

0.Content: Phenomenal! Thanks to you, everything is in chaos!
What are you doing! It looks like you're up to no good!

1.Content: You're human aren't you? So behave like one! If you've even a shred of conscience left, you'll let! Me! Go! Ugh! ... Help me!

0.Content: So, how are you feeling? Happy? Sad? ...Hah, you can't hear me anymore, can you?
How could you... do this? Awful...

1.Content: You won't get away with this!

0.Content: Hah! Hahaha! This is downright... Oh? You're challenging me?

1.Content: There's nothing in it for me. Save it, my dear mortal.

0.Content: Daddy doesn't let me go out to play anymore, he says it's too dangerous. (Written in a child's handwriting, a tall figure with a tail can be seen holding an axe, towering above a cowering man and a little girl.)

1.Content: ... (illegible)

2.Content: Aunt Shelly is sleeping (Missing parts, cannot read)

3.Content: Daddy said the Maulers destroyed everything. (A childish drawing depicts a ferocious beast next to a woman with her eyes closed.)

4.Content: ... (missing page)

5.Content: Daddy wants to play hide and seek, he's so silly.

6.Content: I'm hungry, daddy still hasn't found me.

7.Content: I drew some food... I got so hungry I ate the pages. It didn't taste very nice.

8.Content: ... (missing page)

9.Content: Why can beasts speak?

10.Content: ... (stained with blood, illegible)

0.Content: "If you're ever in search of a Wilder, you'll most likely find them somewhere within the Dark Forest."

1.Content: Such a fine idea, Angelo. And now here we are, in the Dark Forest. Lost.

2.Content: Right at this moment everyone is indulging in pre-party revelry, we're just adding a touch of adventure to bring it to the climax! ... It adds to the poetry of moment.

3.Content: Indeed... Except the only ones on this 'adventure' are you and I, no-one else!

4.Content: Eh, it'll be fine as long as we don't run into any trouble.

0.Content: Thank goodness your music knocked it out, or we wouldn't be able to get away!

1.Content: Such is the power of music! Growing up in such a dingy hole, the Hypogean aren't fond the uplifting and melodious feel of this tune, especially amidst such a cheery pre-party atmosphere...

2.Content: Then what are we waiting for?! Let's hurry up and get out of this fog!

0.Content: Hey! Why'd you suddenly stop like that!?

1.Content: Shh! Listen!

2.Content: Singing! That voice seems... familiar... Is someone nearby?

3.Content: Isn't it the other side of the lake?!

0.Content: Looks like it. Well then, we need to think of a way to get over there.

1.Content: ... Fine fine. But only because you hired me.

2.Content: My Wilder friends once told me... Special life-bearing runes are often born to the Dark Forest... Perhaps we can use those.

0.Content: The singing is coming from here! Seems we've found it!

1.Content: Who's there... Huh? Rowan, why are you here?

2.Content: Lorsan?! I'd just been saying how familiar the voice was...

3.Content: My old friend, "Soul Singer"! Your singing is just as beautiful and moving as always.

4.Content: Oh! Angelo, you're here! How fortunate! I've not long returned to the Dark Forest!

5.Content: Oh for sure! You gave us quite the run-around, we were about to give up... Cough-cough.

6.Content: Hahaha, after I got back I was afraid my singing would disturb others, and I really wanted to be able to give it my all, so I came here to carry on practicing out of earshot.

7.Content: Still, I never expected to be found by you two. You must've cracked all my conundrums!

8.Content: I came especially for you. I would like to cordially invite you to join us for the Noble Tavern music festival!

9.Content: Music festival? That sounds great!

10.Content: The festival needs more experienced and charismatic music lovers to attend! That's right! That's where you come in! Remember the band we once formed?

11.Content: Of course I do! Will that lady be there, too? "The Musical Rose", I mean. I recall she sent me a letter not long ago, but I've no idea where she is now.

0.Content: I'm just off to find her! Maybe you should come with us?

1.Content: I would like nothing more.

0.Content: Is this the place Lorsan meant? I mean, it doesn't look particularly great...

1.Content: The Hypogean seem determined to ruin my party plans.

2.Content: There are canons and blockades all over the place! ...Brother, you're not paying me enough for this! I should be getting hazard pay!

3.Content: But of course! I totally trust in Rowan's abilities. A little hiccup like that won't stop us, will it now?

4.Content: Perhaps we can use the canons to break the blockades... I hope it'll work.

5.Content: I'm adding this to your bill! Don't forget!

1.Content: It's not polite to stare at a beautiful lady, Rowan.

2.Content: But but!! Anyone would stare in shock seeing a lady lift such a huge bow one-handed like that! Literally anyone!

3.Content: Is that flattery?

4.Content: Good grief, yes, it is! You are the strongest lady I have ever met! You're so dignified and unshakable, so I figured-

5.Content: Whatever you buy from now on, I'll give you a special 20% discount. Now I have a handguard that fits and feels just right...

6.Content: Ahaha! The Noble Tavern is going to be holding a music festival and needs a band to keep the atmosphere lively. I immediately thought of you!

7.Content: I've heard about this. Thank you so much for the invitation!

0.Content: The way ahead has been blocked by a dangerous light beam... The Maulers sure aren't easy to goad.

1.Content: Funny, that's not what you say when doing business with them.

2.Content: That's because even Maulers need to eat and relax... Besides, the occasional business risk is necessary for unimaginably huge gains!

3.Content: Uhuh. Well then, we'll have to take a minor detour this time round, avoiding the beam. Maybe we'll find something 'unimaginably huge'.

4.Content: ...That's not what I mean!

5.Content: Calm yourself, Rowan. Look, we just need to be able to move the beam somewhere it can be blocked...

6.Content: Alright, I got this. Sigh, how did I get talked into working for my brother?

0.Content: "Kingpin", is that you? I never thought we'd meet again under such circumstances!

1.Content: Haha, nor I!

2.Content: You must've endured quite a difficult journey, pray tell what you would ask of me?

3.Content: A music festival that's happening is in need of the best band of musicians possible, and you immediately sprung to mind. The cadence of your trumpet is so distinct and resonant!

4.Content: I'd love to take part, it'll be just like old times.

5.Content: Just like old times!

6.Content: There can be no doubt that anyone who loves music is a fine person!

7.Content: I'm so glad you think so.

0.Content: Fear not when dangers arise, For up ahead is where hope lies.

1.Content: Angelo, you've got to tell me, how can I be as lost as you and retain that eternal optimism?

2.Content: Because I've seen the canons appear ahead!

3.Content: That is not something to be happy about!

4.Content: Wrong! Think about it, Rowan. It proves we're going the right way and not round in circles!

5.Content: ...If we get out of this alive, I'm not working this cheaply for my brother again... I'm upping my fees!

0.Content: Is this a portal? Where will it take us?

1.Content: Could it possibly be straight to "Pop Prodigy"?

2.Content: No way...!

3.Content: I got it! This portal must be for turrets!

0.Content: Are you sure it's him, Angelo? Don't you want to check again?

1.Content: No need, no need at all! We music lovers resonate with one another.

2.Content: Hey! Do you remember me? "Pop Prodigy"!

3.Content: ...Yes, I remember you. In the past, we played and discussed music together. There were two other musicians as well, we all performed together.

4.Content: That's right! And now we are planning to perform together once again for a music festival at the Noble Tavern.

5.Content: Do you want to join us?

6.Content: Why not? There's never been any other musicians like you lot, who understand the intricacies of music.

7.Content: Music is the only thing that can bring us all together and push through the barriers of difference, to build mutual understanding.

8.Content: After all that hard work, I really am counting my blessings...

0.Content: There is just one final matter

1.Content: What?

0.Content: That Hypogean that's been tailing us to ruin our party.

1.Content: You can't surely mean to fight it?!

2.Content: It may want to use the party to cause a lot of damage. If that were the case, then those goods you're hoping to peddle at the party...

3.Content: Yeah! Villains will not be tolerated! We just got enough people together, all for my goods... Er, no, I mean, all for our party!

0.Content: Good thing I'm a fast runner! Else I'd have been killed over there!

1.Content: We gave it a good try, I guess. We'll have to go back the way we came and try again.

0.Content: Wait for me! Peggy, waaaiiiiiit!

1.Content: Pe-*gasp*-Peggy, how the heck do you run so fast wearing a dress!?

2.Content: You're so slow! It's utterly exasperating! When will we get to your place?

3.Content: Big, crunchy pinecones, fragrant red berries... You said it's a hole, but it's chock-full of tasty things to eat! I'm honestly so super excited, I can't wait!

4.Content: Oh! And and and! I've never slept in a tree-hole before! (Stands with hands on hips) Hahahaha!

5.Content: (Grabs the arm of his over-excited, incessantly babbling companion) Hold on... Peggy, er, this is the wrong way.

6.Content: Huh? How could this NOT be the right way!?

7.Content: This isn't it... I've never even been here before! AH! A MUSHROOM! I swear I just saw a mushroom run past?!

8.Content: A mushroom with legs? Do you need to get your eyes checked?

9.Content: No... No... Peggy, we seem to be somewhere we really shouldn't be.

0.Content: Oh my gosh! This is the Phantom Veil Thicket! It's a special place that protects the forest and punishes any unfortunate guys trying to enter the Dark Forest!

1.Content: Unfortunate? Us?

2.Content: (Sigh) Look around, do you see any other 'unfortunate guys'?

0.Content: Shhh... This is the most dangerous fella in the Phantom Veil Thicket, we don't want to startle them. Let's take the long way round.

1.Content: How dangerous? No need to fear! (Rolls up sleeves) I've been training for this day a long time!

3.Content: (Stands with hands on hips) Hahahaha! The thrill of dangerous combat! I've been anticipating this, the great dangers of the world outside!

0.Content: They're really ferocious. Raku, when can we leave?

1.Content: We're not going to be waiting around long, are we? I hope it's not too long!

2.Content: The Phantom Veil Thicket although mysterious, has its own special rules.

3.Content: Every day some mist within the Thicket will disappear, revealing an area of land. The mist periodically clears itself in an anti-clockwise direction.

4.Content: (Snaps fingers) So by my calculations, we just need 1, 2, 3, 4... 11 days, and then we can leave!

5.Content: Presuming every day is as straight forward as today.

6.Content: Relax, you have me here! You've got nothing to worry about.

0.Content: So hungry... I can't go another step, I'm so hungry and tired.

1.Content: (Sits down) Peggy, I need a break.

2.Content: It's only just day two, Raku! Surely you want to go home? Think of that soft, warm hay bed!

4.Content: You really are a very strange girl. Are all humans as inexhaustible as you?

5.Content: Absolutely not! But I've been looking forward to this great escapade into the big, wide world! Raku, do you know if there's any bears in the woods? ...Ok, not a bear, but what about ghosts?

0.Content: (A sweet breeze blows through as the illusion vanishes and the Dark Forest's vivid scenery appears before them both)

1.Content: The! Dark! Forest!

2.Content: This is the Dark Forest?! Wow, Raku look! Look! There's a rainbow!

3.Content: Yeah I see it, you clueless Castle-dweller!

4.Content: We're going to have so much fun in the Dark Forest! But goodness, I never imagined we'd be held up in the Phantom Veil Thicket for 12 whole days!

5.Content: Definitely! That 12 days flew by! We've got plenty more fun ahead of us!

7.Content: You've got that right! (stands on tiptoes.) Well, Your Highness, let's seize this opportunity while the mist's gone to get out of here! Let's go!

8.Content: In my "Nutshell Nook" there are plenty of tasty snacks, crunchy pinecones, fragrant red berries... And one very cozy soft hay bed!

0.Content: Good work, soldier. You've completed your Imperial Military training. You're about to embark on an expedition as a leader. You're about to lead your soldiers into danger and adversity.

1.Content: Passing your training only proves you're a formidable soldier, it doesn't prove that you are able to lead your soldiers to victory. You must complete your final trial. You must prove you have a strategic mind.

2.Content: I once fought side by side with Commander Hogan. He told me something which has stuck with me all these years. Anyone can bark orders, but only an excellent commander is able to formulate their own unique style of warfare.

0.Content: Keep in mind, this is a strategic trial, you must use both brains and brawn if you want to be successful. The foes in this trial are strong, attacking enemies head on without the War Relics is a foolish decision. Find and harness the War Relics scattered throughout this place.

1.Content: Each War Relic has its own special effect. You must be cautious when approaching foes, and ensure that the relic you wield is imbued with the correct special effect that is required to slay them.

2.Content: Of course, you can also wield multiple War Relics to utterly crush your enemies.

0.Content: Do you sense that? There's something different about these enemies. There's not only something slightly different about them, they're also incredibly strong.

1.Content: These enemies are strong and positioned in a special formation, they are protecting a crucial passageway. Once you defeat them, the War Relic effects you are utilizing will disappear.

2.Content: The purpose of this is to remove any advantage the trialists may have, for in a real battle, you may not always have the upper hand against your foes. You'll learn that war is never easy, hardship soon becomes the norm. You will now have to face me in combat!

3.Content: I will not go easy on you! You'll soon realize, of all the foes you may face, I am most likely the easiest. If you cannot best me, there is no hope for you!

4.Content: Test your mettle against me, or stop wasting my time! Let's do this!

0.Content: Great work! The final enemy is just ahead. Defeat them and you pass the trial!

1.Content: I must concede, this trial was made difficult by design. I wanted to bring out the full potential in you, and I did, but I never thought you would far exceed my expectations! I truly underestimated your abilities.

2.Content: I finally want to say, I believe that Commander Hogan's words can be interpreted in many ways, all with victory being the final outcome, but that the Art of Conquest is not one bound only by bloodshed. I threw down my blade long ago and adopted my own style. It's now up to you to decide your own style.

3.Content: Go forward, my friend. Become a warrior stronger than I could ever hope to be. Put an end to this war!

0.Content: After being on the road for a year, everything here still feels so familiar and reassuring...

1.Content: (Slowly plucks strings) There are some strange, smiling faces in The Noble Tavern tonight...

2.Content: There are also fewer familiar responses when greeting guests. (Harry: Meow~meow~~)

3.Content: You're right, Harry...friends come and go, and it's good to just enjoy the time we have with each other; but I do miss them...

4.Content: (The pulsating notes suddenly stop)

5.Content: My biggest regret is that this song isn't complete, and our journeys together are over... (Harry: Meow~meow~)

6.Content: You think I should finish it though, right? Ok...

7.Content: But I need some... well... some inspiration for starters; recalling the resonance of those unforgettable moments, maybe we can find a way to finish the song.

8.Content: We can create an eternal melody that encompasses the memories of all the friends who accompanied us.

9.Content: With this piece of music intertwined with our souls---

10.Content: Pay tribute to this beautiful night!

0.Content: Worthless beasts, you fled before I even fired a shot! Come out and fight me!

1.Content: Look, even though the tracks are covered by snow, the density isn't the same. North-west is the right way.

2.Content: Tch, of course you'd think of that! Can't believe I didn't think of it myself!

3.Content: If you toned it down a bit and just controlled your emotions, you'll find it's not actually that's hard.

0.Content: Damnit, why is there a blockade right in the middle of this pathway?

1.Content: The demons set this up to slow us down. Let's find a way to break it down.

0.Content: *cough cough* I've just realized what these monsters are capable of.

1.Content: Truly, Dwarven construction is the finest, still working like new despite so many years of neglect.

2.Content: Huh? This... is a Dwarven contraption...?

0.Content: Hey, this is simple enough! Obviously, the nearest button is the key to open the door!

1.Content: That is certainly plausible. Let's step on it and see what happens.

0.Content: There was definitely no door-opening sound when you pushed this button, didn't you notice? Is this thing broken?
Look over there, it's another of the same kind of button.

1.Content: This door is controlled by two buttons!

2.Content: Correct! The scent of demonic beasts is growing clearer and clearer, we're catching up to them! Let's pick up the pace!

0.Content: They're dreaming if they think they're getting away from me!

1.Content: They've already learned how to use these blockade contraptions to slow us down, I don't think it's going to get any easier from here on.

2.Content: What are you afraid of? Even if there's a mind-boggling contraption ahead, we'll easily figure it out.

3.Content: I suppose if you lend a hand it would be considerably easier...

4.Content: This was a one off, a total accident! Next time they won't outrun my bullets!

5.Content: Remember, you must stay alert when dealing with these sly beasts!

6.Content: Yeah yeah, I know! Now, let's go get a drink, it's freezing out here!

0.Content: You see that! It opened!

1.Content: But... If we step off, it will close again. We don't have time to get through the open doors.

2.Content: Then... What should we do? Surely we can get through if we just run quick enough!

3.Content: Oh come off it. I don't want to see you get crushed. Let's hurry up and find something to weigh the button down.

0.Content: The evil murmurs are emanating from here! That voice makes my blood run cold.

1.Content: It would seem that the abyssal evil hasn't ceased its efforts to claim the world for itself just yet. We must stop it spreading.

2.Content: The Devourer has made an ancient city its new home. We must repel it.

3.Content: War has already erupted. We must call upon all brave souls in Esperia to help rid the world of this evil.

0.Content: I would not believe it if I did not see it. The flame on an old civilization has been rekindled. Beautiful.

1.Content: It has been an honor to fight side by side with my Esperian brethren to cleanse Esperia of The Devourer's evil.

2.Content: Today's triumph will be remembered throughout history.

3.Content: Now that this scourge has been banished, life in Esperia can flourish again.

4.Content: The altars must have blessed us with the power to cleanse the land. When surrounded by darkness, the light shall always prevail.

0.Content: King Thoran's most loyal servant, supreme officer of the Kingdom of Bantus... Grezhul, you have heeded my call.

1.Content: I should have died protecting my King... who are you?

2.Content: Such a small matter, there are surely greater things for you to accomplish.

3.Content: ... You speak the truth. I mustn't linger here, my King needs me. I must return.

4.Content: There is a price to pay, however, if you truly wish to depart this place.

5.Content: I don't care.

6.Content: Then, let me witness your resolve, try crossing this land.

7.Content: There are ways besides using force to become a savior, you know.

0.Content: The wild turbulence here has given rise to a gigantic, destructive tornado.
Perhaps I can use the Wind Altar to lure the tornado elsewhere.

1.Content: There is a lit star next to the Wind Altar, which likely indicates the correct order for triggering the altars. Since there is currently only one altar here, it's likely that this one should be triggered first.

0.Content: The shield is activated by this lever.

1.Content: But, it appears it only controls the shield in this area.

0.Content: Finding your footing despite such an unfavorable plight is truly evidence of your great potential, but the path ahead grows more treacherous, it is not a simple matter. You must make a choice.

1.Content: What choice?

2.Content: For something to be obtained, something else must be lost.

3.Content: From the very beginning, there has only been one choice for me.

0.Content: The fact you got this far, proves you have resolve. But as you are right now, you don't possess the power to bring back King Thoran.

1.Content: What must I do?

2.Content: Give your soul to me.... and defeat him. Only then may you leave here.

0.Content: I never demand the souls of those who are incapable.

1.Content: And? What do I get out of it?

2.Content: You will have the power for vengeance. You will know how to save your King. But this power comes at a price.

3.Content: After all I've experienced, I know what must be done.

4.Content: As I mentioned before, my only purpose is to serve my King.

5.Content: Good. With time, all will be revealed.

0.Content: Just as our sources predicted. This place seems to be enveloped by some kind of mysterious force.

1.Content: A dark and mysterious force. It's apparent that things here are not as they should be.

2.Content: We must find the source of this "force" if things are to return to a state of peace and order.

3.Content: Quickly, let's make haste.

0.Content: The situation is more serious than I had anticipated. The ground ahead has been completely enveloped by this nefarious dark force.

1.Content: That must mean the source of this force is not too far ahead.

2.Content: Enemies, Lucius!

3.Content: Wait. There's something amiss about them. Now may not be the best time to attack.

4.Content: We need more information first.

0.Content: I sense Dura's power inside you both.

1.Content: We are disciples of the Divine Light. How should we address you, my Lady?

2.Content: Do you know what's happening to this place?

3.Content: You may call me Morael, Queen of Stars. The force you sense here emanates from the Void Realm. The Void Realm previously destroyed my Cosmic Garden, and now threatens to do the very same to your home too.

4.Content: The Heart of Zohra I possess can restrain this force, but I alone cannot destroy it. Help me, and together we can bring order back to this land.

5.Content: Dura's prophecy mentioned the existence of a Celestial Star Oracle. It is our honor to fight by your side!

6.Content: We will protect you, in the name of the Light!

0.Content: Careful, the source of the unusual force is just ahead. What's that?

1.Content: The fabric of reality has split apart...

2.Content: The Void Realm's underlings have created a pentagram here, it allows for the Void Realm to seep into this world.

3.Content: The enemies ahead are even greater in strength than they were before. We must think of a way to distract them.

4.Content: If we can find the hidden pentagram, we can destroy it.

5.Content: I sense a Cosmic Field. The point where the energy converges is nearby.

0.Content: This point has already been destroyed. Enemies will soon arrive to fix it. We must find the next critical point, quickly.
The pentagram has been destroyed. We must seize the moment!
The gate to the Void Realm has been shut. Now, order can be gradually restored to this land.

1.Content: I thank you both, for your help. But we must not let our guard down. The Void Realm's underlings still roam this world.

2.Content: For the Light!

3.Content: Where there is light, evil cannot flourish.

0.Content: So are these the Ice Isles? Just as I'd envisioned in my dream, the blizzard is moving at an incredible rate.

1.Content: Yes, it's spreading everywhere. The elemental forces here must be out of balance.

2.Content: According to my premonition, we must protect the surviving Fire Elementals and bring them safely to the small island.

3.Content: By the looks of things, my little friend, completing your task will be no easy feat. Are you sure you want to continue?

4.Content: My dream has foretold me of this disaster. I cannot shirk my responsibility.

5.Content: Even without your help, I will still carry out my duty. I must complete this task.

6.Content: Well then, we must brook no delay!

0.Content: That's the island, it's safe there.

1.Content: Not even the wind can reach the small island. Only the light of the burning fire can lead our path.

0.Content: *Sigh* It would seem this is the only surviving Fire Elemental.

1.Content: Let's get going.

0.Content: I've got it, little Tasi.

1.Content: As long as we help the lost Fire Elemental get close to the Portal, we'll be able to teleport it safely to the final, small island.

2.Content: Little flame, little Tasi... (So does Respen think he's big or something?)

0.Content: (After the Fire Elemental finally reached safety, the blizzard raging across the Ice Isles suddenly came to an abrupt end, the whole place has completely changed...)

1.Content: Little Tasi, you've succeeded. I can hear the sounds of rustling plants, sprouting and budding. Not even the sound of the raging icy wind could conceal it.

2.Content: Is this the sign you saw in your dream?

3.Content: That is indeed what I saw in my dream! I am the protector of dreams, but if only I could turn my dreams into a reality, that would make me a very happy girl!

0.Content: You sure there's treasure here?

1.Content: Not totally, but there's so many rumors in Rustport's bar, a few are bound to be legit.

2.Content: You said that last time, and look how that turned out.

3.Content: You heard there was a vampire from some rumor in Rustport, but it was just a sailor with gingivitis. And let's not forget the time before that, and before that, too...

4.Content: I've got a gut feeling it's true this time.

5.Content: You said that last time, too.

6.Content: How about we fight and the winner decides our course of action?

7.Content: It's fine, there's a village ahead, we can ask around there.

0.Content: Good Adventurers, there is indeed treasure in our village.

1.Content: See! The rumors are true this time! Still, surprisingly considerate of the village to just declare it so frankly.

2.Content: Extinguish that flame of yours.

3.Content: Didn't you just aim a gun at the Chief?

4.Content: (Heaves a sigh of relief) If you can defeat the demon, the treasure is yours.

5.Content: Demon?

6.Content: It's a long story... Put that gun away! I'll keep it short!

0.Content: Good Adventurer, bandits robbed us just outside the village, all our belongings were taken from us, including a book that has great importance to my friend.

1.Content: The bandits' stronghold is not far from the village. If you can help retrieve the book and return it to my friend in town, he will reward you well!

0.Content: Oh thank you! This book is so important to me! I am a scholar trying to restore ancient techniques, and this book contains a great many!

1.Content: Check this out, a long-burn lamp. Fueled by lava, once lit it will keep burning for decades! And this...

2.Content: Ahem, I'll pass. Bounty hunters deal in cash for their services.

0.Content: Warriors, I need your help!

1.Content: Those damned Maulers robbed my shop! They reside by the lake under the volcano just outside of town. Get rid of them and I'll reward you!

0.Content: Bounty hunters are so stupid. Just a few words and they're completely fooled. As soon as those Maulers are all dead... Heh heh heh...

1.Content: It's best they all die together, save me paying for it.

0.Content: That sketchy general store owner is ripping off out-of-towners again.

1.Content: Those poor Maulers haven't eaten a single full meal since working for him.

2.Content: He ended up sending some men to drive the Maulers out. Reward? Not a single coin!

0.Content: You've been deceived by that vile man! We agreed to work for him only in exchange for some grain, but the grain he gave us was riddled with mold!

1.Content: We approached him to discuss it, but were driven away by his lackeys! They even took back the moldy grain!

2.Content: His forefathers had freed our tribe from the demon's slavery, but he enslaved us just as they had!

3.Content: You dare deceive us? Eat lead.

4.Content: I can't wait to see him repent in flames!

0.Content: Thank you for getting rid of those Maulers! Please accept this token of my appreciation. Business hasn't been great lately, but I've heard you're looking for three gems, and it just so happens I have the ideal lead on the Sunstone.
Thank you for your help. My forefather was enslaved in the demon's cavern. Perhaps the message he left behind will be a clue to find the Moonstone?
Is this the Starstone you spoke of? I picked it up in the cavern. I went to retrieve my forefather's lost long-burn lamp, but this is all I found.

1.Content: You want this stone? Listen, if you can find the long-burn lamp, I will gladly give you this stone.

2.Content: A long-burn lamp? That seems to ring a bell.

3.Content: The man talking in town! I think he said something about lava? Alright, we'll bring back the long-burn lamp.

4.Content: Don't try fooling me with a normal lamp when you come back, the one I want burns continuously!

0.Content: This is indeed a long-burn lamp! The stone is all yours.
Thank you, both of you fine heroes, for all you've done for the village. Please take this treasure, as promised.

1.Content: Can you tell us exactly what it is now?

2.Content: The finest sword in this village. Its former owner was one of the brave warriors that originally sealed away the Hypogean.

3.Content: A sword? Bullets are so much better.

4.Content: Well, whatever. At least we destroyed the demon, and we even had a heap of fun along the way!

5.Content: How about a drink? My treat! Now, let's go get our reward.

0.Content: You can't fool me with lamps that go out! The long-burn lamp will only burn with the light of the planet's inner heat!
Is this the Starstone you spoke of? I picked it up in the cavern. I went to retrieve my forefather's lost long-burn lamp, but this is all I found.

1.Content: You want this stone? Listen, if you can find the long-burn lamp, I will gladly give you this stone.

2.Content: Very well, we'll bring back the long-burn lamp.

3.Content: Don't try fooling me with a normal lamp when you come back, the one I want burns continuously!

0.Content: We've been tailing these evil-doers for quite a while now Belinda. Perhaps some rest is in order?

1.Content: I appreciate the thought, but no. The longer we let them get away from us, the more chance they'll deal irreparable damage to someone. I cannot abide that.

2.Content: If Archbishop Palmer hadn't told me about this place, I wouldn't have believed a Divine Temple once stood here.

0.Content: I don't know how long it would've taken to see the light of day again, if it were not for the earthquake.

1.Content: I still sense a divinity here, calling to me. Lucius, I think we need to learn more about this place.

2.Content: There are also many Spectral Wastes here that require cleansing. If you would like to, we'll keep moving forward.

0.Content: Lucius, there's a lever.

1.Content: It might be the only way of getting out of this tricky situation. Don't worry Belinda, I'm with you all the way.

0.Content: Lucius, look here. By moving the tracks, we can cause these peculiar Light Beams to hit the Beam Refractor, allowing the light beams to be oriented towards different directions.

1.Content: Also, when the Seal is illuminated by the Light Beam the Fire Symbol shall descend, revealing a hidden path.

2.Content: Oh, oh! If that's the case, we can use this Seal Lever to reach the place we were originally unable to reach.

0.Content: Belinda, watch your step. This place has been badly damaged.

1.Content: Not only that, the Levers here are more densely concentrated. I can also sense the Divine Light is stronger here than the last place.

2.Content: Let the Light guide us. Let's keep pressing forward.

0.Content: Belinda, this Light Beam Emitter no longer works when another Light Beam is striking it.

1.Content: Wait a minute... then that means we can use this principle to disrupt the Light Beam Emitters that have been blocking our way.

0.Content: It seems we were right about that. But why is this formation of Light Beams still working?

1.Content: We can go around and check the other side, perhaps there is a similar lever that can be used.

0.Content: The Divine Light is telling me that entering this portal will take us back to our initial location.

1.Content: If we find ourselves unable to advance any farther, we can head back to the start.

0.Content: Are you hurt, Lucius?

1.Content: I'm fine. The land here has sunk and been destroyed. The Divine Light here isn't powerful enough to subdue the evildoers, so I knew what to expect beforehand.

2.Content: The Divine Light's guidance will always be profound. The Spectral Wastes have now been cleansed of evil.

3.Content: Let's head back to Archbishop Palmer and tell him of our findings. Let's rebuild the fallen Divine Temple. I hope that this land can once again be protected by the Light.

0.Content: This is the source of all the trouble, is it not?

1.Content: The near perimeter of the island seems to be calm, yet the waves froth and tumult clearly further out to sea. We are trapped here, left for dead.

2.Content: The source of the stirring heat beneath the volcano is causing this phenomenon. Repairs on the ship are underway. As soon as this unusual heat anomaly subsides, we can leave this place.

3.Content: I can't wait to get off this cursed spit of land!

4.Content: Aren't you numbskulls forgetting something very important? Is the sea really our biggest problem right now? How about the threat lurking among us, using our own faces against us to get everyone rattled and stir up trouble?

5.Content: Don't go playing dumb! They definitely came here with us, stealing our looks to blend in without effort! If we don't root them out now, even if the storm subsides, we'll still be stuck here playing their murderous game.

6.Content: Now's really not the time to cast further suspicion over one another.

7.Content: This wretched place is full of traps! You really think laser beams just naturally sprout out of the ground?

8.Content: Let us deal with the source of the heat first. We just need to gather three stone tablets, and once we have them the problem should be eliminated. I shall go collect them.

9.Content: We shall also find the enemy among us!

0.Content: Do you have...

1.Content: Get lost! I don't trust you as far as I can spit!

2.Content: You do not need to trust me. The less you trust me, the greater your caution towards me will be, thus the more taxing it will be for me to hurt you all.

3.Content: If the choice were yours, would you have everyone watch a single person you regard as the imposter?

4.Content: Shove off with your nonsense, I've got my own methods for proving who is who!

5.Content: You want to know where the stone tablet is, don't you? There's one over there, now move it.

0.Content: Woah, not bad! But...
The cave ahead seems pretty important, but unfortunately it's blocked by some contraption. What a pain.
When I was exploring just now, I noticed there seemed to be something in the cave ahead. I'd better go check it out.
Why did you not investigate when you were there?
A toolbox, full of items we can use for repairs. Why has it appeared here?

1.Content: Vurk lost it here.

2.Content: I saw him wandering around the area, he'd put something on the ground and seemed to be setting a trap. I wanted to ask him about it but he dashed off when he saw me.

3.Content: What on earth are you saying?

4.Content: I'm saying there's a huge trap ahead, so watch yourself.

0.Content: Having obtained one stone tablet and some information, it would be wise to make a preliminary deduction. Among Lucius, Antandra and Vurk, which two people are trustworthy and who is the most likely to be the disguised imposter?

1.Content: The trustworthy ought to assist me, but should poor judgement have been passed, they may yet stab me in the back.

0.Content: Does this toolbox look familiar to you?

1.Content: Why would it?

2.Content: Allow me to rephrase the question. Did you do anything while scouting that you need to tell us about?

3.Content: Fool, I'm not wasting my breath on you.

0.Content: You were attacked by the imposter yesterday, and today you went deep into the volcano. Do your wounds pose you no problem?

1.Content: As a Warrior of the Temple, these wounds are nothing compared to my arduous training.

2.Content: I know you to be iron willed, but will is not infallible, bones and muscle are not to soon replaced. You moved with such agility just now, as though harm had never befallen you. Will alone cannot do this.

3.Content: This is absurd! I'm so sick of everything on this island! Sick of the constant suspicion and being a pawn in someone's game! Even if it kills me, I will find the imposter!

4.Content: Shove your fantastical delusions, and don't bother pretending you've any sympathy! If you seeing me cry and fall apart is what it takes to satisfy your suspicions, then I'm afraid I'm going to disappoint you!

0.Content: I found a clue to the second tablet, but that area seems fraught with danger. We'd best go together and watch each other's backs.
Are you not afraid that I am the imposter? This decision of yours is tantamount to suicide.

1.Content: I once wounded my most important comrade because of such suspicion.

2.Content: It made me realize that suspicion and separation is precisely what the imposter wants. They're enjoying this.

3.Content: I'd rather die the death of a fool than live the life of a deserting coward.

4.Content: I admire your integrity, but I refuse to accompany you.

0.Content: Huh, the contraption blocking the cave just moved, we can go in and take a look now.

1.Content: Don't believe me? Believe what you want.

0.Content: The traps here have been tampered with. The tools used by whoever did this do not seem to match those that originally made the trap, the changes are incredibly crude.

1.Content: Furthermore, it seems many monsters have been attracted here. Quite the headache.

2.Content: Once I leave here, I must find Vurk and question him.

0.Content: I know what you want. Yes, the traps were changed by me, and the toolbox was mine, too.

1.Content: For what reason?

2.Content: I told you already. I have my own methods of outing the imposter. I tweaked the traps in the cave to lure others into it.

3.Content: If an imposter goes into those caves, they know where the traps are, so they'll consciously avoid them.

4.Content: So, by making some adjustments and moving the traps to what the imposter reckons are 'safe spaces', they'll trip a trap and expose themselves, even though the traps aren't strong enough to kill anyone.

5.Content: Of course I've had my eye on the cave the whole time, I'd not let an innocent person die.

6.Content: I wish we could be a little more honest.

7.Content: My goal is to get out of here and off this island with a pulse, not to get buddy-buddy with humans.

0.Content: Darnit! The way we came to the stone tablet has been totally blocked off.

1.Content: Hey! Look over here!

2.Content: What are you doing here?

3.Content: I'm an expert trapper, so I was tinkering with a trap just now and discovered a secret passageway! You can quickly get here from the camp, I reckon the original trapper left this behind.

4.Content: Besides which, there's an unexpected surprise inside...

5.Content: (Arthur enters the passageway and discovers a pile of pristine white bones, some human, some not, all strewn about the place, almost blocking the way forward.)

6.Content: ... It would seem we are not the first guests on this island.

7.Content: I was wondering what kind of person could set up such a colossal contraption with only their own strength.

8.Content: I'm afraid the people who arrived before us all lost their minds, maybe the imposter actually enslaved them to build that massive contraption that protects the tablets?

9.Content: If we cannot find a way off this island, the same fate shall eventually befall us.

0.Content: Lucius, please can you explain why the location you directed me to nearly trapped me with no way out?

1.Content: It's precisely because I worried about such things that I offered to accompany you, but you turned me down.

2.Content: I now have more information and should once again make a judgement on who the suspect is.

0.Content: You sprung a poison trap on the imposter yesterday, did you not?

1.Content: Just talking about it riles me up! If Antandra hadn't gone looking for trouble, the imposter would've been caught then and there!

2.Content: The imposter should've been poisoned, they should be dead! But it was the worst blasted luck, last night my antidote was stolen.

3.Content: Is it possible to identify who was poisoned?

4.Content: It's almost impossible. Once the antidote's done its job, the effects of the poison will be completely nullified. They'd look no different.

5.Content: There is one thing. The antidote needs to be used repeatedly, at regular intervals, to properly deal with the poison. Given the timings, I reckon the imposter would've brought it with them.

6.Content: Does the antidote have any distinguishing features?

7.Content: It's a blue liquid, stinks of rotting fish guts, kept in a crude glass bottle.

0.Content: I need to verify something. You know that we are often lacking in repair materials, correct?

1.Content: Indeed, this issue has delayed our departure plans for some time now.

2.Content: Then can you explain to me why you are hiding repair materials in a cave, and even seem to be making your very own boat?

3.Content: ... How many times have the repairs been undone? Three? Four? Do you recall?

4.Content: Every time the end was in sight, something unknown would undo all our hard repair work. The effort was totally wasted, and a huge amount of materials were tossed away.

5.Content: I don't believe it to be coincidence, it must be the imposters handy work. So, I took it upon myself to quietly gather the abandoned materials and make use of them, for a rainy day, so to speak.

6.Content: But why build a boat?

7.Content: To be prepared for the worst. Should the imposter tire of halting the hull repairs and instead destroys the ship altogether, then we have a back-up plan.

8.Content: I'm certain that obstructing the repairs is intended to provoke us and make us act rashly, but I also have no doubt the imposter could well destroy the ship should they will it.

9.Content: Even if the ship is destroyed, this small boat ensures the escape of one person, enough to return to the mainland and get help. Besides which, the materials available are limited, the boat can't hold the weight of an adult man, only a woman or someone frail could ride it.

10.Content: So you see, yes, I built it, but no, I cannot use it.
