0.Content: Only the final stone tablet remains.

1.Content: Actually, I already found it. I'll give it to you.

0.Content: This is somewhat unexpected.

1.Content: I want to bring an end to this vile situation as quickly as possible, so I decided to come and investigate earlier.

2.Content: Seeing as we have all three tablets, we can go directly to the heat source and wipe it out!

3.Content: Hold on. I still want to explore the area myself and check for any other clues.

4.Content: We already have the tablets, so let's just go and deal with the problem! Why waste time?

5.Content: Because seeing is believing.

6.Content: Fine, if you insist. See if there's anything else.

0.Content: But still, if there is anything, it is best we find it together.
I caught the scent of blood at that location, it would wise to take a closer look.
A dagger?

1.Content: I recognize it. The imposter attacked Lucius with it, when they were disguised as Belinda. This must be Lucius' blood.

2.Content: But, Lucius said the imposter fled with the dagger, so why has it appeared here?

3.Content: Perhaps we should ask Lucius to explain.

4.Content: It appears we have another issue at hand... We seem to be surrounded.

0.Content: The mechanism operation panel is damaged, resulting in the elevator next to it not being lowered. Someone is intentionally hiding something.

1.Content: There is some brown and white animal fur stuck to the Mechanism Operation Panel. It may yield some clues.

0.Content: There was nothing important, and the path back was impassable.

1.Content: Our primary concern is to return with the tablet. There are complex mechanisms here, it may be possible to find a way to other areas provided we are eagle-eyed.

0.Content: The three stone tablets have all been collected, and now it is time to make the final choice.

1.Content: I ought to have all the clues I need to uncover the identity of the imposter!

0.Content: The place you led me to contained nothing of worth, it was a dead end with no way out. Explain yourself.

1.Content: I did tell you there was nothing there, that it was a waste of time to explore the area again.

2.Content: Did you happen to break anything while you were investigating the area?

3.Content: I likely smashed a bunch of things, I've no clue what exactly you're referring to.

0.Content: Do you recognize this dagger?

1.Content: This is the dagger the imposter attacked me with when they disguised themselves as Belinda. I've kept it with me these past few days.

2.Content: Why would you carry the weapon that tried to kill you?

3.Content: As a reminder to myself. It was the wielder of the dagger who intended me harm, not the dagger itself. The attacker is the imposter, and not those who've been impersonated.

4.Content: Following the attack, I became shamefully suspicious of the real Belinda, so I kept the dagger to serve as a reminder.

0.Content: Not bad. After being toyed with for so long, you finally wised up.

1.Content: How thrilling! I can't wait to ensnare you for all eternity, you'll be my obedient slaves!

2.Content: What have you done with the real Antandra?

3.Content: Why do you even care? She's still asleep at the camp.

4.Content: I won't mistreat her, after all, she's a tough cookie, my favorite kind of plaything! As for you... I guess we can play for a little while!

5.Content: It appears you do not understand your own situation, for it is you deep in peril!

6.Content: You could manipulate us before only because you could blend in with us, our suspicions prevented us from being at our best.

7.Content: But now, the heat source has been destroyed and your identity has been discovered! We have no reason to hold back! Come at me! Let us end this farce!

0.Content: I had you running in circles for so long, yet you never wised up. I didn't think you were so stupid. Honestly, what a bore.

1.Content: You can join the other bones here in the caves, I need to find better toys.

2.Content: The heat source, the shipwreck... were these your doing?

3.Content: Not the heat source, that was just coincidence, but it gave me an opportunity to have a little fun.

4.Content: Your stupidity is astronomical, it was exactly what I needed to make the most of our playtime together, I even granted you some little gifts!

5.Content: Time to say goodbye to this boring world!

0.Content: ... What is this place? What happened?

1.Content: We were shipwrecked. This remote island is our new home for now.

0.Content: There's ship debris on the beach, we'd best investigate.

1.Content: The hull is ruined, there's no way we could piece this together and get back out to sea.

2.Content: I can.

3.Content: ....Only by repairing the ship's hull can we guarantee everyone's safety.

0.Content: That looks like small bottles floating in the ocean, they seem to contain supplies.

1.Content: A drifting bottle. People would put messages in these and cast them out to sea.

2.Content: I've conveniently just picked up a pen and paper from the wreckage, perhaps we can use our own drifting bottle to send word for help?

3.Content: It's likely that the bottles will just wash back up on this shore again.

0.Content: It'll take some time to repair the ship. The anomaly at sea doesn't appear to be subsiding. If we want to survive, we'd better cultivate our own food.

1.Content: There are all sorts of plants on the island, I'm sure we can find some fruits.

0.Content: I can't live on leaves! I need some meat, too!

1.Content: Perhaps we can try our hand at fishing, that'll give us strength!

0.Content: I used some of the decking from the wreckage to build a simple camp. This is where everyone will stay, it'll be easier to assign tasks to everyone this way.
What's with all the vines on this stupid island?! Setting traps is such a pain!

1.Content: We need to clear these vines to explore more of the island.

0.Content: This is the cause of all our problems. The mysterious sea anomaly and the in-fighting among ourselves. This is where it ends.
What's the matter Gorvo, are you so surprised?

1.Content: My dear friend, why are you on this island? Was it you who sunk the ship?

2.Content: Gorvo has been ambushed! Quickly, help!

0.Content: Huh... why are there two... Belindas?

1.Content: We can be certain of one thing, our enemy has the power to impersonate people. He used this method to trick and deceive us, with the hopes of us turning on each other.

2.Content: Lucius, follow the Light's guidance.

3.Content: My dear Lucius, do you have the heart to harm me?

0.Content: So, what do you think of that huh? How's my skill?

1.Content: Solise dared put poison in the food? Does she have a death wish?

2.Content: Don't do anything rash. The enemy has the power to shapeshift, it's trying to turn us against one another.

3.Content: How do I know you're not the shapeshifter?

0.Content: Gotcha!

1.Content: I let you. I was getting bored of you all anyway. Oh how easily you are all provoked, how eager you are to indulge yourselves. Pathetic. Although you still hadn't fully given into your vices, you made me more powerful than I could have imagined.

2.Content: Face me, coward!

0.Content: Look! A chest, floating in the sea!

1.Content: It must have been one of the chests in the ship's cabin. Let's open it and see what's inside.

0.Content: There seems to be more chests out at sea.

1.Content: I can swim over and investigate, they probably have much-needed supplies inside.

0.Content: Hey! Have you heard the news? The islands off of the Aranti gulf! They're full of great treasures.

1.Content: Well, you're not too late, but you're not that early either!

2.Content: But brace yourself. A lot of crazed people are on the search for the infamous Hodgkin's "hidden treasure".

3.Content: The legend says, wherever the "Dead Fleet" appears, there is sure to be great treasures not far off. So you can understand why people are so interested.

4.Content: Hah! Don't worry! This'll be your territory! Of course, there are still many preparations to be made.

0.Content: Beautiful! That's it! If you plan on getting rich, you need not only work hard, you must also keep your wits about you!

1.Content: There are good and bad people here, but they have one thing in common - greed. Thus, Defensive and Resource buildings are a must.

2.Content: Be aware, the resources on this land are limited. You can only build 4 types of Resource buildings and 14 types of Defensive buildings.

3.Content: Alright, I'm pretty busy so I'll be on my way. But I'm sure we'll be filthy rich soon!

0.Content: Just as I'd expected, great job! I like what you've done with the place, very orderly indeed.

1.Content: I bring good news.

2.Content: Construction on our Shipyard is complete!

3.Content: Quickly, prepare to set sail! But before you leave, don't forget to garrison your buildings with defensive forces.

4.Content: It's time to take a peek at other people's islands!

0.Content: Hmm, this territory is ripe for the picking. An abundance of riches, yet no defensive measures!

1.Content: I mean, she's practically inviting us to "look after" her treasures, isn't she?

2.Content: We must move swiftly! In total we have 6 chances.

3.Content: All we have to do is stop next to a Resource building, and we'll be able to pillage the resources it produces.

4.Content: However, if a building is garrisoned with defensive forces, unfortunately we'll have to overcome them before we can take the prize.

0.Content: Wait a sec, you can't just leave this newly constructed building empty, that just won't do!

1.Content: From a defensive standpoint, it'd be wise to garrison some defensive forces here, don't you think?

0.Content: Er... Raku, do you remember the way we just came?

1.Content: More importantly... Look! We've found a whole new place! New places mean new adventures!

2.Content: But, but-but... This place is so big, who knows what dangers might be lurking...

3.Content: Don't worry Pippi! Just stay close to me! Raku the Clever will ensure a smooth ride!

0.Content: WAAAAH! Pippi! Look out!

1.Content: (Startled) The floor behind us collapsed! Raku! What did you do whilst my back was turned!?

2.Content: Nothing... Well,! I just stepped on something strange... Probably not good. Right here! Pippi look!

3.Content: Uhh... (Carefully examines) A magic rune! Someone clearly didn't want anyone to find it, it looks intentionally hidden, seems to be a trap.

4.Content: Oh! For trespassing villains! Oh! Just like you and me when we stole Arden's cup. We could be stuck here and get caught in the act!

5.Content: Oh dear... then maybe get scolded and forbidden to eat pine nut marzipan?

6.Content: Waaah! Anything but that! Pippi, you're smarter than me, you must have an idea, right?

7.Content: I'm trying!

0.Content: Pippi! Look what I found!

1.Content: Hey! It's a portal!

2.Content: It looks like we'll have to rely on this portal to get out of here... But, I wonder what's on the other side?

3.Content: You think too much! This is the only way we can go, just keep moving!

0.Content: This place looks way more fun than the last place! Let's carry on with our adventure!

1.Content: Seems so... Raku, we need to be careful and find a safe way through here.

2.Content: But Pippi, there is so much cool stuff here, we really must explore!

3.Content: You know the saying, risk and opportunity go hand in hand!

0.Content: That scared me! That light beam looks like bad news.

1.Content: Obviously! Stop taking stupid risks, Raku. We have to find a way to pass these devices.

2.Content: Okay! I'll do as you say. Where do we go from here?

3.Content: Well... I, er, I need a moment to think.

0.Content: Phew, that was close... Huh? Raku, Raku! Look up ahead, there seems to be something... bright and shiny?

1.Content: I got it! It must be treasure hidden here!

2.Content: Wayhey! This adventure has been super exciting and fun! All thanks to Pippi the Clever!

3.Content: It's all thanks to brave Raku! But if Arden found out we made a mess...

4.Content: My lips are sealed! Heeheehee! This'll be our secret!

5.Content: Yeah, for sure!

0.Content: We're finally here. This place is so darn remote!

1.Content: If there wasn't so much hassle on the road, the army would've sent in their troops and we wouldn't have a shot at this bounty.

2.Content: So where's the Hypogean? I wanna put a bullet in it and bail with the goods, my "girls" are itchin' to be reloaded.

3.Content: The town's just up ahead. We'll poke around a bit first, my gut's telling me something's up.

4.Content: Keep your weapons handy, fella, it's the solution to all your problems.

0.Content: Brave warriors, you've finally made it! The Hypogeans have almost breached the town, you have to help us drive them back!

1.Content: You're gonna fight, too, old fella?

2.Content: I was a soldier back in the day, but I was severely wounded and forced to retire from military life. Once everything's in order, I'll be your support.

3.Content: I reckon you'll have a Hypogean corpse waiting for you by the time you arrive.

4.Content: No time like the present, let's go.

0.Content: Outsiders, stay away from this place...

1.Content: The Hypogean here...

2.Content: Your only chance to end this nightmare, is to kill the Mayor.

3.Content: Are you nuts? Our bounty is for protecting the town. If we kill the mayor, we kiss that bounty goodbye!

0.Content: What's the deal? How'd the Hypogean get so strong?

1.Content: My bullets don't work... Watch out, he's coming!

2.Content: Brave warriors, I'm coming! Pull back for now, we'll figure something else out!

3.Content: It's... You... Get back!

0.Content: Alright old fella, what's your deal with this Hypogean? Why didn't he attack you?

1.Content: Cool it, Kren.

2.Content: But... Don't you even think about playing tricks, old fella. Spit it out, bullets don't grow eyes.

3.Content: I... I don't know... Maybe it was the witch's doing...

4.Content: Witch?

5.Content: She lives just northwest of town, away from everyone.

6.Content: Northwest... This is bad! There are Hypogean heading that way, let's get moving!

0.Content: Darn it, seconds too late.

1.Content: Is this... a suicide note? She said there's an important item left at the camp.

2.Content: This place is in tatters, ain't nothing there.

3.Content: The Hypogean might've taken it. Come on, let's go snatch it back.

0.Content: This potion... It lets us walk on water.

1.Content: It seems the witch hid a clue in the lake.

2.Content: Well then, let's go to the lake.

0.Content: Check this out! A sword!

1.Content: Is this the witch's clue? What can a sword tell us?
The witch is delirious, just babbling and chanting "the sword in the lake".

2.Content: Let's go check out the lake for clues.

0.Content: Humans, you do not belong here.

1.Content: That's right, usually we're the ones sending people here.

2.Content: Wait... You're tinged with that sword's essence...

3.Content: The one in the lake, right?

4.Content: Killing the mayor with that sword will put an end to the Hypogeans here.

5.Content: What in blazes are you raving about?

6.Content: The mayor was once a hero who defended this town. Sadly, he died in battle long ago. The fatal blow he suffered came not from the Hypogean he fought, but from the townspeople he was sworn to protect. Corrupted by demonic temptation, they slew him.

7.Content: Is this a joke? We just met the mayor!

8.Content: His son could not accept such tragedy, thus he forged a pact with the Hypogeans to resurrect his father. The price was the mayor's resurrection as a Hypogean.

9.Content: And erase his memories at the same time?

10.Content: Killing the mayor will break the pact. The Hypogeans will also be weakened.

11.Content: Why should we believe you?

12.Content: Take the sword to the mayor, he will prove everything.

0.Content: This sword... I remember... This was the sword that dealt me the fatal blow back then...

1.Content: I see... I'm not seriously wounded... I'm dead.

2.Content: My child... This all started because of me, let me put it to an end...

0.Content: Father... Ahhhh!

1.Content: Let's put an end this.

2.Content: You better not forget my cut when you go claim the reward!

0.Content: My child, mother did her best...
Shoot, surrounded by flames!

1.Content: Go back and ask the old fella, he knows this place best, maybe he's got a solution.

0.Content: Back already! Have you wiped out the Hypogeans?

1.Content: Hmph. Why didn't you tell us there was fire ahead, old fella? My beard got singed!

2.Content: I'm truly sorry, my memory is waning with age. I have a bucket of water here, take it to extinguish the fire.

3.Content: I remembered there's a road nearby that leads to the lake. Let's mosey.

0.Content: Help! I'm being robbed!

1.Content: Did I imagine that? Was there a gust just now? That little green runt took everything...

2.Content: Gold necklaces, chunky gold watches, gold rings, and gold coins! The lot!

3.Content: (Squatting down to investigate) Clean execution, not a single coin left.

4.Content: In broad daylight! On a commercial road with people coming and going! The absolute audacity of this thief!

5.Content: Miss Raine, Mr. Fawkes, everyone said that you two find solutions to impossible problems, so surely you can help.

6.Content: (raises eyebrows) Oh?

7.Content: Please, you're my last hope, you have to help me!

8.Content: As long as we're paid, whatever.

9.Content: Every trader on this route has been shafted! Especially me! I slaved away and saved every single coin of gold myself, and he stole them all!

10.Content: I have a seriously ill brother, he's been bedridden for years, the fees to treat him are huge and I was saving to pay for it, but that little green bandit swiped it all!

11.Content: Please, Sir and Ma'am, the livelihood of a large family depends on me, you'll be remunerated...

13.Content: No discounts.

0.Content: I've laid a few traps along this trade route. They'll create an illusion of gold to lure the thief in.

1.Content: When he's drawn in, land a good blow to his head. Such a petty thief won't long forget such a beating, it's the simplest resolution.

2.Content: Yeah, beat him black and blue! Twice, if you have to!

0.Content: Lovely! Everything should be this easy!

1.Content: Slippery fella, runs faster than a feral hare.

2.Content: Ah! Gold! It's gold! He panicked and dropped quite a lot!

0.Content: Alright you little green punk, (loads gun) why don't you run? Keep on running.

1.Content: Now be a good little sport and return what you took from me. If even one penny is missing, Miss Raine here will put so many bullets in you, you'll make a fine sieve!

2.Content: Wait, what is this little green thief gibbering about? Got something to say?

3.Content: He said, his brother is seriously ill and bedridden, awaiting for money to cover treatment fees. He's hoping we'll spare him.

4.Content: ...Is it just me, or... does this all sound a bit familiar?

5.Content: Ahem.

6.Content: Move it, Raine. Don't forget, we have to meet our next client at The Noble Tavern later.

7.Content: It's the elder brother of the renowned Young Master Rowan.

8.Content: Huh? Brother? But isn't his brother bedridden?

9.Content: Haha, I'll go ahead!

0.Content: Good grief, this is way more profitable than business!

1.Content: If my family permits it, I want to become a bounty hunter, too!

2.Content: Talking nonsense, kid. Fawkes, call it a day. Kid, stay here and clean up.

3.Content: Got it!

0.Content: We're finally free of those pesky demons.

1.Content: The wind is whispering to me. Lightbearer troops stationed nearby seem to be in danger.

2.Content: That's the Frontier Regiment's banner.

3.Content: Let's go and investigate.

0.Content: My Wilder friends, how did you get here? Did you break through the demons' siege?

1.Content: The wind led us to you. Do you require assistance?

2.Content: We're here to strike at the demon stronghold located nearby. However, while we were marching, we became surrounded by demonic forces. Our only option is to stay put for now.

3.Content: The wind speaks to me, there is water and rations nearby. Perhaps we can clear a path for the regiment?

4.Content: Brilliant! I can spare you some of my men, they can help you on your way.

5.Content: They're currently garrisoned at five separate camps on the outskirts. Each camp can provide you with a soldier. Everyone else must remain to fend off the demons.

6.Content: Let's set off. The wind is urging me forwards.

0.Content: Water? See that lake over yonder? You can find all the water you need there, but demons are occupying the nearby land. Those damned demons won't even let us return to town!

1.Content: Also, how will you carry the water to the regiment?

2.Content: Help me clear the nearby area of demons and I'll open the town gate and send water to the regiment.

3.Content: You can count on us.

0.Content: Thank you for helping me open the gate to town. We'll send some water to the regiment.
Food? We have some left, but it won't last us very long.

1.Content: You see? Our wheat is nearly dead. The only source of water is to the west, but the demons are blocking the way.

2.Content: If you can help us clear a path to the water, we will gladly provide you with some of our grain.

3.Content: Leave it to us.

0.Content: Thank you for dealing with the demons. We'll send the regiment some of our grain.
What's that noise?

1.Content: Oh no! My crops!

0.Content: Huh?! It ducked!

1.Content: The smell of burning is carried on the wind. I hope nobody was hurt.

0.Content: Welcome! What can I do for you?

1.Content: Food? I can give you food, providing you have enough gold...

2.Content: No money? Sorry I'm afraid I can't help you.

0.Content: Welcome! What can I do for you?

1.Content: Food? I can give you food, providing you have enough gold...

2.Content: Deal! You guys take it easy now!

0.Content: Here's your food.
We need food in exchange for gold
Thank you for the food.
Thank you. All we have to do now is open the gate that leads to the demons' domain, and prepare for war.
Thank you for the water.
Thank you for all you have done. After a short rest, we'll set off and deal with the demons.
Help us find water and food, then open the gates to the demons' domain, and we will fight by your side.
Only one more to go!

1.Content: These demons shall feel the power of ice!

0.Content: Watch your step!

1.Content: The road has collapsed. Looks like we can't go back the way we came.

2.Content: Let's go into the town first and see if we can open the town's gate and return via the main road.

0.Content: Somebody burned our field, we only have enough food to feed ourselves.

1.Content: Hmm...

2.Content: It was most definitely those wretched demons!

3.Content: Leave here, outsider. There's no food for us to spare. Perhaps you can head North West to the other settlement and try your luck there.

0.Content: The demons' domain is just ahead.

1.Content: Messages carried by the wind are unclear. The demons ahead are strong, perhaps it's not the best time to attack.

2.Content: Agreed, victory is uncertain. Let's act carefully.

0.Content: My friends, we're here to assist you.

1.Content: My scout tells me the gate to the demons' domain is wide open. Leave the demons on its outskirts to us!

2.Content: Soldiers, attack!

0.Content: Too strong...

1.Content: Let's make a tactical retreat. We need the regiment's help.

0.Content: Thank you for the food.
Thank you. All we have to do now is open the gate that leads to the demons' domain, and prepare for war.
Thank you for all you have done. After a short rest, we'll set off and deal with the demons.
Thank you for the water.
Thank you. All we have to do now is open the gate that leads to the demons' domain, and prepare for war.
Thank you for all you have done. After a short rest, we'll set off and deal with the demons.
Although the gate is open, the regiment require food and water before they can advance.
Thank you for all you have done. After a short rest, we'll set off and deal with the demons.
The demons' domain is just ahead.

1.Content: Messages carried by the wind bring bad news. The demons ahead are strong, perhaps it's not the best time to attack.

2.Content: Agreed, victory is uncertain. Let's act carefully.

0.Content: Watch your step!

1.Content: The road has collapsed. Looks like we can't go back the way we came.

2.Content: Let's go into the town first and see if we can open the town's gate and return via the main road.

0.Content: Although the gate is open, the regiment require food and water before they can advance.
Huh?! It ducked!
The village ahead has been long corrupted by demonic forces. We must move with caution.

1.Content: Paying extra attention to where we step.

2.Content: Understood.

1.Content: What is it?

0.Content: It's worse than I thought. The stench of death has corrupted this whole region.

1.Content: Spectral Wastes?

2.Content: Yes. Mortals' bodies cannot safely traverse Spectral Wastes.

3.Content: Lucius, our investigation will take time. We must enter the village before night fall, there isn't much time left.

0.Content: Divine Beacons must simultaneously use two types of energy to be illuminated. Different types of energy can only be transmitted through the colored line with which it corresponds.
This energy hasn't been correctly activated.

1.Content: The valve must be adjusted.

0.Content: There's a problem here too, but it seems to be a different kind of problem.
It worked.

1.Content: Let's pass through as fast as we can.

0.Content: These are temple records. It clearly states around a hundred clerics were sent as reinforcement.

1.Content: How could this have happened to the village?

3.Content: It would seem that the reinforcements couldn't make it here during the time that the undead army were here.

1.Content: Lucius?

2.Content: Let's make haste. Time is of the essence.

0.Content: There's something afoot. The village is heavily corrupted by the undead scourge, how can there still be "residents"?

1.Content: Unless the residents are...

2.Content: (Lucius appears lost in deep thought, as if remembering something)

3.Content: It has to be them.

4.Content: Lucius.

0.Content: (Lucius notices silhouettes in the evening sun)

1.Content: A measure of great desperation. To survive... a steep price must be paid.

2.Content: So in the past you...

3.Content: (The figures behind the window seemed to sense something, and begun murmuring to one another)

4.Content: (The strange murmurs grew louder and closer from all directions)

5.Content: Look out!

0.Content: Mr Wake told me this one should be the knife throwing challenge?

1.Content: So, what happens next? If only I didn't owe him one...

2.Content: Forget it, who cares about him! I'll tell the whole world, not all Durri are small and easily bullied!

0.Content: It's hard to come by such an interesting reward, it's a shame Raine and that lot aren't here... I guess that's what happens when they run off without me!

1.Content: Well, next time I see them I'll definitely tell them, they'll be so jealous!

2.Content: But for now, it's time to put on a magnificent firework show!

0.Content: It's just as Mr Wake described. There seems to be a lot of stiff competition, too.

1.Content: Just as well, I'd been working on something new.... I'll use this opportunity to test it out.

0.Content: Nervous, Stitchy? I'm a little nervous. If I hadn't been invited by Mr Wake...

1.Content: But then I do need to find a good gift for mommy and daddy.... Let's try our best, Stitchy!

0.Content: Mr Wake says I can find strong opponents here.

1.Content: I hope he's not exaggerating. My blade will show no mercy to the weak.

0.Content: Mortals are always indulging in earthly pleasures. A weakness that we Graveborn can exploit!

1.Content: Enjoy it to your heart's content, mortals. This might be your last moment of pleasure.

0.Content: Mr Wake's right! This place is so much more fun than the Palace!

1.Content: My people! It's time for you to witness my performance!

0.Content: Performing on stage is one way to spread the word of the Divine Light, so says Mr Wake.

1.Content: I shall give it my all for the Divine Light, even for a performance none have ever seen before!

0.Content: As a butler, I am always busy. But I will make time to help an old friend who rarely asks for my help.

1.Content: I will set the pace precisely and properly, to bring maximum delight to the audience.

0.Content: Mr Wake said that even I have a chance to get out of this nightmare...

1.Content: Can you really make me feel that joy too...

0.Content: That kid may be here to watch this show.

1.Content: Even if the odds are slim, I'll seize this opportunity.

0.Content: What a fun day! I shall deliver victory to the King.

1.Content: Hedonistic humans, get ready for your souls are about to tremble.

0.Content: Mr Wake gave me leads about the Hypogeans. It's time to repay him now.

1.Content: By the Divine Light above, may the people here take the right path.

0.Content: The Chieftain says that performance and laughter fosters peace. But I'm afraid he may have been swindled by Wake.

1.Content: Alright. Everyone around me is having a good time. But I will guard the Chieftain as closely as ever.

0.Content: The fireworks here aren't powerful enough. Next time I'll bring some legit ones to put on a proper show!

1.Content: The magic show was very interesting. Too bad Wake wouldn't teach me.

0.Content: It's so fun! I want to form a circus in the Dark Forest too!

1.Content: I am going on stage now. Wish me luck!

0.Content: That fella who called himself Wake said this was once the favorite circus of the Rayne Family. Hmm, I won't be fooled by these things.

1.Content: But the decorations on the merry-go-round are so beautiful. I don't mind checking the place out.

0.Content: What a noisy bunch you are. How did you get into my tent?

1.Content: Wake promised me a quiet tent for a good night's sleep. Now you've ruined everything.

0.Content: Only the smartest clown can anticipate the King's temper.

1.Content: And the owner of this circus seems to know how to please a true king. Haha.

0.Content: Mr Wake says being the last one standing in the arena is another way to put your training to the test.

1.Content: I just want to see if, besides my master, there's anyone else in this world who can keep up with my mid-air transformation.

0.Content: We endure pain and torment because we cannot find eternal rest in the realm of the dead.

1.Content: But a mysterious man in a hat told me... I could find a way to break the curse of eternal life here.

0.Content: Astar snuck into the car for some fun, only to be discovered by the man with the hat, who offered to keep it quiet if Astar agreed to do him a favor.

1.Content: Easy peasy! Astar can handle anything with fire!

0.Content: Vulnerable souls gather, creating an opportunity for Hypogean-worshipping animals to blend in unnoticed.

1.Content: I'll be here, waiting for the sins lurking behind them to reveal themselves.

0.Content: In the circus, both good and bad rub shoulders... But no matter what, my blade will guard the Rayne family.

1.Content: A butler shouldn't be so ostentatious, but it sure wouldn't hurt if my blade struck fear into my enemies.

0.Content: Yo! You folks ain't from 'round here, are ya? You lookin' for Monique, too?

1.Content: Monique? Who?

2.Content: That there pretty little thing right across the way, heard she knows a lot about a lot, so folks come from far and wide to meet her.

3.Content: Excuse me, Miss Monique? Would you happen to know anything about any evil nearby?

4.Content: Evil? Can't say for sure... But I heard from my sisters there's some kind of pure-white flower blooming across the river, atop the snowy peak.

5.Content: They say the petals are as soft and white as the clouds in the sky, but the flower's stamen shimmers luminescent gold.

6.Content: If you kind folks have a way up that mountain peak, would you mind bringing it to me?

7.Content: We're incredibly busy people, we don't have time for gardening.

8.Content: Oh... One second, perhaps, should you be willing to trade with me, I can give you this in exchange for that flower?

0.Content: Looks pretty valuable, Fawkes.

1.Content: I just knew you'd say that...

2.Content: All that matters is that flower. Nothing matters more to me, and the value of this certainly can't compare with how I yearn for that bloom.

3.Content: You may thank the stars you can continue to operate...

4.Content: The river is just north of here, visible from the north gate.

0.Content: I haven't been back since I left the village, seems so long ago now. I really miss the red plums my father used to pick for me when I was a boy.

1.Content: So why not go back, then?

2.Content: You're an out-of-towner, right? The route back to the village has been cut-off for a good long time now, how would I make there it alone?

3.Content: That is to say, the town mayor promised year after year to repair it, but never did.

0.Content: Hey old boy, watch yourself! That bag on your back is pretty hefty, mind you don't trip!

1.Content: Thank ye, young'un... You look just like my son.

2.Content: Oi, I'm seriously concerned for you, what's with that critical tone?

3.Content: ... My apologies, it's just that this young'un reminds me of my son. Ever since he became that what's-his-face's Guardian, I've seen neither hide nor hair of him. He never returned.

4.Content: Ah... I'd go and see him myself, but the route through the mountains is long gone, so there's no point in earning any money to make the trip, I'd rather use that money to pay someone else to fix the way up.

5.Content: I'm sorry lass, you can take these oranges, consider it my apology to the pair of you.

0.Content: ... Returning a Moonstone like that, they're so hard to get hold of! How could she possibly dislike it?

1.Content: What on earth does she actually like!?

0.Content: Welcome to Chesterton, what brings you to these parts?

1.Content: We got word something sinister is lurking around here. Would you mind pointing us in the right direction?

2.Content: Sinister... Oh! You must be the legendary bounty hunter, Fawkes? Indeed there is something, but not here, oh no, it's across the river.

3.Content: You can't have known, but ever since the Hypogeans resurfaced, this town has been in constant danger, it's been going on for years! But you're here now, so please, cleanse this area of the lurking Hypogeans!

0.Content: Excuse me...

1.Content: Shh! ... Be quiet!

2.Content: What's his problem?

3.Content: Try asking again and find out.

0.Content: You're scaring away my fish! What the heck do you want!?

1.Content: Hey now! You're the one shouting!

2.Content: Here's the deal, we saw that the railroad up the southern mountain was washed away by the river, so do you know of any other way to get across?

3.Content: Some other way? Swim across, I guess? Pfft, no! No one here has wanted to go to the mountains for a long time, so no one has thought to fix the broken tracks.

4.Content: If you're serious about going up there, then I do have one suggestion.

5.Content: Stop beating around the bush. You want a favor, right? Just tell us what you want already.

6.Content: Well now, the young lady's got panache! Straight to the point, I like it.

7.Content: You see, I've been fishing here a goodly long while now and I'm parched! Fetch me some berries to slake my thirst, would you?

0.Content: Yes that's it, just what I like.

1.Content: Here you go.

0.Content: You wanna know how I came by this track? It was so long ago, I don't rightly recall! I just know it was flood season and stormy at the time, there wasn't a soul who bothered to come over here and look.

1.Content: Thanks to being out fishing at the time, I just so happened to stumble upon it. I had to get something out of this fishing trip, right? So I figured why not, and dragged it home.

2.Content: A stormy fishing trip? There really wasn't any special reason you were there?

3.Content: ... You're making too much noise! Just take what you wanted and get lost!

0.Content: So the lost track turned out to be here.

1.Content: Oi! What do you think you're doing, sneaking around here?

2.Content: Huh? Who's being sneaky? Why the heck did you hide this track here?

3.Content: Track? What's a track? This is a treasure that protects our tribe.

4.Content: Did I hear that right? Train tracks and protecting a tribe?

5.Content: Our tribe has always had an oracle! When disaster is upon us, only the Divine Moon can shelter us from harm!

6.Content: But there are evil beings hungrily lurking around outside, and there's the constant threat of floods. Seems to me like that track isn't protecting much of anything.

0.Content: By the Divine Light! Where'd you appear from? I remember the way up being swept away a long time back.

1.Content: You mean the southern railway track? Fawkes and I have fixed that right up.

2.Content: ... Well I never, this is truly unbelievable.

3.Content: Oh, don't get me wrong! I'm not pointing any fingers, in fact, I'm really grateful to you.

4.Content: Back when Chesterton was still just a village in its infancy, myself and some comrades of mine were guards there, keeping the southern route safe.

5.Content: But after the Hypogeans reared their ugly heads again, this little village in the sticks suffered for it. My comrades fell one after another trying to destroy the Hypogeans dwelling here.

6.Content: There was one guy, said he was going to get help, but once he was gone, he never returned. He probably didn't escape the Hypogeans' sinister clutches. So now, here I am, the last man standing guard.

7.Content: No one else wanted to put their lives on the line, and fear drove most of those early settlers away. The only ones left are those who can't stand to part with their land.

8.Content: Keeping the village safe from the Hypogeans meant removing the tracks to the village.

9.Content: Chesterton... that's the same name as the town back down the mountain.

10.Content: Hypogeans, you say? It just so happens we're on the hunt for those as we speak, so why not let us deal with it?

11.Content: Truly? If you were to destroy the Hypogeans... could I return to the village...?

0.Content: Bounty hunters, listen to me. I've left some things behind in that village, you may be able to make use of them.

1.Content: Back when I could still put up a fight, I hid some artillery near the Hypogeans territory. Sadly, the foul beast discovered me and I darn near lost my life.

2.Content: In fact, I never even got to take the gunpowder I prepped, right now it's still around the camp, you can help yourself to it.

3.Content: That's certainly a real help!

0.Content: Hey! Guess what the good news is?

1.Content: The Hypogeans have been eliminated, there's nothing more to fear. Danger's gone.

2.Content: I can't believe it, I never imagined... I always assumed it would remain a pipe dream, but now... I, I have to find my comrades and tell them!

0.Content: The tracks do indeed seem to have come to an end at Chesterton village.

1.Content: But check out this lever, it's so well-kept even after all this time. Someone's been maintaining things here.

2.Content: (Surprised) By the Divine Light, we've not seen visitors for years now! Did you come up the mountain?

3.Content: Travelers, you've come such a long way, please step inside and get out of the cold. Take a seat.

4.Content: No need for fuss, we've some matters to attend to.

5.Content: I see... Then, since you are here before me, does that mean the railway line that goes down the mountain... could it be... operational?

6.Content: I've been kept away from my son for such a long time, he used to love red plums. I wonder how he's doing.

7.Content: For the time being, not entirely.

8.Content: But trust us, it won't be much longer.

0.Content: Did you bring the flower?

1.Content: So, this is the snow lotus from the mountain top? It really is just as they say, as white as pure snow, a refreshing scent and an elegant form. My sisters were right! I absolutely must go and show them!

2.Content: ... No one can mock me for being an uncultured and uneducated swine anymore, surely?

3.Content: Oh, right, your reward. Here's the Moonstone, as promised. Please take it.

4.Content: Whatever way you cut it, this stone is worth more than that flower...

5.Content: Whatever.

0.Content: How dare you insult the oracle! Get out of here, before I beat you up!

1.Content: Unless you can find an object that looks more like the Divine Moon, don't you dare show yourselves back here!

2.Content: Perhaps I know where your precious Divine Moon happens to be.

3.Content: If... If you truly find the Divine Moon, we will give you our divine relic in exchange.

0.Content: This wouldn't happen to be the Divine Moon, would it?
The water! It's receded! I always said something was wrong before!

1.Content: Thank you. Since we have our Divine Relic back, we'll return this 'track' thing to its rightful owner.

0.Content: Finally made it. This commission sure is out in the sticks. Where did you even pick this one up?

1.Content: Thank the gods Mirael didn't tag along this time, otherwise we'd have had her ribbing and moaning the whole darn way.

2.Content: Is it really so bad? You usually seem to enjoy it.

3.Content: Besides which, the scenery along the way is nice and we can actually take the time to enjoy it, plus handling the monsters en route would be enough quench Mirael's curiosities. Once you've collected the bounty, drinks are on you at the Rustport bar...

4.Content: Alright, alright! Enough already, let's just go.

0.Content: Did you bring the flower?
Raine, look. Seems as if the tracks here were washed away by the river.

1.Content: Indeed, without the railway tracks it looks like our way up the mountain is a write off.

2.Content: Let's check the area for clues.

0.Content: Get lost! Let me fish in peace.
This'll let us keep going.
The tracks are broken here, we need to find another place to cross.
Looks like this isn't a route either.

1.Content: No, no, Fawkes, look! Just ignite the explosives by firing the cannon in front of it, the explosion will make a path forward, right?

2.Content: It sure will, but won't that cause other problems?

3.Content: It's not like we have any other way, so may as well give it a shot.

0.Content: The essence of evil here is incredibly strong.

1.Content: Guess we've found the commission we're going to complete.

2.Content: So what're we waiting for? I'll lead the way, let's go tear it up! Then we'll take its disgusting head and get ourselves a fat paycheck! I can't wait to see the look on Mirael's face.

3.Content: Don't be rash. We don't know anything about this evil creature, rushing in headfirst will only end in disaster, we should investigate the area first.

0.Content: Raine, take a look. It seems like man-made marks left here.

1.Content: Could it be related to the Hypogean territory we just passed?

2.Content: Get going, see if anyone nearby knows anything about the situation here.

0.Content: Hah! That's a whole lot of firepower! It's making me want to bring explosives on my next job!

1.Content: They've got nothing on Mirael's firepower, if she were here I wouldn't even bother using them.

2.Content: Tch, less bellyaching, more working! Let's complete the bounty objective and then we'll go tell the old man.

0.Content: What's with that expression? The job's done, right?

1.Content: I was just thinking, since we've come this far, may as well fix the tracks.

2.Content: Ain't any reward for this, not to mention folks might whine about this remote village being left without rescue for so long.

3.Content: (shrugs) Look Fawkes, I'm feeling charitable, why you raining on my parade?

4.Content: In that case, lead the way.

0.Content: Now I'll finally be able to keep pace with my sister's conversations.
Phew... After all that.

1.Content: After all so much running around, at least it wasn't was naught.

2.Content: Hah, this really has been an interesting experience. When we're back I'll try not to rub it in Mirael's face.

3.Content: Indeed, after all, it's quite something for a certain 'hot-tempered' someone to have been so charitable.

4.Content: Do you ever stop droning on?!

0.Content: When folks in the town got word of the train tracks operating again, they all went on living peacefully as if nothing had happened.

1.Content: The fisherman who'd been over at the bridge boarded the train himself at some point, making the trip back to the village.

2.Content: As it reached the guard's camp the sun was setting. He quietly alighted and slowly made his way over to the place he remembered so well.

0.Content: When the train finally pulled into the village, the residents who had long-awaited its return all let our rapturous cheers.

1.Content: Carrying their most precious possessions, they all clamored to board the train.

2.Content: Some are brimming with the anticipation of being reunited with relatives long-parted.

3.Content: Others were filled by a curiosity of the new and unknown sights ahead.

4.Content: Whether quietly or enthusiastically, I'm certain the long period of isolation here is at an end, soon to be another distant memory as a time of hope and renewed optimism roll in.

0.Content: General, we've arrived. Sunsetton is just ahead.

1.Content: Right. Snault is my former subordinate, you and I both know his character full well.

2.Content: Six months ago he suddenly cut contact with the Temple, so we're here to figure out what's going on.

3.Content: I've no clue on his current status... First thing's first, we should find him and speak with him.

0.Content: The town is nearby, I never expected a Graveborn ambush so close ...Seems this is not going to be an easy ride, Lucius.

1.Content: General, did you come running because you'd already surmised this would be the case?

2.Content: Just an inkling. When you've a lot of experience, even the slightest whiff is detectable from a distance.

3.Content: Snault is a fine lad, and supremely capable, but he's got a tendency to jump the gun... His over-eagerness has always worried me.

0.Content: Thank you! I was sure I was a goner...

1.Content: Without the Captain around, everyone's struggling with the Graveborn...

2.Content: This Captain you speak of, he wouldn't be called Snault, would he?

3.Content: Huh? How'd you know? Do you know the Captain?

4.Content: We're from the Temple. Snault hasn't been in contact with us for six months, so we're here to investigate.

5.Content: So that's how it is. We've been searching, too... The Captain suddenly disappeared one day, not a hint of warning he would. Even his nearest and dearest didn't know where he'd gone.

6.Content: We'll take a look around town, please lead the way.

7.Content: Sure. Please, help us out here. After the Captain vanished, the whole town's been on edge, and now even the Priest is going out of his mind.

0.Content: The Graveborn have already destroyed dozens of nearby villages, we've got refugees pouring in from all over. It's all going downhill...

1.Content: We may not have the Captain with us, but we can't just sit back and wait to die...

2.Content: Captain Snault had been leading defense against the Graveborn with Battering Rams, I wonder if they're still usable?

0.Content: ...Hah, hahaha, the Divine Light... The Divine Light can't save us now, don't you realize?

1.Content: He's deranged.

2.Content: Well, don't you? Once the sun goes down and darkness falls, death will bring our salvation!

3.Content: Have you any clue about Snault's whereabouts?

4.Content: Snault? Who's Snault? ...Isn't that him there?

0.Content: Snault, that fool...

1.Content: This peculiar woman has been lurking nearby for a long time, and even though the town is on the verge of collapse, she still sticks around.

2.Content: Madam, you mentioned Snault a moment ago, do you have any idea where he went?

3.Content: I don't know where he is, but... I do know how to end his suffering.

4.Content: Bring me "Unlife Essence" and a "Stone of Rot", I'll repay you with a gift.

0.Content: The sun will set and darkness will cover everything. Well then, we'd best gather more firewood.

1.Content: Is this what you need? (The Mysterious Witch hands you the crafted sword)

2.Content: Have fun.

0.Content: Thank the gods for your help, I thought I was surely going to die...
What's this?

1.Content: Don't touch it, it's imbued with a potent unlife essence, it can corrupt human minds.

2.Content: ...It would appear that it was deliberately dumped in the lake and barricaded to keep it out of reach.

0.Content: This is where the command center used to be... and where the Captain lived.

1.Content: People rarely come here since the Captain vanished.

2.Content: (Notebook discovered)

3.Content: This is... Snault's handwriting.

4.Content: "...This is the ninth wave of Graveborn we've repelled this year... Without support, my men and I can't hold out any longer... I have no choice now but to take a risk... If the legend of that mountain treasure is true, there's a chance I can turn things in our favor... hopefully."

5.Content: Mountain treasure? What...

6.Content: Soldier, where are the supplies and reinforcements the army allocated to Sunsetton? Didn't they arrive?

7.Content: No... We saw hide nor hair of any reinforcements...

8.Content: As my subordinate, Snault often rubbed folks the wrong way, he was too by-the-book for a lot of people. I never imagined that those same people would be unwilling to send him aid after he transferred to the sticks.

9.Content: That's just going way too far!

10.Content: (Silver amulet discovered)

11.Content: A Divine Light amulet. There's no way he'd have abandoned this...

12.Content: He must've been frantic...

13.Content: He'd lost faith in the Divine Light, that's why he put his hopes in some mountain treasure!

0.Content: (The refugees who had fled to this place from neighboring villages became mindless Graveborn, howling dreadfully as they lunged at everyone)

1.Content: How can this be... All the people the Captain and his men died protecting... They're here...

2.Content: Unlife essence has totally consumed this place. Get back friend, you should leave, everyone here is now Graveborn...

3.Content: But I've yet to discern if they chose to be.

4.Content: Make it snappy, Lucius. The sun's about to set and the odds are not in our favor.

0.Content: Here... a ritual to transform the people into Graveborn took place. These refugees chose to be transformed.

1.Content: But how... The Captain promised...

2.Content: The sun is setting and the long night has no morning. In the face of immeasurable despair, people are more cowardly than they think.

3.Content: They'll give up their freedom if it means they no longer have anything to fear... Such desperation is truly lamentable.

4.Content: Hmph, desperation, you say? I've spent years on the battlefield and as long as there is still breath in my body, I can fight, and never have I felt in plight.

0.Content: (Grubby token discovered)

1.Content: This is the Captain's token... How did it get here?

2.Content: Whatever the reason, Snault must have come here. Everything here is undead, so what is he doing here?

0.Content: (Even though the other party has become an evil spirit, Lucius still found traces of their former friend)

1.Content: (Snault lets out a guttural growl, all traces of his humanity long since gone)

2.Content: Captain?

3.Content: Snault.

4.Content: Look at the state of you, Snault... Look at what you've become for these cowards...

5.Content: (Turning to Lucius and his entourage) Since you are his friends, please put Snault out of his misery. I'll offer you this gift in return.

0.Content: (Plunging the Felblade into Snault's skull, with one blood-curdling scream, the evil spirit once known as Snault dissipates and vanishes into thin air)

1.Content: Why... Snault, can you tell me why?

2.Content: (Lucius falls to this knees in pain, but the dead offer no answers)

3.Content: He's already gone...

0.Content: They both bear the burden of Snault's past. Perhaps... we try one last time.
(Even though the other party has become an evil spirit, Lucius still found traces of their former friend)

1.Content: (Snault lets out a guttural growl, all traces of his humanity long since gone)

2.Content: Captain?

3.Content: Snault.

4.Content: I knew all along that mysterious necromancer was up to no good! 'Mountain treasure' my foot! It was a stone that corrupts souls! All along his aim was propagate necromancy, he concocted that legend to draw people in.

5.Content: Only a fool like you would believe such baseless nonsense...

6.Content: By the Divine Light above, Snault, awaken!

0.Content: (The Purification Stone seems to have some effect)

1.Content: (As the unlife essence dissipates slightly, Snault regains a glimmer of lucidity)

2.Content: As long as I'm here, darkness will find no foothold in this town...

3.Content: Captain?

4.Content: Snault.

5.Content: General... I'm so sorry. And Lucius, I never thought that our next meeting would be under such circumstances...

0.Content: Achoo!! Ugh, Tasi, it's really cold here, almost everything is covered in snow... Are you sure this is the right place?

1.Content: That's strange... According to the dream, this should be a lush grassland.

2.Content: But now there's not a soul around. Huh? Tasi, do you see that tent? Doesn't it look like there's someone there?

3.Content: Spot on as always, my dear Pippa! Let's go ask them!

0.Content: Excuse me...

1.Content: Questions not permitted.

2.Content: Waahaaa, that's so mean...

3.Content: Talking squirrels and butterflies, you look like the folks the witch spoke of...

4.Content: Squirrels and butterflies...? You're so rude!

5.Content: ... My apologies, I spoke out of turn. Heroes from afar, I implore you to hear me out and aid me in my journey to save a person from prison.

6.Content: Prison? No way I'm saving any bad guys!

7.Content: Wow, this is exactly what I saw in the dream. Is the person you're talking about a cute little girl with big eyes?

8.Content: It's not like that. She's the innocent princess of a neighboring land, entangled in a conspiracy. Because of my weakness, we became separated, and now she's being held in prison.

9.Content: Pippa knows how that feels! I was separated from my best friend Raku when I went to the Astral Academy... Tasi, can we help him at all?

10.Content: Of course Pippa, that's why we're here! Don't you remember? The guide in the dream was a pretty girl with big eyes.

11.Content: In the dream, she was separated from someone very important to her. This kind of suffering is precisely the kind that Ezizh revels in! So it's up to me, Tasi, to stop this from happening!

12.Content: You have my undying gratitude, friends. However, the lakes and main roads here have all been enchanted with ice magic by the most powerful witch in our land, as you may have seen already.

13.Content: The moment you step on the ice, you'll slide right across. It's impossible to stop part-way or walk carefully over it.

14.Content: No wonder it's so much colder in here than outside! Pippa even feels a cold coming on... Achoo!!

15.Content: This sounds like so much fun! Don't fret, loyal soldier, we shall help you bust your princess out!

0.Content: This lake really is completely frozen over.

1.Content: It looks solid enough, we can slide right the way down it.

2.Content: Let's hope it really is sturdy enough! We don't want to fall in!

0.Content: Wow! Tasi, look how busy the town is! There're so many people! I wonder if there's anything tasty here to eat, we've been walking for ages! So hungry...

1.Content: Wait a moment Pippa, something about that place seems a little off...

2.Content: Oi! You two there! Have you seen someone that looks like this? (Pulls out a portrait)

3.Content: Huh? Isn't that...

4.Content: (Rushes to cover Pippa's mouth with her hand) This is our first time here, there's no way we could've seen them!

5.Content: If you haven't seen them then get lost, you're in the way! Get searching!

6.Content: We're all in serious trouble if he gets away!

7.Content: Tasi, isn't that picture the loyal soldier we were just talking to?

8.Content: So it would seem... And those folks have a Hypogean taint... They've definitely come into contact with Ezizh! Whoever he sees in his dreams becomes an evil minion!

9.Content: Pippa, I think we should knock them out! Lest they grab the soldier whilst we're not around!

10.Content: But, Tasi, aren't we supposed to be rescuing the princess? Besides, those guys don't look like pushovers...

0.Content: Waaahaaa...! Tasi, what do we do!? The bad guys have caught us!

1.Content: What a ridiculous rabble, lock them up!

2.Content: Huh? We're in prison? So, wouldn't that mean... we can find the princess?

0.Content: What a ridiculous rabble, lock them up!

1.Content: Waaahaaa...! Tasi, the bad guys caught us again!

2.Content: It doesn't matter how many times they catch us, we'll break out every time!

0.Content: That's right! Totally! Just here!

1.Content: Did you see, Pippa? Those high white walls just visible in the distance! If you move in that direction, you can rescue the innocent princess!

2.Content: So what are we waiting for? The princess needs our help right now!

0.Content: Pippa, are you going the right way? I feel like we're moving further away from our destination.

1.Content: (Scratching her head) Pippa's senses chose this way, but why...

2.Content: Well, never mind! Getting lost is just part of the fun! Who knows what amazing things we might find!

3.Content: Alright, I guess I can go along with that, but, are you doing this deliberately?

0.Content: Just look around at all this negativity, Ezizh has surely been up to something here!

1.Content: Who are you? Why are you here in this dank, gloomy place?

2.Content: I've finally found you, girl from my dream!

3.Content: We've been tasked with freeing you of this awful place! Now we've finally found you, it's time to get you out!

4.Content: Oh, so that's it... What a pain for you both. I'm afraid I can't leave here alone, I'm very sorry...

5.Content: Silly girl, why don't you make a break for it? You have such a great chance!

6.Content: When I was locked up here, my beloved fought off the soldiers... But now I've no clue where he is, I can't simply abandon him.

7.Content: If you can, won't you please help me find him? Of course, you're free to walk away from my request if it's too much of a hassle for you...

8.Content: I don't get why the princess is being kept in this place?

9.Content: As a princess of a neighboring country, I was sent to this country by my father to be married off. One day, I was waiting to meet the prince of this country, my future husband. I never imagined that on that day I would be inexplicably imprisoned here.

10.Content: Wow! So who is your beloved?

11.Content: He was my personal guard, responsible for my safety when I came to this country. He wasn't remarkable, but he was very considerate and showed great empathy for me when I was alone in this country.

12.Content: (Pondering) Is the person you're talking about tall and thin with brown hair...

13.Content: Yes, that's him!

14.Content: Huh? Doesn't that mean the soldier who entrusted us to help you is your beloved?

15.Content: Really? Then he's safe! Knowing that is truly enough for me!

16.Content: Let's not dally longer, we need to get out of here and fast! You need to be reunited with your loyal soldier!

0.Content: Princess! Thank the gods above, you have been through a lot. Truly this is the greatest of fortune, I couldn't bear to face you if I were to meet you in death...

1.Content: Thanks to you both for returning the princess safely to me, I am forever indebted to you. When this mess is behind us, you can call upon me at any time, I will come to your aid.

2.Content: Goodness me, that's not important! The princess has told us that this country is no good! Suddenly imprisoning the soon-to-be-wed princess!

3.Content: That's right! Their prince is bad, too! He's never even seen the princess before! He might even be the mastermind behind this!

4.Content: (Wanting to keep talking)

5.Content: Getting out of here is the first priority! Pippa and I will watch out for the guards pursuing you!

6.Content: Right! We just have to go southeast, there are trustworthy people there who can guide us. Once we get there, we'll be safe.

0.Content: I thought it was suddenly really busy, but it's just you. How was your trip?

1.Content: Greatest respects to you, Witch, thank you for your guidance. Some kind people thankfully came along, and everything has been fine since.

2.Content: It was nothing, besides which it's my duty.

3.Content: Pippa had fun, too! So much fun that even Raku would be green with envy!

4.Content: Well then, do not forget our agreement.

5.Content: How could I forget? But I can't leave just yet. I'm sorry, but please take care of the princess.

6.Content: What... What does that mean?

7.Content: I'm sorry princess, but I, too, have a duty to fulfill.

8.Content: But don't worry about me, I will return!

9.Content: ... I understand. I'll be waiting for you. You must return to me safely.

0.Content: It's been so long, I didn't expect to find any more mice here.

1.Content: One does not simply strut away from me. It's not so simple.

0.Content: You know Pippi, coming to this super cold place in such wintery weather and not staying indoors eating roasted sweet potatoes sure is a thrilling...

1.Content: You really don't have a clue, do you? This is the best place to be right now!

2.Content: Just like an amusement park! It's like, how would you say, coming out of your Nutshell Nook shell? The world outside is so big, Raku! You need to see more of it!

3.Content: Bestie Pippi, you sure know a lot about the world!

4.Content: Welcome, welcome! My furry friend here sounds like an expert! Our exciting garden of riddles has just opened up!

5.Content: The rules will be explained after entering, but the gist of it is, every one of our fabulous adventurers will work together to explore, traversing islands and uncovering the many secrets of the Icy Garden!

6.Content: (A sly glint flashes in the astute businessman's eye) This way, please!

7.Content: Um, I can't quite say why, but something feels... off...

0.Content: Woah, everything's spinning!

1.Content: Fabulous adventurers, this conveyor is a one-way ride! Retracing your steps backward is strictly prohibited, you must forge directly ahead at all times!

0.Content: I'm as light as a feather! My hat's going to fly off!
I'm as light as a feather! My hat's going to fly off!
Woah, everything's spinning!

1.Content: Fabulous adventurers, this conveyor is a one-way ride! Retracing your steps backward is strictly prohibited, you must forge directly ahead at all times!

0.Content: What a smart furry friend! You've already got the knack of it!

1.Content: By operating this Miraculous Lever, you can change the direction of the conveyor belt!

2.Content: However... only the first go is free!

3.Content: Wait wait wait, only the first go is free? ...What about after that?

4.Content: We'll discuss that later on. (Our astute businessman snickers) For now, keep on exploring!

0.Content: Once you've successfully made your way off an island, you'll receive some gold coins.

1.Content: This is your reward for departing the island!

2.Content: One, two, three, four... wow, there must be about 100 gold coins here!

3.Content: Not bad at all! And you whole-heartedly deserve it! More excellent rewards await you!

0.Content: From now on, every turn of the Miraculous Lever will cost 800 gold coins.

2.Content: ... WOAH! Wait a second! Eight HUNDRED?! But, that means, all the gold coins we won...

3.Content: To come so far just to turn back again, truly I feel the deepest of sympathy for you, alas!

0.Content: You made it to the final area! The final treasure you seek is here somewhere, fabulous adventurers!

1.Content: However...

2.Content: Yeah yeah, I know... 800 gold coins to turn the Lever.

3.Content: Afraid not. This is a very remote location, off the beaten track. If you want to get there, it's an extra fee.

4.Content: It's not much, the admission ticket is just 50 gold coins per person, and a roundtrip is a mere 500 gold coins each.

5.Content: ... Raku, I... I'm not dreaming, am I? For the next few days...

6.Content: We'll really have to stick to eating baked sweet potatoes in Nutshell Nook for a while...

0.Content: Fawkes, how much farther? The commission says the forest here suddenly froze over. I'd say there's probably a restless Ice Elemental running amok.

1.Content: Why'd I have to take such a boring bounty? Hunting the forces of darkness, now that's our bread and butter!

2.Content: C'mon, you know those kinds of jobs aren't always available. Don't forget, a bounty hunter has to put food on the table too.

3.Content: Good, we've arrived.

4.Content: Damnit! Is that the ice they mentioned? The whole darned forest is frozen over!

5.Content: I've got a hunch that this job is going to be far trickier than I'd anticipated. Raine, stay frosty!

6.Content: There's a person up ahead. Let's gather some intel first.

0.Content: Ah! Who goes there?

1.Content: We're travelers passing through the region. What's happened to this place?

2.Content: Since the ice appeared, the able-bodied townsfolk all left.

3.Content: Why'd you stay?

4.Content: I'm old, I can't get about easily as I once did, and I don't want to leave this place.

5.Content: This is my home, I grew up here, I know of nowhere else. Where would I go? I just want to stay a little longer until it completely disappears...

6.Content: Turn back, travelers. There are many dangers within these woods. If you value your lives, turn back.

7.Content: (The old man turns away and heads into his tent and closes the door.)

8.Content: Could it be nefarious forces at work? They'll soon get a taste of my hot lead.

9.Content: Let's not get ahead of ourselves, Raine. I have a feeling he was hiding something...

10.Content: Let's see what lies ahead. A bounty hunter never leaves empty-handed.

0.Content: Outlanders, you tread on land where you do not belong. Once you enter this forest, you'll never leave again.

1.Content: An enemy!

2.Content: Well, here we go again.

0.Content: This foe is too strong. Let's make a tactical retreat.

1.Content: There's some kind of peculiar power protecting them. My bullets have no effect.

2.Content: This force... it seems to be consistent with the ominous force that hangs over this forest.

3.Content: Perhaps the answer to the frozen forest lies with the peculiar force these foes seem to possess.

4.Content: They ventured deep into the heart of the forest. Let's track 'em!

0.Content: You're still here?

1.Content: You never told us there were monsters lurking here.

2.Content: You stumbled across those monsters, and you escaped with your lives? Perhaps you'll be able to fix the Magic Circle...

3.Content: Magic Circle?

4.Content: This is not the first time the forest has frozen over, but it was never as severe as it is now. A god passed through this way and placed some of their feathers within the Magic Circle, removing this frozen curse.

5.Content: A few months ago, a vile group of twisted monsters appeared. They laid waste to the Magic Circle and scattered the god's feathers to the wind. It was from that day onward that the forest gradually began to freeze over.

6.Content: Brave travelers, please help me fix the Magic Circle! Only by finding the six scattered feathers can we restore balance to the forest.

7.Content: If the forest is returned to normal, will the townsfolk return?

8.Content: If there's hope, they'll return. After all, home is where the heart is.

9.Content: And please, before you head out, use the hot spring nearby to warm yourselves up.

0.Content: Fawkes, the forest... it's the same as before.

1.Content: Seems just using the Magic Circle isn't enough. The changes are already too drastic.

2.Content: After realigning the Magic Circle, I feel another elemental imbalance. Could it be so?

3.Content: Yes. The forest has frozen over yet again. Was it you who was responsible for the Magic Circle's creation?

4.Content: Yes. Come through the portal and meet me.

5.Content: Yes, let's talk face to face.

0.Content: Just as you said, the Magic Circle is no longer able to keep the cold at bay. The elemental imbalance is even greater than ever.

1.Content: Elemental imbalance?

2.Content: Correct, elements that are not evenly distributed in a region cause the all elements to lose their equilibrium. The water elements in that forest are extremely active, causing it to completely freeze over. The Magic Circle I created was supposed to keep the cold at bay.

3.Content: Over the last few years, elemental imbalances have become more frequent throughout the world. Perhaps something big is happening. I'm currently looking for more clues as to its cause.

4.Content: I can't speak about other regions, but I suspect the imbalance here may be a result of someone's meddling.

5.Content: (Fawkes explains to Talene about the incident that occurred with the Mysterious Man.)

6.Content: I see. I shall accompany you.

0.Content: The forest has been returned to normal. It would appear that the Mysterious Man was responsible for the ice. I expect the townsfolk will soon return.

1.Content: It would seem our work is done. Talene, we're heading back to the empire to claim our reward. Would you come with us and share a drink or two? And while you're there, perhaps you could show our fiery friend what a real fire looks like? Heheh.

2.Content: This is where we part ways. There are greater matters I must attend to.

3.Content: The anomaly causing the elemental imbalances is growing ever worse. I must act fast.

4.Content: Farewell. Let's get outta here, Fawkes. It's time to go claim our bounty!

0.Content: All in good time. Before we head back, let's go back to that tent.
You're right. That old man definitely knows something...

1.Content: Onwards!

0.Content: You are indeed strong. Let's talk about what's happening to the forest.
Have you calmed down yet? Let's talk about what's happening to the forest.
It's been a long time, Solaris Flare.

1.Content: The elemental imbalance grows ever stronger, Talene. When the final day comes, what choice will you make?

0.Content: It seems a fierce battle occurred here.

1.Content: Yes, it's as if the earth has been scorched by two different types of flame.

0.Content: These marks...

1.Content: I once fought with a demon here.

0.Content: ...What's going on? Where am I?

1.Content: This place is the sanctum of your innermost thoughts and feelings.

2.Content: Framton? No, you're not him. Who are you?

3.Content: I'm the culmination of your Inner Demons, the Nightmares that keep you up at night. Your fears, your terrors, all of that has made me appear in his form, here before your very eyes.

0.Content: Look around you. Fear, blame, regret... all these suppressed emotions concealed within your Innermost Sanctum, transforming into Clouds of Doubt, eroding your Innermost Sanctum bit by bit.

1.Content: If you let those Clouds consume every last vestige of this place, you'll slip into a state from which you'll never recover.

2.Content: For so many years I was blinded by my lust for vengeance... But no more.

3.Content: Hold fast to hope, and Mental Clarity will grace us with the light to dispel the Clouds' darkness.

0.Content: Your struggle will be all in vain. I've already become one with your Innermost Sanctum - unless you find some way to defeat me, your life will be spent in eternal anguish.

1.Content: The successor of the Solaris Flare will never succumb to the darkness!

0.Content: I will purge my Inner Sanctum of this malign scum! Amidst the gloom and the darkness, I shall be reborn anew!

1.Content: Reborn or lost in anguish... I await the result with great anticipation.

0.Content: Cleansed of Inner Demons, the Inner Sanctum is finally at peace.

1.Content: Now the source of the Clouds has been destroyed, I can feel my Inner Sanctum slowly recovering.

2.Content: But... something is still missing. I have a suspicion that I must dive deeper into my memories to completely eradicate the Clouds that loom once and for all.

0.Content: Cleansed of Inner Demons, the Inner Sanctum is finally at peace.

1.Content: Now the source of the Clouds has been destroyed, I can feel my Inner Sanctum slowly recovering.

0.Content: This is the Fortitude Forge, a place born from my past struggles.

1.Content: Here, you can constantly push yourself to your limits, and strengthen your fortitude.

0.Content: What awful luck! Roaming through a nasty cold place like this again... I really hate the cold!

1.Content: Deary me! Young lady, you're walking terribly quickly. Mind you don't set off any "contraptions" in your hurry.

2.Content: Sorry gramps... Don't you think it's too cold to live here? There's slippery ice all over the ground, too! I just fell flat on my face! ...Achoo!

3.Content: Heh heh, many wonderful new ideas are born in such remote, quiet places. The harsh environment doesn't bother me much. My attention is turned to the creation of miraculous wonders.

4.Content: You sound a lot like the old fossils... er, I mean, old teachers back at the Astral Academy.

5.Content: When I was there, the teachers used to say I was too impulsive and didn't learn anything, they told me I should spend the whole day in silence studying!

6.Content: Heh heh, well, just as not everyone has the aptitude for the arcane, not everyone learns in silence.

7.Content: But what others think doesn't matter, pay them no mind. After all, a young lady like yourself is still a bouncy cutie pie, isn't that so?

8.Content: Gramps reminds me a lot of old Arden, I really like you, Gramps!

9.Content: Don't you worry! I'll make sure you get home safely!

0.Content: Oh boy, there are so many glaciers here...! And it doesn't seem like there's any way through.

1.Content: I have to think of a way to get past.

0.Content: Deary me. I've been looking for you for an awfully long time, young lady. You were here all along!

1.Content: Here's a little thank you gift, you can come by and play whenever you want!

2.Content: Wow! This hot air balloon is huge!

0.Content: (Adjusts her glasses) I was a student of the Astral Academy, and this looks to me like teleportation magic! Simply step through this gateway and voila! You'll be magically transported out the other side elsewhere.

1.Content: Although, this appears to be a one-way teleporter. You can't come back through the same portal! Also, you can only teleport between teleporters of the same color.

2.Content: (Strokes beard with a smile) The young lady here certainly has learned a great deal.

0.Content: I remember this summoning gateway being icy blue before... did I make a mistake while freezing my tail off?

1.Content: (Smiling broadly) You are not mistaken. The color changed because of the contraption we just used, which cut it off the ray of icy light that had been shining on it.

0.Content: I call this an elemental summoning gateway. Depending on the elemental preference it is given, it will summon forth that element.

1.Content: Uh... So that means, I can use it to summon fire right now, yes?

2.Content: Heh heh, indeed. You're such a clever young lady.

3.Content: This is way easier than the summoning magic they taught at the Astral Academy! You're a bona fide genius, Gramps!

0.Content: These woods are a real nuisance. If Mirael was here she'd have burned it down to the ground already.

1.Content: Wait a sec... If I burn the woods down, a new path will appear!

2.Content: Now that sounds quite dangerous. Let's hope nobody else tries to copy you.

3.Content: I'm pondering whether there's a better way or not...

4.Content: Perhaps the Fire Elemental can lend me a hand?

5.Content: This is a fantastic idea!

0.Content: Thank you, young lady, for helping this old chap get back home.

1.Content: My pleasure! Old Arden always said I should try to help people as best I can. So, I'm just doing what I can... Achoo!

2.Content: Such a kind child! Unfortunately I don't have anything I can give you...

3.Content: Hmm, perhaps I have something in my backyard you'll take find interesting. Choose something to take home with you.

4.Content: Thanks a bunch Gramps! I really appreciate it!

0.Content: I found a huge balloon! I'm not sure how to make it fly!

1.Content: I want to take it back to the Dark Forest and show it to Raku so he can experience flying in the sky, too!

0.Content: Hey Gramps, I found this out back, did you lose this?

1.Content: Let me take a look... It has writing on it, "northwest", "by the single glacier"... Oh, now I remember. This is a note I lost a very long time ago.

2.Content: What do "northwest" and "by the single glacier" mean?

3.Content: I likely put something at this location at the time I wrote this note. If you're interested, why not go have a look, young lady? Consider it a token of my thanks.

0.Content: Here it is! So this is what the fuss was about!

1.Content: Oh boy, Raku really missed out on a super fun adventure this time!

0.Content: Whoa! A bunch of weirdos suddenly appeared from nowhere! Gave me a real fright!

1.Content: Listen up, old timer! You better give us what we want, there's some nice stuff in there. Hurry up, otherwise we'll get rowdy!

2.Content: No need to be impulsive, you can have whatever you want. Those weapons you're flailing about look quite dangerous.

3.Content: That's right! You're spot on, boss! Someone who lives in this kind of hellscape has to be using it to hide a tonne of valuables!

4.Content: You're not getting anything with me here!

5.Content: Where'd the tree rat come from? Get lost, rodent.

0.Content: Ugh! Who'd have thought a furry runt like that would hit so hard!

1.Content: Who do you think you're calling a runt!? Looks like you haven't learned your lesson yet! Good thing I'm here to school you scumbags!

2.Content: Hey! Boss! Wait for us, boss! Don't leave us!

0.Content: Wonderful! We're so lucky you brought water! The drought here this year is so severe that our only source of water has dried up. Without water, there's no telling what'll become of this place.

1.Content: We're just following the nature spirit's guidance to bring water, no need to thank us...

2.Content: There must be other places around suffering from the drought, no need to explain. Please hurry on your way.

3.Content: Well, we...

4.Content: We can take care of ourselves now we've got this water, go save the others!

0.Content: Why're you back?

1.Content: Because we...

2.Content: Pulling down the lever can change the direction of the railroad track, go try it.

3.Content: Remember! Disaster waits for no one. Action must be swift!

0.Content: Antandra, wait for me! Wait—Wait for me! Antandra!

2.Content: Antandra, why don't you say something? What's on your mind?

3.Content: I was thinking, these tracks don't look to have a certain direction.

4.Content: Darn, what a hassle. Let's just give the lever a pull and see what happens! Keep it simple.
