5.Content: ...You've been chattering incessantly since the get go, and you've been doing things without caution... I very much doubt that it was Numisu who sent you to deliver water, am I right?

6.Content: Of course he sent me!

7.Content: (Muttering) If you weren't being so weirdly cold, Antandra, I wouldn't have had to keep thinking of ways to spice up the atmosphere around here...

8.Content: ...Fine. But if you have time to talk, you've got time to deliver water, so move it.

9.Content: I know I know!!

10.Content: There's a tunnel ahead, I wonder what'll be on the other side?

11.Content: Come, let's go find out.

0.Content: Seems the track ahead hasn't been lowered.

1.Content: You're right, Antandra! You have excellent eyesight! But, now what?

2.Content: There'll be a switch somewhere nearby, let's go find it.

0.Content: Water, we finally have water! You're our saviors!

1.Content: Now now, there's nothing to thank us for! We're just following the nature spirit's orders.

2.Content: What's this about gods and spirits? I've been coming to this supply point for three days and you're the only ones I've seen bringing water.

3.Content: I'm sorry... I was late.

4.Content: Oh my, whatever are you saying, lass? My hope was all but gone, so I'm really grateful to see you folks show up.

5.Content: It took us longer than it should've to get here, the transports links aren't exactly convenient.

6.Content: You're not wrong, don't fret. Things here in the sticks are a bit different than that abundant oasis, Dura's Gift, you folks hail from. We don't have a lot going for us here. As for these gods or spirits or whatever you mentioned, I haven't ever seen any.

7.Content: That's why when the Hypogean descended, our ancestors knew you didn't have the spare hands to help us out, thus they built this simple railway track. It was the best way we smaller clans out here could send support to each other.

8.Content: These supply points are the same ones that we've always used to send supplies and information to one another with.

9.Content: That said, there's still plenty to lament. We got our fair share of bandits around these parts, but even here it's an unspoken rule that these supply points are a safe zone.

10.Content: Don't sweat! I'm on the case! I'll get water to all those supply points.

0.Content: Ah! The track broke! How'd that even happen...?

1.Content: The years without maintenance combined with the dry climate and hot weather... It's not that unthinkable.

2.Content: Alright, but then how exactly will we get to the next station?

3.Content: We can take a look around for help, but if that's a dead end then we'll have to go back.

4.Content: But I promised that local man...

5.Content: I've been telling you forever not to make promises you're not certain you can keep.

6.Content: ...I'm sure I can resolve this!

0.Content: I'm back! Here are the things you asked for.

1.Content: And water.

2.Content: Hoho! Well done, I'll fix it for you.

0.Content: Antandra, take a look. The tunnel is pitch black, but it kind of looks like there may be a fork in the tracks.

1.Content: If the path does split, could a shortcut appear by finding the right line of track to merge onto?

2.Content: Good idea, Antandra! Let's give it a go!

0.Content: Wow! We actually did it! All the water has been delivered! I'm exhausted...

1.Content: It wasn't Numisu that sent you on this water delivery errand, but you decided to do it yourself, right?

2.Content: How'd you figure it out...

3.Content: You know even less about this place than I do, you don't even have a map. If Numisu sent you here, he'd have to have told you first, wouldn't he now?

4.Content: I just...

5.Content: You did good.

6.Content: I just... Huh? Antandra, did you just compliment me?

7.Content: Ahem. Well, you still have a lot to learn, so after today... make sure you keep doing your best.

8.Content: Hey, hey! You mean you're not going to get rid of me? Hey - don't go! Antandra, answer meeeee! Hey, waaaaait! ...

0.Content: Whoa! Antandra, look at the setup here, it looks like a Smithy.

1.Content: Yeh, an abandoned one.

2.Content: Maybe there's still someone around?

3.Content: There certainly is! But if you two don't give me a good reason for breaking into my house you'll be in for it!

4.Content: D-D-Don't get the wrong idea! We come to deliver water, but the tracks broke, so we wanted to ask for help...

5.Content: I do work with iron, but not to repair railroad tracks. You've got the wrong guy.

6.Content: Wait a second, you work with iron, tracks are iron, it's fine... Yeh, totally fine...

7.Content: Interesting, you young little girl. You said you're here to deliver water? First time I've come across such a thing. I didn't think any outsiders were coming to this damned place anymore.

8.Content: How about this. You leave the water here and go collect the materials I need, then I'll help you fix the tracks.

9.Content: Deal!

0.Content: Here lies the ruins of Bonnpei.

1.Content: Finally! I'm sick of drilling through all these walls!

2.Content: You should've just listened to me at the start! Blasted through the outer wall with one good BLAM! A real stylish entrance!

3.Content: Oh please, you really think these rickety bricks and tiles would handle the blast? You wanna be buried in rubble?

4.Content: If you hadn't mentioned treasure, I wouldn't have even come to this dark, damp and dismal hellhole!

5.Content: As long we get that loot, I can deal with being a gutter rat for a while. Okay, let's go.

0.Content: Phew... Just gotta shift this batch of goods and I'll be raking it in.

1.Content: Time's getting on, better get home and get to bed.

0.Content: Finally home.

1.Content: *Yawn*...

2.Content: Hopefully I'll sleep like a baby tonight.

3.Content: (Andersson puts out the lamp, muttering to himself, and then drifts into a silent slumber)

0.Content: Wha... Where am I?

1.Content: Andersson! Move it! They've got us surrounded!

2.Content: Vincent? Where'd you come from? And who are 'they'?

3.Content: Hans, Bill, Carlsson and their lot! They're gonna take your property!

4.Content: But why? ...They're my friends!

5.Content: Yeah, they used to be! 'Til you got rich.

6.Content: But now? How can those peasants possibly be friends with a hotshot like you? You're all boys from the same poor village, but somehow only you struck it rich?

7.Content: You think you're helping them with your charity? In their eyes, your donations are just pity handouts.

8.Content: Look into their eyes. Jealousy, mockery, hate. These aren't the eyes of friends.

9.Content: It's too late! There's no escape.

10.Content: No one is getting... a single penny from me!

0.Content: A dream? ...What an awful dream.

1.Content: But, their faces were so real...

2.Content: I'm probably overworked and exhausted. Perhaps I should take some time out, spend a few days back in my old hometown in the north.

0.Content: Andersson? Andersson! It's been so long! I hardly recognize you!

1.Content: Long time no see...

2.Content: Bill and the others said you've made a killing in town!

3.Content: No no, they're exaggerating.

0.Content: What's happened? Didn't I already make it home?

1.Content: Huh? What on earth are you talking about? You need to cross the valley. Be careful out there, someone's set a trap.

2.Content: They're fond of solitary wandering piggy banks like yourself.

3.Content: The prisms on those tracks might keep me safe for a while, I just need to get home and I'll be safe.

0.Content: Think you'll be safe once you're home? That's very naive.

1.Content: Everyone wants your riches for themselves, Andersson.

2.Content: There's no escape.

3.Content: No... no!

0.Content: Everyone wants your riches for themselves, Andersson.

1.Content: You'll never reach safety, never...

0.Content: It's not safe here, everyone's out to get me!

1.Content: I have to hide... Somewhere no-one will find me...

2.Content: The woods outside the village, I'll hide there!

0.Content: No one will find me here!

1.Content: (A sense of relief washes over Andersson and he falls unconscious onto his bed)

0.Content: Andersson! Snap out of it!

1.Content: Look around! The villagers have got you surrounded!

2.Content: But why!? I've been hiding out here. Why are they after me?

3.Content: For your money, obviously! Andersson, if you don't want them to steal your money, then...

4.Content: You must strike first...

5.Content: Go on! Eradicate them all! Then no-one can take your riches!

6.Content: And once they're out of the way... what's theirs will be yours, too.

0.Content: Mine... It's all mine...

1.Content: Wrath, greed, selfishness... Mortal willpower is so very fragile.

2.Content: (Vincent's appearance shifts, his body morphing and contorting, revealing his true form)

3.Content: Andersson, listen to me. There is still someone who stands in your way. She's hiding deep in the woods, just waiting to take everything away from you.

4.Content: Who...? I'll kill her!

5.Content: A sinister pink-haired she-devil. Once you're rid of her, you'll be safe again.

6.Content: Thank you for allowing me to sample such a delectable nightmare. As a token of my appreciation, I shall grant you strength. Take it!

0.Content: Yes! ...Kill!
Maybe I'm paranoid, but the villagers seem to be looking at me funny.

1.Content: Nevermind, it's not often that I have the chance to come back home. Time for a well-deserved rest.

0.Content: Think you can escape? You insignificant speck!

1.Content: Sooner or later, you'll be mine.

0.Content: My friend, it's time to wake up. Don't forget, there are important things awaiting us today.

1.Content: I know I know. But Seirus, you best be glad you're my friend. If anyone else woke me from such a good dream, they'd be thrown into the sea.

2.Content: Hahaha, sure sure, that face of yours could frighten the life out of people. Still, our priority right now is helping our companions. We must eradicate or drive the Hypogeans from our waters.

3.Content: You mean... Sorry, I think I'm still a little sleep-addled. You mean this new companion who is joining us, or... do you mean this group of local folks is planning on taking the Hypogeans down themselves?

4.Content: Looks like you're finally awake enough to have realized we do have one more among our number! And to answer your questions, yes to both!

5.Content: Another small squad is setting out to deal with the Hypogeans today.

6.Content: We will be among them.

0.Content: You plan on departing so soon? ...In that case, let me quickly make you some snacks.

1.Content: Madam, you needn't trouble yourself like this. We'd rather know more about the Hypogean, if there's anything you can tell us.

2.Content: I don't know if there's anything more I can add... In the early days of the First Hypogean War, our forefathers left their hometowns, fleeing the war to settle here. They lived on these seven islands peacefully.

3.Content: They originally intended to return home after the war, but not long after all that, a powerful Hypogean came out to sea and settled its very own island nearby. The awful beast's minions would make sport of the local folk, just like those our forebears fled from.

4.Content: The settlers of the seven islands quickly constructed cannons, acting with all haste to avoid detection by the Hypogeans, planning to work together to overcome the evil creatures. But it wasn't long before the Hypogeans soon found us, and began to assail our seven islands.

5.Content: Unfortunately, not only were those seven cannons destroyed, but countless people were killed and injured. After everything that transpired, the few of us left alive came here, far from the Hypogean's grasp.

6.Content: Despite that, evidence of Hypogean activity began appearing on the shore. Squad after squad of warriors were sent out to sea, aiming to crush the Hypogean, but none of them were ever seen again.

7.Content: Hmm that's... Seirus, what's your take?

8.Content: Oh, that's a truly heart-rending tale.

9.Content: I never expected my own child to be one of the brave ones embarking on this task... I know I ought to be gushing with pride, but, forgive me. As a mother, I can't be happy about this.

10.Content: I've readied your boat, it's on the beach. My only hope is that you effortlessly bring down those wretched Hypogeans. Look after each other. My child is depending on you...

11.Content: Please don't fret, madam. With us here, the Hypogeans are already as good as gone.

0.Content: There have been many brave souls who tried to destroy the Hypogeans, but none have ever made it.

1.Content: May Dura protect you.

0.Content: Are you the great heroes that are gonna wipe the Hypogeans off the face of the planet!? Whatever you need, just ask! Don't worry about money either, mom will make sure you get what you need!

1.Content: Ahahaha! The hero is whoever defeats the Hypogean! We're just plain old normal folk, like you.

2.Content: Mom said anyone that goes out to destroy the Hypogeans is a hero, just like my dad was! He went to fight a long time ago, wanting to end this awful situation we're in.

3.Content: That was... the last time I ever saw him... I'm sorry! I shouldn't be bringing this up.

4.Content: No harm done, kid. If we hear of any news about your dad, we'll be sure to fill you in when we're back.

5.Content: Really? If we had some good news, perhaps mom would stop crying every day... Thank you, great heroes! May Dura grant you protection!

0.Content: Who could've foreseen the first step would falter.

1.Content: Still, there are plenty of ways around this, such as making use of the tidal power here. But don't forget, we need to take care of non-waterborne buddy.

2.Content: There's been evidence to suggest Hypogean activity around the shore recently, but it's not certain whether the Hypogean is to blame.

3.Content: Hey! What do you think you're doing, sneaking around here?

4.Content: Hah, speaking of which, here comes someone now.

5.Content: I wouldn't say it's a coincidence that we start talking and get noticed by someone, but if this is a trap, then we might've already fallen for it.

6.Content: Enough of that sort of talk, Seirus! Worst case scenario, we get the fighting over with quickly. It's not like we haven't seen plenty of Hypogeans in our time.

7.Content: Hahaha, you never change!

8.Content: Please listen to what I have to say! You see, it was our plan to sail out to sea with our friend here and help you with your Hypogean problem! It's just that the boat which was supposed to be here waiting for us is gone, have you seen it?

9.Content: So your this round's dead men walking... That is to say, you're this round's brave warriors sent out to destroy the Hypogeans?

10.Content: Sure enough, not so long ago Hypogeans were hanging around here, fresh out the sea. We lost a lot of good men trying to drive them back. I reckon the boat got wrecked right then, it's probably on the seabed now.

11.Content: Since you're brave warriors chasing after deadly Hypogeans, I suppose handling their minions would be short work for you. They just pillaged a lot of our most important supplies. We might be able to help you organize another boat, if you lend us a hand.

0.Content: Would you look at that? Simple as can be.

1.Content: You handled those Hypogean soldiers with such ease! No wonder you're our bravest warriors! We can't thank you enough!

2.Content: We got the boat you needed all ready to go, you can set out whenever you want.

3.Content: All sorts of things can go awry at sea, we need to employ the utmost of caution.

0.Content: You're scaring away all my fish!
Leave me alone, would you? Let me fish in peace.
Hypogeans nearby? How would I know? I'm just a fisherman.
I've told you once, I'll tell you again, I dunno what you're talking about! I'm just a fisherman! Get lost!
Are you quite done!? Your stairway to heaven will be a very short one!
Hahaha! Bull's eye! Hit the nail on the head, Seirus! This guy really was a Hypogean informant, but I never suspected he was actually a Hypogean himself!

1.Content: This is likely the reason that the Hypogean soldiers were able to invade the island.

2.Content: Thankfully the issue is now resolved. Things should be rather safer here for the foreseeable future. We can leave without concern.

0.Content: Ah! A visitor! Goodness, how long has it been? I never expected to see another living soul!

1.Content: Not exactly. It's more like we weren't expecting to see anyone running a store in Hypogean infested waters? Hah, just saying it out loud sounds ludicrous.

2.Content: Since you're passing through here, allowing me the luck of seeing another living soul for possibly the last time in my life, that must be mean you came from over there. By 'over there', I mean the only island with anyone left on it that isn't a Hypogean.

3.Content: Correct. Although things aren't looking good right now, there's been signs of Hypogean activity there.

4.Content: Then you are...

5.Content: Helping out. We're here to support the island's warriors, who are preparing to take down the Hypogeans.

6.Content: ...I see.

7.Content: In that case, I'll share what I can.

8.Content: I'm sure you already know about the seven cannons built by islanders in the past? Those cannons were destroyed, and the islands were overrun by a tough Hypogean and its powerful minions.

9.Content: There was another party of crusaders that went before you, all from different armies. They figured out pretty quickly the cannons were vital since the Hypogean went to such lengths to get rid of them, so they decided to secretly repair all seven of them.

10.Content: Sadly, the islands were swarming with evil things, left to the Hypogean's underlings. Using those vile things, the minions quickly tracked down the warriors, leaving them no way to retreat in one piece.

11.Content: Good grief, what of them now?

12.Content: ...They're still there.

13.Content: If you can take down those Hypogean lackeys and give me the evil things that have been hidden on the islands, I can give you cannon munitions. With that, you can decimate the Hypogeans' island.

14.Content: You've got a good idea there, but I'm a little confused. You seem to know a lot about this situation, and you clearly hate the Hypogeans, so why not just give us the munitions for free? We can defeat the Hypogeans right away.

15.Content: Because I'm a business man.

16.Content: What kind of business man does business at a profit loss?

0.Content: Let me guess. Would you perchance like me to 'loan' you some items? Or do you think this task is beyond your capabilities? Do you want to throw in the towel and go home?

1.Content: What can be used without expense?

2.Content: Nothing, obviously.

3.Content: Hahaha, don't worry. We've done as you've asked, in the way you wanted. Only the final step remains.

4.Content: The Hypogeans plaguing these islands will be wiped out!

5.Content: You guys really are... true heroes.

6.Content: Apologies, here's what was promised. Make sure you don't ignite it before loading it into the cannon's barrel!

7.Content: With that done, it's time for me to return home.

8.Content: Hey, buddy, do you want us to escort you back? Most of the Hypogean are gone, but there may be a few stragglers still in the water.

9.Content: No need! I can handle the small fries by myself. It's your time now, heroes.

10.Content: Something about you feels so familiar. You know so much about the previous squad that fought the Hypogeans, could it be you're...

11.Content: Hahaha, I'm just a regular guy.

0.Content: Goddess above... I can't believe my eyes.

1.Content: My child! You've fulfilled your promise and returned safely.

2.Content: There's a bite to eat in the kitchen, I'll go bring it out!

0.Content: Mighty heroes! Thank you, thank you so much for bringing dad home!

1.Content: Your father? I mean, we don't actually have any news about him...

2.Content: Hahaha, why hello again! I didn't expect you to get back so soon!

3.Content: It's you!

4.Content: Thank you for your service to us, and to the islands.

5.Content: My companions stayed behind, all so that I could get away from the Hypogeans' clutches.

6.Content: I was consumed by the desire for revenge, every waking moment was spent thinking about how to be rid of the Hypogeans. But then, seeing all those folks from this town making their way out there, brimming with confidence, so sure they would be able to annihilate it... Ultimately, they left their families, left their homes, only to be defeated and flee in desperation. Even now, I've no clue where those folks are.

7.Content: Perhaps this is a curse that's followed our people since we fled our ancestral lands? A kind of retribution.

8.Content: I was slowly running out of ammo. To be completely honest, I gave you the last of my munitions. It's a good thing you pulled it off!

9.Content: My mom can finally stop crying! I'm so grateful! Thank you so much, heroes!

0.Content: Many brave warriors once went out to sea to quell the Hypogeans. Some of them laid down their lives for justice. Others fled, desperate to stay alive.

1.Content: You are the only ones to have returned with good news.

2.Content: While not every squad that went to destroy the Hypogean menace was as pure of heart as you, those that paid with their lives are still heroes.

0.Content: Once, those that embarked on this path were truly committed, yet, they all...
Hey! Look over there! There's a person alive on that tiny island, you don't think it's a Hypogean scout, do you?

1.Content: Time to practice what you preach... "Worst case scenario, we get the fighting over with quickly." Alright, as long as we're well-prepared.

0.Content: Is this the 'evil thing' the merchant mentioned? It doesn't look like much, but it definitely has a grim Hypogean aura about it. It's making me feel nauseous.

1.Content: At this speed, we'll crush them like an unblockable tide!

0.Content: And so, our final stop on the road to Hypogean decimation.

1.Content: Enough of the sentimental nonsense, Seirus. Let's get to it!

2.Content: It's time to cleanse the ocean of their vile presence for once and for all!

0.Content: Thank heavens... Lorsan, sir, you've finally made it.

1.Content: My lovely Rosaline, long time no see. I was wondering what the "big deal" you wrote of in your last letter would turn out to be. If it's preparations for the banquet, then it's really quite simple.

2.Content: Although Oscar keeps saying that "leaving preparations to you is quite reassuring"...

3.Content: I really don't know that I'm up the task, especially since it's my first time, you know? I can't help worrying I'm biting off more than I can chew.

4.Content: No need to fret, Rosaline. I believe the precise opposite is true - Oscar would not have left things in your care had he no confidence in you to handle it.

5.Content: ...You're right! I just need to concentrate on Oscar's instructions, my Tea Cup of Vibrancy's encouragement, and my Broom of Vitality's support!

6.Content: A-Anyway! First thing's first, let's make our way to the Manor and discuss the banquet plans with their Housekeeper!

7.Content: That's the way, Rosaline! Keep your chin up! I'll be with you the whole time, there's nothing to worry about.

0.Content: Apologies for my intrusion, dear Housekeeper, but I, er, we, are here now to... We want to discuss the banquet preparations with you.

1.Content: I've already heard about the details in a letter I received earlier.

2.Content: Huh? I don't recall ever sending out any letters...

3.Content: It's nothing of consequence. Prior to your arrival I had the Manor cleaned top to bottom, inside and out. Using it for the banquet is no issue.

4.Content: Gosh, you truly are dependable!

5.Content: However, somewhere east of the Manor a band of brigands from who-knows-where have set up camp.

6.Content: If they are not removed, I am concerned that their presence will endanger our guests.

7.Content: That being said, it is my hope you can resolve this inconvenience before the guests arrive.

0.Content: We'll have them gone in no time.

1.Content: Oh, that reminds me, a suitable professional dancer will be required for the dances.

2.Content: I've recently been on the look out for suitable individuals, apparently one such person who is keen to improve their rhythmic aptitude has been seen in the eastern hills. You ought to enquire en route.

3.Content: There's also the matter of banquet food...

4.Content: Purchase of the essentials has already been arranged by myself, but to the north is a market assembled by local farmers and their kin.

5.Content: Should there be any other foodstuffs or articles you deem necessary, that would be the place to shop.

6.Content: Duly noted! Thank you very much, Oscar, sir!

7.Content: In that case, I wish us all a successful banquet.

0.Content: (Muttering) Seems everything is just as Oscar said. In the long time since we've last seen each other, Rosaline really has come a long way. She's perfectly capable of getting her work done efficiently and methodically.

1.Content: (Muttering) But Oscar, who had me secretly escort her for fear of any mishap, is ever the same. He truly covers all angles.

0.Content: With this stuff we've bought, that should be everything.

1.Content: Lorsan, sir, please wait a moment to allow me to take note of our stock.

2.Content: Vegetables, meats... Hmm, I can't help feeling like something is missing...

3.Content: Did you forget fruit? I recall you were reading up on how to prepare a mixed-berry cake.

4.Content: You're absolutely right, I'm shy one bag of cranberries. Good thing you're here to remind me, Lorsan, sir!

0.Content: Oh dear, I'm terribly sorry, our cranberries have all sold out.

1.Content: How about this? You swing by my orchard and pick your own? For a little effort, it'll cut your costs - I won't charge you as much. One bush's worth will fill a single bag.

2.Content: Wonderful! Thank you so much, sir!

0.Content: If I recall rightly, you folks are here to pick some cranberries, is that right? This one here is blueberries, not the one you're looking for.
Didn't you say you only needed one bag? Why are you taking so many? Stop picking all my fruit!
You again! I've had enough of you! Time to teach you a lesson!
(Embarrassed) I-I'm s-sorry!

1.Content: You don't seem like the bad sort, so I'll overlook it this time, but don't be so greedy in the future!

0.Content: Oi! What do you think you're doin'!? Stealing my fruit, eh?!
It looks really dangerous around here. I wonder where those brigands Oscar spoke of are hiding themselves?

1.Content: The wind speaks of imminent danger. Tread carefully, Rosaline.

2.Content: O-okay Lorsan, sir!

0.Content: Watch out!

1.Content: Are these the brigands Oscar mentioned? They look totally unbeatable...

2.Content: The wind has informed me of another route. We just need avoid the cannons, then we'll be fine.

0.Content: Thank goodness you were here, Lorsan, sir! You sent them on their way! Unfortunately, we've yet to enquire about the dancer...

1.Content: Don't be disheartened. See that little shack just in front of you? Perhaps the dancer we seek is there?

2.Content: You're absolutely right, Lorsan, sir! Let's go take a look.

0.Content: Nice! Someone's come to save me!

1.Content: Thank you so much! I wouldn't be locked up here if I hadn't fallen for their stupid ploy.

2.Content: I-I'm sorry to inconvenience you, Ms Dancer... We require a dancer for our banquet, a professional to liven things up, and we want to invite you to fulfil that role...

3.Content: A dancer? You folks got the wrong person, I'm just a bounty hunter.

4.Content: However, I do happen to know a dancer, they live pretty close by. There's a magic Doorway in that wood over there to the west, perhaps give that a shot?

5.Content: Oh yeah, I also found a bunch of tunnels those bandits dug, seems to be a shortcut outside. Since those fellas are gone now, you can use that route if you're in a hurry.

6.Content: I see... Well, thank you, Ms Bounty Hunter!

0.Content: Excellent work, you've done well.

1.Content: The banquet premises will be considerably safer for all.

0.Content: Is this the place Ms Bounty Hunter meant? It doesn't look like anyone's around, and the door doesn't even open...

1.Content: The wind's guidance is never wrong. Perhaps we should consider how best to open that doorway.

2.Content: Thinking carefully about it, it seems that turning all the lights here yellow may be the best plan to get that doorway opened.

3.Content: It truly is a delight to see just how much you've grown, Rosaline.

0.Content: Who are you? Are you people daddy found to play with me?

1.Content: The person Ms Bounty Hunter mentioned... Could it really be a child?

2.Content: Sorry to interrupt, little one, but we're looking for a dancer. You wouldn't happen to know someone around here who dances, would you?

3.Content: Oh I know I know! The dance teacher daddy found for me!

4.Content: But he's hardly ever here after class, and when he is, he usually just hangs out in the garden on his own, lost in thought in the bushes. Bushes like that one, actually. You can ask him when you find him.

0.Content: Mr Dancer... Um? Why are you going back into hiding, Mr Dancer?

1.Content: It's possible he thinks we're merely annoying rubberneckers, it might serve us best to explain our situation to him.

2.Content: You have a good point, Lorsan, sir.

0.Content: Mr Dancer walked off at such a pace that I didn't even have chance to call out to him.

1.Content: It seems our work here is yet to be done!

0.Content: Found you!

1.Content: Mr Dancer, I would like to formally invite you to dance at our banquet...

2.Content: Can I refuse?

3.Content: Well, yes, I suppose you can, but please consider the proposal a moment...

4.Content: (Sigh) I'm not unwilling, it's just... Just thinking about all the eyes on me, everyone staring, it makes me so nervous. I can't stop myself from shaking all over! If you're happy with that sort of performance, then fine, I'll take part.

5.Content: Oh, well, in that case... It isn't terribly ideal.

6.Content: ... (Sigh)

7.Content: Come now Rosaline, don't let this take the wind from your sails! There may yet be someone else we can ask, we can always go back and ask the Housekeeper.

8.Content: Alright...

0.Content: You couldn't find a suitable dancer? What a pity...

1.Content: Hmm... Maybe the village near the market would be worth a try, there's a lass there who used to be a maid.

2.Content: She loved to dance! She only gave it up because the dresses were too costly.

3.Content: In that case, please take this dress to her and ask her to try it on, I doubt she'll refuse.

4.Content: You're so generous, sir!

0.Content: Can I help you?

1.Content: Greetings, we are seeking an outstanding dancer for our banquet, you wouldn't happen to be interested in taking the leading role, would you?

2.Content: Goodness! I'm honored, really! ...It's just, I don't have a single nice frock to wear, I'm afraid I'd look a shambles at such an occasion.

3.Content: No trouble at all, we've prepared a fine gown here for you. If it's not too much hassle, would you mind trying it on?

4.Content: Gosh, it's gorgeous! I'll try it right away!

0.Content: Wow... A perfect fit!

1.Content: Thank you, thank you so much for allowing me the chance to fulfil my dream of dancing in front of everyone!

2.Content: I'll be sure to dazzle everyone with each and every step!

0.Content: The preparations for the banquet are finally finished... I won't let Oscar down!

1.Content: Thanks so much for everything, Lorsan, sir. If not for you, I'd never have managed any of this.

2.Content: Not at all, Rosaline. You're not the timid wallflower maid you used to be, you've grown so much and come so far.

3.Content: I've no doubt Oscar would be immensely proud of your hard work.

0.Content: Are you folks trying to get to the south dock? There's nothing there.
I told you, there's nothing there! You're scaring off all my fish.
Why is it folks like you are always here to pester me when I'm fishing? I can't catch any fish all because of you!

1.Content: You want to go to the south dock, right? Then go into the kitchen and find out what ingredients are needed for Pirate's Delight.

0.Content: Did you ask? How to make Pirate's Delight?
So what ingredients are needed for the Pirate's Delight?
How do I catch a Starry Night Blue Lobster?
That seems like a lie to me. Want to rethink that?
Alright, so I need to catch fish and lobster, and then steal, er... 'borrow' some vegetables, and I can make it myself.

1.Content: Okay, let's get going. I'll take you myself.

0.Content: The Musical Rose, Kingpin, Pop Prodigy... No wonder I've not been able to reach you, you've been here rehearsing!

1.Content: That just leaves Soul Singer. Don't forget, we're invited to the banquet this year!

2.Content: Of course I've not forgotten!

0.Content: Pirate's Delight is made from a combination of various types of seafood and full-grain rice. The juices of the seafood infuse the rice with rich flavor, making it a memorable experience.

1.Content: The main ingredients are Deep-sea Dotted Rainbow Fish, Starry Night Blue Lobster and Bok-choy.

2.Content: The Starry Night Blue Lobster is the rarest of the lot, and it needs to be caught on a clear night in a sea reflecting the stars.

0.Content: Watch out!
Rosaline? A thief? Impossible! How could Prince Lester determine it so?

1.Content: (Oscar angrily tosses the notice in his hand to the ground)

2.Content: Believing her to be the thief just because she was the last person to have touched the apparel? Preposterous!

3.Content: Prince Lester won't even allow her visitors, such is his ire.

4.Content: There's surely been a misunderstanding. First order of business is to free Rosaline, she can't be left to linger in jail.

0.Content: She must be fraught with terror. I'm going there at once!
There's surely holes in this jail's armor, a little investigation is in order.
Jail is such a bore. We came out for a bit of fun, so how about you test our skills? If you can guess which of us will be the victor, I'll let you pass.
Rosaline?

1.Content: Oscar, sir? Have you come to save me?

2.Content: I'm so sorry, sir! I didn't take the apparel, I didn't! But no-one believes me...

3.Content: I believe you. Well now, let's get going.

4.Content: But, where can I go?

5.Content: I have a stop-over just outside of town. We'll go there first.

0.Content: Rosaline! Oscar! How dare you flee!

1.Content: Listen to me. Rosaline is no thief, and provided you allow me to investigate this, I shall prove it beyond doubt.

2.Content: You can't talk your way out of this! That apparel has immeasurable significance to those who care about the Hypogean War! Now hand it over!

3.Content: My sincere apologies, but I've no time for this chatter. Until we've uncovered the truth, you'll just have to sit tight.

0.Content: Rosaline, you'll be safe to hide here for a few days.

1.Content: Of course, hiding is not a long-term solution, they could find this place any day soon.

2.Content: To clear your name it is imperative we find the real culprit.

3.Content: We should eliminate the suspects one by one, starting with Earl Leofric.

4.Content: THE Earl Leofric? An out-of-towner?

5.Content: I was instructed by the Prince himself to visit the Earl and extend an invitation to the banquet to him.

6.Content: The Earl's retainer told me that he was reading in his study, but I didn't once spy a single soul leave, so perhaps he wasn't at the Manor at all that day.

7.Content: Rosaline, did you notice anything out of the ordinary that day?

8.Content: Well, speaking of 'out of the ordinary', a few days before the banquet, I overheard Thane and the Prince quarreling.

9.Content: Thane? ...Then there is certainly motive.

10.Content: Also, it felt like there was a peculiar sound coming from under the floor during the dances. My Broom of Life told me there was also sand on the floor, seemingly from out of nowhere.

11.Content: Under the floor... Sand... Perhaps someone was digging tunnels.

12.Content: I know of one slightly unhinged fellow with a gift for tunneling.

13.Content: Kren. A wanted Mauler. He has an entire family of talented tunnelers.

14.Content: I have listed some basic information about them on this board. Surprising no-one, the thief is indeed one among the three of them.

0.Content: Since the evidence against Kren is clearest, we should start our investigations with him. The presence of sand suggests the western sands may hold some clues. Let's go take a look.
We're holding a traditional tribe-members only ceremony here. No outsiders. Beat it.

1.Content: That's how it's gonna be, huh? Alright, I can see you folks have a few brain cells. Guess which of these teams will be victorious, and I'll let you pass. If you guess wrong, you'll have to fight our warriors!

0.Content: Oscar, sir! Look!

1.Content: That certainly is a hole in the ground, well spotted. This tunnel seems fairly fresh still, had it been here much longer the wind would've blown it over with sand, burying it.

2.Content: If I'm not mistaken, this tunnel is the work of Kren and his kin.

3.Content: Sadly it's too small to fit inside, we've no way of knowing where it goes.

4.Content: No matter. Let's go to the banquet venue and investigate the dance hall. If the hole indeed leads to the Manor, there will surely be evidence left there.

0.Content: Now, let's depart for Oakenfell.

1.Content: Oscar, sir, there seem to be a lot of patrols ahead. Rushing in seems like a bad idea.

0.Content: Was anything amiss that day?

1.Content: I was on guard, watching the room the apparel was stored inside.

2.Content: The only thing of note occurred before the banquet began. I heard some odd noise outside, something moving. It sounded a bit like a Durri skittering around so I went to check it out.

3.Content: So there came a point at which you left your post watching the room the apparel was in.

4.Content: That's right, but Master Thane was also patrolling nearby.

5.Content: Did you find anyone suspicious lurking?

6.Content: There was no-one there.

7.Content: Were there any other leads?

8.Content: Only one thing. After the apparel was stolen, the Prince turned the whole city upside down looking for it, but came up empty. It's probably no longer in the city.

9.Content: I had a quiet word with one of gate guards. Apparently only one carriage left the city during the banquet - Earl Leofric's.

10.Content: As for who was actually in the carriage, I can't say. The gate guards can't check who's in the carriages of senior figures.

11.Content: But, if the apparel were to have been taken out of town, that would be the only way.

12.Content: Do you know where the carriage went?

13.Content: To the Leafy Woods. Master Thane followed along not too far behind.

0.Content: The city is heavily guarded right now, so take this. Wearing this should keep you hidden from patrolling guardsmen.
A key? I did make a copy of one earlier. I gave it to a jailer mate for safekeeping, but the tool told me he lost it.

1.Content: He said something about a tree near the jail, there's crows there that like collecting shiny things. He wanted to see if there was any gold coins but ended up falling from the tree and that was that, the key was gone.

0.Content: We're finally in. The venue is ahead, let's be thorough and not overlook any possible clues.
Well, we now know for certain that Kren dug the tunnel, but there's neither hide nor hair to be found of him.

1.Content: Both the direction the carriage went and the direction Thane departed lead to the woods in the north, so let's head over there and investigate.

2.Content: Stop right there criminal scum! Hand over the Rayne Family apparel!

0.Content: I, too, think something's afoot. Thane leaving the venue? He told me about it, said he saw someone suspicious getting into a carriage, so he wanted to follow.

1.Content: A carriage... The Earl's carriage, I suspect.

2.Content: Let's go further into the forest, perhaps we'll find more clues.

0.Content: Oscar, sir! There's wheel marks here!

1.Content: Wheel marks? It would seem the Earl's carriage went towards the Silent Forest. Humans and Graveborn mingle here, so proceed with caution.

0.Content: The Silent Forest fringe is often rife with vile brigands and Graveborn ghouls, we should exercise considerable caution.

1.Content: They're not active at the same time of day. When the sun is up, the brigands are strong and ready to fight whilst the Graveborn are frail and vulnerable. When the stars come out, the opposite is true.

2.Content: I'll be sure to remember that. Oscar, sir, how did you come to learn of this?

3.Content: The Imperial Stewardship Guild, of course.

0.Content: It's just you? I'm stunned you would follow me all the way out here. You truly are an excellent steward.

1.Content: As a "steward", it is only natural to strive for the best in all respects. I am sure you understand.

2.Content: Thane, sir, we'd like to know what happened on the day of the banquet.

3.Content: I'm sure it does no harm to tell you that I also believe the thief was someone else.

4.Content: The day of the banquet, I observed the Earl's carriage heading out of town. I thought it suspicious to be departing during the banquet.

5.Content: You were suspicious of the carriage so you left the banquet?

6.Content: It was not the carriage alone, but rather, the short-statured figure that seemed to be hiding beneath it. I was concerned something was being plotted, and so decided to pursue the vehicle.

7.Content: Perhaps I was moments too late, or perhaps they were deliberately leading me away...

8.Content: My apologies for the inconvenience I've caused you all.

9.Content: Can you tell us what you were doing in the afternoon? That might provide a lead.

10.Content: Before the banquet began, the guardsmen and I were keeping watch of the room the apparel was stored in. I noticed the guard stationed at the room sneak off briefly at one point and go outside. When asked, he said he saw someone sneaking around and went to investigate, fearing it might be a crime in progress.

11.Content: I took his place briefly, standing watch the room door until he returned. After the dancing had begun at the banquet, I noticed the Earl's carriage readying for departure, beneath which I spied a silhouette seemingly in hiding. I presumed it to be the suspicious figure the guard had mentioned earlier.

12.Content: Thus, I left the banquet and pursued the carriage out of town. I eventually caught up to it and stopped it, but there was nothing beneath it by then, and inside was merely a butler and a pile of old tomes.

13.Content: I suspect the individual jumped off en route, so I returned to this area looking for clues amongst the wheel marks.

14.Content: Thank you for your assistance, we will also continue searching for clues.

0.Content: Kren should be hiding in here somewhere. Watch your step, there may be traps awaiting us.
It would seem Kren slipped up. I knew that oversized rodent couldn't be trusted.

1.Content: Whatever. Whether I catch you or him, the bounty reward's all the same back at the palace. I'm not going back empty-handed having come all this way.

0.Content: You're pretty handy. Seems that the bounty for you guys isn't worth it.

1.Content: What were you just saying about Kren slipping up?

2.Content: He and I made a deal. He'd steal the Rayne Family apparel, and then I'd meet him here and take it off his hands.

3.Content: But, the rat never showed up. Since you folks're here, he either slipped up and got caught, or kept the apparel for himself.

4.Content: We are currently searching for Kren's whereabouts.

5.Content: That sly rat. So you guys wanna know where he is, and you're asking me? This deal went belly-up, but he's still my partner...

6.Content: I won't turn you into the city authorities.

7.Content: We're a pair, inseparable.

8.Content: You'll be rewarded once he's found, I'll see to it.

9.Content: Deal.

10.Content: Rustport. The place is a cesspit. Perfect place for rats to hide.

11.Content: A pleasure doing business with you.

0.Content: We're here, Rustport. This place is fraught with danger, nothing like Oakenfell. Rosaline, be sure to protect yourself.

1.Content: I trust you, Oscar, sir.

0.Content: Kren, come up here, we've found you.

1.Content: Darnit! The big fella must've sold me out!

2.Content: Hand over the apparel!

3.Content: Apparel? You're seriously asking me about an apparel?!

4.Content: The whole thing was a scam! There wasn't even an apparel in there!

5.Content: You mean...

6.Content: I snuck in at noon, entering with the guests of Oakenfell. Meanwhile, my kin tunneled their way in from the desert outside of town. Once the dancing started, we knew no-one would notice any movement beneath the floor.

7.Content: We all agreed that once they got their hands on that apparel, I'd wreak a little havoc with some explosions near the Manor, giving them chance to get away in the confusion.

8.Content: But it turns out, the room was empty! They said they thought they'd dug right into the wrong room! While I was waiting for word from them, the guards almost found me, so the second I heard there was nothing in that room, I bailed. I hid under the carriage and got the heck out of town.

9.Content: While I was on the road, I kept thinking how only that Lone Ranger knew about the plan, so I figured he must've sold me out to claim the bounty for himself! I wasn't gonna risk meeting him, so I hopped off the carriage en route and made a beeline for Rustport to lay low.

10.Content: So I ended up here just in time for everything to go south, and now I'm just hiding out here in this cold, damp shack.

11.Content: That carriage even had plush fabric on the exterior underside, it felt too expensive for my blood! Rich folks are wild.

12.Content: If I hadn't been running for my life, I would've swiped some of that fabric for a little financial return!

13.Content: Carriage exterior underside... fabric... I see. Let's go back to the Earl's Manor. I believe this carriage will shed light on the truth of matters.

0.Content: This Earl Leofric's Manor. Let's get going, Rosaline.

1.Content: It's inappropriate conduct as a housekeeper to force entry, but under the circumstances there's little to be done.

0.Content: Halt.

1.Content: Your Grace, avoiding your guests is not due hospitality.

2.Content: Says the one forcing entry into private property. I'm afraid Mister Oscar must've flunked etiquette class.

3.Content: I already know why you're here.

4.Content: I was at home in the Manor all day that day, and much to my embarrassment I did not leave the building once. I had agree to attend, telling the Prince as much, but unfortunately I became so absorbed by an excellent book that I simply forgot to go.

5.Content: Every afternoon is spent in my study, reading ancient texts and tomes. My staff do not dare disturb me.

6.Content: The day of the banquet, I dispatched my butler to the venue to send my wishes ahead of my anticipated arrival. He also borrowed some books from the library for me.

7.Content: Thane stopped the carriage on its return journey, claiming to have seen a figure beneath the carriage, but we found nothing.

8.Content: That carriage is now parked just over there. You are free to inspect it, by way of apology.

0.Content: The carriage was cushioned with a wool-spun blanket, bearing the marks of having been pressed by something heavy.

1.Content: The underside of the carriage is hardwood, and an ornate cufflink is wedged into a gap in the wood paneling.

2.Content: I see, many thanks for your help, Earl.

3.Content: Rosaline, I know who stole the apparel.

0.Content: We have now gathered some clues. Do you suspect any of these three people?
It seems that the sound I heard coming from underground was indeed made by the Durri. Oscar, sir, who do you think is the most suspicious of these three people now?
You are very responsible, Master Thane, sir! But why did the Earl's carriage leave town at the time of the dance? Oscar, sir, do you have any new thoughts about who the culprit is?
Tap on the items in the scene that look suspicious, and find the hidden clues.
Cough-cough, this damn storm... I swear, I'm never gonna listen to that woman ever again!

1.Content: You say that literally every time... Mirael just knows you've got a short temper and likes to push your buttons.

2.Content: The info about rumored treasure on this island was given to us out of the kindness of her heart, so perhaps save some of that energy of yours for actually finding it.

3.Content: Yeah but she failed to mention this all-year-round storm! Had I been informed of this earlier, I'd have had a different opinion!

4.Content: Yeah well, there's a market just up ahead. Let's check there first for some intel.

5.Content: More importantly, we need a break. You're barely staying upright! A strong gust would be enough to knock you down.

6.Content: Ha! How about we race to see who gets to the market first?

0.Content: Things are looking up, I see drinks in our near future!

1.Content: Quit dreaming. This pittance is all we've got to spare.

0.Content: Treasure maps! Dozens of treasure maps! Fair trading only, gold coins not accepted! Trade pearls for maps! Come inquire!

1.Content: Hey Fawkes, looks like the gods are smiling on us! Treasure maps! You know, the reason we're here?

2.Content: So do have any pearls on you, my darling Raine? We only have 5 gold coins, remember?

4.Content: Heeey! You two have the look of tourists that have had a rough ride, am I right?

5.Content: Have you noticed the inn southwest of the market? You can take a load off your feet over there.

6.Content: That's great to know, thanks a lot.

7.Content: Haha, it's nothing! If you happen to come across any pearls, please come see me right away! I got all the maps you could possibly want to trade!

0.Content: Would you like a room? Our rooms are spotlessly clean and extremely comfortable, I can promise you an outstanding rest.

1.Content: A mere 5 gold for the night, a genuine bargain!

2.Content: It's certainly not a bad price, but 5 gold is all we have to our names.

3.Content: Well, rest is paramount, we should get ourselves all recovered and recharged.

0.Content: Wonderful. Our pockets are now cleaner than my face. Also, Fawkes, I'm starving.

1.Content: You look somewhat aggrieved madam, is something wrong?

2.Content: Well, you see, our boat got wrecked getting here, and we're out of money so we can't buy anything to eat.

3.Content: Oh my, I'm truly sorry to hear such a tale... How about this? Deliver some food to the two families just north of my inn, and I will compensate you appropriately.

4.Content: Really!? Thank you so much, ma'am!

0.Content: Is anyone here? The innkeeper's wife asked us to deliver your food.

1.Content: Ah, my food's here! Thank you!

0.Content: Who might you be?

1.Content: Hello there. The owner of the inn asked us to bring you this food.

2.Content: What took so long? You're such slowpokes.

3.Content: Very sorry about that, we'll be quicker next time.

0.Content: Oh my, you're back so soon! Did you deliver everything?

1.Content: Of course! We're the finest bounty hunters anywhere!

2.Content: Thank you so much! Here, plenty of food for you both, assured to fill you to your brim! You're always welcome to stay here!

3.Content: Such hardworking, toiling young folk such as yourselves deserve a proper meal and a place to rest. You ever need a place to stay, it's free for you, that's a promise.

4.Content: If you encounter any other troubles, be sure to let me know and I'll do all I can to help.

5.Content: In that case, you wouldn't happen to know where we might find pearls around here, would you ma'am?

6.Content: The cheaper, the better. After all, we're stone broke.

7.Content: Hahaha, you're quite the comedian! If it's pearls you seek, I suggest visiting the Blacksmith, I know he has a fondness for pearls.

8.Content: Much appreciated, madam.

1.Content: Fawkes, get over here! I think I see someone!

2.Content: Sure that's not a corpse?

3.Content: ... hungry... food... give me... food... seafood platter... grilled steak... bacon wrapped spinach...

4.Content: We only got basic snacks, want them?

5.Content: Y... yes!

6.Content: The way he wolfed that down in one gulp, I think he's way hungrier than us.

7.Content: I'm saved... I'm finally full. Young'uns, thank you so much for the bread. Was there something you needed me for?

8.Content: The innkeeper said you might know where we can find some pearls.

9.Content: 'Course, if you have a treasure map, that'd be even better!

10.Content: Can't say I know anything about a map, but I certainly know about pearls. West of the woods you'll find a lumberyard. The lumberyard owner is a pearl collector, I believe he's got plenty laying around. Ask him.

11.Content: Thanks for the great intel.

12.Content: You're leaving? Wait a second.

13.Content: You see, I was fulfilling a rush order for a suit of leather armor, but the deadline was so tight I didn't have a moment to eat, and worse still, I'm now nearly out of materials. If you two folks would be so kind as to fetch me some more leather, I'll pay you for your trouble.

14.Content: No problem, consider it done! Take it as a thank you for your intel. Now, leave the fighting to me!

15.Content: You can take these bows and some arrows, just make sure you keep safe. You'll find your source of leather just east of the smithy.

0.Content: You've already got it? Amazing work! But, er, I don't have enough money on me right now...

1.Content: Alright, I'll give you this leather armor I just finished working on, I hope that'll serve you well! Hopefully your luck will better here on out.

2.Content: We lost all our clothes and weapons when our ship got wrecked, so this is really great, thank you.

0.Content: You folks're armed to the teeth! Did you see my Bounty poster?

1.Content: Can't say we've seen any such bounty. We're here because the blacksmith told us you know about pearls.

2.Content: Just the mention of pearls makes my blood boil! I dunno who started these tall tales about us having tons of treasure, but sure enough some bandits calling themselves 'bounty hunters' showed up and ransacked the place! All my pearls are gone!

3.Content: Speaking of which, where did you come from?

4.Content: Cough! That's not important. What IS important is that we're here to help! We'll get your pearls back.

5.Content: Absolutely! This is just too infuriating! We'll get your stuff back, no doubt!

0.Content: Boss man, we got your stuff back!

1.Content: Oh, that's so wonderful! Thank you both. Thankfully my precious baby isn't lost.

2.Content: Here, take this pearl as a thank you for your help. Oh, you can take this finished lumber, too.

3.Content: Your precious baby... isn't this pearl?

4.Content: Heh heh, what could ever be more precious than my darling daughter's handmade gift? Look at it, this little wooden pony is just exquisite!

5.Content: All's well that ends well!

0.Content: Hey there! We meet again, tourist friends! Do you have the pearls this time? Let me take a gander...

1.Content: Yes, just look at the luster! This is exactly the kind of pearl I'm after! Here, your treasure map! Hold tight! I assume you've got a shovel? Best of luck finding the booty!

2.Content: ...Fawkes, do we have a shovel?

3.Content: We can probably ask the blacksmith...

0.Content: You're back again, young'uns. What can I do for you this time?

1.Content: Would you happen to have a shovel?

2.Content: Can't say I've got any ready to go, but I can certainly make one for you. Let's see now... I got plenty of iron, but I'm out of wood. If you can give me some wood, I can help you no problem.

3.Content: We have some wood the lumberyard owner gave us, is that any use?

4.Content: This is fine wood indeed, I can definitely use this!

5.Content: Here you go, one shovel! Last I heard, the boss down at the mine also had some pearls, so if you're still after some I reckon you can swing by his place just south of the woods.

6.Content: That's excellent news, thanks so much for the intel!

0.Content: You here for iron ore? The mine's been non-operational for a long while now.

1.Content: Eh? Not at all, we're here about pearls.

2.Content: Why's the mine not operating?

3.Content: Sigh. The mine was operating and doing good business, but it roused an awful beast from its sleep that created all kinds of chaos and snatched my mine away!

4.Content: I have an idea. If we rid you of this awful beast, you reward us with pearls? Sound good?

5.Content: You're lucky I'm here!

6.Content: This vile beast had the thickest nastiest hide you ever saw! Only ancient arrows will see it killed.

0.Content: No worries! It's just a minor setback, we'll try again!

1.Content: How about this? Let's have the blacksmith enhance the lethality of this arrow.

2.Content: Good plan!

0.Content: You're saying you want to add some punch to this arrow? Sure, that's not hard at all.

1.Content: There's a hunting reserve to the east, head there and defeat some of the birds. There's a chance they'll drop a magic feather, and when they do, you bring that feather to me.

2.Content: Got it.

0.Content: This is it! A magic feather. By replacing the feather on this arrow with the magic feather you gave me, the piercing power of this arrow will be greatly improved.

1.Content: You've been a massive help, thank you so much.

2.Content: No need for such niceties! You've been good to me in the past, it's only right for folks to help each other out.

0.Content: Wonderful! You guys are my saviors!

1.Content: My pearls are deep in the heart of the mine, go help yourselves. I need to get my workers back in and start operations again! We've got lost time to make up!

0.Content: Hey there! We meet again, tourist friends! Do you have the pearls this time? Let me take a gander...

1.Content: Yes, just look at the luster! This is exactly the kind of pearls I'm after! Here, your treasure map! Hold it tight!

0.Content: The heck is this? Fawkes, can you make this out?

1.Content: Seems we'll have to go bother the blacksmith again.

0.Content: This is certainly a fine treasure of sorts, it's a blueprint that tells me how to make you folks a new boat. You've been bustling around looking for treasure, right?

1.Content: I dunno if it caught your eye, but there's an island just across the seas here. You hop on a boat and you can get yourselves over there to see what awaits.

2.Content: What else do you need?

3.Content: Not much, just a few hides. Head over to the hunting reserve and fetch me a few.

0.Content: You folks are certainly no slackers, that was fast.

1.Content: You should take the boat across the sea and find that pot o' gold.

0.Content: This 'treasure' is really underwhelming.

1.Content: You ought to know by now that a businessman like that guy isn't going to sell at a loss.

0.Content: There's more here than last time, so at the very least Mirael wasn't lying.

1.Content: We should keep trying! See if we can't find the mother lode!

0.Content: What about this pearl? It looks way more valuable than the others! Let's take it to the merchant at the market!
I've had my eye on you fellas for a good while now... These are my nice things! You can't touch them!
A small boat and the great ocean... Which has reminded me how much I do not want to be caught up in that dreadful storm.

1.Content: Simmer down Raine. Nothing bad's going to happen from here.

0.Content: Looks deserted. Good. More chance of finding something decent.

1.Content: There's a tent just over there, seems we can use it to shelter up and get rested.

0.Content: Who are you! How dare you trespass into someone's forest!
It's my forest... I'm not letting you in...!
I'll say it again! Huff... Puff... I'm saving these plums so I don't eat them too quickly, you know! Huff... So tired... Let's not fight, okay...
My body's spent... Kind people, can you find me something to eat...? I want plums...

1.Content: Where do we find plums?

2.Content: Let's head westward.

0.Content: It's been so long since I enjoyed this taste... Thank you. Did you come here for treasure?

1.Content: Bingo! That's exactly right.

2.Content: Let me thank you by assisting you in clearing the beasts here.

3.Content: This is the only treasure I know of. Thanks again, guys.

4.Content: Well, let's take a look and split it equally, okay?

5.Content: No need. I'm not in it for wealth, I adventure because I love freedom and exploration! I'm off on a new journey, but I'm sure we'll bump into one another again someday.

0.Content: Is this the treasure? It's just a single pearl.

1.Content: Let's take it to the merchant at the market, get ourselves a new map.

2.Content: I just pray that nothing strange happens this time.

0.Content: Wow! This pearl is simply... Ahem, actually, it's pretty ordinary. Not especially valuable, what a shame!

1.Content: But since you've been such good business partners and we've had so many trades, here's the finest map I can offer you.

0.Content: This looks like it's on the ocean floor... You know, Fawkes, the fact Mirael actually told the truth, I don't know if that's more or less disturbing.

1.Content: I'm sure she'll be delighted to hear you feel that way.

2.Content: Hmph. Let's move, since we've got the treasure it's time to pack up and go home.

3.Content: We'll be able to live fancy for a while with this sum of cash.

0.Content: Estrilda has been in a coma for two days and nights. The court physicians are at a loss about her illness...

1.Content: Perhaps Belinda from the Temple of Light could offer some aid. O divine goddess, may you bless my pupil, the last hope of House Rayne.

2.Content: If the Divine Light can't save her... I must ready myself for a journey.

0.Content: You must be inspected before entering Rayne Manor.

1.Content: (The guard conducts a thorough inspection.)

2.Content: Thank you for your cooperation, you may enter now.

0.Content: Thank you for your cooperation, you may enter now.
I'm sorry. Estrilda's situation is beyond my capabilities, even the Divine Light has no effect on her injuries.

1.Content: She is in a dire situation. We must tell master Thane at once.

0.Content: Even the Temple of Light couldn't save her? Oh, I see.
Master Thane.

1.Content: How's Estrilda?

2.Content: Her body is marked with strange scars. I couldn't find the cause of her coma, let alone cure her.

3.Content: They say the Wilders in The Dark Forest are masters of herbal medicines. Perhaps you could seek them out for their aid.

4.Content: Thank you, Belinda. I shall pay them a visit soon.

5.Content: (Thane casts his eyes to Estrilda lying on the bed.)

6.Content: Estrilda, you're going to be all right. I will soon return.

0.Content: Our borders have not been stable as of late. No one is allowed to cross the border unless absolutely necessary.
Master Thane, is something happening?

1.Content: (Thane explains the purpose of his journey to Hogan.)

2.Content: I see, you must tread carefully, for monsters roam beyond the borders.

0.Content: The path has collapsed. There's no going back.
What are those?! Must be the monsters Hogan mentioned...
There's no end to them, I must find a way to escape.
Watch out! I'll help you!
You have my gratitude. May I know your name, my lady?

1.Content: I'm Talene, a descendant of the Obsidian Finches. The Corruptors are quite a dangerous lot, you should be extra cautious on your journey.

2.Content: Corruptors? You mean these monsters? It seems you have a rather deep understanding about them.

3.Content: Allow my companion, a historian of The Dark Forest, to tell you more about the Corruptors.

4.Content: Corruptors are twisted creatures, born out of an elemental imbalance. When we mortals are injured by these creatures, the twisted power of the element causes peculiar scars to appear on our bodies, after which people soon fall into a coma.

5.Content: Strange scars?

6.Content: (Remembering the scars on Estrilda's body, Thane came to a realization, it had to have been a Corruptor.)

7.Content: Once the victim's body is fully covered in scars, there is no hope for them.

8.Content: (Thane tells Talene and her companion about Estrilda's situation and asks for a cure.)

9.Content: Conventional healing methods have no effect. These creatures grow increasingly chaotic as the elementals fall even further out of balance, likewise, natural disasters now increase in numbers across the land.

10.Content: We must seek the help of the five Elemental Guardians and have them activate the Elemental Altars. Only then can elemental order be returned to Esperia. This is our only chance to resolve the crisis.

11.Content: It's the only way those hurt by the Corruptors can wake from their comas.

12.Content: We are on our way to venture into the Bastion of the Elements in the depth of The Dark Forest. There, we should be able to find the Guardians.

13.Content: If you do so permit, I shall accompany you on your mission.

14.Content: No time like the present, let's go.

0.Content: Indeed, we should make haste to the Bastion of the Elements.
Have you come for the Elemental Guardians? Alas, they have already left this place.

1.Content: As the elemental imbalance keeps escalating, the Guardians have set out to suppress the myriad natural disasters throughout Esperia.

2.Content: Do you know where to find them?

3.Content: The Earth Guardian joined the Maulers many years ago due to a disagreement between him and the other Guardians. I trust you may find him in the depths of the desert.

4.Content: As for the other Guardians, I'm as clueless as you lot.

5.Content: Thank you. We'll go and find the Earth Guardian right away!

0.Content: Baden?

1.Content: Thane? What brings you here?

2.Content: We've come to find the Elemental Guardian.

3.Content: (Thane quickly explains the purpose of his journey.)

4.Content: The Wood Guardian has been imprisoned on the Island of the Banished. Respen and I were on our way to rescue him when we were attacked by Corruptors.

5.Content: We must escape first!

0.Content: Baden, this time, we fight side by side, together!
We've cleared all the Corruptors. Let's continue our journey into the desert and find this Earth Guardian.

1.Content: We must also return to the Island of the Banished to save the Wood Guardian.

2.Content: I'm the only one among us who's familiar with the island. Thane, we should stop this elemental disaster as soon as we can. I suggest we split up.

3.Content: When we find the Guardians, we shall meet at the Bastion of the Elements and fight together!

0.Content: Be careful, there are hordes of Corruptors roaming about, just up ahead.

1.Content: I spot two figures surrounded by the Corruptors, we must come to their rescue!

2.Content: Let's go!

0.Content: More Corruptors keep coming. I fear we won't withstand their attacks for long.

1.Content: We've got to find a way out!

2.Content: I've a bold idea, if a bit risky. The Wind Emblem is one of the keys to activating the Elemental Altar. It is also said to be able to grant extraordinary power to mortals.

3.Content: Yet no mortal has ever borne the Elemental Emblems in history before. The risk is far too much for any single person to take.

4.Content: Know that whoever holds the Elemental Emblems will become the target of the Corruptors.

5.Content: The Elemental Emblems are like a lantern at night, luring the Corruptors to come like moths to a flame. They will tirelessly chase after the bearer, as hungry hyenas after the weak and injured.

6.Content: This is the cost of bearing the Elemental Emblems.

0.Content: They are coming!

1.Content: Thane, go now! Leave them to me! (Baden blocks the Corruptors with his wounded body, buying precious time for Thane.)

2.Content: Baden, nooooooo! (Thane)

3.Content: (Baden's resolve reminds Thane of the day they were ambushed by the Maulers. He only managed to escape at the cost of Baden's sacrifice. Yet now, the same tragedy is about to begin again!)

4.Content: I won't let this happen again!

5.Content: Respen, I'm ready for a fight!

0.Content: A good night's rest after a long journey is the most comfortable! Next it's time to start a new journey, isn't it, sir?

1.Content: Haha, yes indeed! This bumpy ride on the sea has really knocked me around! Thank the Divine Light for giving us a peaceful night.

2.Content: And, of course, thanks to Angelo for recommending me a witty and dependable companion.

3.Content: You're too kind, sir. Let's go ahead and investigate the Ancient Ruins.

0.Content: Now's not the time to leave the city, let's investigate here first.
This doesn't seem to be a museum. It would be best to check out the museum first.
Sir, is it true that there are things that can be learned about the Ancient Ruins from the museum?

1.Content: Haha, of course! I've heard that the curator here is very knowledgeable and is aware of much that is not apparent to the average person.

2.Content: Thank you both for waiting, I am the curator here, is there something I can help you with?

3.Content: Oh... I had rather expected the curator to be a sagely old man like myself.

4.Content: Ahem... the curator seems to be enchanted by a very advanced Golem. This is a type of magic I have only heard of on the wind.

5.Content: Haha, as they say, the world is a big and peculiar place.

6.Content: I once learned in a history book that there was a long-extinct kingdom in this vicinity, and that under the remains of this kingdom lies the final treasure bequeathed to its people.

7.Content: I would like to ask you, curator, is this true?

8.Content: The story you describe did spread in this region.

9.Content: There is a Magic Elemental Tower on each of the islands in this vicinity. According to legend, if the Magic Elemental Towers on these islands are illuminated, the ancient remains will emerge with the lost treasures.

10.Content: But for nearly a hundred years many people have tried and struggled in pursuance of this legend, and so far no one has been successful.

11.Content: Then I, the curious old codger that I am, must witness the truth of the matter before I can rest.

12.Content: Not a problem, I will handle your hassles for you. After all, I promised Angelo I would look after you.

13.Content: In that case, I should like to make my proposal as well.

14.Content: If you find buried treasures in the ruins, can you send them here for the Museum collection?

15.Content: For fairness, I will present you with a treasure that I have kept to this day - it should be very helpful to you on your journey.

16.Content: If you would like to sir, then I have no objections.

17.Content: That sounds terrific! So that's decided.

18.Content: Before you depart I must also remind you that this item is very precious. If you use it without care, you may miss other opportunities.

0.Content: Ancient ruins? I've heard of them. They belonged to a nation that died out a long, long time ago. It was once a prosperous and wealthy country with generous people of high moral integrity.

1.Content: Later, however, the country suffered from both natural and man-made disasters - the land's resources were depleted, and the people didn't have enough to eat, followed by warfare sweeping across the country until a powerful mage cast a spell capable of destroying the world. Together with the kingdom, the land was torn apart and shattered into what is now this group of islands.

2.Content: I wonder how vast the fabled treasure of the ruins is?

0.Content: We have an extensive collection here at the museum, and I heard that the museum curator himself traveled all over to collect them.

1.Content: The curator, who is extremely knowledgeable and physically fit, despite his unusual-looking appearance, was always very patient with us and often answered our questions. That's why no one felt that he was any different from us.

2.Content: The curator is a monster! The curator is a bad guy!

3.Content: ...Hey now, you shouldn't take the words of a child's nonsense seriously. Recently, he keeps saying he saw the curator looking at a map in a deserted area, chanting that he will certainly get the legacy, something about restoring the faded kingdom or some such...

4.Content: Heh heh, just a kid fooling around.

0.Content: It looks like our maritime journey resumes from here.

1.Content: Haha, I believe you won't want to go sailing for a long time after accompanying this old boy back.

2.Content: Right now it's more important to get to a nearby island and try to illuminate the Magic Elemental Tower.

0.Content: A job once begun is half done! With the experience, I believe it will be much easier to illuminate the rest of the Towers.
According to what the curator said, after we have illuminated all the Magic Elemental Towers, the Ancient Ruins will surface with the lost treasures.

1.Content: The journey wasn't easy, but do you think we're lighting the way to the ancient kingdom like this?

0.Content: Hey there! Hurry over here!
Someone seems to be asking for help over there, can you hear what he's saying?

1.Content: That man is calling to us, so if he's in a jam, how about we give him a hand?

0.Content: Thank goodness! Finally, someone alive! Seeing how easily you guys got here, you must be pretty strong. The beasts around here are really troublesome and are affecting my luck in catching big fish.

1.Content: If you can help me get rid of them, I'll give you something nice that might come in handy.

0.Content: The nearby beasts have all been driven away, so you should be fine now.

1.Content: No problem? There's a huge problem! I just almost caught a big fish, but even the littlest of movements made by those guys scared it away! You have to dispatch every beast on this island!

0.Content: Good job! Now I can finally fish in peace. Here you go, this magic bridge is my reward to you. Perhaps you'll need it?

1.Content: Oh... the curator gave us one of these, too.

2.Content: You really did find your way here thanks to that fellow's instructions. I thought that after all this time, even after the number of people attracted by the so-called treasure was getting smaller and smaller, he would have given up.

3.Content: I didn't expect him to be so persistent.

4.Content: Judging from your words, are you and the curator acquainted?

0.Content: It is still too soon to understand all of this. To give you a hint, what you're looking for will only appear after you've lit up all the Magic Towers in these waters.
Seeing as you are the only people who have illuminated the Magic Towers we left behind, let me tell you a story.

1.Content: A long, long time ago, when this area of the sea was still a whole continent, there was a prosperous and rich country. In this country, people didn't know the desolation of starvation, didn't understand the misery of war, and everyone lived happily, striving to create a better tomorrow.

2.Content: It was not until later that the land was depleted and war engulfed the land, the beautiful country was transformed into a place that breeds nightmares. But even then, the people yearned to return to their past, to the days when they were still content.

3.Content: So, they used the last of their resources to leave behind their treasure, entrusting the possibility of a surviving warrior using this Relic to recall their souls and restore the former Kingdom.

4.Content: But this hope was crushed by the country's most powerful mage. He cast a spell of absolute devastation. Since then, the land has been shattered, the Relic perished, and their beautiful kingdom became a ghost of a bygone era.

5.Content: I don't know how long it took, but the passing sea winds made stagnant time march onward, and new life was born from the wreckage of this earth. Unlike the past, the flower of civilization bloomed again.

6.Content: ...So, are you the warrior who was entrusted with all this, or the mage who destroyed it all?

7.Content: People are so obsessed with looking back at the good old days, running away from catastrophe and not knowing how to do any introspection. This fragility will be retained forever and civilization will not be able to advance. Unfortunately, he still doesn't understand this.

8.Content: What you say really struck a chord with me... but at the risk of repeating myself, how can I see the Ancient Ruins in their former state? I have a keen interest in the kingdom you described.

9.Content: It is situated at the end of the world, blanketed with Purity Blossoms, the gateway of the Illusory Dream. The remnants of the Ancient Kingdom were annihilated by steel, blood and tears, but they will never be forgotten.

10.Content: All right, get out of here and leave me to my fishing.

0.Content: It looks like this could be the rumored treasure.

1.Content: I can indeed feel magic emanating from it.

0.Content: Huh? So this place is... It seems that acquiring the treasures of the Ancient Ruins won't be straight forward.

1.Content: Sir, what's next for you?

0.Content: I'm glad to hear that you're back. How was the trip? Did you find any treasure at the Ancient Ruins?

1.Content: We have the legacy treasure right here.

2.Content: However, I should like to pass on to you the words of a fisherman: people are so obsessed with looking back at the good old days, running away from catastrophe and not knowing how to do any introspection. This fragility will be retained forever and civilization will not be able to advance.

3.Content: Oh, it appears you've already met him.

4.Content: It is true, I am the one once entrusted with the hopes of the people. Unfortunately, I was affected by the magic residue of the war, my body was ruined after a prolonged period exposed to it. I could only survive with the aid of golem magic.

5.Content: I've always looked forward to the restoration of my homeland, the wonderful country of my past, to this land. But the more time that passes, the hazier my memories of the past become.

6.Content: Thanks to the Relic you brought back, I was able to recall all my old memories. The prosperity and splendor of the kingdom, the respect of the people, and my wife's smile. They'd all been a blur, but they are vivid once again.

7.Content: The people who live here now are no different from the people I miss in the past.

8.Content: If that's the case, what do you intend to do now?

9.Content: I will record my memories, write them down in a book, and inscribe this otherwise fanciful legend into history once and for all. That is what I intend to do.

10.Content: Thank you so much for recovering my memories. I hope this journey has been enlightening for you.

0.Content: I'm glad to hear that you're back. How was the trip? Did you find any treasure at the Ancient Ruins?

1.Content: We have the legacy treasure right here.

2.Content: It's wonderful! Thank you so much for your contribution! I will cherish it forever in my museum and tell anyone who comes here that the legend is indeed true!

3.Content: It's just a pity that we can't see the legendary Kingdom with our own eyes. I wonder how glorious it actually used to be?

0.Content: You are all alone for the rest of the journey sir, Godspeed!

1.Content: Many thanks for accompanying me for so long, Lorsan. It was an absolute pleasure to have you recommended to me by Angelo.
