2.Content: If we ever cross paths again, I would love to sit down with you somewhere and talk about my subsequent experiences and discoveries!

3.Content: May we both be blessed with luck, Lorsan.

0.Content: I don't get it, why is this childish Crystabug herding task our job?

1.Content: Well, you were the one who blindly tore the ad from the Bounty Board.

2.Content: That was the last one left! Besides, if we don't pull in some gold, we'll miss the compensation deadline for the house we razed on that last job. Anyway, each Crystabug is supposed to be the size of a carriage! How are we even meant to herd them?

3.Content: They're quite docile critters, if you bring them close to one another they'll form an orderly line as they move forward. We just need to lead them towards their familiars. If we're able to find the Rancher, he'll herd the rest, and then that's it, mission accomplished.

4.Content: Ah whatever! If we happen to stomp a few bandit dens along the way then even better! I'm actually pretty pumped!

0.Content: These pioneers sure have some stones, building a mine in such a dangerous place... But what on earth are some old drunk and a little kid doing here?!

1.Content: Pah! You can't pull the wool over my eyes. I've been hearing about the steam coming from this rift for years. They say it makes the best wine in the world, and all I want for my day's wages is a barrel full of it!

2.Content: Listen to what you're saying. It took a lot of hard work to get here, and after jumping through all the hoops to get exclusive rights to the rift steam, it'll be under my sole control. By then, Master Rigby, you are welcome to purchase as much as you wish!

0.Content: Remember to use the mechanism's symmetry. The cannons on either side of the rift are symmetrical, and connected to each other, so you can fire the one over here to break any obstructions on the other side.

1.Content: Hey, take it easy! That's a barrel full of the finest materials, so watch it.

0.Content: The finish line's in sight! This is it, the last push!

1.Content: Don't get complacent. Remember what you've learned, and be careful.

0.Content: Thank you so much, Gwyneth. I've long heard Hendrik praise your talent with a bow, so I'm certain that you being here with us will be an enormous boon.

1.Content: You speak far too highly of me, Commander Hogan. Sir Hendrik sent me here to hone my archery skill, all the while performing my solemn duties with all haste.

2.Content: Then let's not chatter idly. Come this way.

3.Content: These are the outskirts of the Black Woods. There's been a resurgence in Graveborn patrolling the area. It is vital we nip this in the bud and do not give them chance to invade. We must patrol the area daily, watching keenly for any Graveborn movement.

0.Content: No Lightbearer may cross these Spectral Wastes. The atmosphere is heavily tainted by Unlife Essence, if we do not act soon enough, who can say what the Graveborn will do to this place.

1.Content: We need to employ the purifying powers of the Divine Light Towers, left here by the Temple.

2.Content: Unfortunately, as the Graveborn power here grows, the purifying powers of the Divine Light Towers thus weakens. We must obtain the power of the Divine Light lingering in the other Towers to purify the Spectral Wastes.

0.Content: (Shocked) Is that...

1.Content: According to reports from an earlier guard's patrol, this Cannon was recently built by active Graveborn in the area.

2.Content: They saw heavy losses in the Battle of the Black Woods, so I think this is their attempt at retaliation. They intend to stop those who have interacted with Divine Light from getting closer.

3.Content: Understood. I need to weave around to the top in order to activate the Divine Light Towers, and initiate purification.

4.Content: Correct. Provided there's no interaction with Divine Light, there will be no attack from the Graveborn Cannon.

0.Content: We ought to use the Divine Light's power to purify the western Spectral Wastes, but... (Looks around) there's another Graveborn Cannon in the area.

1.Content: What a pain...

0.Content: Hah! I've got it. If my memory serves, there's a Cannon a little ways north. We can make use of that to destroy the Graveborn Cannon.

1.Content: It requires a minor detour, but we can patrol with caution.

0.Content: Good. Now the remaining Spectral Wastes won't pose us any problems.

1.Content: Well said, Gwyneth! The rumors of your calmness, intelligence and bravery are indeed true. Hendrik is deeply fortunate to be blessed with such a daughter!

2.Content: It's only what is expected of me, Commander Hogan. We can now confirm these Graveborn Cannons can be destroyed with powerful Cannons...

3.Content: Indeed, so my next course of action is to send someone to destroy the rest of the Graveborn Cannons here.

4.Content: Haha, with your assistance, a great deal of time and energy was saved. You're welcome anytime, Gwyneth.

0.Content: Long have I sought you, Mauler traitor.

1.Content: It's been a long time, my pupil.

0.Content: I was furious, inconsolably so, for such a long time. You had abandoned your Mauler honor and betrayed everyone's trust. I did not understand.

1.Content: You're not one prone to ambition. Why did you turn your back?

2.Content: Brutus, that's enough talk. Let's finish this battle once and for all. Prove yourself worthy of the Blood Claw title.

3.Content: Tell me the truth!

0.Content: Very well then, I'll tell you!

1.Content: I'll tell you everything that happened!

0.Content: That's all for today's training, Brutus.

1.Content: Teacher, Skriath's forces grow stronger by the day...

2.Content: Worry not, Brutus. I'm ready for anything.

3.Content: Once my plans come to fruition, the Maulers shall have their new Grand Chieftain. Soon.

0.Content: Skriath's plan is working. The Quicksand Claws thinks I'm having a conflict with Skriath and has sent his men to conduct a negotiation.

1.Content: The Quicksand Claws also mentioned that the Lightbearer's emissary might come.

2.Content: Time to head to their scout post.

0.Content: Exalted Blood Claw, Skriath's influence is gaining traction, we——

1.Content: You doubt my ability? Skriath is a mere youngster.

2.Content: Everything is well in hand.

3.Content: But you, the Lightbearer Temple... Where's your goodwill?

4.Content: We've got money and weapons, as much as you want. The Quicksand Claws will also be at your disposal.

5.Content: Get rid of Skriath and the role of Mauler Grand Chieftain is yours to take.

6.Content: It's "ours".

7.Content: It'll all kick off soon enough. Once the time is right, I'll lead the attack.

8.Content: We look forward to your good news, Blood Claw. No, Mauler Great Chieftain.

0.Content: Everything is just as we expected, the Quicksand Claws have taken the bait.

1.Content: Anasta, are you really going through with this? This "traitor" plan of yours?

2.Content: Skriath, it was you that told me the Maulers were divided, that Lightbearers were tearing them apart.

3.Content: But as you can see, just like hyenas that have lost their sense of smell, the tribe chiefs are totally oblivious, instead killing one another over scraps of carcasses while the humans reap all the benefits.

4.Content: We must snap them out of it. We need to use a method that will bring them back to their senses.

5.Content: Are you certain you want Brutus to be the one who discovers your betrayal? It doesn't have to be him... You know how deeply his trust for you runs.

6.Content: He will do a fine job. Believe me, it's time he took on that responsibility.

7.Content: But... Shouldn't he know the truth?

8.Content: I know him well. If he knew the truth, he wouldn't take it on. He's a warrior who values glory and pride, and this pride will inspire him to become a worthy Blood Claw.

9.Content: I've already left a clue in my tent. When Brutus finds it, he'll be sure to stop me.

10.Content: Enough talk. The goal is in sight! Let's get things started.

11.Content: For the Maulers.

12.Content: For the Maulers.

0.Content: Skriath desires a meeting of the tribe chiefs at Chieftain's Peak, this is the perfect opportunity.

1.Content: The Quicksand Claws are at your disposal.

2.Content: Then, I can handle them all in one fell swoop.

0.Content: Who?

1.Content: Chieftains, apologies for my tardiness.

2.Content: Anasta, you are colluding with the Quicksand Claws!

3.Content: The Maulers need a new leader.

0.Content: Stop right there!

1.Content: Brutus, you've arrived in the nick of time.

2.Content: I never realized you were in league with the Lightbearers... Anasta!

3.Content: Lightbearers?

4.Content: The Quicksand Claws have long colluded with the Lightbearers, and here you are, planning a coup d'état with them in tow!

5.Content: The Maulers need to change.

6.Content: There's been a change of plan. We're withdrawing.

0.Content: Anasta, why!?

1.Content: The time for talk is over.

2.Content: Fleeing is futile!

0.Content: Let's end it here, Brutus.

1.Content: STOP!

2.Content: Don't bother following her, Brutus, there are more important matters to address.

0.Content: And ever since, Anasta has lived a secret life, protecting the Mauler tribes from the shadows.

1.Content: Only when the Earth Guardian came to halt the spreading of the desert sands did Anasta come to stand guard, under orders.

2.Content: This is the truth. Anasta, the "traitor", never betrayed the tribe.

3.Content: I knew... I just knew... But why? Why didn't you tell me from the beginning?

4.Content: Let me ask you, Brutus. What exactly is a warrior?

5.Content: One who knows when to bide their time and stand back, one who must sometimes make difficult choices, even choices that seem inglorious.

7.Content: I understand.

8.Content: The elemental imbalance grows yet, we must find the successor to the Earth Emblem with all haste and bring a halt to the spreading calamity!

9.Content: Anasta, it's time.

10.Content: I am here because of the elemental imbalance. I wish to grant you the power of the Earth Emblem. You will gain immense power, but you will pay a heavy price.

11.Content: You will become the Corruptors' prime target.

12.Content: For the tribe, nothing is too high a price.

13.Content: Let me be the one to accept the Earth Emblem.

14.Content: Teacher, you have already shouldered too much. Now I will bear these burdens.

15.Content: The Elemental Emblems grant more than power, they are bearers of unknown disaster. Corruptors are inescapably drawn to them, you'll be in constant, unwavering danger.

16.Content: I am ready.

17.Content: There is one matter I must attend before I depart.

18.Content: The Crown and Cloak passed down through generations of Blood Claws... I sealed them away in the temple. I shall retrieve them, and only then will my journey as the true Blood Claw begin.

0.Content: I hear something. It's here.

1.Content: A Corruptor... I arrived just in time.

0.Content: As the Blood Claw, I must not fall!

1.Content: Blood Claw is much more than just a title. It represents something so much greater.

2.Content: The one who bears this title shoulders a huge burden.

3.Content: The road is fated to be difficult, surrounded by powerful enemies, outnumbered and alone.

4.Content: Humiliated and doubtful, alone in the darkness.

5.Content: When the Tribe is in need, I must rise to the occasion.

6.Content: My body is a blade, and I will carve my way forward!

0.Content: Hey, what's this? It's round like a balloon!

1.Content: It's a pufferfish, Peggy. Be careful. Their spines are sharp…

2.Content: I'm not your regular pufferfish! Call me——Captain Pufferfish! I am the lord of this sea...*Coughs*!

3.Content: Captain? Are you the captain of a pirate ship? Shouldn't a captain have a ship? Why don't I see one?

4.Content: That's rude! Who said I didn't have a ship! I have a huge ship called "The Pufferfish"! Have you heard of it? It's enormous and powerful!

5.Content: I've never heard of it. Does it look like a pufferfish?

6.Content: It's nothing like a pufferfish! It's the greatest ship ever! But... a while ago we were ambushed by The Reviled Captain with his ship "The Immortal". And they sunk my poor Pufferfish!

7.Content: Captain Pufferfish, it's okay. You can rebuild a ship and seek your revenge against The Reviled Captain!

8.Content: Haha, you spoke my mind! You seem clever and resourceful... Have you ever been out at sea? Why don't you help me rebuild The Pufferfish and seek revenge against The Reviled Captain?

9.Content: *Coughs* If you help me rebuild Pufferfish and exact revenge on the Reviled Captain, you can have three parts of the treasures and seven parts of the sea…I'm a great voyager. I've seen all kinds of treasures in the sea...

10.Content: Marvelous! Treasures in the sea! Let's go treasure hunting then!

11.Content: Peggy, let's calm down first! So Captain, what's the first thing we should do?

12.Content: First we'll need a reliable shipbuilder to help us repair The Pufferfish! I know Motiz Cove like the back of my hand. If my memory serves me right, there's a shipbuilder up ahead. Let's go find him.

0.Content: Oh, aren't you little Pufferfish? What brings you here? Where's your big…

1.Content: *Coughs* It's a long story. I'm here to seek your help repairing The Pufferfish. Our ship was sunken and we only have a bit of wood left...Can you fix it?

2.Content: I think it's beyond repair. Why don't we buy another ship? Raku, what do you think~

3.Content: This young lady has a good eye indeed. The ships I build are sturdy, but they're going to cost you…

4.Content: But I'm penniless...That means I can't get a new Pufferfish, and I can't go to sea anymore...

5.Content: Mr Shipbuilder, how much would it cost? I have a little bit of money, but I don't know if it's enough!

6.Content: I suppose the young lady won't have much money to spare...oh? That much? That's more than enough! Come on, this ship is yours!

0.Content: This is... The Pufferfish?

1.Content: It's such a small ship. Raku, how many people can it carry? I don't think there's enough space for even a big conch…

2.Content: ...This is a far cry from the old Pufferfish!!! Mr Shipbuilder, did you not find a suitable ship based on the amount of money Peggy offered?

3.Content: It's what the young girl's money can get you. Good luck!

4.Content: I feel we've been ripped off... but my ship-handling skills are never limited by the size of the ship. Let's get on board, children! I'll take you on an adventure, and sail across this great sea toward our ultimate goal——to defeat The Reviled Captain!

0.Content: There are reefs here! We should turn around and try another way!

1.Content: We can't sail over these reefs. I wonder if there's a way to break them?

2.Content: Let's go ask Mr Shipbuilder!

0.Content: Our ship has come up against some huge reefs at sea. How can we pass over them?

1.Content: Ah, these reefs won't break easily...If you want to break through them to reach the outer waters, you can try looking in the town of Port Motiz.

0.Content: Captain Pufferfish, is this sea big? Are there many places we won't be able to reach?

1.Content: The sea is endless...We don't know how far we can go.

2.Content: It's said the weather is strange over these waters. Many islands here are shrouded by fog. If we enter the sea rashly and unprepared, things will go wrong! Let's take it one step at a time. Don't rush into anything.

3.Content: *Whimpers* I wonder how big the sea is! What's there at the other end of the sea~ *Whimpers* Why can't someone check it out for us! That way we won't have to worry about the fog!

4.Content: But we don't have any more men on deck now.

5.Content: I've got an idea! Let me see if my scouts are here. They'll be able to find many fun places~

6.Content: What a clever kid... but we're not sailing for pleasure. We're on quest for revenge! It's revenge!

7.Content: Peggy sure is happy. I hope the scouts can clear the fog for us.

0.Content: Wow. This looks like a great fishing spot!

1.Content: Is this Her Highness Princess Peggy? It's really you. I'm a bit flustered...

2.Content: Hi, Mr Fisherman! May I play with the little fishes?

3.Content: There are a lot of different fish in this part of the sea. You could try fishing, and who knows, you might just find your favorite fish.

4.Content: Really? Great! Then I'm going to catch a lot of fish!

5.Content: Your Highness can exchange the fish you catch for rewards. Each area has its own special fish. If you see them, be sure to catch them!

6.Content: Wow. Will there be a lot of fish? How am I gonna remember all their names...

7.Content: This is the Fishpedia, a compilation of many years of records by the fisherfolks. It has descriptions of the physical characteristics of various fish. I'm giving it to Your Highness in the hopes that you will find it useful in your fishing quests.

8.Content: Thank you, Mr Fisherman! I'm going to catch so many fish!

9.Content: It looks like the little princess is starting to enjoy the thrill of adventures.

0.Content: I see a lot of sailors returning from the sea in this tavern. I wonder what interesting things they've encountered.

1.Content: Dear guests, please take a seat anywhere in the tavern. We also have juices for the little ones. But watch out for the drunken sailor over there. He mumbles and boasts about all day. I wouldn't get too close if I were you.

2.Content: What fools! They have no idea how much gold there is on Treasure Island. It's the island filled with the treasures of You-know-who.

3.Content: Captain Pufferfish, this sailor is talking about Treasure Island. What kind of an island is it? Does it have a lot of treasures?

4.Content: Oh, you heard what I said? *Burps* Pardon me, I had a little too much to drink! Haha. Let me tell you, Treasure Island is a magical place. Without my clues, you'll never find it.

5.Content: Treasure Island? Is that The Reviled Captain…

6.Content: Shhh——how could you say the name of You-know-who? The island is actually there in plain sight. It's just that many are blinded by ignorance and fail to see the real treasures that are close at hand.

7.Content: I don't understand... So Mr Sailor, do you know where Treasure Island is?

8.Content: You are the first person to ask me about the location of Treasure Island. That's interesting. Nobody else in this tavern knows a gem even if it hits them in the face. How funny. I do know where it is. Give me a moment to think...

9.Content: Oops, I seem to have forgotten the exact location...I have a map here. Haha. But it was already in pieces when I got it. If you believe me, why not piece these clues together? You might find where Treasure Island is.

10.Content: So why didn't you go there on your own? I think you're just looking for help piecing the map together!

11.Content: Who would ever put this wine down…Besides, if you do find Treasure Island, it's got enough treasure to last you till your next life! So you've got to share half of it with me!

12.Content: Is the wine that great? It's Peggy's first time in a tavern!

13.Content: Peggy is still young. You aren't allowed to drink!

14.Content: Take this clue. I've visited all the places in these waters. I'll give you more clues the next time you're here. I'll also tell you some interesting stories. They're 100 times more delicious than the wine!

0.Content: Whaaaah! Help, help!

1.Content: Huh? Are you here for the legendary Dwarven treasures too?

2.Content: There are no treasures whatsoever! There's nothing here but traps!

3.Content: They must've set traps to protect the treasures. I'll go in and check it out.

4.Content: Hey, wait!

0.Content: What's that sound? Oh? Have I stepped on something?

1.Content: You just triggered a trap... Look there! Now the road ahead is completely blocked!

0.Content: Whoa... Over there!
I see, if we trigger a trap that blocks our way, all we need to do is find the right Deactivation Tower to undo the blockage.
My feet feel so warm, have you noticed too?

1.Content: Ah! This is a hot spring!

0.Content: Don't worry, whoever set this trap wouldn't trap themselves. There's got to be a way to remove it...

1.Content: Okay, let's search around!

0.Content: Huh? Where are we?

1.Content: I don't know. This seems to be some sort of portal set by the dwarves. It should be safe.

2.Content: So we got past the trap?

3.Content: Yeah... Let's keep going!

0.Content: My scouts are here!

1.Content: Hehehe. We don't have to be afraid of the fog anymore.

2.Content: I've got to hand it to you, little girl. These scouts are amazing!

0.Content: Oh, hi... handsome lady, are you interested in joining our Pufferfish crew?

1.Content: Pufferfish? How is it that this pufferfish can talk?

2.Content: This is Captain Pufferfish, the owner of The Pufferfish. We're helping him in his quest across the sea to seek revenge against The Reviled Captain.

3.Content: Excuse me, what do you mean by "this pufferfish"? *Coughs* I'm the captain of the mighty Pufferfish. But you seem interested in our adventure. Why don't you join us? We might be short-handed now, but in no time many more great seamen will be joining our crew!

4.Content: We'll explore the sea and find so many treasures! And defeat… defeat the big baddie!

5.Content: Captain Pufferfish may not look reliable… but he knows a great deal about navigating the seas! You might learn a thing or two from him!

6.Content: That sounds fun. It's a great idea. Let me see where you're heading to next.

0.Content: Up ahead is Port Motiz. A shipbuilder there told us we could find out how to modify The Pufferfish into a more seaworthy ship here...First, we need to figure out how to break the reefs! Or we won't be able to leave here at all!

1.Content: The buildings in this city are gorgeous! The people at this port must be rich!

2.Content: What's that shiny house? Will it have treasures?

3.Content: I guess it's the residence of the lord of the city, the richest man in the port. Why don't we ask him? He should know how to break a reef.

0.Content: Strangers, what brings you to Port Motiz? How can I help you?

1.Content: My Noble Lord, we'd like to travel to the waters outside Port Motiz, but we're blocked by the reefs. Is there any way we can break them?

2.Content: To crush the reefs and clear your passage, you'd definitely need a solid bow.

3.Content: There's a bow! Could you give...No, I mean, could you lend it to us? We'll return it to you once we've broken the reefs.

4.Content: As outsiders, you should know that this is not a peaceful place. I can't just give you this reef-crushing bow without you making a contribution to Port Motiz.

5.Content: Did something happen here?

6.Content: The people of Port Motiz have been trading by the sea for centuries. Originally, no trade could thrive here due to the reefs that form naturally around the port. However, the bows made by the residents were able to break the reefs. Eventually, that put Port Motiz on the map.

7.Content: Then why are there more reefs now…

8.Content: We've been frequently harassed by pirates in recent years. They took our bows and forced the people to pay them for using the bows whenever they went to sea. After a few times, the people could no longer afford to pay, and trading ceased.

9.Content: That's so sad... Why didn't my Lord drive the pirates out of here?

10.Content: We never had any skilled soldiers at the port to begin with. We did fight, but in the end we couldn't stop the pirates from entering the city or retrieve the bows that had been taken. With what material that was left, we couldn't make more bows. And those pirates...They were no ordinary pirates...

11.Content: Would my Lord lend us the bow if we could chase away the pirates?

12.Content: As long as you can drive them out of Port Motiz, I'll certainly lend you a reef-crushing bow. The pirates usually roam around the southern and eastern coasts. It's especially dangerous in the east, so be careful.

0.Content: Young ones, you don't look like you're from around here. We've had many people gone missing lately. It's too dangerous here. Don't wander around.

1.Content: What's happened here, sir?

2.Content: Ever since the pirates arrived, we haven't left the port...It's not just because of the pirates though. If you ever meet the Lord of the City, don't believe a word he says!

3.Content: The Lord? Why would the pirates want to keep you in the port? Wouldn't they want you to trade and make more money, so they can take more?

4.Content: That's right! Why would they do that? It's odd.

5.Content: It's a long story...You look like brave souls. If you want to get out of here, go take a look in the east of the port. Be careful though, since the pirates there don't look human…

0.Content: Wooaahh…It stinks here!

1.Content: There are a lot of rotten things…It stinks so bad!

2.Content: Why do these pirates look so strange? They're not like the pirates who plunder at sea. They're more like the minions of The Reviled Captain!

3.Content: I'm detecting the smell of Graveborn——the smell of death.

4.Content: Oh dear, that looks like their captain! Wooaahhh——how does he have three heads?!

0.Content: Is the bartender deaf? I asked for another round of beer.

1.Content: You're a great drinker! Your belly's like a bottomless pit!

2.Content: No, trust me, this is no bottomless pit...Let me tell you. Just south of the cove, there's an area of the sea that has the most powerful hurricanes. The whirlpools they cause are the real bottomless pits!

3.Content: Wooaahh…Then I'm not going there. I'd be blown away!

4.Content: It's normal to encounter a storm at sea. But people don't make it back from those winds there. So if I were you… I'd try to find a way to control my ship's direction!

5.Content: So is Treasure Island there?

6.Content: Treasure Island... Treasure Island's not gonna be in an obvious place like this. Here you go, don't let the wind blow away this clue! Next time you're here, I hope the bartender will have served up my favorite tipple.

0.Content: The trinity of Graveborn pirates have wreaked havoc on Port Motiz.

1.Content: The poor Lord of the City has locked the people in their houses so hastily. But I guess they won't be in any danger as long as they don't encounter any Graveborn.

2.Content: So can their lives return to normal?

3.Content: We have the bow now. Let's go tell the lord!

0.Content: The pirates may not have been driven out for good, but it also means that they are not invincible! Port Motiz is once again full of hope. Now let me bring the bows...

1.Content: We've retrieved the bows from the pirates. They look sturdy!

2.Content: What? Shouldn't all the bows be...Does that mean...

3.Content: My Lord, we've heard about your concerns. Rest assured, we won't say anything to the people. Hopefully, you'll be able to bring the port back to its former glory.

4.Content: But...Why do they have the bows?

5.Content: They may have fallen out from somewhere, I suppose. Everything here is so interesting! It's a shame there are no treasures. I wonder what else is in the waters out there!

6.Content: As far as I know, your ultimate destination seems to be that captain's base. So I think you need to transform your ship so that it can fight him.

7.Content: I heard the captain concealed the treasures on an island, but no one has ever been there. Everyone says it's a mirage. If you can find that island, you'll have all the riches in the world.

8.Content: Huh, I don't care if it's a mirage! Let's move on! I can't wait to find out what treasures are lying in the sea!

0.Content: The winds here are too strong! I can't work the rudder at all!

1.Content: We're in the middle of a hurricane. It looks like this whole area has been overtaken by the hurricane. We're lucky that we can even control the ship's direction!

2.Content: Raku! I'm feeling woozy. Everything is swirling. *Whimpers*

3.Content: We need to find a way to steady the ship in the storm. If only we had a sail., so we can at least sail against the wind...

4.Content: Watch out! There's a reef up ahead. Don't run into it!

5.Content: I'll do all I can to control the ship's direction!

0.Content: Phew. Thank god there's no wind here!

1.Content: The winds have stopped before the reef. They say the sea god protects devout adventurers. This may be the sea god looking after us.

2.Content: We're devout adventurers! The waters here are so calm. It's like a mirror!

3.Content: Do you hear it? Look, something's there!

0.Content: It's probably a sail left by someone who's survived a storm. If we can fit it to our ship, we might just get through this storm safely.

1.Content: Let's do it then. Put it on! Time to get out of here!

2.Content: I saw a lot of supplies on the sea when Sis and I were feeling sick. Why don't we pick them up? I don't want to run out of bread!

3.Content: Well, if the sail can stabilize the hull, we can collect the supplies from the sea to last us for our journey ahead.

0.Content: What's there in the fog…

1.Content: Mr Sailor, are you drunk again?

2.Content: Nonsense! Young lady, let me tell you… If you ever come into a fog at sea, do everything you can to keep to the right direction. Or you might end up in that deserted port, where you'll be caught and never leave the place again!

3.Content: Who would sail into the deserted port for no good reason?

4.Content: Hey, be careful. Don't get heard. I'll share with you a secret. I heard there are dead… *Coughs* Well let's leave it at that. And take this clue with you!

5.Content: It sounds a bit scary...

6.Content: Haha. What if Treasure Island is there?

0.Content: The fog is so thick. It feels like we're just going around in circles. I remember this used to be a bustling port. But now it's completely deserted. How different it looks now than before.

1.Content: What a desolate place! It's scary... Raku, this place is giving me the creeps!

2.Content: I don't know if the ship will hit anything in this thick fog...It's too dangerous!

3.Content: Please, save them. Save these poor cursed souls…

4.Content: Wow, who's this? It came out of nowhere!

5.Content: It's an incarnation of the devil...It's them...They're controlling everyone...It's too late. It's over now…It's begun...

6.Content: What's going on? You never finish what you say. What's wrong with you?

7.Content: I...I am a guard of the Port of Thorns. I'm sorry, but we're dealing with a unique situation. I'm sorry.

8.Content: A guard? Isn't this place deserted?

9.Content: Well, even though it's no longer a port here, we still have a number of residents. Not too long ago, a strange ship docked here. Since then everything has changed.

10.Content: Was there anything strange about that ship?

11.Content: No one got off the ship. It just docked here. So we sent a brave fellow guard to sneak into the ship and check it out during the day. But he only returned after a long time. In the evening, we'd hear bellows from the ship...The residents were so terrified!

12.Content: Did the guard who sneaked in ever come back?

13.Content: Yes he did only after a few days. But he looked different, and he was always surrounded by white smoke!

14.Content: White smoke! Like a ghost...

15.Content: Yes, and those people that he approached would become unconscious. When they woke up, they'd be like him, and nothing like their old selves!

16.Content: Why didn't you lock them up?

17.Content: We thought of doing that too...But oddly, those people who woke up would even attack their family and friends. Since then, the entire island has been dead like a graveyard. Even when the residents stayed at home, some of them would still be lured out by those strange people.

18.Content: Lured out? But who would go out in these circumstances?

19.Content: They would ask for help like how they used to when they were normal. Hearing the cries of help of their family or friends, most people would still go out...And in the end...

20.Content: It sounds like a horror story! So why didn't you seek help from the outside?

21.Content: I think the fog is what's keeping them here.

22.Content: Yes, this lady is right. That's exactly our predicament. If you are willing to help us, the fog might just go away...It's not safe here now. Come with me.

0.Content: They look exactly like normal people, but they also look murderous. It's so scary.

1.Content: How do we tell the strange people and the normal residents apart?

2.Content: When I helped some people escape from attacks, I discovered a compass that could point out the direction of any unusual person. It seemed helpful for keeping people away from sudden attacks.

3.Content: It sounds like a blessed compass.

4.Content: Try not to hurt the residents...They can definitely be saved. They haven't lost their souls yet.

5.Content: But... what we just defeated looked like...

6.Content: After this, let's follow the compass! Stay alert!

0.Content: You killed him and took the lives of innocent people. You've committed a sin...
Where are we? Did we hurt any residents just now...

1.Content: They can even teleport. That's unusual. I don't think they are "real" people.

2.Content: Hey, where's the guard? He's gone! Is this...

3.Content: These buildings look like a prison. So the people you just met should be prison guards. We need to get out of here as quickly as possible.

0.Content: Why can't we get out of here? I've never been in a prison that's so like a maze!

1.Content: Captain, have you ever been in prison?

2.Content: Oh yes...But hey, that's not the point! How do we get out of here?

3.Content: How about we check the compass from before! It could be useful!

4.Content: Compass, compass, if you could lead us to the mastermind...

5.Content: Look! The compass is moving!

6.Content: Let's follow it. It's no good staying here anyway.

0.Content: What fools! All they're doing is useless. It's amusing.

1.Content: Wooaahh——What a scary Graveborn lady. *Whimpers*

2.Content: Why are there Graveborn here? Who are you...

3.Content: This place was destroyed long ago. You'll only become dead souls under my blade if you stay here.

4.Content: Cut the nonsense. Graveborn like you are in no place to threaten me.

0.Content: Ah...The fog has disappeared. Why is there nothing here?

1.Content: Perhaps none of it was real, including the guard. He was simply replaying his obsessions. What a sad soul...

2.Content: If all the Graveborn have disappeared, will they get to rest in peace?

0.Content: Raku, can this compass guide us to the things we desire the most?

1.Content: I think so, Captain. What do you desire?

2.Content: Of course it would be...

0.Content: It's so noisy. How can I fish?

1.Content: (The fisherman disappears)...He's gone!!!

2.Content: Is it possible that... he was fishing when tragedy struck, so he's been fishing ever since but never caught the fish he wanted?

3.Content: Wooaahh. Then I must catch that special fish!

0.Content: Have you ever heard the rumor that the Captain built a Blissful Bay to entertain his pirates, where they float all their plundered treasures on the sea, so any pirate that goes there can take anything they like?

1.Content: That sounds ridiculous.

2.Content: I've heard of it, but he's no philanthropist!

3.Content: Little Pufferfish, you sound like you have a story... Maybe it's true? If you get the chance to go there, try and grab something. Who knows you might get a windfall...

4.Content: Treasures? As bright and shiny as those on Treasure Island?

5.Content: Young ladies will always love the bling... Then take this clue with you. When you're at Treasure Island, take a good look and see if it's all shiny like a gold mine!

0.Content: A shiny chest! It's a treasure chest!

1.Content: Looks like the rumor is true... but it's all a bit bizarre. Why would anyone be so absurd as to cast all their treasures on the sea for others to take?

2.Content: Huh. It's said that he rigs the chests. The lucky pirates will get the treasures, while the unlucky ones will be killed by monsters hidden in them or toxic gas that's released when the chest is opened.

3.Content: Wow, that's terrifying!

4.Content: But there are also buildings floating on the water. It's like there are people living in them. Who would they be?

5.Content: Pirates! They must be pirates!

6.Content: The Raging Currents are a famous territory infested by pirates. These buildings should be their supply stations. But still, let's not get too close…

7.Content: Ah... There are so many beautiful chests. Can I pick one?

8.Content: Peggy! It's dangerous! We should listen to the Captain!

9.Content: But I just like...

10.Content: It's so hard to say no to the young lady. Let's pick the most beautiful chest then. If anything goes wrong, we'll just throw it back into the sea!

0.Content: Haha, another little brat is here to end his own life!

1.Content: Damn! He's from The Reviled Captain's crew! He was there when The Pufferfish was wrecked... What a disgusting face!

2.Content: It's all a trap!

3.Content: You're just like those fools drawn here by rumors about the Blissful Bay built by The Reviled Captain, to be slaughtered by us like fat fish for the treasures.

4.Content: Damn it! I won't let it happen!

0.Content: I've been out in the sea for a while now, I started to feel that my hearing is getting muffled... Sometimes I can't even hear little Raku and the little princess calling for me.

1.Content: Well, isn't that a good thing then? It is said that there is a Siren in the sea that can lure sailors with her singing. If you can't hear her singing, then you're safe!

2.Content: Singing? Wouldn't the sound of the Siren sound strange to us…

3.Content: It could sound like noise!

4.Content: Kiddos, if you hear any sound of beautiful singing, hold right on the mast and don't be dragged into the sea...

5.Content: It doesn't even sound that frightening...

6.Content: I really look forward to knowing what kind of singing you'll hear, but in the meantime, help me put together the clues first. I can't wait to see if there will be any singing Sirens on Treasure Island.

0.Content: Although the hull has gone through quite a transformation, it's still not enough to compete with The Reviled Captain. It looks like we have a long adventure ahead...

1.Content: Wow, it's so peaceful here!

2.Content: The little princess always interrupted me! But it seems kind of weird here... Such a calm sea always reminds people of fabled mythic.

3.Content: Mythic? Captain, is it an interesting story?

4.Content: I wouldn't say it's interesting... It is rumored that there's a Siren who can sing in the sea, she uses her singing to distract captains and sailors that steer pass by here, which eventually causes the ships to hit the rocks and sink into the reef.

5.Content: The singing of Siren is indeed a temptation.

6.Content: Yes, Sirens often wander among reefs or ships... There is a legendary captain in the mythic who has never suffered any shipwrecks in his lifetime, but he once betrayed his loved ones and sailed here with his ship. He experienced countless storms and defeated plenty of sea monsters, but he failed to resist the temptation of the Siren and lost his life here eventually.

7.Content: What kind of singing is it that can attract everyone?

8.Content: Hey listen, can you hear the singing...

0.Content: We lost control of the ship just now... The noise was too loud, our eardrums were about the burst. It's so painful!

1.Content: What a terrible noise! Ahh, my head hurts!

2.Content: Noise? Why didn't I hear it, it just seemed to be a lovely song to me... but it was really thrilling! We better steer more carefully!

3.Content: Captain, what you heard was different from what we heard. I just saw a human with a fishtail in the fog! Did you see it?

4.Content: I saw it... and I also heard some noise.

5.Content: It's strange... We better find something to stabilize the hull to avoid being dragged again.

6.Content: Is it something heavy? We won't get dragged if it is!

7.Content: In that case, the legendary captain's ship was sunk in this part of the sea, his anchors could secure the ship's position.

8.Content: But wasn't his ship sinking?

9.Content: At that time, he may have been lured by the Siren's singing and he did not order to let the anchors sink, which caused the ship to perish. If we can find the anchors now, we should be able to prevent them from being towed again.

0.Content: I smell betrayal in you...
I feel that her resentment is deep!

1.Content: It's said that she has a deep resentment for betrayers, so she hid in the sea to drag all the betrayers into the deep sea and destroy them...

2.Content: Oh, Captain, but the one who was lured by the singing just now… seems to be you only?

3.Content: That's right! All we heard was noise, it was horrible!

4.Content: Maybe... you might have betrayed someone?

5.Content: Haha, how is that possible! There's no such thing. It's time for us to go to the next area and the end of The Reviled Captain is getting nearer! Come on, kids!

6.Content: It feels strange!

0.Content: Sailor, sailor, the world's most boring profession is sailor!

1.Content: Mr. Sailor, you're drunk now too!

2.Content: Did you know? In fact, I've always dreamed of being a pirate! That's more fun than a sailor! For example... for example, I can build a fort on the sea so that all passersby can't defend against my cannons! I can also...

3.Content: Cannon... Our ship, The Pufferfish, was attacked by cannons... Waa waa…

4.Content: Mr. Sailor! You hit Captain Pufferfish's sore spot! How unkind of you!

5.Content: Oops, little pufferfish, haha! You have to be careful! Don't be sunk by the cannons again!

6.Content: Will not...

7.Content: What if Treasure Island is also full of pirates' cannons? Can you all still get there safely? Haha, let's take the clues and think about it!

8.Content: Mr. Sailor is a bit scary now...

0.Content: What a fierce attack! The gunfire went on... I remembered what was destroyed at that time...

1.Content: Don't get caught up in memories! It's getting dangerous now!

2.Content: The hull of the Pufferfish is made out of wood. It is currently under heavy attacks from cannons. We have to dodge the attacks and look for materials that can help repair the hull.

3.Content: There seems to be quite a lot of sailors around here! Maybe they can help us!

4.Content: Little Princess! He's from the Reviled Captain's crew! They're all pirates! Now that we're very close to his hideout, we can't underestimate them!

5.Content: I see there are pirates guarding the cannon batteries. It must mean they can be destroyed. Why don't we destroy them all? That way, we won't get attacked anymore.

6.Content: Don't joke anymore... have you counted how many cannon batteries there are here?

7.Content: Ah... I'm joking, chill out.

8.Content: This is not the time for jokes, if we can't defend against cannon attacks, the Pufferfish will be destroyed sooner or later.

9.Content: Miss, please don't be upset with me! I just saw the pirate ship passing through the cannons, but it didn't get attacked!

10.Content: Yes, instead it has bounced the cannonball back to the sea!

11.Content: The hull they use should be a special kind of armor.

12.Content: If the Pufferfish could be fitted with this armor, we would be spared from being damaged by the cannons... or maybe even rebound the cannonballs back onto the battery.

13.Content: That's right! So let's go find out where the armor is!

14.Content: I guess it must be in a very hidden place!

0.Content: Armor should be in the North!

1.Content: Without further ado, let's go.

0.Content: We can destroy all the cannon batteries here with armor!

1.Content: Raku, adjust the boat to the correct angle so that we can reflect cannonballs to them as we pass through them!

2.Content: Bounce it like a marble! Destroy them all!

0.Content: How dare you destroy the captain's cannon! You will all pay the price!

1.Content: This stupid Pufferfish! We will remember this!

2.Content: How ambitious! Let that bastard captain wait for our sanctions!

0.Content: This bartender, always adding algae to spice up my drink... but it tastes awful! I'm filing a complaint!

1.Content: Algae... What is algae?

2.Content: Is algae a type of seaweed? The ones that grow in the sea... It seems to be seen where there are conch shells.

3.Content: Can the big conch that was given to me by Raku play together with seaweed?

4.Content: It's going to get eaten! Ewww... it tastes awful! I have to order a new drink! Having said that... It seems there's one last Treasure Island clue. You must find it.

5.Content: Where exactly will it be?

6.Content: No matter where you are, you will have to come back and give me half of it after you find the treasure. I'll be here waiting for your return. Don't break your promise, those who break promises will be swallowed by seaweed.

7.Content: Whoa! That's scary! Let's go look for Treasure Island! Mr. Sailor, we'll be back!

0.Content: There are so many treasures! Mr. Sailor is truly amazing!

1.Content: That's right! Captain, he's much better than you!

2.Content: Hey! Why is this supposed to denigrate me... But we've got a good haul this time. Let's go back to Mr. Sailor and give him half of these!

0.Content: Mr. Sailor! We're back... oh? What's he gone?

1.Content: This is strange, this is where Mr. Sailor sits normally!

2.Content: Mr. Bartender, have you seen the drunk Sailor that sat here before?

3.Content: Sailor? Drunk sailors? We have a lot of sailors here, but we haven't seen a drunk one around. Besides, sailors are all good drinkers.

4.Content: You're lying! We see him every time we come here! He even told us you made him a glass of wine with seaweed last time!

5.Content: Sorry, guests, but I really haven't seen the sailor you're looking for. And we never use algae to mix our drinks...

6.Content: Ah... strange, where did he go? It was agreed that half of the treasure would go to him…

7.Content: It's like... he doesn't exist?

0.Content: Captain, the Pufferfish is so powerful now! Do we still need to return to Motiz Cove?

1.Content: Hmmm, now the Pufferfish is ready to attack and also defend! It looks like it's not far from hearing The Reviled Captain begging for mercy... haha!

2.Content: Is there a shortcut if we go back from here?

3.Content: Just go ahead... Oops, this is a seaweed-covered strait!

4.Content: Seaweed? Will there be a lot of them in the sea?

5.Content: This is no ordinary grass, little princess. If we don't steer carefully, we may lose our heads.

6.Content: Wow, that's terrifying!

7.Content: It looks like the seaweed's ability to entangle is amazing.

8.Content: It is said that the ships of Port Motiz are often entangled with seaweed when they go out to the sea, which eventually leads to countless capsizes... and some people were found with their heads entangled with seaweed and split, which is why this strait was named The Executioner's Strait.

9.Content: That's horrific! Then we need to pay attention to the direction and avoid seaweed!

10.Content: Un-huh! Be sure to save Peggy and everyone's head!

0.Content: Damn... it's still entangled!

1.Content: We can remove it.

2.Content: Once or twice is still okay... But in the long run, these seaweeds will grow endlessly.

3.Content: Is there any way to keep the seaweed away from entangling us?

4.Content: I heard someone saying "Conch can enclose seaweed" before, maybe we can use conch!

5.Content: Conch... Raku gave me a big conch! Let me blow it!

6.Content: Peggy! The sound of this conch is too gentle... Ah! There is a big conch on the reef ahead!

7.Content: Such a large conch, it can have an inhibitory effect on seaweed.

0.Content: The seaweed has subsided quite a bit….

1.Content: Great! We can leave here!

2.Content: But the conch seems to temporarily keep the seaweed from growing. If we don't blow the conch all the time, the seaweed will still wrap around the ship!

3.Content: Then let's leave one person behind here to keep blowing, and the others will go first...

4.Content: That's not good, Captain! How can you leave the crew behind!

5.Content: Ahem, I'm only joking... if only there were propellers that can shred the seaweed!

6.Content: Then let's find it here! Peggy had an instinct that she would find something good today!

0.Content: Princess Peggy's luck is really suitable for adventure...

1.Content: Great! We can shred all the seaweed!

2.Content: With this sharp propeller, we can get out of here! I don't know if this propeller can also make the Reviled Captain…

3.Content: Captain Pufferfish is thinking terrible things!

4.Content: Let's leave this strait first. The battlefield of revenge is ahead of us, I hope everything will go well.

0.Content: Humph, looks like we're about to defeat the Reviled Captain! But Peggy hasn't caught enough interesting fish yet! My fishing career...

1.Content: Looks like Peggy's fishing career needs some different fish! I wonder if there are fish that like seaweed here?

2.Content: With that being the case, let's go fishing here and see if there's any fish that Peggy wants.

0.Content: Finally... we're here.

1.Content: The atmosphere here is horrible... Is this the Isle of the Damned?

2.Content: Previously, we accidentally broke into the Isle of the Damned and were attacked by the Reviled Captain...

3.Content: It's really evil to even attack ships that didn't intrude intentionally.

4.Content: I lost everything because the original Pufferfish was destroyed. Even though I knew the opportunity for revenge was slim, I wouldn't back down!

5.Content: Captain, now you have us as your friends! It will be a success!

6.Content: But... achoo! It's so cold. It was sunny when we got here, but now the sky is all dark suddenly. It always felt windy... I feel really uncomfortable!

7.Content: Isle of the Damned, as the residence of the Reviled Captain, will definitely not have a trace of vitality. His line of sight is everywhere, we need to be careful not to fall into his trap!

0.Content: How dare you intrude into my territory.

1.Content: Hod... Hodgkin! I'll make you the price... for the avenge of the Pufferfish!

2.Content: Oh! We can definitely beat you!

3.Content: Raccoons, little girls, stinky girl... and a pufferfish mascot, you guys must be joking with me. Now that you're trespassing into my territory, you better hand me all your treasures and souls to make up to me, I might consider letting you die more comfortably.

4.Content: How arrogant! Not taking us seriously at all… it's really unpleasant.

5.Content: When you destroyed our ship... you killed my friends in the deep sea. I must let them all witness the moment of my revenge against you!

6.Content: Oh? How come I don't remember wrecking you ship at all? Anyway, you're just a mascot that is pretty fun to listen to, you might as well be the dinner on our table tonight, haha!

7.Content: How dare you! How could you call Captain Pufferfish a mascot and even want to turn him into a meal…

8.Content: Captain Pufferfish is not food!

9.Content: Don't let him talk any more nonsense, it's time to get this over with.

0.Content: Captain Pufferfish! We made it! But... why don't you look happy at all!

1.Content: He won't bully you anymore!

2.Content: Alas, thank you for helping me all the time, but I don't know whether I'm happy or worried now because I lied to you...

3.Content: What's wrong!

4.Content: You lied to us?

5.Content: Actually, I'm not the real captain of the Pufferfish. Hodgkin was right. I'm just a mascot. My master... He was the owner of the Pufferfish, but he was killed in the attack…

6.Content: So, you've been getting everyone involved to rebuild the Pufferfish and put us through all the danger just so that you can take a revenge for your master?

7.Content: Although I have lived with the master on the ship for a long time, I have not actually operated it... so there have been many times when my mistakes led to putting everyone in danger... I'm really sorry!

8.Content: Although the captain was deceiving... but I think Peggy had fun! It didn't feel that dangerous because everyone was so courageous! We defeated so many bad guys together!

9.Content: Although not a real captain, your loyalty to your master and your bravery in taking risks are excellent qualities that make you a good captain on your own.

10.Content: Oh come on... I'm getting embarrassed now, hahaha!

11.Content: You apparently promised them at the beginning that you would share the treasures with them, could we still make it happen?

12.Content: Treasures... What Treasures?

13.Content: It's really a lie after all! Captain! You're not trustworthy at all!

14.Content: Ahhh – I'm not pretending to forget, I just didn't seem to have found anything valuable during this tour. How about I can sell the Pufferfish… and give the money to you all…

15.Content: What are you talking about? The Pufferfish was originally bought with Peggy's pocket money.

16.Content: Ahhh –-

17.Content: Just kidding! The Pufferfish is the captain's precious treasure! Be sure to protect it well, don't let it be destroyed again! Peggy gave the Pufferfish to Captain Pufferfish!

18.Content: We don't want any treasure! We've all had a great day! Peggy caught so many fish that I can bring back to the Dark Forest.

19.Content: It's really different from my past experience... it seems that having a companion isn't a bad thing.

20.Content: Big sister, smile more! Come to see Peggy in the future!

22.Content: Thank you, everyone. I'm very happy to be with all of you. It seems that I'll be the only one left to explore new waters with the Pufferfish… who knows when we'll see each other again.

23.Content: It's okay! We'll always be the crew of the Pufferfish!

24.Content: Yes, I'll see you again! Families, I hope you all the best of luck! But... how am I going to sail without you?

25.Content: Captain, maybe you can grow some hands yourself?

26.Content: See, Peggy, the captain is bulging again!

0.Content: Aha, Chief Officer Raku. Tell us where we are now.

1.Content: Yes, Captain Peggy! We are now at the Fantastic Conch Island. The map in the drifting bottle led us here.

2.Content: Marvelous! Let's get ready for a warm welcome from the islanders. Hahaha.

5.Content: Where's everyone? I don't see a soul other than all the conch shells on the beach. Did you go the wrong way, Chief Officer Raku?

6.Content: No. I didn't. I didn't!

7.Content: ...Who's there? Who's speaking?

8.Content: It's me, it's me. I'm a conch!

0.Content: A conch that speaks! Ah woo...

1.Content: Woooo...Stop...Woooo...Stop blowing...Woooo...Stop. I can't...Woooo... speak properly!

2.Content: Hahaha, it's fun!

3.Content: My noble Princess Peggy, you are on the Fantastic Conch Island. I may look like a conch now, but like all the other conches here, we were humans once.

4.Content: One day a demon arrived and turned us all into conches and shells. Please help us defeat the demon so we can regain our original form.

5.Content: If that's the case, I must help. Chief Officer Raku, prepare to fight!

6.Content: Aye aye, Captain!

7.Content: Fantastic! The demon has many minions on the island. To stay out of sight, we suggest Princess Peggy and Chief Officer Raku change into our local clothing.

0.Content: The demon has destroyed all the bridges on the island, to keep us from going anywhere. Conches like us don't have arms to build bridges. But I'm sure nothing can stop our brilliant Princess Peggy!

1.Content: That's right. Chief Officer Raku, cut a tree down to build a bridge.

2.Content: Aye aye, Captain!

3.Content: There are some special trees on this island. Let's cut some down and use them as timber!

0.Content: Fire! Hang on. Where is the boulder?

1.Content: Captain, the boulder rolled over the barrier and sank into the pond.

2.Content: Not a problem. Next time, repair the bridge first and the boulder will roll over instead of sinking.

0.Content: So the bridge allows the boulder to pass through the pond, but the boulder also crushes it when it rolls over.

1.Content: Fantastic. I've perfected the method. Chief Officer Raku, let's march forward!

0.Content: The boulder crushed the bridge we've just built. Hold on. The boulder also crushed the monsters camps. My brilliant Princess Peggy, was this part of your plan?

1.Content: Hehe. Even if I hadn't seen any monsters there, I'd still come up with the perfect plan. It's called instinct. Chief Officer Raku!

2.Content: Yes, Captain! We're cutting some trees right away to rebuild the bridge.

0.Content: Haha, hand over everything of value, and then die! Men, surround him!

1.Content: Captain Peggy, it's an ambush!

2.Content: Don't panic, Chief Officer Raku. The righteous Captain Peggy of the Imperial Royal Navy is here to wipe out these pirates!

3.Content: Sailors, show them what we're made of!

0.Content: You're a formidable fighter indeed, Captain Peggy! This is not over. Sailors, retreat!

1.Content: Chief Officer Raku, don't let them run away. Go after them!

0.Content: Ahhhh… Fire, fire, fire! This labyrinth is making me dizzy. Chief Officer Raku, fire and blast our way out of here!

1.Content: Yes, Captain!

2.Content: BOOM!

3.Content: Stop! *Coughs* Stop firing! You are truly full of surprises, Princess Peggy. But now that you've found me, there's no escape.

4.Content: It's you! The speaking conch!

5.Content: That's right. It's me. That conch is just my copy. The real me lives in this cave. Not only have I turned the islanders into conches, I've also lured more people to the island with my drifting bottles, so I can turn them into conches too! Hahaha, the more the conches, the stronger I become.

6.Content: Especially you, the powerful Princess Peggy––if I can catch you, I will become invincible. Join me and be my conch!

7.Content: Hehe. I've made a deal with the Conch Demon. It's filled my crew of fools with his mighty power!

8.Content: My evil and greedy minions: Take out Captain Peggy!

0.Content: Oh wow, the pirates have indeed grown stronger with the demon's power. That leaves me with no choice but to use our ultimate weapon. Summon the Pufferfish! Captain Pufferfish, it's your turn to shine!

1.Content: The loyal Pufferfish crew is here to help Princess Peggy!

0.Content: Damn, Princess Peggy has ruined my plan in one fell swoop!

1.Content: I haven't even started fighting yet!

2.Content: Hahaha, now you've witnessed the might of Princess Peggy!

3.Content: No one can defeat Captain Peggy!

0.Content: Oh wow, we've turned back into our human form. We're no longer conches and shells! Thank you, our great Princess Peggy!

1.Content: Hahaha, Hahaha!

2.Content: All hail Princess Peggy! All hail Princess Peggy!

3.Content: All hail Princess Peggy! All hail Princess Peggy!

4.Content: Princess Peggy! Princess Peggy!

5.Content: Princess Peggy! Peggy!

0.Content: Peggy! Peggy!

1.Content: (Peggy wakes up from her sleep, mumbling)

2.Content: Uhh? What happened, Chief Officer Raku? Where are the people of the Fantastic Conch Island?

3.Content: What Chief Officer? But you're finally awake, Peggy. I was so worried.

4.Content: What...Where am I? Where's Conch Island?

5.Content: We're on the Pufferfish now. You saw the Dream Conch on the crate and took it down and blew it. Before we could stop you, the sound of the conch had already sent you into your dreams. Since then you've been talking in your dream, until now.

6.Content: Ah, so it was all a dream... Hmph!

7.Content: Yeah, you've been hugging the Dream Conch in your sleep and wouldn't let it go.

8.Content: (Peggy picks up the Dream Conch from her lap. It looks just like the Fantastic Conch Island in her dream!)

0.Content: Ahhh. It's a monster! How terrifying!

1.Content: The treasures can't be all fake, can they…

2.Content: Even if they were fake… I wouldn't skip any of the chests!

0.Content: Why are all of them gold coins...They are not really treasures at all!

1.Content: Maybe the Captain only wanted money!

2.Content: *Coughs* Stop making me sound so shallow! I still hoped to find some interesting treasures...This is outrageous! Who buried them here?

3.Content: You've gotten so many gold coins and you still don't find them enough. How greedy you must be.

0.Content: Wooaahh…Why is there a trap!

1.Content: They raised the barriers from the bottom of the water...We're being blocked in and can't turn back anymore.

2.Content: Looks like we can only move forward and look for any tools that can destroy the barriers.

0.Content: This cannon should be able to destroy the barriers!

1.Content: But the barriers are all in the water...Wouldn't the cannon be extinguished?

2.Content: Let's destroy the barrier controller with the cannon. That way we'll also destroy the barrier.

3.Content: The Captain is smart! Let's try it!

0.Content: Wow, this area turned into a glacier!

1.Content: Make sure you don't get frostbitten! The water and fire elemental powers are rampant here. Be careful.

2.Content: We've come prepared. The Rickety Cart's Shield is embedded with the water element. We shouldn't have any problem passing through this glacial path.

0.Content: Yikes, that's hot!

1.Content: It appears the fire elementals have already infiltrated this pathway and turned it into lava. We'll have to find some way of dealing with it first.

0.Content: Check it out, the fire element is spreading!

1.Content: I've got an idea...we can use the power of the fire element to transform our shield, then we should have no problem passing over the lava.

2.Content: But the shield can only contain one element at a time. When we have to pass over the glacial path, we'll have to find a water element rift.

0.Content: Teacher, have a look at this. What do you think it is?

1.Content: Amazing! It looks like the two elements underground have become bound together in a knot. This is a fragile balance indeed. The slightest hit to that knot, and elemental power will come surging out of the opening!

2.Content: Oh, so which element will come surging out?

3.Content: The power balance of the elements is currently stable, but don't forget, we are carrying elemental power with us on the carriage. Just a little bit extra will be enough to allow that element to overcome the other.

4.Content: Then we should make good use of the elemental power in the rift! That will allow us to cover over the pathway with the element we need!

0.Content: Did you record everything that just happened?

1.Content: Yes, I recorded all of it. I never would have imagined that this imbalance of elemental forces could have turned what was once an oasis into what it is now.

0.Content: We've been walking for a while. Are you holding up alright, teacher?

1.Content: I'm ok, but we've got to be careful not to touch any of the elemental rifts. Otherwise, if we set off a wrong elemental reaction we might end up having to take a long detour.

0.Content: What's going on? Why isn't the fire element power covering over the Rickety Cart here?

1.Content: I'm guessing the elemental power from this rift is a bit weak. Don't worry, we just need to find some Elemental Crystals around here. By making a slight adjustment we should be able to use it just like we did before.

0.Content: Alright, now that we've got the Elemental Crystals, we can power up the elemental rift and we won't have to worry about that lava path!
Teacher, I made a detailed recording of the elemental infiltration in this area, but how are we supposed to deal with the glaciation and lava?

1.Content: I'll erect a Totem to prevent any further infiltration. But if we want to resolve this situation once and for all, we'll have to wait for the Elemental Guardian to use the Elemental Altar...

0.Content: Why did the ancient dwarves build two tracks? How fascinating.

1.Content: Who knows what the dwarves were thinking. Maybe they wanted to transport something.

0.Content: Your Highness, we have dispelled the fog in this area for you. You can now explore freely!

1.Content: During the reconnaissance, we also met a local hero and managed to recruit them.

0.Content: Something doesn't seem right about the forest lately. I can hear the whimpers of the Floral Specters. Perhaps a disaster is imminent.

1.Content: I heard from the Yuexi Botanists that monsters never seen before had been spotted outside the forest.

2.Content: Those monsters might invade here soon. I have to prepare for any attack now.

3.Content: I could use the many herbs in the forest to create concoctions for self-protection.

0.Content: Night berries. They are a natural catalyst that can boost the potency of medicines dramatically.
Ha. I've found it. A dewberry, for making plants grow quicker.
Stanching scales, essential for treating injuries.
Oh dear, so it was monsters! I need to try to escape...
I need to find another way to get out of here.
I'll help you!
He's badly injured, and must be treated as soon as possible.
Something is moving in the bushes.
This is...?

1.Content: Don't move, you haven't fully recovered yet. This is where I prepare my medicines, like the ones I've applied on you.

2.Content: Thank you for saving me. I'm Eorin. And you are…?

3.Content: Solise. It was you who saved me.

4.Content: The Corruptors are wreaking havoc in the forest. I must leave now.

5.Content: The Corruptors? Are you talking about the monsters that attacked me?

6.Content: Yes, the elemental imbalance has unleashed the Corruptors and the forest is on the eve of a disaster.

7.Content: I've heard the whimpers of the Floral Specters. Perhaps with the water of Yuexi Spring, I can create a medicine that averts the disaster.

8.Content: But it's dangerous there...

9.Content: Yuexi Spring? I can go along and protect you.

10.Content: Let's wait until you're fully healed.

0.Content: 蘑菇蘑菇，我们要去月溪泉了，之后就麻烦你帮我看下家了
You're... safe...

1.Content: (The youth loses strength and collapses to the ground.)

0.Content: Oh no, the Corruptors have occupied the area up ahead, and the cave is narrow. Let me fend them off.
Perhaps the mushrooms nearby will know the way through the area.
Turns out there is a trap in the cave. Step on it and a boulder will come rolling down. Maybe I can use it to get rid of the Corruptors.
Eorin, get out of the way!
The Corruptors are gone. Let's keep moving.

Yuexi Spring is right after this thick forest. But the trees here form a natural array of Magic Circles, each of them like a portal. If you walk into them randomly, you'll end up going around in circles.

1.Content: You can only reach Yuexi Spring by stepping through the portals in a specific sequence.

2.Content: What sequence?

3.Content: The pattern changes every day. We need to pay attention to our surroundings.

4.Content: Let's start first, then figure them out along the way.

0.Content: I got it. The three portals at the entrance are the pattern for today. We just have to pass through them from south to north to reach Yuexi Spring.
We're here, at Yuexi Spring. I'll get the water, Eorin. Keep watch for me.
Eorin?
Oh no, the Magic Circle that hides the Elemental Emblem is broken! The Corruptors will be here soon.

1.Content: Be the power of the Thorned Vengeance... Huh?

2.Content: Why?

3.Content: (Eorin moves his hands frantically, wanting to grab the emblem. But it is like a reflection in the water. It cannot be touched.)

4.Content: The Elemental Emblem carries the power of a guardian. It cannot be used to provoke conflicts.

0.Content: The Corruptors? When did they...

1.Content: Let's get out of here!

2.Content: It's too late... Just go, Solise.

3.Content: But you...

4.Content: This was my fault. As long as I draw breath, I'll never let the Corruptors get their hands on the Elemental Emblem.

5.Content: The Thorned Vengeance will stop any invader of the forest.

6.Content: Go, now!

0.Content: The Elemental Emblem is glowing...

1.Content: The Elemental Emblem wields the force of a guardian. It was born to protect all beings from the threat of elemental imbalances.

2.Content: The chaos of the elements is making the forest weep.

3.Content: Answer my prayers, water element. Protect those whose sounds are ringing by your ears.

0.Content: The Corruptors have fled...
The forest is still in danger. Perhaps I should leave the forest and find a solution to the crisis.
That way we can lose the pursuers.
Let's get going.

1.Content: Slow down. The tree's souls told me that the forest where we met earlier has been occupied by the Corruptors.

2.Content: I know a way to Yuexi Spring that bypasses the Corruptors through the cave in the north.

0.Content: Solise, what Magic Circles are these?

1.Content: They are the Magic Circles of the Water Emblem, which is itself in Yuexi Spring. That's why medicines made using the spring's water can defend against the Corruptors.

2.Content: The Water Emblem... is indeed hidden in Yuexi Spring.

3.Content: Eorin, stay away from it. The Water Emblem's power is not something we should covet.

4.Content: The Water Emblem must belong to the Thorned Vengeance. Solise, you're just as tiresome as Arden.

5.Content: You have a weapon such as the Elemental Altar but you've never used it to punish the forest's invaders.

6.Content: The same is true with the Elemental Emblem. If it could keep out the Corruptors simply by being left in Yuexi Spring, the forest wouldn't be in this state today.

7.Content: As long as we control this force, we'll be able to protect the forest and punish those who dare invade it.

8.Content: The Elemental Emblems should not be used to provoke conflicts.

9.Content: I thought... we were friends.

10.Content: There are things that matter more than friendship. This is the mission of the Thorned Vengeance and the responsibility of every Wilder.

11.Content: I don't want to hurt you. Just stay here.

0.Content: Become my thorns, Water Emblem! I'll bring you out of the forest and make the intruders pay!

1.Content: Eorin, no!

0.Content: Ah…

1.Content: Damn. I hate portals.

2.Content: Yen? What happened? Where are we?

3.Content: Far from home… Looks like we triggered some portal in the ruins. Let's get back before it closes.

4.Content: And it's gone. Great.

5.Content: So… how do we go back?

6.Content: Using another portal? I don't know, Geralt. There's a town nearby, you can ask your question there.

0.Content: You heard this troubadour on the stage? This is a completely different world. But it looks like it's filled with turmoil all the same. Graveborns, Hypogeans…

1.Content: If this guy is even just a little bit like Dandelion, all these stories are worth shit.

2.Content: Maybe. But if there's even a grain of truth in it… That's a start. We need to find another Arcane Portal, just like the one that brought us here.

3.Content: I heard in the tavern that there's a Renegade Brotherhood nearby. I will try to gather some intel there.

4.Content: You sure?

5.Content: They have monsters here. And I have a silver sword. I'm sure we will get along just fine.

6.Content: Fair enough, just… be careful. Try not to drag too much attention.

7.Content: You mean not to kill anyone on the first day? I will try. And what's your plan?

8.Content: I've seen some mages in the tavern. I'm gonna follow them. If someone knows something about Arcane Portal, it's gonna be them.

9.Content: Alright. Let's meet back here as soon as we get some information.

0.Content: Hold it right there, stranger. Who are you?

1.Content: Geralt of Rivia. A witcher.

2.Content: A witcher? What the hell is that?

3.Content: I kill monsters. For coins. Do you have any open contracts?

4.Content: Hey fellas, come take a look at this bumpkin. He thinks he's some kind of hero just because he's found himself a chainmail and two broken swords!

5.Content: I said, I kill monsters. But I might have killed a few humans too.

6.Content: Listen, fella. I don't know you. You think you're any good? Start from the Bounty Board over there. You don't get killed, we'll think of some real job for you.

7.Content: I'll take this one.

8.Content: This one is for teams only. You can't sign up by yourself.

9.Content: Then I can make a team with him.

10.Content: Fawkes? Are you serious?

11.Content: Go ahead and register yourself. I will take care of the rest.

12.Content: Hmm… I work alone.

13.Content: Me too. Are you going or not?

14.Content: Mhm. Let's go.

0.Content: What kind of monsters do you have here?

2.Content: Those Graveborns… What are they?

4.Content: Mhm… I might as well talk to Roach.

5.Content: You talk to fishes?

6.Content: Roach is a horse. Still more talkative than you.

7.Content: Listen, the Renegade Brotherhood isn't simply a monster hunters guild. We defend the Empire. We protect humans and fight with Hypogeans, Graveborns and other filthy beings.

8.Content: And there's clearly something disturbing about you. I don't know your intentions, I don't trust you. So don't expect me to answer your questions…

9.Content: Look out!

0.Content: What happened to your face? Are you alright?

1.Content: That's just my natural charm. And side effects of the elixirs.

2.Content: Thanks, for the warning. How did you know they would attack?

3.Content: My medallion. It's sensitive to magic and monsters.

4.Content: I've never seen people fight like that. I could barely see you moving. And what you did with your sword… How's that even possible?

5.Content: Years of murderous training and killing monsters on the path. If you add to that some mutations…

6.Content: Wait, mutations?

7.Content: Witchers were created to fight monsters. No matter the price.

8.Content: But enough about me. You destroyed Graveborns using basically just your left hand…

9.Content: There is an evil power in my hand. When I was a child, I was used as a sacrifice by a necromancer. One day, I'll hunt him down and make him pay. Until then, I try to make a blessing out of this curse.

10.Content: Listen, if we're about to work together, I need some answers. You're clearly not from here. What are you doing in the Empire?

11.Content: Just trying to come back home. I was exploring some ancient elven ruins in Wyzima… And next thing I knew, I was teleported here. Do you know something about Arcane Portal?

12.Content: Wyzima? I've never heard of it. But I do know a thing or two about Arcane Portals. They sometimes appear in Hathor. Also they seem to attract Graveborns…

13.Content: Do you know where to find one of these Portals?

14.Content: No. But I could ask around in the Brotherhood.

15.Content: But first we should check the Village. The Graveborns we killed… I was just a handful. So what do you say? You help me, and I help you.

16.Content: I say, we have a deal. Lead the way, Fawkes.

0.Content: Hold it there, Mr Fawkes.

1.Content: Do I know you, sorcerer?

2.Content: I'm afraid you don't. I'm representing Astral Academy…

3.Content: What do you want?

4.Content: You see, the commission you've accepted is… within the area of our interest. There has been an unfortunate accident…

5.Content: You mean the Graveborns?

6.Content: Precisely. We're taking care of it as we speak and we simply can't allow anyone to interfere with our rituals. It might just be too dangerous.

7.Content: Then I guess we'll just go back. Report to the Brotherhood…

8.Content: Nonsense, you need to rest! Gentlemen, I would like you to come with us. I insist you accept our invitation. And recompensation for all your troubles on the way.

9.Content: Bag full of gold, welcome committee… Yeah, I can imagine myself hunting monsters here.

10.Content: My companions will escort both of you to our camp.

11.Content: I don't trust sorcerers. And I have killed a few before…

12.Content: Let's not make an enemy of the Astral Academy. At least for now.

13.Content: Very well. I hope you can clean up this mess then. Let's go.

0.Content: What are you doing? Ah!

1.Content: Gwaah!

0.Content: Stop, sorcerer! What are you doing?

1.Content: Geralt, ask your new friend to let go of me. Or I will make him.

2.Content: Yen? You can let her go, Fawkes. She's with me.

3.Content: I will. If she explains why she is attacking Astral Academy.

4.Content: Yennefer? What's going on?

5.Content: They didn't want to let me talk to you. So I put them to sleep.

6.Content: You're not one of them. What are you doing in the ranks of the Academy?

7.Content: She's a sorceress herself. We parted ways to gather intelligence about the Arcane Portals. I went to the Brotherhood…

8.Content: And I visited Astral Academy. I told I was looking for an Arcane Portal. And then persuade them that my expertise in this area could be useful.

9.Content: And they just invited you in?

10.Content: Kinda. They thought they would use me… and then get rid of me. I let them think that.

11.Content: Do you know what's going on in this village? What are they trying to hide?

12.Content: There's a new Arcane Portal, near this village. The Astral Academy believes it can be used as a source of unlimited energy. But there's a problem…

13.Content: An elder of the Academy colluded with the School of the Dead. Started experimenting with the portal on his own… And transformed villagers into Graveborns.

14.Content: If it ever comes to light… The Academy's reputation would be destroyed.

15.Content: That's why they sent out a team to deal with the traitor. And bury all the evidence.

16.Content: Classic sorcerer's move.

17.Content: If this is true… No, I have to confront them first. And this time I will have all the answers.

18.Content: Wait, Fawkes!

0.Content: Geralt, it's none of our business.

1.Content: Yen, they will get rid of him. And he can't take them all by himself…

2.Content: That was his decision. We have our own shit to worry about. We have a chance to go home. I can take us to the Arcane Portal…

3.Content: I took the contract. And I gave Fawkes my word.

4.Content: Fine! Just don't jump out at me with this stupid "code" of yours. I will return to the sorcerers and watch your back.

5.Content: Yen… Thanks.

6.Content: Oh, back off!

0.Content: Sorcerer, we need to talk.

1.Content: Mr Fawkes. Shouldn't you be under the protection of my colleagues?

2.Content: Stop playing games. I want to know what you're doing here.

3.Content: Nothing unusual, really. As I said, we're taking care of some Graveborns…

4.Content: Then I can relay everything I've seen and heard back to the Brotherhood?

5.Content: This is an internal matter of the Astral Academy. It shouldn't be blown out of proportion. I would prefer that you keep this a secret between us.

6.Content: We can return the favor, Mr Fawkes. After we're done here, we could send you a letter with a clue on someone… Someone you've been searching for a long time.

7.Content: What do you mean?

8.Content: Oh, you know exactly who I mean. The Astral Academy has investigated an incident that involved the use of innocent children in necromantic sacrifices…

9.Content: Watch it. You're on very thin ice…

10.Content: Calm down, Mr Fawkes. I wouldn't want to bring it up either if I had a choice. So, what say you?

12.Content: He's playing you, Fawkes.

13.Content: Mr Fawkes, if you decline my offer now, you won't be able to find this person for the rest of your life.

14.Content: Enough! I'm done with your lies, you sanctimonious scum. The Brotherhood will hear of this.

15.Content: It's a shame we couldn't come to an agreement. But still, I'm afraid you're outnumbered.

16.Content: I fought against more (*pulls sword*).
