0.Content: The Corruptors are running amok, and the sleeping sickness is spreading to many—General Estrilda among them. The Divine Light has been unable to awaken them thus far... We are coming to the point where there's only one solution ahead of us.

1.Content: I must find Archbishop Palmer of the Temple of Light. I'm just not sure if he'll support my decision...

0.Content: Father Palmer, I am preparing to journey to the Great Volcano of legend in search of the Elemental Guardians.

1.Content: Belinda... Are you sure?

2.Content: How can we hesitate any longer? There is so much chaos and destruction around us. We must act. The cause must surely be a grave imbalance of the elemental order. Only the Guardians and their power will be able to bring order out of chaos and restore it anew to this land.

3.Content: Oh Divine Light, may you continue to watch over and protect our land!

4.Content: Let it be so. May the Light always watch over us. But, as you know, there are some things even the Divine Light cannot do.

5.Content: I must warn you, oh Priestess of the Temple, that you embark upon a very dangerous road.

6.Content: I have always allowed myself to be guided in everything by Light. It is the same Light that shall guide me to saving our people. Archbishop, I ask that I be allowed to depart at once.

7.Content: But you should also know that the Temple has its own ideas about how we can still save our people...

8.Content: As the Divine Light is my witness, I will find the Elemental Guardian... and restore hope to this land!

0.Content: Priestess Belinda! Do you know why my daddy hasn't been able to wake up yet?
Can the Light really protect us?
Quit dilly-dallying! Who cares about luggage! Time to get outta here!
Corruptors! Corruptors are here! Outside! Look!
Greetings. May I enquire whether this road leads to the Great Volcano?

1.Content: "Volcano"? I don't know what you're talking about. But my best advice would be don't go running through these woods. There are Hypogeans and the... black mist. We can't even draw water from our well!

2.Content: ...Perhaps I could help you dispel this black mist of which you speak with the power of the Light?

0.Content: One of my predecessors has left a Divine Light Tower to guard these woods, yet it has since been extinguished. No wonder the place has fallen to darkness. I must restart it to drive away the black mist.
So long and so deep has darkness plagued these woods... it is hard for me to awaken my own inner Light. I must find a way to restore the connection!
By the Light! One of my predecessors must have left this Memorial Stele to the Divine Light. I can feel my connection!
Sorry I wasn't more help. I did manage to find a way through, but it looks like I'm too late. The water is corrupted beyond all use.

1.Content: We do not blame you—rather we thank you for your courage and bravery! And thank you for dispelling the black mist and Hypogeans. We will find a way.

2.Content: The Divine Light protect and shine upon you all! As for me, I shall continue on my quest to the Volcano.

0.Content: Would you help me take a look at this map? How far do you think it is to the Volcano?

1.Content: Not that far, by my reckoning. But you'll still need to cross over the mountain, not to mention the river up ahead. And the bridge is currently broken.

2.Content: Is there some way of fixing it at short notice then?

3.Content: I've had it in mind to fix it for some time except the black mist has scourged the area. Not to mention Hypogeans in the woods. They are frightening indeed.

4.Content: Then I will drive away the Hypogeans and black mist! Then we can talk of repairing the bridge.

0.Content: The Hypogeans are gone.

1.Content: Wonderful! Yet the black mist still bars the way. I dare not go.

2.Content: Very well. The way will be open soon enough.

0.Content: The bridge is fixed, Priestess Belinda! May you enjoy a safe journey!
Ah! My home! My forest! Why ever did I leave? Everything has been set to ruin...

1.Content: It's the Corruptors! They've made a home for themselves here. The Divine Light Tower could not stop them... I must head to the Volcano at once.

0.Content: Apologies for the intrusion. I have a question...

1.Content: Please, help me, I beg you! Please find my daughter!

2.Content: Don't worry, I'll see what I can do. Where might your daughter have gone?

3.Content: She went out to play. She hasn't come back yet and it's been hours! I wanted to look for her, but there are monsters everywhere!

4.Content: I promise I'll do all I can to find your daughter.

0.Content: Why hello there, little one. Hurry home now, your mother is worried sick!

1.Content: (Sobs) Thank you! That black mist came out of nowhere! I was so scared... I want to go home...

0.Content: Something tells me the Elemental Guardians are just ahead—across this path of fire.
Chin up, Belinda. I cannot afford to fail here... Not yet!
In the name of the Divine Light... I vow to defend the defenseless!
For the Empire... For all of Esperia!
I am he who tends the flames. Why have you come here, Daughter of the Light?

1.Content: The Elemental Strife has brought much destruction and suffering. Only the power of the elements themselves are capable of resolving the crisis.

2.Content: To inherit the power of the Elements is to court death. Corruptors will hunt you to the ends of the world...

3.Content: I was ready for a long time.

4.Content: Then I shall grant you your wish. Behold, the power of the Divine Flame! Burn this world clean of evil, and bring succor to the suffering!

5.Content: Ever since I've joined my order I've always let the Divine Light guide my every move...

6.Content: And I swear that no matter how deep the darkness and shadow, I will never ignore the cries of the helpless and those in need!

0.Content: The residents can get here safely, but the water source has been contaminated. Oh dear…
The Hypogeans and black mist are now gone.

1.Content: Thank you so much! I'll fix the bridge for you now.

0.Content: My child... you came back!

1.Content: Master, our Divine Light has guided me here.

0.Content: Help! Someone save me!
Hold on! Things will start looking up once we get in the city. Don't forget there's a Temple of the Light inside.
Divine Light of infinite power, please save my child!
What do fire and light have in common? The power to burn away darkness...

1.Content: With the power of the Fire Element I can finally face the Corruptors and save our suffering people.

2.Content: I shall always stand with hope!

0.Content: Pheeew, finally. After all the days away from the Capital, here we are, the border of the Maulers' domain. The money for intel was well spent indeed. See the potential here? What a beautiful stage for commerce and business!

1.Content: By "beautiful stage"... Do you mean getting scammed for all your gold the minute you got here?

2.Content: Ahem... I'll have you know, even the wisest and craftiest merchants will fall for the occasional trick. Just a minor setback.

3.Content: Look at all this land, Raine. You know what I see? Profit! I'll be swimming in gold in no time, so long as I can get Trading Permits for both sides of the border.

4.Content: You can only get those from the local lords, right? Not exactly people you'd just bump into on the street.

5.Content: Way ahead of you, Raine.

6.Content: The people here use "badges" as tokens of power. They're divided into three types—Strength Badges, Intelligence Badges, and Agility Badges. We can get badges by completing certain requests. The more badges we have, the more powerful we'll seem.

7.Content: However, some requests are so demanding that we'll need a certain number of badges of a specific type just to accept them—so the client knows we can handle the job.

8.Content: Well, you certainly seem to know what you have to do, but can you actually do it?

9.Content: It'll be a breeze... I hope.

0.Content: We'll need 3 Intelligence Badges to be seen by the Lightbearer Marcher Lord.
As for the Chieftain of the Mauler Frontier, you'll need 3 Strength Badges. After we complete the quests he gives us, he should sign off on a Trading Permit.

1.Content: Don't worry about it Raine, I'm a businessman. Where there's profit, there's a way.

0.Content: Great timing! The vicious beasts from the Maulers' territory have no respect for the borders of our Empire! They keep coming over and harassing—even attacking—ordinary civilians!

1.Content: What I need is for you to defeat the beasts. Return with proof of the deed to collect your reward.

2.Content: (Muttering) Good thing I'm paying Raine by the hour instead of per-battle...

0.Content: Excellent! A new bounty has just been posted.

1.Content: Same as usual—wipe out a nest of wild beasts and then come get your award.

0.Content: Excellent! A new bounty has just been posted.

1.Content: Same as usual—wipe out a nest of wild beasts and then come get your award.

0.Content: Are you that warrior my men can't stop talking about? (He sizes you up) Hmm. You don't look like much of a warrior to me.

1.Content: Here's the score: I need you to go over again and wipe out a particularly vicious beast. I've got something good for you if you can.

0.Content: Excellent! A new bounty has just been posted.

1.Content: Same as usual—wipe out a nest of wild beasts and then come get your award.

0.Content: (Gives Rowan a long, furtive look)

1.Content: Salutations, young master. A traveler like you really should be prepared before you hit the road. Have a gander at my wares. There's nothing we don't sell, and you'll definitely find something you like.

2.Content: How about our latest arrival, the "Hat of Omniscience"? The built-in head massager is the perfect thing for long nights on the road. Just for you, I'll throw in a free Intelligence Badge, what do you say? Wow, look how well it suits you! This is the last one we have in stock, don't miss out!

3.Content: It's alright I guess... What's your price?

4.Content: Rest assured, my young master, it's a steal! Just 5 Gold Coins and it's yours.

5.Content: 5 Gold Coins?! That's too much.

6.Content: Don't think I'm just another tourist you can rip off! I've done my market research, and I know my stuff. All the materials of this hat aren't even worth a single Gold Coin! What do you say we take this up with the Marcher Lord?

7.Content: P-please forgive me, young master. That was uncouth of me. But look at the detailing on this hat, you must be kind enough to pay a bit more for the craftsmanship, no?

0.Content: Well... It is beautiful indeed. I'll give you 3 Gold Coins. Deal?

1.Content: Of course it's a deal! 40% off for my new friend.

2.Content: By the way, we have "Travel Boots" in stock. They're are perfect for both daily life and long journeys. You can get these for only 2 Gold Coins next time you come! Please visit again, young master.

0.Content: Salutations! If it isn't the young master!

1.Content: Did you come for the "Travel Boots" today? If so, they're only 2 Gold Coins—an exclusive discount just for you! Oh, and I'll throw in a free Agility Badge, too.

2.Content: Alright, I'll have those.

3.Content: Alrighty! Please visit again, young master. (Yes! I finally got rid of that junk.)

0.Content: Our long and storied institute is here to satisfy any curiosity you might have about anything—anything at all in this vast universe! You shall leave this place a wise and erudite scholar.

1.Content: There may not be a price tag attached to knowledge per se, but the acquisition of knowledge itself must surely be worth a lot.

2.Content: I may be a merchant by trade, but I still understand the importance of not being tight when it comes to learning new things.

3.Content: Well said! Then surely you would be willing to part with a measly two Gold Coins!

0.Content: Understanding more of the lay of the land and its people will be invaluable for selecting the best-selling goods... Ah-hah! I've got it!
One of the best situations you can come across as a merchant is when supply does not meet demand... Ah-hah! I've got it!
First, incite a potential customer's curiosity. This will then naturally improve the value of your products, and how much you can get paid for it... Ah-hah! I've got it!
Well done on completing one of our fine academy courses. I must say, you must be the smartest and hardest-working of all the pupils I've seen.

1.Content: Here. Have this Intelligence Medal in recognition of your wisdom. And never forget what you have learned in these hallowed halls!

0.Content: Step right up! All you need to do to win a super awesome prize is just traverse the whole area without stepping on the same tile twice!

1.Content: Fancy a challenge? It's just one Gold Coin...

0.Content: I knew it! Those Cannon Towers still had a bit of gunpowder left in them. Didn't expect you to be able to bring it back though. Very impressive.

1.Content: No big deal, it was a piece of cake!

2.Content: Here's the Agility Medal as promised. And I'll be sure to come to you first if we have anything else we need help with.

3.Content: As long as the gold is good, nothing's off the table.

0.Content: That got a little tense, but all's well that ends well!

1.Content: Hah! You're an agile fellow! Here's your Agility Medal, you've earned it!

0.Content: I'm finished! If I can't get it sent over this time, I won't be able to put food on the table!

1.Content: What's the matter?

2.Content: My business partner over in the Lightbearer Empire wants help moving some goods. But they're just too far away—all the way in the west. And to do it I'm going to have to walk right in front of a whole bunch of Imperial cannons along the Imperial March.

3.Content: I don't see the problem. Isn't there a general ceasefire? Those cannons are just for show these days, my friend.

4.Content: You don't get it! One of my very best friends was blown to smithereens by one of those cannons—right in front of my eyes! You really think I'm going to walk in front of 'em?!

5.Content: By the way, aren't you a Lightbearer? Say, would you mind helping me move the goods yourself? There'd be something in it for you.

6.Content: You mean some kind of material payment, I hope? Not a problem! Leave it to me.

0.Content: I don't know what divine wind brought that crazy fellow my way, but thank the Goddess! Hehehe. Another sucker...

1.Content: Now what I need is for you to take all of your earthly possessions out and hand 'em over—easy there, fella!

2.Content: You've got another thing coming if you think I'm just a simple merchant. I never take on a job I can't do. Time to show off your skills, Raine.

0.Content: If nobody's claimed these goods, I'll take them.
... Anyway, why don't you consider a long-term partnership with me? It could mean the monthly profits far in excess of even the considerable sum you see before you.

1.Content: If what you say is all true, then working together is definitely a win-win for us. My only concern is... Can you put money where your mouth is?

2.Content: Well... See those bumpkins kicking up a huge fuss by that corner? Just settle their dispute and I'll be happy to consider working with you.

3.Content: That's all? Just settle a dispute? Easy-peasy.

4.Content: Woah there. You really just gonna walk over there and tell 'em to stop arguing?

5.Content: I have you here to back me up, don't I?

6.Content: Crafty as ever, I see.

7.Content: Alright guys, knock it off. What's got you all so hot and bothered? Really think it's worth kicking up this kind of fuss?

8.Content: The heck? Get lost. Mind your own darned business.

9.Content: Oh, what a cute little dwarf. Now beat it! This is just between us.

10.Content: Did you just call me... short?!

11.Content: Just fight and get it over with. How about: whoever wins gets to kick the others out?

0.Content: ... Anyway, why don't you consider a long-term partnership with me? It could mean the monthly profits far in excess of even the considerable sum you see before you.

1.Content: If you really can do everything you say, I don't see why not. My only concern is... I know you can get the job, but can you do the job?

2.Content: Well... See those bumpkins kicking up a huge fuss by that corner? Just settle their dispute and I'll be happy to consider working with you.

3.Content: That's all? Just settle a dispute? Easy-peasy.

4.Content: Woah there. You really just gonna walk over there and tell 'em to stop arguing?

5.Content: I have you here to back me up, don't I?

6.Content: Crafty as ever, I see.

7.Content: Alright guys, knock it off. What's got you all so hot and bothered? Really think it's worth kicking up this kind of fuss?

8.Content: The heck? Get lost. Mind your own darned business.

9.Content: Yeah, short stuff, beat it! This is just between us.

10.Content: Well, I'm not convincing anybody just standing here. How about we nominate someone to fight, and then whoever wins decides who stays?

11.Content: ... And if we win, then you've also got to pay back the publican for the damage you've caused.

12.Content: Alrighty. But don't go crying to mummy when we beat you black and blue!

13.Content: I've never backed down from a fight since I was a kid!

14.Content: Hah. Clumsy oafs. I reckon I could take down a hundred of you.

0.Content: Easy.
You completed my task with flying colors! Here is a Strength Medal. You've earned it. Not to mention... I look forward to working with you again.

We have one thing to thank for the long years of peace our village has enjoyed in the midst of all this warmongering—our forest outskirts. Without it we'd no doubt see plenty of interlopers. Problem is, those cannon towers over the river have knocked down some of our best trees. We're exposed to passersby!

1.Content: I know there's been a ceasefire between our two nations, but I know better than to believe in ceasefires. We want to build a defensive fortification! It'd help us sleep better at night. We ain't got many strong young'uns to fend off bandits or wild beasts and the like.

2.Content: So you're saying you'd like me to help you do what? Bring resources? Materials?

3.Content: No, no, no! We'd never ask you to do something that arduous. We got plenty of resources in the village. Our problem is those darned cannons over the river! No one wants to set anything up with a bunch of cannons pointed at 'em.

4.Content: So what we'd really like you to help us with is: pop over to the other side of the river and just check whether those cannons pose any imminent threat to our workers.

5.Content: Got it. Sounds reasonable. But my only question is: what's in it for me? I'm a merchant, yeah? Merchants don't do things for free.

6.Content: Well... if you could help us do this then I suppose we could find something very valuable to give you.

7.Content: It's settled then.

8.Content: (Both sides have agreed on a ceasefire. I doubt the Empire would deliberately break their word. But there's no telling whether maybe some of the soldiers might do something dumb—like forget to unload the gunpowder from the cannons.)

9.Content: (It looks like these Mauler villages have had enough of war. I suppose I should inspect the other side carefully—if it'll help them sleep better at night.)

8.Content: (These poor Mauler villages have had their fill of war, no wonder they're so sensitive. I'll take a quick look, bring back some gunpowder residue, then call it a day.)

0.Content: There's nothing here
There's nothing here either.
Still nothing.

1.Content: Halt! Who are you? You're not authorized to be here!

2.Content: He must've been sent over by the Maulers! They're already planning to break the ceasefire! Put him in prison. We'll interrogate him!

0.Content: Hey! Didn't you help me inspect our cannons the other day?

1.Content: That's me! And please don't manhandle me. It's been a long night.

2.Content: Sorry to hear that you got captured. We'll keep our side of the bargain. Here's the Agility Medal for you. And thank you so much.

0.Content: Good thing I got a few scraps of gunpowder to hand in.
A son was born to the great Perosi family today, and by tradition every tribe's chieftain must come and pay respects to the newborn.

1.Content: Unfortunately it just so happens our chieftain is away on business visiting another tribe. What are we gonna do?

2.Content: Perhaps I can be of some assistance...

3.Content: You think you can fill in for our tribe's Chieftain in this most solemn ceremony to welcome the newborn? Then you're going to have to be as smart and brave as they come.

4.Content: No offense but... you don't look like a particularly distinguished fellow. You seem more like a travelling merchant to me.

5.Content: Ahem, I fear you have "misunderestimated" me.

6.Content: I'll have you know, I'm well on my way to becoming the wealthiest landholder in all of the Lightbearer Empire! I take part in solemn ceremonies like this virtually on a daily basis. I'm well acquainted with all the ceremonial hoo-hah. Doubtful? Ask anyone in the Empire.

7.Content: Well then...

8.Content: Please. If I make a mistake or embarrass myself in any way, then you may seek recompense upon me.

9.Content: I suppose there's no harm in letting you try.

10.Content: (The grand ceremony is almost ready to go ahead. We just need to add a few finishing touches...)

0.Content: A son was born to the great Perosi family today, and by tradition every tribe's chieftain must come and pay respects to the newborn.

1.Content: Unfortunately it just so happens our chieftain is away on business visiting another tribe. What are we gonna do?

2.Content: Perhaps I can be of some assistance...

3.Content: You think you can fill in for our tribe's Chieftain in this most solemn ceremony to welcome the newborn? Then you're going to have to be as smart and brave as they come.

4.Content: No offense but... you don't look like a particularly distinguished fellow. You seem more like a travelling merchant to me.

5.Content: Ahem, I fear you have "misunderestimated" me.

6.Content: If you can defeat our tribe's warrior and procure proof of your identity, then and only then will you be worthy to join this most solemn ceremony and stand in our chieftain's place.

7.Content: (Uh oh. I'd better send Raine in to bat for me. Might need to do some roleplaying... I remember one of the stores in the empire was selling a scholar's cap. Maybe I can put that on...)

8.Content: Sounds good to me. It shall be done.

0.Content: I think I have enough branches now. I'd better go over to the right side of the forest for some flowers.
What a beautiful flower! Time to return and prep the ceremony.
Thank you so much! You really got us out of a tight spot in short order. Here's an Intelligence Medal for you as a token of our thanks.
(Wearing the scholar's cap) I shall hereby demonstrate my worthiness!
Enter!
Greetings, "Rowan the Brilliant"! We have heard tell of your recent exploits. But I'm sure they are nothing compared to the skills you must have at your disposal.

1.Content: I'm at your service, my lord!

2.Content: Here's the thing... some time ago the Empire sent 3 spies deep into Mauler territory. Their mission? To provoke their warriors into starting a war. As you can see, we are now at peace. Unfortunately, we have reason to think one of our spies may have turned traitor.

3.Content: Unfortunately, all three spies happen to be experts on the Empire's forces, and if my men interrogate them they won't say a thing, even if they aren't the turncoat. But they don't know you! I think you may have better luck talking to them and figuring it out.

4.Content: Uh... OK. I'll give it a shot.

5.Content: Spies tend to lie through their teeth—such is the nature of their work. Except for our turncoat. The turncoat will tell you the truth.

6.Content: If you can complete this task for us, I'd be willing to grant you an Imperial March Trading Permit.

7.Content: It will be done!

0.Content: In my experience, my younger male colleague always lies.
There's no way my female colleague could ever be secretly in cahoots with the Maulers.
I find my older colleague to be an honest fellow. He will not lie to you.
I got you! You're the traitor!
Rowan! I had heard so much about your brilliant mind. How could you make such an elementary mistake? Take this poor spy away. He deserves some peace and quiet.
Hah! You truly are "Rowan the Brilliant"! Your powers of deduction are great indeed.

1.Content: Here you go: an Imperial March Trading Permit. I've heard you intend to become the wealthiest man in all the Empire. I certainly hope this Trading Permit may serve as a decent first stop on your quest for riches.

0.Content: Honored guests of the Chief! Please enter!
Outsiders are forbidden!
I heard much of your valiant deeds of late. And now I've also heard you need a Trading Permit signed by me personally. I take it you intend to do legitimate business here?

1.Content: Yes sir. If I can get a Trading Permit, then it would be a major stepping stone to stronger trading relations between here and "next door." It could be a major positive development.

2.Content: Heh! Perhaps so. I've also heard you're very skilled at challenges. So may I propose you take me on in a friendly challenge?

3.Content: If you can succeed, then you'll be the first to receive one of my newly-signed Trading Permits. What do you think?

4.Content: Excellent! I mean... I'm very happy to give it my best attempt.

0.Content: Good luck in completing the Chief's challenge!
Hah! Well done, Rowan—as expected. Take this. Here's the Permit you wanted.

1.Content: Remember you will always be welcome among the Maulers. And we hope you will continue to bring many marvelous trinkets our way.

0.Content: Ouch! My hip! My darned hip! Can anyone help me haul this grain? I'll be eternally grateful.
Did you lose something over here? Or did you want to try your hand at fishing, son?

1.Content: How about this: catch a fish, and I'll give you 5 Gold Coins.

0.Content: That's a lot of barrels! Argh. I don't want to deal with 'em anymore.

1.Content: Hey, you over there! Help me get these barrels organized, and whatever in that chest is yours.

0.Content: What are you doing—destroying my wine barrels?! You're gonna pay for that!
(Sobbing)...

1.Content: Hey little one, what happened?

2.Content: My kite got caught on a tree... (Sobbing) Do you think you could help me... get it back, sir?

0.Content: Wonderful! Thank you, kind sir!
You're not from around here, are you? Got any cool stories?

1.Content: Stories? I got plenty. Ever seen a flying lion? Or blue butterflies, or deer with flowers growing out of their horns?

2.Content: Gosh. Life sure does sound exciting outside our village. If you don't mind... here. You can have this chest.

0.Content: Huh. This hay pile looks a little flat. What if I just jump over it...
Done!
(Cradles chin) The jail's walls are a lot smaller than I would have expected...
Obviously! All you have to do is jump over!
Let's check out that Bounty Board first. We might find a few leads.
Blast it! This place is way too cold.

1.Content: If it wasn't for the gold, I would never step anywhere near this dark and damp mine in this freezing weather.

2.Content: What you need is some belly-warming dwarven stout.

3.Content: Or maybe a gun barrel that's been warmed by gunpowder.

4.Content: Shooting is next to useless in the mines. Unless you plan on blasting rocks with your bullets.

5.Content: Don't speak too soon. Movement up ahead.

0.Content: Never thought there'd be still wanna-be miners in this place.

1.Content: Well, there's no shortage of people who want a piece of dwarven tech. Just ask my client.

2.Content: Those guys just now didn't seem to be interested in mining technology though. They attacked us without so much as a 'howdy-do'. Odds are they were here for some treasure.

3.Content: Treasure?

4.Content: We've got more company. Let's deal with them first.

0.Content: So you were saying something about a treasure?

1.Content: Just something I heard from the clan elder. Apparently the Old Mine was established to mine some sort of ancient ore.

2.Content: Ancient ore?

3.Content: Yes, but it's an old story, and the mine had dried up long ago. All that ancient ore would've been transported away when my forefathers evacuated this mine.

4.Content: Forget about the treasure. There's no way us dwarves would've wasted a single speck of a resource.

5.Content: Speaking as a dwarf, the most valuable resource here is the actual mine itself.

6.Content: If anyone dares to wreck this place, my flamethrower won't let those bastards off.

0.Content: So according to you, this mine itself is the actual "treasure".

1.Content: At first I was worried that the sound of our guns might cause a cave-in, but it looks like the shockwaves had cleared the debris from the tracks instead.

2.Content: That's our prized dwarven machinery for you. Unfortunately, these machines and the mines have long been integrated into the city, so there's no way for anyone to remove them from here.

3.Content: Looks like my mission failed then.

4.Content: Look, I like your attitude. Why don't you take these outdated schematics back and deliver them to your client?

5.Content: Once you get your pay, don't forget to buy me a drink.

6.Content: Dwarven stout, was it? Then let's meet at the Noble Tavern.

0.Content: As they walk along a deserted coast, Phantasmoths rest on Eironn's left shoulder and Lorsan's head.

1.Content: Whatever the season, it's rare to see them outside the rainforest.

2.Content: The two initially thought of it as a serendipitous encounter. But soon enough, more and more Phantasmoth began appearing in droves, lingering around them with no intention to leave.

3.Content: Meanwhile, the winds from afar brought grim tidings. Lorsan reckoned that something must be amiss with the natural habitat of these magical creatures. So, he set out with Eironn and followed the Phantasmoths to their habitat to investigate.

0.Content: The shimmering scales of Phantasmoths are a potent hallucinogen. It would be wise to watch out for them, even if these creatures have no desire to harm us.

1.Content: I understand, but wait... I smell Hypogeans in the air!

2.Content: Is there nowhere they have not defiled? It must be Hypogeans that turned this place into a freezing tundra. To restore it, we must first figure out how to destroy these evil beings.

3.Content: I suppose the Phantasmoths were reluctant to leave because they wanted our help in defeating the Hypogeans.

4.Content: If that's the case, let's teach these rascals a lesson!

0.Content: Thank Dura for the Phantasmoths. If they hadn't beguiled the Hypogeans, we would have had a hard time escaping.

1.Content: There aren't as many Hypogeans as I thought. Let's seize the opportunity and eliminate them right away.

2.Content: That's right. They shall defile the Phantasmoths' habitat no more!

1.Content: Phew... we're finally rid of the Hypogeans. But it will still take some time before the place can return to its original state. I hope these Phantasmoths can dwell in peace from now on.

2.Content: We can't let our guard down just yet. There may be something larger at work behind this invasion of the Hypogeans.

0.Content: Damn this weather... What are the odds of a blizzard whipping up right as soon as I get here? Good thing someone left a tent here...
What's this? ... An imperial decree from the Lightbearer Empire?

1.Content: Brrrr... That snowstorm is merciless! Thank goodness I found this tent, or else I'd never live to see the Dark Forest again!

2.Content: Oh, hello there! Didn't think I'd meet anyone out here! My name is Lorsan, I'm a wanderer.

4.Content: Judging from that decree in your hand, you must be on some kind of official imperial business, right? Can't say I've ever traveled with someone like you before!

5.Content: So what brings you to these parts?

6.Content: The ice elementals near the town are growing restless…

7.Content: Wow, so the ice elementals are raging out here too, huh? Well, I can't just sit by and do nothing about it, so let me give you a hand!

8.Content: Let's head over to the town and investigate first.

0.Content: Look, there's an ice elemental on that raft! If we can find a way to knock it into the lake, it'll freeze the water and we can keep going!

1.Content: There are a few turbines on the shore over there. Why don't we try blowing it off the raft?

2.Content: That's not a bad idea! Good thing I'm pretty well-versed in wind magic, too.

0.Content: Wait! If we make the turbines face each other, we'll just end up breaking them!
You, over there! Show yourself!

1.Content: Hail, travelers. I'm just an ordinary villager from Glacier Town... I was on my way home with medicine for my sick mother, but the frozen passage back to town had melted away... I had no choice but to swim across the lake, but now I'm too tired to keep going...

2.Content: Don't worry, friend! This young lady is from the Lightbearer Empire, and she came to help you with your ice elemental problems!

3.Content: Goddess be praised... If you're heading for town, would you mind delivering this medicine to my mother for me? She's in dire need of it...

4.Content: Don't worry, we'll make sure this medicine is delivered as soon as possible.

0.Content: This ice elemental sure is a rambunctious one... I don't think it wants to go in the water at all.

1.Content: Well, we're not asking! Let's use the turbines to cut off its escape!

0.Content: Damn... The turbines won't reach it over there!

1.Content: We'll have to find a way to rotate them... Here, let's try turning the handwheel.

0.Content: Y-You blasted ice elementals... You used to be so gentle and tame! Help! Someone save me!

1.Content: This isn't good... Those rampaging ice elementals have that villager surrounded! We have to rescue him!

0.Content: I'm saved... Thank you, kind strangers. The rest of the villagers are taking shelter in the church. It's the strongest structure in all of the town.

1.Content: Was this church built recently?

2.Content: Why yes, it was! Glacier Town is rich in water resources, which is why some of Oakenfell's biggest merchants have decided to build waterwheel workshops here! Thanks to them, our little village has prospered like never before... We even had enough in our town coffers to build this beautiful church!

3.Content: A man entrusted us with delivering medicine to his sick mother. Do you happen to know where we could find her?

4.Content: We house the sick and the frail in our town's warmest cottage. You'll have to cross over two lakes to get there, and there will be plenty of enemies along the way...

5.Content: You don't have to worry for my sake. I promised I would deliver this medicine, and I have no intention of going back on my word.

0.Content: Thank you, miss... We are beyond grateful to you and your long-eared assistant! Thanks to you, the ice elementals have finally been subdued, and our normal lives can continue once again!

1.Content: Here, your brother asked us to deliver this medicine to your mother. As for the ice elementals, something tells me this was no natural disaster...

2.Content: What's happening over there, behind that grove of trees?

0.Content: My goodness... Are these the workshops that the villager told us about before? No wonder the ice elementals went berserk... With all of this noise and smoke, they were bound to lose control sooner or later.

1.Content: B-But without these workshops, our town would go back to being another poverty-stricken village! If it wasn't for the jobs they made, we wouldn't have been able to afford our mother's medicine, either...

2.Content: There has to be some sort of compromise, or else it's just a matter of time before the ice elementals go on another rampage. In these lands, living in harmony with the elements should always come first.

3.Content: Will you be reporting this to the empire then, missy?

4.Content: First of all, my name is Scarlet, not "missy." Second, I have a better idea. I think I'll have a word with those money-grubbing merchants instead, and show them the importance of protecting the environment...

5.Content: That's, uh... That's one way to go about it, I suppose.

0.Content: Dang it, back here again! Keep that Iron-jaw of yours on a leash!

1.Content: Quit your whining! He just stepped on the wrong energy tile, is all!

2.Content: Easy for you to say! This keeps up, we won't even be able to leave, much less get any legendary treasure!

0.Content: It's okay, Savagehorn... Don't look down! These energy tiles are simple, just follow me.

1.Content: Step on every tile and don't step on the same one twice! Or else the tower won't have enough energy and we'll have to restart!

0.Content: You never should have brought that thing along in the first place!

1.Content: That's not what you said when you told him to smash through those boulders!

2.Content: I'll say it again, only by stepping on all of the energy tiles in order will the tower teleport us past it! I don't want to be stuck here!

0.Content: Alright, Savagehorn, onward!

1.Content: Ancient treasure, here we come! But, uh, how do we get out of here once we find the treasure?

2.Content: We'll just have to make it to the end. All the towers should be charged at that point, so I'm sure we'll be able to just teleport back.

0.Content: Lift that torch up a bit so I can take a look at this magic circle... Agh, my back! Damned beast!

1.Content: Ho there, settle down Savagehorn! Hey, the circle lit up... Look over there, a bridge!

2.Content: Alright! Recharging that tower just got a whole lot easier.

3.Content: Let's go, Savagehorn!

0.Content: We're going to be rich! Wait... Look, all the towers from before are gone... Looks like we can just head back the way we came.

1.Content: See, didn't I say we could depend on this big guy?

0.Content: Look at that damn rock. It's gonna be a problem. There's no way tower can be fully charged!

1.Content: Calm down. We can still do it again if we fail this time. When Savagehorn stepped on the wrong tile the other time, we still made it through anyhow.

2.Content: This damn cycle!

0.Content: Another nightmare, Talene?

1.Content: Yes, the same one. I was dreaming I was going on a far journey...

2.Content: Esperia is in the midst of its worst crisis yet.

3.Content: And that is where our sacred mission lies: to save the land!

4.Content: We're getting close now. I don't know why I keep dreaming the same dream. It's getting clearer each time.

5.Content: Many scenes in my dreams have become reality...

6.Content: This is nothing to worry about. The five inheritors are assembled.

7.Content: All that remains is to activate the Elemental Altar, and the world will return to the way it once was.

8.Content: Very well. It is time to depart. Let's see if our camp is ready.

0.Content: Does all go well with you, Belinda?

1.Content: By the Light above, I'm ready to depart any time.

0.Content: And how about you, Brutus?

1.Content: There are so many Corruptors... I suggest we try to break through to the Elemental Altar before they can encircle the place.

0.Content: Talene, I hear the forest cry. I think it's telling me Corruptors are nearby.

1.Content: I'm sure that activating the Elemental Altar will bring all of our fears to an end, and restore Esperia from this latest cataclysm.

0.Content: Why are Thane and Baden not in camp?

1.Content: They left to investigate the Corruptors' latest movements. I would have expected them to have returned by now.

2.Content: With all these Corruptors, I think it was a bit rash to go alone. I'll scout ahead to check on them.

0.Content: Baden is fighting Corruptors! We've got to help!
Baden, what's going on?

1.Content: I went scouting with Thane. There's a very deep chasm up ahead. I'm afraid we're not going to be able to follow our original route.

2.Content: Corruptors ambushed us! Far worse than what I'm used to. Thane led some of them away. I'm worried he's still fighting them.

0.Content: There's of great big rift up ahead. I can't see any way forward.

1.Content: What's more, I think the rift is recent. It means the Elemental Strife is getting worse. I fear any other paths we try will have met a similar fate.

2.Content: When you factor in the threat of our original route caving in, and all the Corruptors around here, wisdom might advise another path.

0.Content: I've heard of an underground passage deep within the mountain that Wilder sorcerers reinforced with their magicks. But it's been abandoned for centuries, and there's no telling if the Corruptors have got there first.

1.Content: Only one way to find out...

2.Content: Let's rendezvous with everyone at camp before setting out.

0.Content: Corruptors! There are so many of them! What does that mean...

1.Content: The crisis is getting worse, which is imbuing new Corruptors with twisted elemental power. They'll continue to evolve as the cataclysm deteriorates.

2.Content: Help! Someone, save us!

3.Content: There's a group of trapped villagers on the other side of that rift! Refugees, by the look of their clothes.

4.Content: Oh no! Hot magma released by the rift is bubbling up! It's going to swallow them if we don't save them right away!

0.Content: Someone... anyone... please save my daughter?!

1.Content: Oh dear, more townsfolk trapped over there!

2.Content: There's no time for second guessing!

0.Content: Go, now!

1.Content: (Turns to the trapped townsfolk) Just hold on, I'll be over right away!

0.Content: AH!
Talene...

1.Content: There was nothing you could have done. Don't...

2.Content: I didn't save them.

3.Content: I could have saved them. I could have saved more people, but I...

4.Content: You had to choose.

6.Content: Sometimes you have to choose who lives and who dies. That is what it means to be a "savior." There are no perfect answers.

7.Content: If you wish to save the most people possible, our best course is to ignore those we come across and press on. The longer we delay our mission, the worse this crisis will get, and the more people will die.

8.Content: Cold logic would dictate the "few" must die for the sake of the "many." But it isn't an easy choice to make.

9.Content: We are not gods from afar. We are bound by ties of kith and kin. Other factors will always influence our judgment.

10.Content: It is neither right nor practical to evaluate life by pure numbers. Make your choice. But once you've made it, do not allow it to haunt you.

11.Content: Our only choice now is to keep going. To keep going and... keep making our choices.

0.Content: Corruptors in the camp!

1.Content: Let's get them!

0.Content: Our route has been completely blocked by this ravine. Maetria knows about a secret underground tunnel that leads all the way to the Elemental Altar.

1.Content: Then let's be off. May the Divine Light illuminate our path.

2.Content: No time like the present, let's go.

0.Content: So these woods were simply an illusion?

1.Content: Not all the eye sees is real. Just like not every legend one hears about the past reflects the truth.

2.Content: Follow me.

0.Content: There's the Infernal Temple, Tidal Temple, Wildwood Temple, Vortex Temple, and Cragrise Temple.

1.Content: Each sacred temple is activated by its corresponding Elemental Emblem. Activate them all, and the Elemental Altar will spring to life.

2.Content: Inheritors of each Elemental Emblem, please proceed to your temple.

3.Content: Talene and I will be sure to protect the Elemental Altar while you activate each Temple. We are about to enter our final battle.

0.Content: Let us begin. I want to see this end.
For the Light!
I-I'll do my best!
Let's go and fight our final battle.
We shall fulfil our guardian vows, which we have made unto the death!
The ceremony has begun and the 5 temples have been activated!

1.Content: But something is wrong with the Elemental Altar! It seems one more step is required? Just like you told me...

2.Content: The final step is a union between the spirit of a hero and the Altar itself.

3.Content: A truly powerful and determined spirit capable of crossing the wall of fire and personally entering into the Altar.

4.Content: These rites were only completed once before, by the former leader of the Obsidian Finches. Now only one true Obsidian Finch remains...

5.Content: I already made my decision long ago, haven't I? This is my choice.

6.Content: To protect Esperia is the sacred mission of all Obsidian Finches.

7.Content: Let's not delay another moment! The Altar must be activated.

8.Content: I don't care what happens to me. We need to restore our world! I have no regrets...

9.Content: I'll go with you.

0.Content: There's something... deeply familiar about this place. It's almost like...

1.Content: Almost like the place we were born, isn't it?

2.Content: The birthplace of the Obsidian Finches—the Solaran Furnace.

3.Content: Who are you, really?

4.Content: Just a witness to the truth.

5.Content: Remember, Talene, how I told you the story of the Obsidian Finches, and how they saved the world?

6.Content: The calamity ravaged the earth while the divine avians saved the world...

7.Content: I had hoped by now you would've figured out the more... unpleasant side to that story.

8.Content: Honas, the Creator forged a Furnace in the void when he made Esperia. He then plucked a spark of fire from the sun, the Solaris Flame, and mixed it with all the elements to create the new world.

9.Content: Unfortunately, the elements were not quite aligned. Eventually, this would lead to disaster.

10.Content: So the Creator made his "Solaran Furnace" a part of the world he'd made, but hidden deep, deep underground.

11.Content: That Furnace was to lie in wait for disaster. When the elements inevitably fell out of balance, it would be used to reignite the Solaris Flare and set right the world.

12.Content: Centuries passed as the energies latent within the Furnace evolved into a unique species of divine avians.

13.Content: Their sacred mission, to protect the world, was written into their very blood, their very bones, their very existence.

14.Content: The Obsidian Finches...

15.Content: At the appointed time, in the gravest hour of the crisis, the pure Obsidian Finches would go to the base of the Elemental Altar to release the fragments of the Solaris Flare within themselves.

16.Content: Then the Elemental Altar would carry that power to every corner of the world to remake our planet—without the elemental imbalance.

17.Content: Unfortunately, the Solaris Flare is also the very same spark that gives life to our species. An Obsidian Finch will die shortly after their spark is taken away. And so they did.

18.Content: A thousand years ago, I lost my people! OUR people! I tried to turn back the Creator's wheel and stop the process, but I couldn't save them.

19.Content: You must be the one I heard about—the legendary Obsidian Finch who initiated these rites before!

0.Content: You cannot be everyone's salvation, Talene.

1.Content: The value of life means something very different...

2.Content: To the one who holds the scales of life and death in their hands.

3.Content: I have since come to understand that survival always requires one group to prosper at the expense of another.

4.Content: That doesn't justify a cataclysm that could end our world!

5.Content: Who will think of the Obsidian Finches then? Who gets to write our ending?!

6.Content: Should we follow silly ideas of faith, justice, and fairness? Because of how we were created? Because there are fewer of us than of them?

7.Content: Once again, everything just boils down to "our mission."

8.Content: It's time to end this futile struggle, Talene. Follow me and let's deposit the last vestige of the Solaris Flare into the Furnace.

9.Content: And the Obsidian Finches will be reborn from within.

10.Content: Isn't that what you've always wanted? To see another member of your species?

11.Content: And now it is within your grasp...

12.Content: Mother...

13.Content: Maetria... what's past is past.

14.Content: We can't sacrifice the present to restore the past. We're talking about millions of lives just for a possibility to restore something... It's murder!

15.Content: Is that your final choice?

16.Content: The rites must be concluded. If not, you cannot leave.

17.Content: My last Obsidian Finch... you are the one who will lead our race to new life!

0.Content: The Elemental Altar... it's been activated!
What's this power? Is it the Solaris Flare?
Is that Talene?
The Corruptors have retreated! I sense a realignment and restoration of order in the Elemental forces.
...and Talene?
I... I do not know. She brought Esperia a miracle; let us pray that she may see a miracle as well.
The Lady of Oakenfell has a restaurant she absolutely loves, which has recently run into financial problems.

1.Content: Rosaline, a servant who greatly admires her, is working tirelessly to gather every recipe known to the realm in order to revive the restaurant. Even in her dreams, she is thinking about adding a delicious dessert to her menu.

2.Content: When Rosaline opens her eyes, she realizes she is in a world of candy and confectionary. A beautiful Savage Soufflé is flying and dancing around her, its ears fluttering adorably.

3.Content: But not far away, several monsters are inching closer and closer, their predatory gaze fixed on their new prey... Run, Rosaline. Run!

0.Content: I remember you, Savage Soufflé, we've met before! Do you have any idea where we are?

1.Content: Oh, you'll be guiding me? That's great! I'm counting on you!

0.Content: Thank you so much, little one. It's strange, but now that those monsters have been turned into cakes, they actually look quite delicious. I don't think I'm afraid anymore…

1.Content: Let's fight our way out together!

0.Content: I think I get it now. I'm dreaming, aren't I? Lately, I've been really stressed out by the troubles at the restaurant.

1.Content: Well, I guess this is goodbye for now. But don't worry, next time we meet up, I'll have some tasty treats waiting for you! I'm sure you'll love them!

0.Content: (Sobbing) Oh no... What a disaster!

1.Content: Where are we?!

2.Content: Something went wrong with my spell... And the cake? What about our cake?

3.Content: Yes! How did that baking spell go? Mm. It smells so good, I couldn't help but take a bite!

4.Content: It's your fault, Raku! You distracted me! Messed up my spell! And now look where we are... where are we?!

5.Content: I don't know, but I can smell freshly-baked cake. There's a big one over there. Let's have a look!

0.Content: Hello! Can I ask where we are?

1.Content: The very same cake that you baked.

2.Content: Cakes? These are cakes, are they?

3.Content: I just took a closer look at the ground, and it looks like we're standing on cake!

4.Content: What does that mean? I can eat the ground I'm standing on?

5.Content: Don't be weird, Raku! That reminds me—milady, you look a lot like the little Sugar Elf we just decorated our cake with.

6.Content: Sugar Elf? What a strange description. Sounds rather sweet though.

7.Content: I think your spell brought the Sugar Elf to life! You know what? I'm actually impressed!

8.Content: I knew something would go wrong. I just knew it!

9.Content: Did Pippa's spell also turn us into cake? I wonder if I taste like cream? Should I take a bite of myself?

10.Content: We may look like Sugar Elves too! I need an undo spell which means I need to cast... ugh. I can't remember!

11.Content: So are we just stuck here then? If we don't make it to the party, I'm afraid... we're gonna miss out on a lot of other tasty desserts!

12.Content: Shh! If you listen you might hear the wishes of your cake! That's right—treat your hand-made cake lovingly and it will repay you tenfold!

13.Content: The cake has wishes? I hope that it's to be eaten by us!

14.Content: This is getting weirder and weirder... I think the cake's wish might just be to have beautiful candles on top!

15.Content: Insightful. Four beautiful candles have been placed on this cake. Light them all, and you might find some of your wishes have come true.

16.Content: I love lighting candles! But where are they? How do we get there?

17.Content: As you can see, cakes are blocking your way. This is not deliberate—simply a sign that in this realm we demand far more than ordinary, boring cakes.

18.Content: So we need to add some sparkle? Give them a bit of personality?!

19.Content: Exactly. Now, find different ingredients to transform the cakes into your ideal dessert.

20.Content: I'm afraid it's even more complicated than my magic...

21.Content: Worry not! Simply make cakes, then I shall take them away, and your path shall be cleared.

22.Content: See that cake over there? I happen to have a blueberry. Would you like to try it?

0.Content: Anyway, to illuminate all the candles, you must prepare the cakes in your path with your favorite dessert flavors!
The lady said that we need to find the right ingredients to change the flavors of these plain cakes.

1.Content: It wants to be a blueberry cake! And she just gave us a blueberry... Let's grab another one!

2.Content: Don't bother her! Maybe there are some more blueberries around here, OK?

0.Content: Sweet-and-sour blueberry cake. A delicious combo!

1.Content: Actually, this is a bit easier than spellcasting...

2.Content: Over there is the first candle. I suggest we light it now.

0.Content: The candle is shining bright!

1.Content: Very festive! Come to think of it, there are a lot of lovely glittering things around here.

2.Content: Illuminate all four candles and I guarantee good things will come your way.

3.Content: Awesome! Then let's light the next one!

0.Content: Blueberries? Oranges? Or something a little sourer?

1.Content: But we don't have any of either. Any other ideas?

2.Content: Pippa, do you think we can go another way?

0.Content: Berry cheese? Still blueberries?

1.Content: What about blueberries and strawberries? I quite like that combo in a drink.

2.Content: Strawberries always improve a cake! I think we should prioritize finding strawberries—as well as blueberries.

3.Content: But where are the strawberries? We'd better look around...

0.Content: Wow! Strawberries at last!

1.Content: What happened? There are all these weird things on the cake...

2.Content: Oh dear, my runaway magic spell? I am so, so sorry!

3.Content: That's quite alright! Easily handled. So apart from the strawberries, I think we should make a berry cheese cake too.

0.Content: You've lit the second candle now, and may have seen many intriguing items on your journey.

1.Content: Is this really the cake I baked? I feel like it's almost got a life of its own.

2.Content: Well, perhaps you need to listen to what your cake is trying to tell you! I do so forward to the big reveal once you light all the candles...

3.Content: Just what is this cake gonna taste like?

4.Content: I'd love to find out too!

0.Content: So where do we go from here?

1.Content: Behold a new flavor for your cake! And if you don't have enough ingredients on hand for both, you may need to choose...

2.Content: Oh, but I did so want to make both! But I don't think we have any other ingredients...

3.Content: Perhaps we should look around for more ingredients before deciding?

4.Content: Raku, where do you think we should go?

0.Content: Oh my my, how I'd love some delicious strawberries right now!

1.Content: Yikes! Are you telling me there are other residents of this cake? So I didn't just animate the Sugar Elf...

2.Content: A little squirrel and a little raccoon? Tasty, no doubt...

3.Content: Pippa, your spell went way too far! You've given life to an entire world in this cake!

4.Content: World? Enough nonsense! We've lived here for eons! Back to the real issue: do you have any strawberries?

5.Content: We do, but we were hoping to use it to bake a cake...

6.Content: Gosh! I have mangoes and oranges, but the thing is, I don't really care for either. I'd much rather have strawberries.

7.Content: So do you mind if we trade our strawberries for your fruits? Actually, it'd be quite easy for you to just go back over there and get your own strawberries.

8.Content: (Cough) Then I would have to contend with those fearsome creatures! No way!

9.Content: I'll give you mangoes and oranges for strawberries. But I only want one strawberry. So think about it...

10.Content: So can we swap for the mango and then get orange later?

11.Content: You can't keep exchanging ingredients! You need to stick with things!

12.Content: Fair enough, I guess?

0.Content: A very fragrant orange!

1.Content: Great! So our cake will have a wonderful zesty orange flavor!

2.Content: And taste great.

0.Content: This is the third candle. You have only a little further to go to light all four!

1.Content: Gosh. I'm starting to get a bit tired. What a beautiful world this is. Maybe we should sit and admire it? It's been a long day.

2.Content: Never fear, the cake is gaining that which it seeks. Your persistence shall be well-rewarded in wishes!

3.Content: What I'd like is an everlasting dessert I can never finish!

4.Content: What I'd like is... a book granting access to even greater magicks!

5.Content: That could be a bit risky!

6.Content: Of course, it is not necessarily guaranteed that all wishes will come true...

0.Content: Strawberries? Strawberries, anyone? Ah, strawberries!

1.Content: Another strawberry fanatic!

2.Content: Maybe with more fruits on offer like the other one?

3.Content: I have a lot—and I mean a lot—of mangoes! And I can't stand mangoes!

4.Content: Greetings! We come bringing strawberries. Would you mind giving us some of your mangoes?

5.Content: Strawberries? Wonderful! Just give me some strawberries and you can have as many mangoes as you want in return!

6.Content: He really does love strawberries, huh?

0.Content: You have lit the fourth and final candle!

1.Content: Wow. Lots of treasure just appeared in the middle section!

2.Content: And a lot of cakes!

3.Content: These cakes are a generous gift for you.

4.Content: So we need to go into the middle section, right? I've always felt it's kind of like the heart and soul of a cake.

5.Content: Maybe if we can just eat that section, we'll return to normal?

6.Content: That might very well be true! So, milady, will we get to see you again if we end up eating our way out of this cake?

7.Content: I am bound to the realm of cake, and it has been my pleasure to serve you today. We may well meet again on your next cake-baking adventure!

8.Content: I got it! Well, I look forward to seeing you again then!

0.Content: Just one thing—what's with the candles? Is it somebody's birthday?

1.Content: This big cake looks a lot like the one we started off making, but much, much better than when we were just resorting to spell-casting!

2.Content: The sweetest cake is always made with the most dedicated heart.

3.Content: Good point! So who's birthday is it anyway?

4.Content: Well, no matter whose it is, with a cake like that, I'm sure it's gonna be a good one!

5.Content: Well, let's wish them a very proper happy birthday!

0.Content: (Knock-knock) Hello? Anyone inside?

1.Content: (Door opens) I'm terribly sorry! We're just taking a short break at the moment.

2.Content: Oh! If it isn't the housekeeper of the Lady of Oakenfell! Please, by all means, come in!

3.Content: What are you doing here, Miss Mirael? I see the restaurant is closed. Have I come to the wrong place?

4.Content: Not at all! This is most definitely a place. Can I ask, did the Lady of the City send you?

5.Content: Yes! She's hosting a large banquet for friends in 7 days' time and asked me to organize it on this restaurant's premises.

6.Content: Ah. And what a fine restaurant it is despite its, uh, current state... We were once considered one of the "wonders of Oakenfell." I'm sure in those days the good Lady herself must've been a frequent patron.

7.Content: I'm sorry to interrupt this happy conversation, but Miss Mirael, can we continue?

8.Content: Good day to you, Earl.

9.Content: Greetings, Miss Rosaline! And please convey my finest regards to the good Lady.

10.Content: As I was saying, Miss Mirael, I may have to deprive you of one of your hobbies, that is, restaurant management. You've been in arrears for months now. Please do me the service of signing this Contract of Lien over the property...

11.Content: Oh, heh! That old thing... Well, you see, good Earl, our fortunes have just improved remarkably! Miss Rosaline, since you're here, would you mind explaining to the profit-driven Earl what Oakenfell's Lady asked of you today?

12.Content: Well, the menu here famously includes the finest delicacies from across Hathor, promising a taste of Mauler, Wilder, or even Graveborn food without having to step outside Oakenfell.

13.Content: Milady has already sent out the invites—seeking a great gathering of friends to the gourmet restaurant she remembers well from the days of her youth.

14.Content: Exactly so, dear Earl! Sadly, it seems the Lady's banquet is about to be cancelled for what is, relative to her, a few pennies' worth of debts. I struggle to imagine her embarrassment... and blow to the reputation of anyone who'd operate in our stead!

15.Content: Uh. Well... This is an interesting turn of events, Miss Mirael. I must admit you have me in somewhat of a bind.

16.Content: (Pondering)

17.Content: The restaurant's main selling point is unique dishes not found elsewhere in Oakenfell. But, since I've always found experience a good guide, I must sorely question how you can manage that in 7 days?

18.Content: Particularly as the former head chef's recipes were included in the items he desperately pledged for a bridging loan to keep this place afloat.

19.Content: And that brings me to my next important point! I'm afraid we're going to need those back. I'd like to reopen—with his famous "Chaz Hathor" recipes!

20.Content: And why, pray tell, would I return it?

21.Content: We need it! We're the only restaurant that can source those ingredients anywhere in Oakenfell! Plus, Rosaline is a fine cook! With our resources and her cooking skills, this restaurant can absolutely produce the 5-star meals we were once famous for!

22.Content: An intriguing hypothesis. What say you to all this, Miss Rosaline? Your Ladyship would be willing for you to undertake such an endeavor?

23.Content: I am sworn to milady's service, as you know, Earl. I'd certainly be wanting to help.

24.Content: You may thank the stars you can continue to operate...

25.Content: Well then, please return our copy of the "Chaz Hathor" and ingredient lists!

26.Content: All in good time, Miss Mirael. But I did not get to my current station in life by taking everything on faith. I'd like to see evidence of the great cooking skills you have laid claim to. Please pass a simple little test for me first.

27.Content: A test? Goodness. See what I have to deal with? What is the point?

28.Content: This is the point, milady: I'm a connoisseur of fine dining myself. Even the best chefs in Oakenfell take my advice very seriously. All I ask is you produce a few dishes to satisfy me, and I'll be very happy to return everything to your control, Miss Mirael. How does that sound, ladies?

29.Content: Well, I am sworn to ensure milady's banquet goes ahead as planned.

30.Content: Alright then, have a little test! But since you agreed to give it back, I'm counting on you to renovate the place to her Ladyship's desires.

31.Content: ...In any case, the first dish I would to see is a classic cake of many a Oakenfell banquet in former days—that's right, the Love Drunk Jello.

32.Content: Heh! That one! All we need are Tree-heart Fruits and Lover's Pearls, both of which our pantry still has in abundance. I'll just grab it and get cooking.

0.Content: I'm sorry about the mess. It's not just a restaurant, it's also my home when I'm visiting Oakenfell. And it's been years since I came back.

1.Content: I've been meaning to ask you, Miss Mirael: you're a well-known bounty hunter. Why take time out of your busy schedule to run a restaurant in Oakenfell?

2.Content: I stayed here for a few years while studying as a youth here in Oakenfell. The then boss and head chef was a distant uncle.

3.Content: I'd been out on my own for some years when I suddenly received a letter from him claiming he needed to go someplace far away for an extended convalescence. He wanted me to take over for a while. I knew he was serious when I saw the official change of ownership form attached to the letter.

4.Content: I had no idea what I was getting myself into. When I arrived the place was a mess—pretty much what you see now. But even then, I wouldn't let the restaurant close.

5.Content: I see.

6.Content: I know we just had a bit of rainfall, but this mudslide is ridiculous! Our poor storeroom! Must've lost at least half. Rosaline? Can I get your help finding ingredients?

0.Content: We've gathered the ingredients needed for your meal, dear Earl.

1.Content: Very good. I look forward to your forthcoming culinary display.

2.Content: Any maidservant to the Lady worth her salt knows how to make a good dessert! I'm sure you'll find it most satisfying.

3.Content: Confidence is always lovely to behold, dear girl. But I'm afraid you'll need much more than a typical servant-girl's skills to cook up the more outlandish dishes in the "Chaz."

4.Content: He has a point, you know. But don't worry. I'm here to help even if I might not be much of a chef. I'm great at the other stuff—like handling the oven.

5.Content: Let's begin!

0.Content: Phew! That really brings me back to my days as a young'n, helping my uncle in the old kitchen. Cooking and spellcasting is strangely similar.

1.Content: It's going really well, I should think, with Miss Mirael's invaluable help, my Earl! Please, enjoy.

2.Content: Ah. You have surpassed my expectations moderately in aroma and complexion, but I'm afraid the crux of this particular dessert lies in its impeccable presentation. You could have improved on that.

3.Content: But of course! Nobles must value external appearance over substance. I should have known.

4.Content: ...A pass then on this very first test. I suspect many of Oakenfell's nobility will be rather excited to see Love Drunk Jello make a glorious comeback.

5.Content: Isn't that great, Miss Mirael?

6.Content: Heh. Glad I could help. But there's a lot more than just desserts in the "Chaz" list. We might need some outside help...

7.Content: For my next dish I'd very much like to try a simple presentation of Clansnake Potpourri.

8.Content: Clansnake Potpourri? Got it. For that we'll need Ringtailed Viper meat, Scorpion Pincers, and Oasis Grain... and, if I'm not mistaken, all mainly from Mauler's Enclave.

9.Content: Oh yes. You're very right.

10.Content: So how are we going to get the ingredients?

11.Content: Hopefully they're in the extra "pantry supplies" from the back garden. Follow me, Miss Rosaline. The Earl shall have his tastebuds satisfied! Let him cool his heels for now.

0.Content: This "back garden pantry" is a bit of a secret. Have a look at this...

1.Content: What's this?! A portal?!

2.Content: To just about anywhere across Hathor—including Mauler, Wilder, and even Graveborn territory for the occasional cheeky restock.

3.Content: Let me guess... that's how the restaurant managed to produce delicacies from all over Hathor?

4.Content: You hit the nail on the head. I just restored the portal to Mauler's Enclave. Actually, it's a little odd I had to do that as normally they're open year round. They seem to have just turned themselves off recently.

5.Content: Well, you've been away for a number of years, as you said? Let's go visit some Maulers and get some snake meat!

0.Content: Wow. It's pretty hot! Wait, are we in the middle of the desert? I distinctly remember the portal exited in a village...

1.Content: And I distinctly feel like the sand around our feet is swirling, Miss Mirael.

2.Content: No need to panic! I'm in control. Just follow me.

0.Content: Darn you, Thesku! Trapped me at last!

1.Content: Mirael! Someone over there is about to walk into that quicksand!

2.Content: Some people have all the bad luck... Hi there, bro! Any last words you'd like me to share with your clan?

3.Content: Huh?! What are you two silly maids doing on Mauler turf?

4.Content: The quicksand is already up to his chest...

5.Content: Anyway, I don't mind! Please just get me out of here! Please!

6.Content: Did you just say something about a "Thesku" trapping you?

7.Content: Yah! Little coward got my kinfolk with his darned snakes! I've sworn I'll not rest till I turn him and his snakes into a pot of stew!

8.Content: Is that so? Then I suppose you'd also know how to get your hands on some Ringtail Viper Meat?

9.Content: Oddly specific, but yah! They're all snakes. But first, can ya please pull me out!?

10.Content: I'm afraid Mr Mauler here is about to go under...

11.Content: Let's pull him out, Rosaline! I think he can help us find the right snake meat.

12.Content: Very good.

13.Content: (He is pulled out) Gah! Sweet, sweet air!

14.Content: So could you help us get our hands on some Ringtail Viper Meat then?

15.Content: Call me Tidus. You want snake meat, ya follow me. I'll guarantee as much as you want.

16.Content: Only reason I'm all the way out here is to get Thesku, but he got me good with that quicksand! Owe ya me life.

17.Content: He must be fixing to steal our village's spices and water. Help me out, and I'll be sure to cut up his precious snake for ya!

18.Content: Heh. Okay. That's a deal.

0.Content: Hey Thesku! I, Tidus, still live! Nasty surprise, eh?

1.Content: Tidus?! Huh. Didn't figure you could get yourself out of quicksand.

2.Content: You seem to have an ample supply of different snakes species with you, my friend. I was wondering if you might provide us with the best Ringtail Viper Meat you have?

3.Content: What in the blazes are you doing with a couple of Lightbearer humans?!

4.Content: At ease, Ilshu! I won't let them hurt you.

5.Content: Enough! Thought you could get at our clan? Today we're gonna cook those fine long scales!

0.Content: Curses! A fire-bringer, huh? Gotta watch out for her, darlings. Zilsu, what are you doing coiling up?!

1.Content: Alright then. The omens are against me today. Let's get out of here!

2.Content: Hey snakeling, come back here! Or you're just going to leave him here to get his head chopped? Suit yourself!

3.Content: Darn you, Tidus! Just you wait!

4.Content: Four heads yet only two legs between them. But my goodness do they run...

0.Content: Heh! I don't care whether you wanna boil him or fry him! It'll be enough for my kinsfolk for a fair few days.

1.Content: Oh? Don't tell me you're the chef in your local clan?

2.Content: Chef? Whaddaya mean? Anyone can cook snake! Why else would you want Ringtail Viper Meat? Here. I'll cut it for you.

3.Content: So if you don't mind me asking: what's the secret to preparing snake meat?

4.Content: Secret? Not much to it I guess. Just your ingredients. Like this.

5.Content: Isn't that Oasis Grain? One of the key ingredients for a proper Clansnake Potpourri.

6.Content: You know about that? No Mauler cook would be caught dead without it. The elders of my clan taught just two Maulers, and I was one of 'em.

7.Content: Very impressive. In fact, I'm starting to suspect you might just be the best chef for Clansnake Potpourri we're going to find in this entire continent.

8.Content: Hah! Ya, Miss. I swear to you the honest truth, my snake meat'll get the whole clan out hollerin' for more!

9.Content: I think there'll be quite a few human chefs interested in your talents in Oakenfell. Care to accompany us for a short demonstration?

10.Content: Well, I'm... shocked to hear so coming from you Lightbearers. But I gotta take care of me and my own first. Sorry ladies.

11.Content: That's alright! We have a portal, so you can practically be in two places at once. It won't take you away from your clan.

12.Content: Please, good master Tidus? Please, please?!

13.Content: I, uh, guess I can do yer lot a little demonstration, missus.

0.Content: Dear Earl, Clansnake Potpourri a la carte. Enjoy.

1.Content: My my. What an assault on the senses. Quite the intense smokiness.

2.Content: We informed the chef your comments, upon which he said, "There's something wrong with yer human's nose! If it ain't smoky, it ain't Clansnake Potpourri!"

3.Content: Well, I reserve the right to my opinion. So I really hope your next dish is more appetizing. I'm very concerned your culinary skills may not be up to the standard expected of high Oakenfell society.

4.Content: For the next dish, I'd like you to attempt the Cream of Pumpkin.

5.Content: Oh. That's that Dreamwood soup! (Mirael winks at Rosaline)

6.Content: Then we'll start prepping for you as soon as we've brought ingredients.

0.Content: Every family in Oakenfell knows how to make Pumpkin Soup, Miss Mirael. But what's the Cream of Pumpkin?

1.Content: Oh, nothing—you just swap out the onions for a similar-looking fruit from Dreamwood. Pippa came up one day with it when she couldn't find any onions and so just grabbed some fruit that looked similar.

2.Content: Who goes there?! What are you doing here?!

3.Content: We come in peace, good lady! We are friends with Pippa. Actually, I used to study with her. This is a Wilder camp, is it not? What are you doing encamping in Dreamwood?

4.Content: Are you injured, milady?

5.Content: You know Pippa?! I think she once mentioned friends like you. I'm alright. Nemora has already seen to my wounds. But this isn't a place for Lightbearer folk! You don't look like slave traders to me, so I advise you to get the heck out of here.

6.Content: I'm afraid your wound bears telltale hallmarks of a Hypogean-inflicted injury. Was there a battle nearby? I'm a hunter myself.

7.Content: Are you searching for the Hypogeans?

8.Content: We're not here for Hypogeans, but I also have a sacred duty to root them out wherever I find them.

9.Content: Thank you. But the thick of the battle is far from here. A human pyromancer helped us beat them back. Our healer, Nemora, came to Dreamwood for Bell Whistles to heal us.

10.Content: But she hasn't come back yet, and I'm starting to worry. Would you do me a favor and look out for her? Consider it part of your Hypogean crusade. And if you can help her, I'll do just about anything you ask.

11.Content: Oh, what's this... you have quite a few pumpkins in your camp. Mind sharing a couple?

12.Content: Is that all you want? Pumpkins? Is that all I can thank you with?

13.Content: Are there purple pumpkins? We'll need the purple variety for the Cream of Pumpkin.

14.Content: Uh, a few maybe? Get enough pumpkins and you're bound to find one. Just return Nemora safe and sound, and you can have every pumpkin you can see.

15.Content: Please be on your guard. Dreamwood is full of fantasies to bewitch even the smartest travelers.

16.Content: Don't worry, we'll definitely help you find the doctor.

0.Content: The sun is going down... I must return with the Bell Whistles soon if I'm to heal our poor wounded.

1.Content: (They run into each other) What's that noise? A Hypogean?! Eat a fireball!

2.Content: Hold on, Mirael! Ms Tea Cup isn't picking up any Hypogean traces!

3.Content: Ah! You're blinding me.

4.Content: Hey! On closer examination it looks like we've found our healer. Wonderful! Perhaps a pathfinder too...

5.Content: And you are?

6.Content: My name is Mirael, I'm a bounty hunter. And here is my dear friend and housekeeper Miss Rosaline—and a very talented chef.

7.Content: We've come to escort you safely out of Dreamwood, although we have had a few issues with navigation...

8.Content: I appreciate the sentiment. But I have to find my Bell Whistles first. I'm taking care of wounded soldiers in need of its healing properties.

9.Content: "Stir-fry the Bell Whistles in butter and then simmer with purple pumpkin (skin off), before adding pure Cowlpie Milk..." Sound familiar?

10.Content: That's Pippa's old dish, Cream of Pumpkin! I can't believe it. Fancy running into someone who knows Pippa's recipes here!

11.Content: But more importantly, that's a dish that'll really help someone recover fast from their injuries—and a great source of nutrients. If we can help you find your Bell Whistles, we can help you cook a hearty meal for the wounded.

12.Content: Of course, all we need is for you to share just a few Bell Whistles.

13.Content: Thanks for the offer! Then let's find some Bell Whistles right now.

0.Content: These barriers are a bit tricky. I think the key is to destroy each illusion in the right order.
Finally—a way out Dreamwood, and with more than enough Bell Whistles.

1.Content: Wonderful, Ms Nemora, to have your safe return! And thank you too, ladies. Have as many pumpkins as you please!

2.Content: Just to clarify, all we can do for you in return is just give you some of our pumpkin provisions?

3.Content: Heh. To tell you the truth, we're only here to find ingredients for the Cream of Pumpkin. We simply need Pure Cowlpie Milk and we're finished. That's it! Cowlpie milk.

4.Content: Oh. I may have a suggestion if you're willing to hear it?

5.Content: Please, Ms Nemora.

6.Content: I think "Pure Cowlpie Milk" just refers to milk from one of the Dark Forest's few remaining Cowlpies. There aren't many pure-blooded Cowlpies left, and the ones that you can find are only deep within the Dark Forest. But they're said to have the best, most nutritious milk.

7.Content: I see. In other words, if we're going to get our hands on the purest of the pure cowlpie milk for the Cream of Pumpkin, then to the Dark Forest we must go.

8.Content: That complicates things. We really need to venture all the way to the Dark Forest just to get our hands on a bottle of milk?

9.Content: Actually no! I happen to have a little here. You helped me in Dreamwood, so I'll help you. And if you need an assistant chef for your cooking, I'd happy to oblige for a time.

10.Content: Wonderful! Thank you, Ms Nemora!

0.Content: We'll have to break these illusions down if we want to make it past. And I'm afraid that the illusion has something to do with the statue.
My good Earl, we present the Cream of Pumpkin. Bon appetit.

1.Content: Ah... I can taste the purity of the milk used—authentic cowlpie, is it not? Truly, it elevates the dish and its Bell Whistles to the next level, transforming what should be a simple culinary experience into a transcendent one.

2.Content: Heh. OK. I'm glad you like it, my good Earl.

3.Content: I'm beginning to marvel at the prodigious capabilities of your backyard pantry. I wonder what other exotic foods one might find there?

4.Content: Well, as you know trade secrets are very important in this business. As well as, of course, cooking skills.

5.Content: I think Cream of Pumpkin cooked to this level is capable of satisfying the cravings of the most demanding diners. But I'm afraid you must not only be exceptional, but also bold to impress Oakenfell's finest critics!

6.Content: Strange how such exhausting tastes are parred for the course among the aristocracy. So what about your next dish?

7.Content: The fear of death and inauspicious omens are forever at the forefront of an aristocrat's mind. So what experience could be more unforgettable than a Graveborn delicacy, such as the Ocean's Zest Galore?
