I believe you will attract many customers not just from Oakenfell City, but all around Hathor with that exotic dish back on the menu.

8.Content: My goodness. It's nuts. But your wish is our command! All we need to do is grab some Blue-spine Cod from the bottom of the ocean and Soul Snatchers from the Island of the Banished. Not a problem.

0.Content: Miss Mirael? I don't want to be a bother but where are we? It's awfully dark and... oppressive.

1.Content: This is the Hermit Isle, Graveborn territory located on the edge of the Island of the Banished.

2.Content: Graveborn? Goodness. I don't like the sound of that, not at all!

3.Content: There really isn't anything to worry about, Rosaline! You know, there are different kinds of Graveborn just like there are different kinds of people. They're not all "evil" like Bantus! The Graveborn of Hermit Isle just want to enjoy their death in peaceful coexistence with the living. They're only here because they don't want to become the Fallen King's servants.

4.Content: You mean even among the Graveborn there are some who desire... peace and good?

5.Content: Of course! Some of which I count among my best friends. You know there are times I even envy them. In some sense you could say they have nothing to fear from death.

6.Content: I remember one Graveborn friend, Lombardy, was always boasting about how he used to be such an amazing chef during his life. I think he's the one we need to talk to.

0.Content: Hey, Lombardy? What are you doing lying down there?

1.Content: What could I be doing? Sunbathing, of course.

2.Content: Sunbathing?! On Hermit Isle?

3.Content: Lie here long enough and eventually you will gain a few glimpses of real sunlight... even stranger things have happened.

4.Content: Alright. I'm sorry for disturbing you then, but we need a favor. We wish to get our hands on some Soul Snatchers.

5.Content: Oh, you would like some Soul Snatchers, would you? Well, I wish I wanted to help you.

6.Content: Lombardy! That's no way to treat a friend—even if it has been a number of years. When did you get so bad-tempered?

7.Content: It's been a dozen years! And ever since you last visited through that portal of yours, I've spent most of the time just lying here! The average day isn't very interesting for a Graveborn! Would've been really nice to see you more often. But it looks like I can expect a visit maybe once every dozen years? Thought you'd forgotten about me...

8.Content: Oh, uh, I hadn't realized that you'd been somewhat lonely, Lombardy.

9.Content: Lonely? I'm not lonely! I'm just grateful you took some precious time out of your no doubt very busy schedule to visit me after decades so I can help you get some Soul Snatchers. I should be honored.

10.Content: ... Come now, Lombardy. Now is not a time for unkind words. You'll offend my dear guest.

11.Content: Greetings Mr Lombardy! I'm Rosaline.

12.Content: (He eyes Rosaline) Hmph!

13.Content: OK. If you won't help us, then my dear Rosaline we must get going. We shall visit Freid instead.

14.Content: Hey! Your attitude to friendship disgusts me! Go on, get out of here! Obviously I may as well not exist to you! Go and never come back!

0.Content: Hey! Are they biting today, Freid?

1.Content: Ahh! Little Mirael, if my eyes do not deceive me. How you've grown in the last dozen years. You were just yay high, like a little fishing rod, when you last left. Now look at you and look at me!

2.Content: Your eyesight must be so bad, Freid, I'm not sure even glasses would help. Everyone knows Graveborn don't age! By the way, this is Rosaline.

3.Content: Greetings Mr Freid, I'm Rosaline.

4.Content: From the sound of her voice I can tell she's a good child. Wait, let me catch you something special!

5.Content: Mr Freid, what are you doing fishing? You don't need to eat.

6.Content: (His eyes glimmer) What does fishing have to do with being a Graveborn? It's simply a hobby—one I've continued even after death.

7.Content: ... Think you could catch a Blue-spine Cod?

8.Content: You always knew how to stump me. Blue-spine Cod is a fairly rare deep sea fish, but there's more to it—I have to put up with so many ne'er-do-wells making trouble around my den these days, I don't get much fishing in.

9.Content: But I think you did just agree to catch Rosaline a large fish, no? We'll only take Blue-spine Cod.

10.Content: Alright then! I'll catch a Blue-spine Cod for you, but in return I'd like you to help clear out those loiterers off my bay. They sometimes steal my fish too. And the fish won't bite with them nearby.

11.Content: It's a deal, Freid.

0.Content: I recognize the gear. What are humans doing this far out?

1.Content: You mean, humans other than us?

2.Content: Yes. As far as I know, humans out here are practically unheard of.

0.Content: Come on, little fishy—how about a contest of strength for your ol' pal Freid!

1.Content: Shh! I think Freid's got something. He's wrestling with the fish on the line now.

2.Content: You want to play, dear fishy? Then let's play! Heh. Tired? Tired is good.

3.Content: Now up with you!

4.Content: Haha, I've got a fish! That's one of the benefits of being a Graveborn—endless endurance.

5.Content: Wonderful! You've caught a Blue-spine Cod. Thank you, Mr Freid!

6.Content: We're lucky to know you, Freid—you can catch any fish in the ocean. Unlike Lombardy, who had nothing but curses for us when we asked for help.

7.Content: Huh!

8.Content: Lombardy? What are you doing here?

9.Content: Who, me? Walking. Should I not be out walking?

10.Content: I mean, where are you going? Why would you want to walk past here?

11.Content: I'm simply getting my hands on some Soul Snatchers. But I'm not sure if these two bags will be enough to hold them all.

12.Content: Do you think you could share where we might find some Soul Snatchers, Mr Lombardy? Perhaps you could take us there?

13.Content: I'm not sure... I do have a rotten temper after all, don't I? I doubt you could stand a journey with me.

14.Content: You... You may be a Graveborn, but I know for a fact you have a kind heart under that acerbic wit.

15.Content: And also I think that the only reason Mirael hasn't returned in so many years is just because of how hard she's been studying at the academy! She's sacrificed a lot to become a hunter, and protect humanity from the thread of Hypogeans and the bad Graveborn. It's not like she was avoiding you!

16.Content: For a dozen years?

17.Content: Lombardy has come by here from time to time, always muttering about how Mirael hasn't visited him yet.

18.Content: You keep your mouth shut!

19.Content: Well, I'm sure that Mirael has made her intentions clear that—from now on—she'll take many more opportunities to visit you!

20.Content: All right... Change of topic. My Soul Snatchers are withering on the vine! So... are you coming or not?

0.Content: Halt, crafty outsiders! Your evil plans have come undone!

1.Content: Guardians, surround them!

2.Content: Huh? Why are we being ambushed? We're not even at the Island of the Banished!

3.Content: We're hot on the tail of some Soul Snatcher smugglers, and you're the only humans in sight! Arrest them.

0.Content: Archers, fire!

1.Content: (Lombardy shields arrows intended for Mirael with his body!) Watch out, Mirael! Take cover!

2.Content: Lombardy!

3.Content: Mr Lombardy!

4.Content: Cease fire! Surround them.

5.Content: Outsiders, I charge you with the grievous crime of coming to the Island of the Banished in search of Soul Snatchers.

6.Content: What?! We just arrived in Hermit Isle, and were about to be on our way after getting a few local ingredients. I see no reason for any hostilities!

7.Content: Exactly! Our good friends Lombardy and Freid will vouch for us.

8.Content: Break it down for me, Lombardy.

9.Content: It's my fault. I was so curious about what Mirael was doing in the human world, I contacted a group of human smugglers. I may have, uh, inadvertently let them in on a possible Soul Snatcher trade around Hermit Isle and the Island of the Banished.

10.Content: I see. And I've been sent to investigate a group of human smugglers violating the sanctity of the Island of the Banished.

11.Content: Lombardy, you really can be a fool at times!

12.Content: (She pulls out an arrow from Lombardy) And now you've learnt your lesson...

13.Content: I'm glad somebody's cleared up this misunderstanding—please go about your business. Know that even if you count Lombardy and Freid as friends, don't think this allows you to interfere in Graveborn business. Help yourselves to Soul Snatchers except for the Island of the Banished!

14.Content: We thank you, Guardian!

0.Content: Our quest is finished, it seems. Get a look at this thing, would you? It just radiates a kind of creepy alertness. Or is it vampiric desire...

1.Content: Nobles are the only sort who'll go for that kind of thing. They've had their fill of the more sensible, mundane stuff, and nothing left to try but the craziest foods imaginable.

2.Content: Dear Earl, we present the Ocean's Zest Galore!

3.Content: Intriguing! And also the first time I'd ever tasted this infamous dish. The strange coldness in the fish bones and the odd succulence of the meat create an uneasy feeling—one wonders whether the dish or the patron is the real "victor" of the eating...

4.Content: It's a good thing all I need to do is just heat it.

5.Content: My dear Miss Rosaline, my estimation of your abilities grows with each passing hour! I wonder whether you can accomplish the next dish with such outstanding results.

6.Content: There's been a certain martial spirit in the air of Oakenfell in recent days, especially amongst the aristocratic youth. Perhaps we should look to a dish that can satisfy the tastebuds of our budding future generals—and advertise this establishment to the farthest hinterlands of the empire.

7.Content: So for the next dish may I request a Mauler specialty? Chieftain's Stew!

8.Content: Finally a chance to exercise my carnivorous tendencies, heh. What say you, Miss Rosaline?

9.Content: I'll, uh, do my best!

0.Content: Our destination this time will also be in the Mauler's Enclave—the other end of it, that is.

1.Content: And what we're looking for on this trip is [Short-tail Veal], [Steelthorn Hens] and [Chieftain's Bok-choy].

2.Content: Tidus was saying this particular stew is a rather haphazard concoction stewed by Mauler hunters in their free time with whatever stray pieces of meat they happen to throw into the pot. Ratios are always a bit uncertain with these things. Finding the right combination of ingredients and spices can take several attempts. That's what makes it hard...

3.Content: Yikes (cough)! Where did this sudden storm come from?

4.Content: Look at the horizon, Mirael! A massive sandstorm is closing in!

5.Content: Oh dear. We'll have to take refuge in the village!

0.Content: This is ridiculous. We are at the mercy of a particularly useless aristocrat who delights in torturing us with complex dishes. And what right does this place have to generate such an overbearing storm?!

1.Content: I take it you used to help the previous head chef search for ingredients, Mirael?

2.Content: I sure did—for a very memorable but short time. I must say, these excursions have really left me thinking Hathor is not what it once was.

3.Content: Good thing we made it to the village in time! So what's the next step? How do we get our ingredients?

4.Content: There should be a Mauler marketplace somewhere here with what we need. Of course, the market's not going to be open in a raging sandstorm. I wouldn't mind asking someone what the story is with that storm...

5.Content: Hey, excuse me, warrior? I must say, that mane of yours is particularly impressive. Do you mind if I ask you something?

6.Content: Hmph. Ye have a pleasing tongue about ya, outsider. Let me guess: about the sandstorm?

7.Content: You got it. I don't understand... isn't it extraordinary?

8.Content: This desert used to be relatively peaceful, but sandstorms have been raging more frequently of late.

9.Content: Is there any way, do you think, of stopping these terrible storms?

10.Content: Stopping 'em?! Oh, I wish! Every sandstorm leaves us even fewer turkeys and cows—even the ones well-fenced in! Some people've been talking about Hypogeans hiding in the storms! But if we can't do anything about it, I sure as heck bet two little maids like you ain't got a chance!

11.Content: ...But we are more than we appear, dear Mauler. What we lack in your physical strength department, we more than make up for in the magical arts.

12.Content: Means ya can do witchcraft like the elder priests? Well, now that may come in handy. Ya get a chance to see that large Stone Tablet Beacon on your way here?

13.Content: If you really have the skills you're saying, I suggest you check out that Beacon! Just a few months ago I saw someone do something to turn it on. And then? The whole sandstorm disappeared into thin air!

14.Content: I see. Thank you for that, "Mr Mane".

15.Content: Whatya taking 'bout?

0.Content: Look, Mirael. There's a little calf.

1.Content: What a find! Steak for this evening?

2.Content: Rosaline, I think it would be a shame if we didn't get our knives out right now and start carving up this beautiful piece of meat.

3.Content: Huh? Mirael, you want to "prep" the calf right here and now?

4.Content: Of course not. Just kidding! We'll sell it at the marketplace for something already cut.

5.Content: Well, that sounds a lot more pleasant!

0.Content: And here I was thinking I was the only traveler on these strange paths. What a joy to meet two fair ladies such as yourselves—with whom to appreciate this beautiful and wild scenery.

1.Content: First of all, anyone who mistakes me for a "fair lady" is going to end up much the worse for it! But I have a question for you, fellow traveler: why cover yourself head-to-toe? Don't want to be recognized, huh?

2.Content: I do apologize for that, madam. The thing is, I have a certain... condition. It makes it rather difficult to reveal my facial features. In fact, I was hoping to find a certain miraculous desert creature that might help me.

3.Content: For healing?

4.Content: "For healing"? You could say that. Or perhaps just an improvement. I'm in the midst of an experiment, actually. I need to find a desert creature with miraculous vitality.

5.Content: I heard simple "bok-choy" once grown successfully at Chieftain's Peak takes on new miraculous qualities—that it can survive boiling water longer than any other plant.

6.Content: You're talking about [Chieftain's Bok-choy], aren't you?

7.Content: The very same, dear maidservant. And also another miraculous species of bird, the "Steelthorn Hen". I need only obtain for a chance to prove my hypothesis!

8.Content: How do you feel about trading some of your [Chieftain's Bok-choy] if we could bring you [Steelthorn Hens]?

9.Content: The trade is for sure! If you could gather [Steelthorn Hens], I would not only do that, you can be the guests of honor at my greatest experiment!

10.Content: Sounds like a deal!

0.Content: We defeated some poachers, plundering [Steelthorn Hens] from them.

1.Content: Wonderful news! Now at last I can continue my testing. Please wait a moment.

2.Content: Fellow traveler, you don't mean to say that you're currently... cooking?

3.Content: Cooking? Ah, I see why you would think that. There is some similarity between cooking and experimenting, yes. Dissolution, amalgamation, heating, evaporation—all exquisite processes of fire and water upon reagents to achieve a result.

4.Content: It is finished! A thick, enchanting gel containing the hardened essence of indomitable life forces.

5.Content: That is more of a condensed soup to me. And that smell... Well, I don't know, my friend. You might benefit from a recipe book. Speaking of a recipe...

6.Content: Mr. Traveler, do you think this recipe will guide you to an accurate replication of a [Chieftain's Stew]?

7.Content: Let me have a look. Interesting. It's rather exact—requiring specified meat quality, cooking time, and portion of various herbs and spices. It shouldn't be too difficult, for me. I am now starting to wonder what this dish will turn out to be.

8.Content: Sounds great! Why don't you try cooking it in our kitchen?

0.Content: This is exactly the kind of smell I was looking for.

1.Content: [Chieftain's Stew], dear Earl. Bon appetit!

2.Content: I must say it's immaculately presented, not only in the subtle richness of its exotic origins, for which I cannot fault it versus its antecedents, but also in the exactness of the meat cuts used. The only issue is the dish as a whole lacks a certain kind of passion. Passion, yes—the emotion is not enough.

3.Content: The very definition of grasping at straws...

4.Content: I would hate for you to misunderstand my earnest criticisms, Miss Mirael. But no. Many patrons, such as myself, have developed a sixth sense for detecting the enthusiasm of a chef. Which happily makes me think you may be more at home with elegant Lightbearer cuisine than rustic Mauler fare.

5.Content: So for my next dish I would very much like to sample the [Dusksnow Coolerr], if you please—a once highly popular item in Lightbearer circles with its attractive dreamy colors.

0.Content: Not every trip has to go beyond Lightbearer territory... This time the portal will take us to the grand marketplace in Sankast City. It's a rather impressive market, with all sorts of goods for sale, both fair and foul. Everything in the Empire is available here if you have the money to pay for it.

1.Content: So why do we need to get there in a portal?

2.Content: Because it's fast.

3.Content: ...Makes sense, Mirael. So the ingredients we'll need on this occasion are [Lanternberry Jam] and [Oval Citrus].

4.Content: I remember shops in Sankast that used to traffic in rare fruits. Are they still there? Oh dear, no. There's not even one!

5.Content: Is it a seasonal thing, maybe?

6.Content: I shouldn't think so! [Oval Citrus] can only be grown with magic. It's rather rare, but not seasonal. I might have to go to the local marketplace tavern to ask what happened.

0.Content: Seems like a popular watering hole.

1.Content: You really have to jostle your way in if you want to eavesdrop on the latest market gossip. We should check out the current [Lanternberry Jam] and [Oval Citrus] prices on the board.

2.Content: No prices?

3.Content: That is passing strange! A very odd misfortune.

4.Content: Excuse me, ladies? I take it you haven't found the "fresh produce" you were after?

5.Content: "Fresh produce"?

6.Content: And how does one get one's hands on such "fresh produce" in these parts?

7.Content: The marketplace is clean sold out of major goods lately thanks to some mysterious traders. Always dealing in the dark. If you're happy enough to eavesdrop, I can point you in the right direction. Maybe you can arrange to take your share...

8.Content: Then I'm happy enough to have a few glasses of ale tonight! (She pays)

9.Content: (Receives money) Heh! Whatever floats yer boat, lass. More than merrier! There are times I've seen a few of those traders dealin' in the grasslands behind the port.

10.Content: Thank you.

0.Content: Mirael, what are you doing?

1.Content: Don't just stand there, get in!

2.Content: Mirael? It's not proper to eavesdrop on other people!

3.Content: Don't be silly! We are not eavesdropping! We're just cooling ourselves by this grassy knoll. If somebody happens to discuss something important nearby, well we can't turn our ears off!

4.Content: But...

5.Content: They're here! Quiet!

6.Content: Have the goods arrived yet?

7.Content: Yeah. We got 'em.

8.Content: Very good. It's like taking candy from a baby, heh.

9.Content: What on earth are they talking about?

10.Content: Hey! You two! You look like you're up to no good! Let's see your papers. I want to question you!

0.Content: Crap! That tavern owner! He's played us. It's the only possible explanation. I'm going to give him the right piece of my mind after!
Greetings, bounty hunter. Stand down, please.

1.Content: Who are you and what gives you the right to stand in my way? You'd better know who you're messing with.

2.Content: Just a moment if you please? I saw everything. Actually I'm one of the city guards here in Sankast, part of a team investigating corruption in the marketplace.

3.Content: I've been staking the tavern for quite a while. I've seen many travelers going the same way you did after a chat with the owner, many of whom ended up in jail. And a lot of them disappeared a few days later.

4.Content: We were originally going to intervene on your behalf, but it looks like you two don't need help! Unfortunately, your escape has destabilized our operation. That's why I'm here—please help us arrest all the members of this criminal enterprise!

5.Content: I see! Mirael, I think we can afford to co-operate with this gentleman and his taskforce. Don't you?

6.Content: Gah. Terrible plan—terrible because it inconveniences us for others' misdeeds. But, as you can see, Rosaline is not against it. So I suppose I can go along with it too. But I want you to let me deal with the ringleader!

7.Content: Oh... Can I please ask you to not be too extreme? It is, uh, proper to hold a trial in these parts...

0.Content: So? Where's your boss?

1.Content: Hah! Get lost, dog of a Lightbearer!

2.Content: Mirael! They're holding an enormous number of [Oval Citrus] here!

3.Content: Great! We'll take it all.

4.Content: W-what are you doing?!

5.Content: What are you doing hoarding all these citrus? Big citrus fans, are you? Well, either you eat them all in front of us now or I'm going to suspect you of foul play and punish you accordingly. Eat! (She forces Whispers to eat all the fruits)

6.Content: How am I supposed to eat all this? They're... enormous (sobbing).

7.Content: Not for personal consumption, I take it? Look how much he's enjoying these citrus, Rosaline.

8.Content: And there's a huge pile left...

9.Content: Stop! I can't do it anymore! Alright, you'll find our boss near the marketplace tavern.

10.Content: Great! Rosaline? We'll leave with the rest of the [Oval Citrus]. They've already eaten enough of them for the whole town. Next, just do as I say.

0.Content: (She dispenses citrus) Ladies and gentlemen, may I present to you the latest, freshest [Oval Citrus] in all of Sankast! Best of all? They're free!

1.Content: What?! Aren't they really expensive? For free?!

2.Content: They've been out of stock the whole week! And now suddenly they're giving 'em away? I'll take it!

3.Content: Get a hold of yourself, ladies! They can't be real! She must have done something to 'em!

4.Content: Hey you! Surprise! You tried to orchestrate jail for us, but we orchestrated free [Oval Citrus] for everybody! Aren't you rather moved by our kindness?

5.Content: (The owner slowly comes to grips with reality) Oh, yes, uh, that was a terrible misunderstanding, Miss bounty hunter. I had no idea that...

6.Content: Choose your next words carefully as they will decide the fate of your tavern.

7.Content: I... l'll tell you who instigated this whole thing, if you just agree not to do anything rash!

0.Content: I suppose your presence here means our very lucrative trade is now at an end. Here to fight? Then I suggest you start.

1.Content: Heh! What a way to make my dreams come true. Take this!

0.Content: She's not bad, this criminal. Rosaline? Get your "tea friends" to block her movements!

1.Content: I'm trying, Mirael!

2.Content: Most of the brothers should have made it to the ship by now. Rustport's not to be trifled with. Can't believe I ran into you mages here. Take this [Lanternberry Jam] as a going-away present! (She throws it out)

3.Content: Ahh! The valuable jam! Catch it for me, Mister Plate!

4.Content: Darn. She still got away in the end.

5.Content: You really kicked up the hornet's nest. You did drive away a gang of dangerous criminals, but I'm afraid someone here is going to have to pay for all this property damage. So, please, come with me.

6.Content: Oh no... Just to be clear, it's not financial compensation I'm afraid of, it's wasting my time with their bureaucratic system. Just take this gold and be done with it. (Throws out some gold coins)

7.Content: Rosaline? Let's get out of here right now!

0.Content: That was a very roundabout way of getting some relatively simple ingredients. Surprisingly, even a Lightbearer city can be just as unfriendly as anywhere else.

1.Content: Earl? Your Dusksnow Cooler. Enjoy.

2.Content: Rather than enjoying the fruits of your labor myself, and this mesmerizing dish, why don't you two hard-working ladies take a well-earned reprieve?

3.Content: I might just say yes. These last few days have been... crazy. I think we deserve a toast or two.

4.Content: Fragrant!

5.Content: Don't spend too long sucking on the ice. It'll turn your tongue blue.

6.Content: AH!

7.Content: Hehe, got you!

8.Content: Very good. I'd say this restaurant has accumulated enough unique delicacies to justify the Lady of the City's visit. But we're going to need to offer simpler, cheaper fare to appeal to the masses. And, of course, without a reduction in quality.

9.Content: For my next dish, I'd like to try the Forest Salad. As famously reported, a Forest Salad should reflect the hazy jungle-like impressions of a traveler in that mysterious forest upon the banqueting table.

0.Content: Where's our portal destination this time, Mirael?

1.Content: Look, a Forest Salad will require Golden Apples, Twins Persimmons and Succulent Dewdrops.

2.Content: ...All specialties of the Dark Forest. The good news is we don't have to venture deep into Wilder territory. Lightbearer farmers also cultivate these crops on the border.

3.Content: We just had a major run-in with law enforcement in a fairly sizeable market! I'm not sure how well it's going to go for us at the next farmer's fair...

4.Content: Hopefully, the Lady doesn't ever hear any, uh, disturbing allegations about those events.

5.Content: Look! An orchard.

6.Content: ...And yet nothing planted in it, it seems.

0.Content: Since we're passing by... Excuse me, farmer sir? Are you the master of this orchard? What's wrong?

1.Content: Nothing you'd wanna hear! I've just been all over town searching for Golden Apples. Couldn't find 'em or seeds... and it's gonna ruin my planting for the next season! I'd give a fortune in Succulent Dewdrops if someone could give me some.

2.Content: I thought this town specialized in Golden Apples?

3.Content: 'Tis true we are near the Dark Forest, so the soil is good for it. That's why I moved here—to plant Golden Apples myself.

4.Content: Let's ask around town then.

0.Content: Excuse me, shopkeeper? Do you have any Golden Apples for sale?

1.Content: Golden Apples, huh? Interesting. You should know a bit of a high-flyer just came through town. He bought up all of our Golden Apples and seeds—for a very good price!

2.Content: But doesn't that mean local farmers won't have any seeds for the next season's crop?

3.Content: 'Tis true, but honestly, with the money he was offering? I'd pick retirement over some poor farmers any day.

4.Content: I see that money holds some sway with you. So is this crazy fan of Golden Apples still in town? Where is he?

5.Content: Headed northside is all I know—by the way of that broken bridge. Darned bridge recently broke as well...

6.Content: So how do we go over to the north side of the village?

7.Content: We happen to be selling some very sturdy timber here, if you're interested? And at a good price...

8.Content: I see you have a real knack for this, shopkeeper.

0.Content: I say! I was wondering who this fiendish merchant could be! Never expected to run into the great Rowan!

1.Content: Mirael? Rosaline? What are you doing here?!

2.Content: Good day, Rowan. We're looking to buy some Golden Apples. Care to share?

3.Content: Do I get a choice?! I'm on to the trade of the century here. Although I admit it's a bit tiring lugging them everywhere... And as soon as I close my eyes to rest, a few more Golden Apples always mysteriously disappear!

4.Content: Your apples "disappear"?

5.Content: Exactly! Someone's stealing 'em. Maybe someone's tracking me... I've been finding apple cores all over the place, pointing in the direction of the river. I was just going over for a look.

6.Content: We can go with you.

0.Content: They're not content with just stealing from me, they have to ambush us too! Curse them!

1.Content: Only one person could've known Rowan has a huge stash of Golden Apples and where he was going—that shopkeeper.

2.Content: I'm gonna have to go back to that darned greedy guts and ask him a few hard questions.

0.Content: It's just what you said! The fellow packed up and got out while the getting was good! No wonder he had that greedy look in his eyes when he sold me all those expensive apples! Even that wasn't enough—he had to steal 'em back!

1.Content: It hasn't been long. They can't have gone far. Let's look around for clues.

2.Content: Smell anything, Mr Teapot?

3.Content: The back of the woods?

4.Content: Everyone, come and have a look!

5.Content: The clearing behind this thicket leads directly into a small village. Looks like some bandits got to it, then cut down some trees to cover their tracks by making it look like the road naturally ends here.

6.Content: There's nothing worse than a merchant without principles! Let's chase after 'em!

0.Content: It's terrible. These farmers have been working hard all year only to see their precious houses and barns plundered by bandits and then burned to the ground.

1.Content: But it doesn't look like a traditional burn. It's more like... the kind of damage you get from a fire spell.

0.Content: Disgusting animals! How many innocent hamlets and villages have they destroyed?

1.Content: Don't go pointing fingers without evidence! These villages were destroyed before we got here. Must've been some big battle. We just had a look-through for valuables after!

2.Content: Idiots! Should've sailed by to pick us up already! How'd you manage to beach yourselves? If we'd pulled this operation off, all of us could've been retired and living out our days carefree and happy!

3.Content: Now return all of my Golden Apples!

4.Content: Hah! Your precious Golden Apples are right here. You are interested in getting out of our trade at a decent price, huh? I'll safeguard 'em! Just let us off this one time and you can have half of all the other loot we've got so far!

5.Content: We are not "traders" to be bargained with. I'm going to notify the guards to take them in.

0.Content: Thank goodness I got all of my apples back. By the way, did the Lady send you all the way out here from Oakenfell just to get a few Golden Apples?

1.Content: Not quite. It's one of the key ingredients in the Forest Salad. We're just trying to help her restaurant—the Chaz Hathor—reopen.

2.Content: What? The Chaz Hathor, the wonder of Oakenfell, closed down? And you're going to reopen it?

3.Content: Yep. And the Lady of the City has decided to hold a big banquet there.

4.Content: I'll be... those thugs never had a chance! You know, I happen to be something of an aficionado of the Forest Salad myself, and I also was thinking of dropping by Oakenfell as well. Maybe I'll pay the Chaz Hathor a visit.

5.Content: Can you make a decent Forest Salad yourself?

6.Content: As a travelling merchant who often sleeps on the open road many a night, I need simple, healthy meals packed full of nutrients. The Forest Salad's Golden Apples, Twins Persimmons, and Succulent Dewdrops are some of my best sellers. Yes, I'm very familiar with it.

0.Content: Great! Then we'll take some of these Golden Apples and exchange them with that farmer for Succulent Dewdrops.
Earl? A Forest Salad for your degustation.

1.Content: ...Generously garnished with an additional secret Wilder sauce courtesy of our mysterious sous-chef.

2.Content: A truly delicious flavor! Ahh... I do believe if the average citizen had the chance to sample such a delightful salad on an afternoon break, it might just melt all their cares and worries away...

3.Content: It's enough to make a man wonder, Rosaline, Mirael: I've been deeply moved by your efforts and outstanding skill. I've become more convinced than ever that the Chaz Hathor has everything it needs to succeed again in your capable hands.

4.Content: And I'm sure with Rosaline present, there will be no issues with that whatsoever.

5.Content: Wonderful! So the Lady's banquet should be a smooth one.

6.Content: And thank you for your generous hospitality these last few days. But I have one more very special beverage I'd like to gift the Lady at the banquet: Polar Sweet Spring.

7.Content: Polar Sweet Spring? I've only ever heard about it... some people say it's the very nectar of the very gods themselves.

8.Content: So it might well be. It's a very difficult beverage to procure, no question—and also the end goal of many food critics' tireless quests. How do you feel about turning your Lady's banquet into one for the history books, dear Rosaline?

9.Content: If the question is what I would be willing to do for milady...

10.Content: Splendid! I shall look forward to the stellar event with bated breath.

0.Content: According to Earl's recipe, we'll need to go all the way to the Polar Peaks to get our hands on Rock Orchid and Polar Snowmelt. It'll be rather difficult, and I don't know if we ought to go through with it.

1.Content: It's OK! I'm happy to do a bit more for milady. It shouldn't be too hard. She's been very good to me all these years. I'm alright with it if it can add a little special something to her celebration.

0.Content: Rosaline, we have no shortage of polar pioneers to tell us that we need to tread carefully.

1.Content: Don't worry! Mr Teapot said everyone is really supportive of me, and it's also for the sake of milady, so...

0.Content: What's the meaning of this engraving? What kind of "trade" are they talking about?

1.Content: We've got our hands on Rock Orchid, Mirael! Just one more ingredient to go! We can't give up now.

0.Content: Is the engraving referring to this bottle of Polar Snowmelt helping us? On the question of whether it is worth risking life and limb: definitely not.

1.Content: Thank you, Mr Adventurer.

0.Content: What a pleasant surprise! Rosaline, Mirael! I've sent countless explorers out to retrieve "it", but you seem uniquely gifted for success... and have helped me realize a lifelong wish.

1.Content: Did you know that we went to the Polar Peaks?

2.Content: Oh, I'm sorry. I make it a habit to be well aware of the features of any properties mortgaged to my estate, and so was already acquainted with your little "garden portal". And now the final celebration has arrived!

3.Content: So what were you really after? A cup of Polar Sweet Spring? Really?

0.Content: Hear that? It's awfully quiet all of a sudden. Something happen in the garden?

1.Content: Is that a Devouring Hypogean? It must have come here through the portal!

2.Content: We've got to stop it before it destroys milady's banquet! Stop it now!

0.Content: You defeated a Devouring Hypogean?! impossible! They're the biggest and meanest of them all!

1.Content: Did you see the burn injuries on its body before the battle? It must have already been injured from some other fight before it came to us.

2.Content: Then I suppose milady's banquet can proceed as if nothing happened...

3.Content: My goodness. What a terrible oversight! Most unpleasant! To think a Hypogean could have portalled into Oakenfell?!

4.Content: Thank goodness for Rosaline and her trustee cutlery helpers. She was truly fearless going into battle against that beast.

5.Content: I can barely fathom the power unleashed by such a young maid-servant in defense of her Lady's honor. It has given me much food for thought.

6.Content: And now the Chaz Hathor can finally reopen its doors to the public!

7.Content: Yes! You've not only eliminated a dangerous Hypogean, but also brought countless delicacies to a banquet in milady's honor. I believe the entire city has much to thank you two for.

8.Content: Truly, truly. Congratulations!

0.Content: Mirael, we're about to fall into the quicksand!
Looks like we'll have to defeat the enemies inside to escape from the quicksand.

1.Content: The quicksand disappeared as soon as we defeated the enemies.

0.Content: Yikes! Did they just shut the door we just entered?!
Wait! I haven't gotten any Bell Whistles. I can't leave Dreamwood now.
Hey, friend! We found some Golden Apples.

1.Content: Thank you! And here are the Succulent Dewdrops as promised. Please, take them!

0.Content: While Seirus and Gorvo are patrolling the seas as usual, they discover that Slumber Seals have congregated and are attacking the fisherfolk at the bay.

1.Content: Seirus felt something must have been amiss and wanted to investigate, as Slumber Seals are normally gentle and human-friendly creatures. They are even regarded as mascots by fishing villagers.

2.Content: When they arrived at the scene, they realized that the Slumber Seals were actually attacking a group of overfishers whom they had once fought off.

0.Content: Apparently, these evil poachers had gone so overboard that even these docile beasts had enough of them.

1.Content: I would be angry when if encountered those who plunder endlessly from the ocean, let alone these beasts who love the ocean.

2.Content: Look at those greedy scumbags. They are still trying to fight back. Shouldn't we go help the little creatures?

3.Content: Absolutely!

0.Content: They are still using cheap tactics like before. What a bunch of losers.

1.Content: We've got to teach them a lesson they won't forget.

0.Content: Done! These losers are just a waste of my nap time. Where are the little seals? I was shocked to see them sleep through the battle.

1.Content: Just look at them. I'm sure they've fallen asleep again. I guess they're probably the only creatures that sleep as well as you do?

2.Content: Ha, sleep is important for our health. Sweet dreams, my slumbering beasts.

0.Content: Phew. Well, it's night-time now. I'd better be going!
I'm not getting through the front gate with all those guards. Nope. Wouldn't want dad to find out...

1.Content: What will he think if he does? Will he be angry? Gah. I don't care. I'm not going back like this!

0.Content: Hey innkeeper? Innkeeper?!

1.Content: It's midnight, who in the blazes... Oh! Your Ladyship, Princess Peggy?!

2.Content: Shh! Don't say my name! I'm getting out of this city so... here's my money! Just like before!

3.Content: Your Ladyship, I... uh, I'm not sure how safe it is for you outside the royal castle. I, uh, don't want to...

4.Content: I get it! But there's no way I'm walking through the main gate. Listen, how much gold? Is this enough to get me out of here?

5.Content: Milady, the thing is, things are a little different today. Your father has strictly forbidden entry to the forest, and if—in the unlikely event something were to happen to you...

6.Content: Listen, I'm not some little girl who doesn't know how to handle herself, OK?! And right now I need to get out of here! That's an order!

7.Content: Uh, y-yes, your Ladyship!

8.Content: Hah! Time for a new adventure!

0.Content: Ah... hot, hot, hot! How'd it started? Huh.

1.Content: I may need to find some other way out... Just my luck!

0.Content: Yikes!
I've never seen magic like that!

1.Content: That was a close one! Are you alright, young lady?

2.Content: My goodness, what beautiful silver hair and purple eyes you have! I-I'm alright! Thanks for saving me.

3.Content: Don't mention it.

4.Content: You can credit me for Lia's surpassing beauty, for she is my daughter.

5.Content: My goodness, a talking cat! Just like Raku!

6.Content: Oh? You know another talking cat? A new rival has entered the arena, it seems...

7.Content: So... do you live close?

8.Content: The name's Peggy, and I'm from Ranhorn! As for what I'm doing here, uh hey—are you not from around here?

9.Content: My name is Emilia, I'm a spiritual arts user. This is Puck, a spirit.

10.Content: Pleased to make your acquaintance. We're from the Kingdom of Lugunica. Heard of it?

11.Content: Lugu-what? I'm afraid not...

12.Content: What about Arlam Village? Rem and I lived in a forest near Arlam for many years. Suddenly, a magical black mist appeared strangely, and we followed it all the way here.

13.Content: It's been a confusing road. But somehow it looks like Rem and I have wandered down different paths...

14.Content: I can safely say I'm not familiar with any of those names.

15.Content: And that is why our present quest is to find Rem and return from whence we came. But we lost the way. Just now we were investigating a strange Black Mist and ran into Mabeasts.

16.Content: I suspect the Mabeasts have something to do with the Black Mist. They often appear together.

17.Content: What do you know of these things, Peggy?

18.Content: The Black Mist? Sounds ominous, but I've never so much as seen it before. Maybe Graveborn causing trouble?

19.Content: Maybe you can know more at the royal castle... But I'd rather not go back there if at all possible!

20.Content: Thank you, I sincerely hope you know your way around these woods, Peggy. You wouldn't be lost too, would you?

21.Content: Lost? Never! I mean, no—I'm here on an adventure! I can't go back anyway. I don't know what my father, the king, would do to me...

22.Content: Though I'm terrified that you're lost in this very forest right now. But it's alright. We won't try to persuade you to go back.

23.Content: I told you, I'm not lost!

24.Content: Then perhaps we should continue our investigations into the Black Mist. It's our only real clue so far.

25.Content: Yes. And also we need to find Rem!

26.Content: You're going? Mind if I tag along? I'm very familiar with this neck of the woods! I could help you in return for saving me. Plus, I'm very curious about this Black Mist!

27.Content: Really? Well, then we must thank you, Peggy.

28.Content: Wonderful! I feel just like a fantastical woodland adventure!

0.Content: I fear the Black Mist is ultimately coming from somewhere deep within the forest. We should try to locate its source.

1.Content: You know, these forests really are quite big, huh? So which direction do you think?

2.Content: Ahhh! The Princess! Help us! Something's attacking our home!

3.Content: Hey, who is that calling out for me?

4.Content: The royal castle has heard our cries at last? Someone's here finally! Huh? The Princess... where's the army?

5.Content: Sorry. On this occasion, there's, uh, just me...

6.Content: What do you mean? Where are the troops? How are you going to save us from the Mabeasts?

7.Content: So what's going on? Something terrible, from the looks of it.

8.Content: The village has been surrounded by Mabeasts! Many people have been injured. So much village property was destroyed... We fear for our lives!

9.Content: We've had a run-in with these Mabeasts—just now in the woods. I get the sentiment. It seems very dangerous around here?

10.Content: Not really! We usually never get problems like this in our kingdom...

11.Content: There are rampaging Mabeasts near my house at this very moment! Ain't safe to return. Could you help me out?

12.Content: I understand what you're asking. We'll deal with them. Don't worry.

13.Content: Thank you, beautiful lady! My home is just over there. Our future is in your hands!

0.Content: These Mabeasts are rather difficult.

1.Content: Thanks, Emilia. You're very powerful! If it wasn't for you, these houses would've been torn to pieces. What are these terrible creatures doing!?

2.Content: Thank you so much! Ah, my home...

3.Content: You poor people. I have some spare gold. Please take it! Use it to rebuild once matters have improved. But we must be going.

4.Content: Thank you, milady! And thank you too, beautiful lass, for defeating those terrifying Mabeasts!

5.Content: It's alright. Just happy to help. Then let's be going, Puck.

6.Content: Fare thee well.

0.Content: Argh! My goodness. It's hurts so bad!

1.Content: Dear me, you're hurt! How?

2.Content: Ran into a pack of wild Mabeasts in the forest just now—had to jump over a fence to avoid getting trampled to death. But I'm afraid I've broken my leg.

3.Content: You poor thing. That sounds horrible. What were you doing in the forest?

4.Content: Today's a good hunting day, and I'd already caught three rabbits! Just my luck to run into a pack of crazy animals! Goodness.

5.Content: I think the Black Mist is most likely responsible for turning the Mabeasts wild. And that does not bode well for these woods.

6.Content: What's this "Black Mist"? No idea what you're talking about. My poor legs! It's gonna cost a fortune to see a doctor in town. My wife's gonna kill me.

7.Content: This might just be my forte. Just bear with me for a second.

8.Content: My leg doesn't hurt anymore... What did you do?

9.Content: Healing magic. I think it should be fine now—you should take care for a while.

10.Content: You're a lifesaver! I get to enjoy a healed leg and rabbit soup tonight, thanks to you, kind lass!

0.Content: The Black Mist really seems to be hanging around here for some reason. I suppose there's a whole bunch of monsters inside then.

1.Content: It's very inauspicious, whatever it is. We must remain on high alert.

2.Content: Our situation could really turn on a dime—especially if we can find ourselves under attack by Black Mist-affected Mabeasts.

3.Content: I think I've been here before! It's my uncle's manor!

0.Content: I've got a very bad feeling about this... Ah!

1.Content: What's this?!

2.Content: You two, watch out!

0.Content: That was really close! Hey, Miss Rosaline!

1.Content: Your Ladyship! What are you doing here? And who is this?

2.Content: My new friends! And who is that you have with you, Miss Rosaline?

3.Content: Rem, thanks for saving me. How are you holding up?

4.Content: Miss Emilia, and the Great Spirit! I see you're safe and well. That's great news.

5.Content: Oh? You know this person?

6.Content: Just who we were looking for, who I told you about—Rem.

7.Content: A pleasure to make your acquaintance. I'm Rem, a servant-girl in the Mathers Estate in the Kingdom of Lugunica.

8.Content: So you're Rem! Wonderful to finally be able to catch up with you!

9.Content: Thank you, your Ladyship. Somehow I parted ways from Miss Emilia as I was tracking down an unwholesome disturbance in the area. I'm sorry.

10.Content: It's okay, Rem. The important thing is that you're here now.

11.Content: Come to think of it, you did see that Black Mist nearby as well?

12.Content: And you saw it too, Miss Emilia?

13.Content: Perhaps we should compare notes.

14.Content: How nice it is to find that we are all friends! And especially gratifying to see Miss Emilia and the Princess together. I'd like to invite you all back to the manor for some rest and repose.

15.Content: Sneaking out of the royal castle again late at night, your Ladyship? You don't think you should head back soon?

16.Content: Please don't be as stern as my father, Miss Rosaline! So did you and Miss Rem end up traveling together?

17.Content: Of course, your Ladyship. This very day I was preparing tonight's meal when I stumbled across Miss Rem in the woods. I was just about to host her.

18.Content: So you haven't known each other very long. That's funny, I got quite the opposite impression!

19.Content: Well, I suppose we're both servant-girls in our respective houses. We must have a lot to talk about!

20.Content: Wonderful to meet like-minded friends, isn't it?

21.Content: It's already late, and probably not a good idea to stay outside for too much longer. I strongly suggest we all head back for a rest and discuss our next steps.

22.Content: I'd like to help myself to a cup of Fruit Tea on a Float!

24.Content: I'd like to help, Miss Rosaline, once we get to the manor.

25.Content: Dinner isn't quite ready yet. Fancy a stroll in the meantime?

0.Content: Those stones completely blocked the canal! What do we do?

1.Content: Hello dear sir! You don't look too happy. What's wrong?

2.Content: Oh, the Princess! I'm sorry for standing in your path. We were just going...

3.Content: Hey! Stop. That's not what I meant!

4.Content: What is it?

5.Content: Oh, it's a bit embarrassing to say but... not long ago some wild beasts came and inexplicably decided to fill the canal with stones! They've basically blocked it. We can't irrigate our crops!

6.Content: We're all in our "golden years" now. Frankly, we can't move these stones.

7.Content: Why don't you just break them apart into smaller stones? Miss Emilia, do you think you could freeze the stones with your magic so that we could more easily smash them?

8.Content: Wait, your Ladyship! You don't think an ice spell might also damage nearby crops? They'll wilt at a low temperature.

9.Content: Think it'd be possible to smash the stones without ice magic?

10.Content: Maybe I can be of assistance?

0.Content: Thank the heavens! You are a wonder, milady!

1.Content: Wow. You are more powerful than you look, Miss Rem!

2.Content: The problem is solved now!

3.Content: Thank you! Our precious crops will now get the water they so desperately need! You've truly saved the day!

4.Content: It's quite alright. We're just concerned travelers trying to help.

5.Content: Something dark has appeared in the forest lately... Please be careful! I have a herbicide that could be of assistance, in case you need it...

0.Content: Peggy!

1.Content: Ah! Dame Gwyneth, what are you doing here?

2.Content: Please don't play dumb, your Ladyship. Everyone is very worried about you!

3.Content: Who is this, your Ladyship?

4.Content: This is Dame Gwyneth, a very impressive knight in my father's service. He must have asked her to take me back...

5.Content: Do you have any idea how utterly brazen you're being, Peggy? There are reports of Mabeasts going crazy from all over the kingdom. If you had come to harm...

6.Content: Alright. I messed up. But it has turned out completely fine—thanks in no small part to Miss Emilia, Puck, Miss Rosaline, and Miss Rem!

7.Content: That is not the issue! Everyone, I'd like to thank you all on behalf of the kingdom for keeping Princess Peggy safe. Sorry for not properly introducing myself. My name is Gwyneth of the Royal Guards.

8.Content: I'm Emilia, and this here is my spirit, Puck.

9.Content: I'm Rem. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Dame Gwyneth.

10.Content: They followed the Black Mist all the way here.

11.Content: Black Mist?! Our soldiers have also reported a Black Mist where the townsfolk have come heavy Mabeast assault...

12.Content: There you are.

13.Content: Evenin' all! I may have something to share on this strange new misty phenomenon...

14.Content: Rosaline has updated me on the latest developments. I am the overseer of this here manor, Oscar.

15.Content: It's hard to say yet where the Black Mist comes from, but just as the royal guard says, it's always sighted near Mabeast attacks. I think it's inciting them to violence!

16.Content: We spent some time looking for clues, in the process stumbling upon a Mabeast attack on a poor village.

17.Content: We're starting to see the same disturbing phenomenon in different areas of the Lightbearer Empire. I'm sure it's causing your father the king no end of trouble.

18.Content: No wonder dad didn't want me to leave...

19.Content: Mr. Oscar, I'd like to ask something: are there any places where this strange Black Mist is showing up more than others?

20.Content: At the moment, I think the Black Mist is strongest in the woods just outside Oakenfell. Does that line up with what you've heard?

21.Content: We have reports of many disturbances from Mabeasts in the woods west of Oakenfell. Scouts have also reported a strange rift deep in the forest. Perhaps it has something to do with it?

22.Content: That's also what I'm seeing—more crazed Mabeast activity nearest the Western Wood. As for this strange rift? I'm almost certain it has something to do with it.

23.Content: The Black Mist and a strange rift... and perhaps a way to return home. To the Western Wood we must go!

24.Content: And methinks if we can deal with the Black Mist, it will also stop these wild Mabeast attacks on innocent townsfolk.

25.Content: I'm pleased to see you have the heart to help, Miss Emilia. We are of the same mind. There's no telling how many innocent townsfolk may be hurt if this Black Mist continues. We must stop it now!

26.Content: Miss Emilia, do you think that's your ticket home? All you have to do to return is just find the rift!

27.Content: Or rather finding the rift may present an alternative pathway before us.

28.Content: I think we're gonna need to deal with this problem at its source.

29.Content: If we are going to investigate the rift ourselves, we should try to rest up as much as we can.

30.Content: Yeah. Let's get some good relaxation in.

31.Content: Take your leave. When all is ready, we shall head forthwith to the Western Wood to resolve the source of this malfeasance!

32.Content: Dinner is served! Please help yourselves, everyone.

0.Content: The darkness seems to be growing in strength! Are you sure the rift is here?

1.Content: What's that strange sound from the forest? Mabeasts?

2.Content: The Black Mist has formed a kind of Spectral Disruption barrier... I fear we are near a nest of Mabeasts.

3.Content: Defeat the Mabeasts and the barrier will likewise vanish.

0.Content: I heard a loud rumbling sound from the forest when the Black Mist barrier came down.

1.Content: Puck, do you think there might be other barriers?

2.Content: Yes. I am picking up a similar aura nearby. Let's have a look!

0.Content: That rumbling from the forest is getting louder! It must be the rift.

1.Content: We've got to deal with this right away before it overpowers us! Follow the Black Mist, and find the rift!

0.Content: What's that noise? It's like something exploded!

1.Content: I sense a very dark aura... over there!

2.Content: It is a great power from the deepness of the earth. There! There's the rift!

3.Content: Finally.

4.Content: I'm ready!

0.Content: Most of them have been badly affected by the rift—the same rift producing the Black Mist!

1.Content: If we can get rid of these Mabeasts, do you think we'll have time to investigate the rift?

2.Content: I'm not sure. The rift looks like it's changing. Careful!

0.Content: All the wretched monsters are vanquished. So why hasn't peace returned to the forest?

1.Content: Look at the other side of the rift...

2.Content: It looks like a doorway to the outside of our mansion!

3.Content: I believe this very rift is a portal back to our Kingdom of Lugunica.

4.Content: Oh... Miss Emilia, Puck, Miss Rem... I suppose you'll be leaving us forever then?

5.Content: Oh. Parting is such sweet sorrow...

6.Content: Ahhh! Save us!

7.Content: What happened?!

0.Content: Townsfolk are sounding the alarm about a horde of Mabeasts heading for Oakenfell!

1.Content: Where's our army? Have they all gone away to investigate the Black Mist?

2.Content: I've sounded the alarm, but I'm afraid Oakenfell is badly under-defended at the moment...

3.Content: We have to get back before those poor townsfolk get slaughtered by Mabeasts!

4.Content: Yes, yes! We must get back at once!

5.Content: Miss Emilia, Mr. Puck, Miss Rem, I'm afraid we must bid farewell. Our kingdom needs saving, not yours. Feel free to return.

6.Content: Hey, I'm here to help as well, Gwyneth! So, ladies, don't worry about a thing.

7.Content: I don't like the prospect of a bunch of injured villagers. Oscar will be here soon. I should think we can help you.

8.Content: Oh, Puck...

9.Content: Where would I be without you, my dear Lia?

10.Content: They don't have enough soldiers! They need our help.

11.Content: But, ladies, this isn't your fight! It's not your home...

12.Content: I'm afraid I have to agree with Miss Emilia. And don't forget we can also use our magic to heal people—not just fight Mabeasts.

13.Content: Miss Emilia, Mr. Puck, and Miss Rem, thank you! Mr. Oscar, just in case, can I ask you to keep a close eye on the rift until we get back?

14.Content: Exactly what I was thinking. Very well. Try to stay safe out there, everyone!

0.Content: That was a close one! We just made it in the nick of time...

1.Content: That's right. Our quick response saved not just Oakenfell but also the surrounding villages from taking much damage.

2.Content: True, but more importantly no one was very badly hurt.

3.Content: I'm fairly sure Miss Emilia and I have healed all of the wounded.

4.Content: I dread to think what might have happened if you hadn't been here today. We owe you a great debt.

0.Content: There you are! Hey everyone.

1.Content: Mr. Oscar, what's wrong? You look... concerned?

2.Content: Well, I'm very sorry to say so, but the rift has closed and disappeared altogether!

3.Content: You mean... there's no way back?

4.Content: From the rift that we just saw? I'd say so.

5.Content: But we've received reports from officers of a similar rift near East Ranhorn!

6.Content: Another rift may be able to take us back home perhaps.

7.Content: Will there be no end of troubles? At least for now the Mabeasts threat seems not ended!

8.Content: And Oakenfell's troops will be all the more ready to deal with the next threat, Dame Gwyneth.

9.Content: Then why don't we go back to the royal castle, Gwyneth? You can come too, Miss Emilia, Miss Rem and Puck!

10.Content: I was also about to extend an invitation. But I'm afraid your return will take some time.

11.Content: You are the saviors of Oakenfell, and as such we are obliged to help you find a way back home.

12.Content: Thank you for saying so, Dame Gwyneth.

13.Content: Leave it to me. I'll get daddy to assign a whole legion to find another rift. You'll be back before you know it!

14.Content: As for you, Peggy, your father was very upset! Have you thought about what you will say to him?

15.Content: Oh... Goodness me, I totally forgot! He's really going to have it out with me, isn't he?

16.Content: Your father has been in a terrible state dealing not only with your disappearance but this terrifying Black Mist! I think you owe him an apology!

17.Content: I'm sorry. Yes, I messed up...

0.Content: Look! This is the puzzle I found. A relic of dwarfs, isn't it?

1.Content: This metal... Still shiny like new after all these years... Indeed the work of dwarfs.

2.Content: But this ray is blocking the way. Do you have a solution?

3.Content: It's a tricky one for you, but we dwarfs understand the design. Over there. Move a launcher on the track to hit the other launcher with the ray and stop it from emitting. Problem solved.

0.Content: We are approaching a sheer cliff.

1.Content: Dwarfs never yield to the environment. This is exactly the kind of place where we would set up a portal.

2.Content: It's hard to imagine that dwarfs could already travel between the foot of the mountain and the summit with ease so long ago.

0.Content: I believe a dwarf village was here many years ago.

1.Content: Terrific. Let's go further. Maybe they left something behind.

0.Content: Thank you for showing me these relics of my ancestors.

1.Content: You are too kind. I should thank you for introducing me to the dwarf life. A great inspiration!

0.Content: You'll find the village invaded by the Hypogeans just through this mountain pass, Cecilia.

1.Content: A word of warning, Lucius. The defense of our land is more important than any individual and, for your sake, I hope you don't get in my way.

2.Content: I'm familiar with the Heresy Inquisition and its methods, Cecilia. I only hope that you will refrain from unnecessary bloodshed.

3.Content: A hope that smacks of weakness, which Hypogeans will be all too happy to exploit. Heresy must be destroyed, root and branch.

4.Content: I sense already the putrefaction in the air declaring Hypogean evil at work here.

5.Content: Yet somehow I also detect another powerful, celestial force in contest against it.

6.Content: Who could conjure that much power? It must be the great Athalia!

7.Content: The "sword of punishment from heaven"? I've heard her described as an angel of death on the battlefield.

8.Content: 'Tis well said. Nary a guilty soul has survived the specter of her blade.

9.Content: We must press on. Perhaps we shall have the honor of witnessing Athalia's sword strike down heresy ourselves.

0.Content: Anyone there?

2.Content: Is anyone in there? We're emissaries from the Temple of Light.

3.Content: Away from me, Hypogean devils! I've had enough of your tricks. Or prove yourself human!

4.Content: By the Light above! (Lucius generates a magical flourish of warming divine light from his hands)

5.Content: Praise the Light Above! It's so wonderful the Temple has sent help!

6.Content: Could you stand guard over the village for a short time, friend? Some townsfolk out and about are in need of saving.

7.Content: The area is teeming with Hypogeans, sir. Stay put. I'll save whoever's in need of saving.

8.Content: What are you talking about, Lucius! We need to find Athalia post haste.

9.Content: As far as I'm concerned, our main priority should be protecting survivors.

0.Content: We've cleansed the Hypogeans on the main road. Follow us, and we'll take you back!

1.Content: Thank you, but just before I saw two injured fellow townsfolk on the road. They need help!

2.Content: Please have some compassion on their wounds! Could you?

3.Content: Take note of these tentacles, Lucius. You will only find them in areas infested with Hypogeans.

4.Content: You mean one of the two "injured townsfolk" is a Hypogean in disguise?

5.Content: All I want to remind you of, Lucius, is your compassion could be made to serve the interests of evil.

0.Content: It must be...

1.Content: The blade of the greater Athalia!

2.Content: What kind of battle must've been fought for even these weapons to break?

3.Content: The broken sword contains a remnant of her celestial power, Cecilia. We may be able to activate it to clear a path.

4.Content: Hardly any of her power remains. I fear I'll only be able to use it once, wherever I point the blade.

5.Content: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of light is eternal life.

0.Content: When did the Hypogeans first appear?

1.Content: They came out of nowhere almost half a month ago. We were quickly surrounded, and the nearby villages also laid to waste.

2.Content: Then the Goddess of Punishment appeared to slaughter all of the Hypogeans about here.

3.Content: But she truly was an Angel of Death in so doing, more fearsome to many folk even than the Hypogean demons.

0.Content: I've heard you seek this avenging goddess? I saw her while fleeing a Hypogean. She was chasing something else, yet destroyed my pursuer with one stroke of her sword!

1.Content: I counsel caution, though. I'm not sure whether she will distinguish you as friend or foe. I was so fearful when she passed by... I could not move a muscle.

2.Content: I heard if she even suspects you're in league with the Hypogeans, she won't hesitate to cut you down!

0.Content: The Goddess of Punishment? Some say she headed north.

1.Content: Then that is where the Hypogeans have gathered. We must also proceed cautiously.

2.Content: I know a mountain cave near where you found me. It will take you to the other side so you need not face that band of Hypogeans.

0.Content: We have much to thank you for, kind heroes. Anything we can do for you in return?

1.Content: Have you seen a celestial warrior wielding dual blades?

2.Content: You speak of Athalia?

3.Content: You've seen her?

4.Content: She collapsed nearby. I helped nurse her back to health from her wounds, for they were many.

5.Content: You weren't afraid she would cut you down as well? That seems to be a common sentiment around here.

6.Content: Of course I was afraid! I witnessed her pile the Hypogeans' bodies 10 feet high. It was a fearful battle, out of the depths of madness.

7.Content: Yet for her efforts she has also been greatly wounded. It's the least I could do considering her sacrifice.

8.Content: You can see her helmet has been torn asunder and blade broken.

10.Content: By the Light...

11.Content: And what happened then?

12.Content: She set out again in search of Hypogeans once able to stand on her own two feet. It was a long recovery.

13.Content: I crafted a new sword for her from my spare materials. It is a good sword, although only of common metals.

14.Content: We thank you on Athalia's behalf for your good deeds.

15.Content: 'Tis no more than what I ought to do as a blacksmith of this town.

16.Content: She certainly has something of an... icy reserve about her, but is by no means the heartless butcher described by some.

17.Content: And... I feel you need not worry for her safety or health.

18.Content: In my experience, what does not kill us often makes us stronger.

0.Content: Caught you, hook line and sinker!

1.Content: Haha! We should keep survivors more often... we have hooked two more humans with the bait of one!

2.Content: Die, Hypogean scum!

0.Content: Hypogean scum indeed.

1.Content: Curses! How'd you see through my disguise?

2.Content: Die, Hypogean scum!

0.Content: This path leads right through the mountains, and is brimming with celestial power.

1.Content: It's a sure sign that Athalia has been here before, and the signs of her power are here.

2.Content: The village ruins are doubly scarred by Hypogean remains and the marks of Athalia's holy blade.

3.Content: I fear Athalia endured a difficult battle here.

4.Content: By the Light above, I also fear we face a much stronger Hypogean foe than expected.

5.Content: Worse still, I sense a waning of Athalia's powers in these signs of battle. She must have been injured...

6.Content: We need to find out what happened. I suggest we investigate the heart of the mountain for survivors.

0.Content: Careful, Cecilia.

1.Content: Clear signs of Hypogean infestation, which has seeped into the ground to create these disturbing tentacles. Only a fool would rush in here.

2.Content: The growth of tentacles imply a nearby Hypogean stronghold. Destroying it will remove the tentacles' sustenance.

3.Content: You mean, if we follow the tentacles we'll find their stronghold? Let us depart forthwith!

0.Content: By the Light, has the great Athalia passed by here?

1.Content: She has already been and left this place.

2.Content: We should redouble our pace to catch up, Lucius! She may yet be struggling against a fierce Hypogean now for all we know.

3.Content: Fear not. I've heard Athalia has already prevailed in her great fight against the great Hypogean to which you refer.

4.Content: She came barging through a few days ago. Only later I found she suspected a powerful Hypogean had infiltrated the Temple.

5.Content: A fierce battle ensued between Athalia and the forces of darkness.

6.Content: Athalia suffered the worst of it, and was eventually struck down by that same great Hypogean.

7.Content: I had not the strength to help turn the tide. All I could do was pray to the Goddess Dura for help and healing.

8.Content: I can't explain what happened or how she was saved... All I know is perhaps Dura gave us a genuine miracle.

9.Content: Dura's Light enveloped Athalia. She stood once again on her own two feet, re-energized with holy light.

10.Content: To the Hypogean she pointed her blade which, with blinding and holy light, fatally struck through the beast.

11.Content: But then how does one explain the continued Hypogean infestation in other areas?

12.Content: ...Exactly why Athalia departed! She can never rest as long as the Hypogean threat remains elsewhere, after having been eliminated here.

0.Content: Emissaries from the Holy Temple, please save us!

1.Content: Lucius, refugees are seeking asylum in the Temple!

2.Content: I can hardly blame them for clutching at the only remaining strand of light in a world so dimly-lit.

3.Content: To offer consolation at a time like this is the very purpose of our order's founding.

4.Content: See those tentacles? Many Hypogean must've infiltrated the group of refugees unawares.

5.Content: We must be prepared to take up arms against them too.

6.Content: No! Even if Hypogeans have hidden among the refugees, our arms could put all of them in danger.

7.Content: Enough of your bookish morality, Lucius! You'll not hinder me from cleansing evil!

8.Content: They have thrown all of their hope upon us and the promise of the Light! We cannot raise swords against innocents seeking refuge.

9.Content: Curse your morality! Don't you see they draw ever nearer?

0.Content: (An unmistakable Hypogean scent...)
We have pierced the veil of Hypogean secrecy so real refugees have come to no harm.

1.Content: The great Athalia!

2.Content: I have brought their leader to justice, but many still haunt the land.

3.Content: If only I could travel with you...

4.Content: Cecilia, focus! These refugees need the protection of the Light more than Athalia needs your assistance.

5.Content: Leave her to concentrate on what she does so well.

6.Content: I have to admit Athalia is not as cold-hearted as I'd been led to believe.

7.Content: She wields her blade only against the darkness.

0.Content: Based on our intel, there should be a village here that's protected by the Divine Light. But I don't sense any sign of life. Chances are there aren't any living souls left.

1.Content: This place is dead silent, which is unusual. Clearly, the Hypogeans have been here.

2.Content: The Hypogeans destroyed everything here.

3.Content: Those who despise the Divine Light shall receive no mercy.

0.Content: We must not underestimate these evil beings. They don't intend to fight alone.

1.Content: It's time to show them the power of the Divine Light.

0.Content: I can still smell evil in the air. There are still Hypogeans lurking in the dark, waiting to ambush.

1.Content: Countless souls have perished because of them. They shall be judged by the Divine Light on their sins.

2.Content: It is the nature of the Hypogeans to destroy everything... We must stop them before they harm any more beings!

3.Content: It's time to obey the divine order and set off on our journey.

0.Content: Damn it, what is this crap?! Thali, didn't you say this place was packed with treasure?

1.Content: How was I supposed to know? I just saw some Lightbearers sneaking around here digging something up, so I thought I'd call you over to take care of business with me.

2.Content: Hey, at least we gave them a damn good beatdown! Hahaha!

3.Content: Yeah, yeah, yeah... You made me come all this way for nothing!

0.Content: These weird stones are creeping me out! Hehe... (Starts shooting them)

1.Content: Huh? What did you do, Kren? Something around here looks... different.

2.Content: I dunno, I just shot up that altar-looking thing, and... Hey, check out these rails—why do they look all shiny and new all of a sudden?

3.Content: I think I know what's going on here. You must've activated that magic altar, transforming this place into how it used to be way back in the past.

4.Content: As crazy as it sounds, I'm gonna have to agree with you on that.

0.Content: The altar even brought this cactus back to life... It almost gave me a heart attack!

1.Content: Let me see... Well, the good news is, you didn't overreact and cause the entire cave to collapse, and the even better news is—there's a cave back here packed with treasure!

2.Content: So, after traveling back in time, not only do we get to fight as much as we want, but we also get to nab the treasure that used to be here?

3.Content: What are you waiting for? Let's hurry up and explore deeper inside!

0.Content: Huh? Has someone already activated the altar in this area?

1.Content: You mean there's someone else in here and they're one step ahead of us? If they came here for the treasure, I'll make sure they leave here in a cremation urn.

0.Content: Yeowch! What's the big idea? This minecart just tossed me out like yesterday's trash!

1.Content: Huh? Am I seeing things, or did this minecart just start growing treasure?!

2.Content: Growing treasure...? Hey, do you reckon this treasure was already in this minecart, but just at another time? When the minecart arrived here, the altar pushed it back into the ancient past—back to when it was full of treasure.

3.Content: So, how are we gonna bring this ancient treasure back to the present with us?

4.Content: I don't think we can. If this treasure leaves this area, it'll just become a worthless pile of dust.

5.Content: Oh, for crying out loud! I'm this close to turning this whole place into a worthless pile of dust!

6.Content: Whoa, don't get carried away, now. We should probably get out of here first, before you bring this cave down on our heads!

0.Content: I'm honing my swordcraft here, I take it?

1.Content: Correct. Those Ice Elementals are no match for your blade. But take note of the way in which you drive them forth.

2.Content: "Drive them forth"?

3.Content: By the angle of the blade, by the direction of your sword stroke! They will freeze a path across the water, and hence to your destination.

4.Content: Ah... I'm to angle my strike to where I want them to go?

5.Content: Mm. It should be easy enough for you.

0.Content: 'Tis fair training for one who seeks to master the powers of nature.

1.Content: There's also a reset button here if you fear the water and ice are too far out of your control. You can rethink your steps.

2.Content: Unnecessary, I hope.

0.Content: Yet their position leaves something to be desired... A wise idea to add a reset button.

1.Content: Please. Proceed.

0.Content: You reached the end much faster than I'd expected. I trust it was instructive?

1.Content: It's a fine boon to my precision training. I appreciate the effort.

0.Content: Satrana is feeling distressed in a tiny cell. A few days ago, she was presiding over a prayer ritual at a tribe, when the Quicksand Claws came plundering and abducted her to their base camp.

1.Content: Anxiously, Satrana is figuring out what to do. Suddenly, the cell door swings open and a silhouette she has long missed appears before her––it's Antandra!

2.Content: Without time to explain, Antandra grabs Satrana and makes for an escape. As for the many guards, Antandra has come prepared. She has brought a clever little companion…

0.Content: Thank god it's just a simple lock... Come on out.

1.Content: Antandra? No, you have to leave! There are too many guards here!

2.Content: Don't worry. I've brought Fox Fatale. Let her handle them.

0.Content: What an amazing little fox!

1.Content: Shhh...

2.Content: Alright...

0.Content: Finally, we get to rest up. Fox Fatale is also exhausted.

1.Content: We couldn't have pulled it off without her! Oh yes, there's something I need to tell the elder urgently! The Quicksand Claws are planning to attack the temple! They even wanted me to lead the way!

2.Content: Well, they must have recognized you during the plunder and got greedy. In that case, you should probably head back.

3.Content: Are you not going back with me? We haven't seen each other for so long...

4.Content: You know I can't go back to the temple with you. Be careful.

5.Content: I understand... Next time, I'll come back and find you in the Land of the Exiles!

0.Content: Yikes! Where am I, Gramp Arden? These trees are... massive.

1.Content: You are deep in the Fungi Forest. They look massive only because of the shrinking spell I applied to you. Take your time here and think about your behavior.

2.Content: I'm sorry, Gramp Arden, I know I've done wrong...

3.Content: You've got a good heart, Pippa, but you're quite clumsy. This forest will train you towards plenty of grit, persistence, and attention to detail! I'm sure if you just focus and analyze your surroundings you'll find a way out of here—out of this trial—in no time.

4.Content: I, I got this, Gramp Arden!

0.Content: Weird mushroom. What's it do, Gramp Arden?

1.Content: It's a "Super-Size Me" mushroom, as I like to call it. Eat it and you'll become much larger than even your original size.

2.Content: I can become larger? If I'm a giant, I could just kick these wooden walls over!

3.Content: Hehe. But there's a con to it. You could not cross the tumbledown Forest Bridge as a giant! It's more than likely going to collapse. Then you'll have no way back.

4.Content: Oh, right. I see.

5.Content: That's what I mean by focus and attention to detail! You can't just brute force your way through this test. You need to think about your next steps.

0.Content: Huh? What did I just step on?

1.Content: Pay attention to your surroundings, Pippa!

2.Content: A green barrier just popped up in the path! What am I supposed to do? I can't get past it.

3.Content: All part of the test, don't worry. There's a way you can deactivate it.

0.Content: Oh, look, a new type of mushroom. Seems similar to the one that made me big.

1.Content: It is. It's what I call a "Shrink Me" mushroom. It will make you just as small as you were when we first started.

2.Content: Oh, I get it! I can eat this whenever I want to get really small. Some things I need to get past while I'm big, others while I'm small—like this cave.

0.Content: I get it now! I'm going to have to think about how to get through this section...

1.Content: There are two control panels here and a Reset Crystal. Hitting the Reset Crystal resets the area back to the way it was at the start...

2.Content: You can actually hit that Reset Crystal from anywhere. Try it and see what happens.

0.Content: You've already made it to the last area! Well done, Pippa. Do you see your ultimate goal ahead of you?

1.Content: Let's see... it must be that statue in the middle!

2.Content: Yes! Reaching that statue will conclude the test—although it may not be as it seems. It also divided the island into two.

3.Content: Hehe, have I been doing well?

4.Content: Very well, my dear child! Just keep a cool head and you should pass this last section.

0.Content: Congratulations, my dear Pippa on an outstanding performance. You passed the trial!

1.Content: Great, Gramp Arden! It's just like what you said—gotta keep a cool head and think carefully!

2.Content: I hope you've learned something today, Pippa. Because the day is coming you'll share the heavy responsibilities of Nature's Voice.

3.Content: That sounds amazing, Gramp Arden! I'll... study and practice harder than ever before, calmly and cautiously!

0.Content: Protect the Queen! Fall back! Hurry!

1.Content: Don't let the Sphinxes follow! We'll guard the rear!

0.Content: You do well to fear the power of the Void, Arachin!
Spiderwebs again, Arachin? Thanks for reminding me of my first foray into one of your wretched nests. Hah.

1.Content: How could I ever forget those disgusting webs...

0.Content: You should know better than to stand in my way. Begone!

1.Content: I've been expecting you, Safiya.

2.Content: And who are you? Is this another one of Ankhira's traps?

3.Content: Simply answer me three questions and you may pass. Think carefully.

4.Content: I have no interest in silly games today. Out of my way.

5.Content: This road shall be forever impassable if you do not.
