2.Content: If I hadn't "tampered" with this timeline, you wouldn't have been able to set it back on course... So who does this timeline really belong to?

3.Content: You sensed it too. It has manifested. That fleeting Gaze stopped us from acting on this timeline.

4.Content: No direct interference, yet the victor's fate was cut short... Seems we were both only permitted to go this far.

5.Content: I tried to fix it and failed; you tried to seize control and were blocked. So... was this timeline's deviation deliberately orchestrated by It?

6.Content: Can't rule that out. We both believed we were calling the shots... but It was orchestrating everything from behind the curtain all along.

7.Content: Still, there's an unknown figure moving freely between both timelines... neither cast out nor controlled.

8.Content: I've seen it too. The only being that can exist in both worlds' rules, like... some kind of anchor point?

9.Content: If there's any truth to be found in this deviant timeline, that figure might be our key to uncovering the real identity of It.

10.Content: Ha, perhaps we'll all have to rely on this unknown variable to wrap things up. Or maybe... we'll fight together?

11.Content: How ironic that would be... But the deviation persists, and the mystery continues. Only when we find It can we uncover the real truth.

0.Content: Ancient arts, heed my call! Bring forth the "Peerless Champion!"

1.Content: Hahaha! Finally! The strongest Wonder in history is about to be born!

2.Content: Doctor, there's no way this could fail! I've studied your "Thirty Years of Trials with Wonders" and created a summoning array that breaks all boundaries!

3.Content: Our lifelong dream is finally within reach! I... I can finally write a new book!

4.Content: Doctor! Look—the array is responding!

0.Content: What... where am I?

1.Content: ...Hmm? Is someone over there?

0.Content: Hey! You! What is this place?!

1.Content: This is the "Peerless Champion"? Doesn't feel right... that's just a little girl.

2.Content: Wh-what? The array was supposed to summon a warrior who could lay waste to the world...

3.Content: Who are you calling a little girl? I'm asking the questions here! Now answer me!

4.Content: Let me double-check... something must have gone wrong.

5.Content: Don't ignore me!

6.Content: Come now, don't be too hard on yourself. You just accidentally summoned a little girl. You can do better next time!

7.Content: As for this chirpy little girl... just take care of her!

8.Content: Unbelievable! Not only did they ignore me, they called me a little girl? I'm an adult!

0.Content: URGH! GRAH!

1.Content: COUGH COUGH... this power… it's incredible! Truly remarkable... the ultimate warrior… excellent work… you'll be highly rewarded! COUGH COUGH COUGH!

2.Content: Honestly! What a waste of my time!

3.Content: Hahaha... perfect... let's use you to test our next mechanisms... COUGH COUGH... hey, help me out, let's sneak away!

4.Content: Got it, Doctor!

0.Content: The Wonder isn't even open yet... but someone's already here? Well, better go greet them!

1.Content: Hahaha! Life is full of ups and downs! Welcome to the Elevator Zone! I'm the designer here!

2.Content: You foolish, fearless adventurer! See the elevator blocking your way? You'll need to use your brains to bring it down!

3.Content: Ugh... what a pain.

0.Content: What are you doing?! You don't understand the art of the elevator! It's not meant to be used like that—

1.Content: Then don't blame me for being ruthless! All mechanisms activated!

2.Content: You disgust me. Leave.

0.Content: Nooo… my life's work!

1.Content: Forget it... despite appearances, I was a master fighter once!

2.Content: Today, you're not leaving!

0.Content: Where's the exit, anyway?
General Hogan, according to the scouts, this is where the Doctor Trix was last seen.

1.Content: We've captured three wanted labyrinth designers on site, but...

2.Content: But what?

3.Content: The labyrinth is almost entirely ruins. The three fugitives seem to be in shock and are babbling nonsense...

4.Content: Hmm... let's go interrogate them and see if we can get anything useful.

0.Content: Waahaah... my life's work... my life... crumbled before me...

1.Content: I devoted my whole life to this... who will compensate me... Bwaaaah...

2.Content: Looks like we won't get anything useful out of him.

0.Content: Damn it! I was so close to pulling it off!

1.Content: The array is fine... the only problem is controlling the summon. Next time, if perhaps I add some restrictions...

2.Content: It worked! Yes! Hahahahahahaha!

3.Content: These people are insane... I'd better go ask the mastermind...

0.Content: Doctor Trix, there's no escaping now. Tell us everything you know!

1.Content: Hahaha… no escape? Foolish mortals! You don't understand the beauty of the Wonder at all!

2.Content: My ultimate creation is designed with layers upon layers... as long as the array on the other side is properly summoned...

3.Content: Wait... the other side is using the same array, isn't it?

4.Content: I'm firing that foolish summoner! Aaaah!

5.Content: Hmm... we did get some useful intel. Morvus, have someone watch these three. Let's move on.

0.Content: How long have we been waiting?! Can we really trust this summoning array?

1.Content: According to the Mad Summoner, once they activate their array, we'll summon a "Peerless Champion" here too, to guard the labyrinth.

2.Content: Let's hope so... if you ask me, nothing's as reliable as a cannon!

3.Content: Hmm? The array is responding!

0.Content: Ah... where... is this place?

1.Content: Genos and King aren't here...

0.Content: Hey, where am I?

1.Content: ...Uh... hmm?

2.Content: Could this really be the Peerless... Champion?

3.Content: I knew that summoner couldn't be trusted! There's no way this person looks like a real powerhouse!

4.Content: And such a weird outfit... looks kind of clueless.

5.Content: What's with the rude attitude? Oh, right... do you know where's the exit?

6.Content: It's over there!

7.Content: Got it, thanks!

8.Content: ...Sigh... looks like your cannon just added another soul to the count...

0.Content: Hmm? Something's flying this way. What is that? Hey! Is this yours? Here, take it back.
Oh... sorry about that.
Argh! My... cannon!
It's so bright! What's with this light? Is that a switch?

1.Content: I'll step on it.

0.Content: Ah! My... laser cannon!
Damn it! We can't just let this go!
Wait! Calm down first. This is no ordinary guy—let's toss him to the next floor.

1.Content: Next floor? That's our abandoned design! If those things get unleashed, the whole Wonder could be ruined!

2.Content: If he keeps causing trouble like this, the Wonder won't survive either! Let's give him a taste of what true hell is!

0.Content: Where is this? How did we end up somewhere else again? I'd better hurry before the big sale at the supermarket starts!
Hey, you... what are you doing all of a sudden?
Is this the right way?
What's been going on?
...I... I'm not imagining it! He actually...

1.Content: Now's not the time for nonsense! Run! You want to die?

0.Content: At this rate, I'm really going to miss the supermarket sale...
Hmm? Someone... very suspicious. Could they be an ally of Doctor Trix? Don't move, slowly turn around!

1.Content: Huh? Me?

2.Content: ...Looks like just an ordinary person.

3.Content: General Hogan, we just scouted ahead... The labyrinth has been destroyed, and there are the remains of two puppets.

4.Content: Destroyed? Could this stranger be responsible?

5.Content: Sir, did you destroy this labyrinth?

6.Content: Labyrinth? Oh... I think I smashed it all up inside. Uh-oh... do I have to pay for this?

7.Content: No, not at all... Actually, you've done us a big favor! Can you tell us what happened? We'd like the full story.

8.Content: Eh? Nah… that'd take too long. The supermarket sale is about to start anyway...

9.Content: At least tell us your name!

0.Content: The name's Saitama and just a guy who's a hero for fun... Goodbye!
A "hero," huh? How peculiar...
Well done, Hogan. I hear you've tracked down the labyrinth designers.

1.Content: We caught three designers, including Doctor Trix, but two or three may still be at large...

2.Content: No matter. Capturing the mastermind alone is a great achievement. We've been tracking these cunning designers for years with little success.

3.Content: Lord Hendrik...

4.Content: Reward your soldiers properly for this.

5.Content: Actually...

6.Content: Let's all cheer for General Hogan!

0.Content: (Overwhelmed by the soldiers' cheers) Actually someone else destroyed the labyrinth.

1.Content: Forget it, General Hogan. You'd better wait until later to explain more.

0.Content: Something's glowing up ahead. I'll go check it out.
Looks like I'll have to clear out some little roadblocks first!
She looks very weak...

1.Content: Her blessed relics have been scattered. Each one must be found!

0.Content: The villagers are just up ahead!

1.Content: We're saved! Finally!

2.Content: You're safe now. Let's go!

0.Content: Stay close to me!
Let Mira go!
Too slow!

1.Content: Your end is here!

0.Content: You will all die here!

1.Content: Get lost!

2.Content: Stay out of my way!

0.Content: The troops are right up ahead!
Just in time!

1.Content: Together! Let's go!

0.Content: There's no end to them!

1.Content: On my command! Take positions!

0.Content: We've got to find someone to help us turn the tide!
Thank you for giving me a new life.

1.Content: I've summoned someone to help you eliminate the demons!

0.Content: What…?

1.Content: I'm sorry. My body is too gravely wounded to appear.

2.Content: But I will guide you to the blessed relics.

3.Content: The crown... lies just ahead.

4.Content: Please retrieve it.

5.Content: Don't worry. Leave it to me.

0.Content: Next are the plumes. Right up ahead.

1.Content: Thanks again.

0.Content: And the core's aura... It's drawing closer.

1.Content: The path ahead is fraught with danger. Be careful.

2.Content: Rest assured. It shall be done.

0.Content: Let's go. My Lunar Skiff is just ahead.

1.Content: Please bring it back to me.

0.Content: And finally, only the final blessed relic remains.

1.Content: Look! The bouquet is right there!

2.Content: With the relics collected, you'll be healed, right?

3.Content: Yes. Just please await my rebirth...

4.Content: By then, another helper will have arrived...

0.Content: The skies of Esperia are shrouded in demonic darkness. I cannot linger here.

1.Content: This companion will fight alongside you to eliminate the demons... Please... You must keep up the fight.

0.Content: Come on, folks! Act fast! Delicious food is not going to jump into the pot by itself. We need to haul that sea monster ashore, and fast!

1.Content: This is my first time hearing about hunting sea monsters during the Spring Spree. Did seafood prices go up again or something?

2.Content: Well, in weather like this, everyone should eat something warm.

3.Content: You all just lack imagination when it comes to food! I got my hands on a mysterious recipe from a faraway land!

4.Content: It says it clearly: "Cook the eight-armed beast together with raging flames." That is obviously referring to this sea monster, right?

5.Content: That sounds more like some foreign ritual phrase rather than a dish you'd find in Hathor.

6.Content: This sounds fishy! Did someone at the tavern trick you? Who exactly gave you this recipe anyway?

7.Content: Ahem! A chef's family secrets are not something to blurt out so casually. Just wait until you taste it. It will definitely live up to the sacred flames of the Spring Spree!

8.Content: Ha! Big words. I've come all this way, so don't disappoint me!

9.Content: Relax! As long as we take this sea monster down, leave the rest to me!

10.Content: Hmph. This thing gave me a real beating last time! I am definitely settling the score today!

11.Content: But this sea monster seems stronger than before. Can we really handle it with just a few of us?

12.Content: The Spring Spree is Esperia's big day! There are plenty of people eager to join the fun! Come on, let's get to work!

0.Content: These are our supplies? What a mess!

1.Content: Hurry up and sort them out. Otherwise, forget about food. We might lose our lives here. Follow my instructions and organize them properly.

0.Content: This backpack is stuffed with all sorts of things. Open it up and let's see what goodies we've got!
There is more of the same piled up in the corner. Clear it out, and scrape away those cobwebs too!
Good! Get these supplies to the front line and let that sea monster have a taste of what's coming!
Well done! Looks like we'll soon have that beast beaten into submission and ready for the pot!
Great work! Here's some Stamina replenishment. After a big job like this, it is important to rest.
Drink this to restore your Stamina! Remember, once your Stamina is depleted, you won't be able to do anything.

1.Content: Stamina potions can be combined further. The higher the level, the more Stamina they restore!

0.Content: Let's see what's hidden here... Oh, bombs! Well, that explains it. They were stuffed into the advanced supplies.
Bombs are excellent against sea monsters. One bomb makes your work twice as effective. Try out their power!

1.Content: Bombs can be combined further into larger ones. Bigger bombs mean doubled power.

0.Content: An Illusionary Crystal! You're in luck! Who would've thought the generator would spit out something this valuable!
It can be combined with any other resource to upgrade it directly by one level, saving you a combination step.
Oh, this is a Genesis Cutter. Use it well and you can organize your preparation area nicely!
Drag it onto a supply to consume it, and split one high-level supply into two supplies of the next lower level, making further combinations easier.
They can stack together, and any unused charges will carry over.
Psst, tell me, who gave you this recipe? If it's from somewhere extraordinary, I might be able to open up a new trade route!

1.Content: Haha, that's not something I can just share with anyone! But once these dishes make it to the Spring Spree feast table, you'll find some clues.

2.Content: Then I'd better give it my all today.

0.Content: I often help Madam prepare banquets, but this is my first time working with a foreign chef.

1.Content: Haha! Once we bring this sea monster down, I'll show you what a true Mauler-style Dish of the Day tastes like!

0.Content: Hey there, warriors of the Crimson Arena! This time we're battling on the high seas. Think you can handle it?

1.Content: Just a sea monster and a few waves! I was careless last time, but this time I'll beat it so badly it won't even be able to make a splash!

2.Content: Ugh... mmph! Why does this ship... keep rocking so much... *cough* I-I can still fight!

3.Content: Hahaha, a warrior of the Crimson Arena defeated by mere waves? Looks like our desert duels haven't taught you anything!

4.Content: Let's hope this little bout of seasickness doesn't affect our haul today! Charge. Now!

0.Content: Wow! It's exactly as Antandra described! This sea monster is even more magnificent than I imagined! And it looks kind of cute too!

1.Content: Cute only from afar. We need to finish this quickly and not give it a chance to cause trouble.

2.Content: Good! Excellent! That's the spirit! Let's follow your lead then!

0.Content: Well, well... what an "uninvited guest"! You must have gone through quite a bit to get here, haven't you?

1.Content: The smell of the sea is completely different from the earthy stench of the graveyard. It is... fascinating.

2.Content: We shouldn't be in a place like this... but if it can bring a smile to Daimon's face, then it's worth trying.

3.Content: Since you're all here, let's have some fun together! First, let's go catch our ingredients!

0.Content: Hey, hey, hey! How can there be good food without me?

1.Content: Please forgive any discourtesy. We came at the invitation of the Spring Spree to offer our assistance and hope to be of help.

2.Content: What distinguished guests we have. With the two of you around, even the sea monster is getting excited and churning the waves.

3.Content: Hmph, such trivialities are not worth dirtying my hands.

0.Content: Ah, are you preparing dishes for the Spring Spree? Can I use my flames to deal with this giant sea monster?

1.Content: Astar, flames without restraint will only reduce it to ashes. That way, we can neither make a proper dish nor carry people's blessings.

2.Content: That's right! This is the final battle, so please show some mercy! Don't set both the ship and the main course on fire!

0.Content: Whew... That was easier than I expected. If only making money could go this smoothly.

1.Content: Haha, your mind is all about business from start to finish! Why not look forward to how many delicious dishes this sea monster will become?

0.Content: Thanks to you, the harvest exceeded my expectations.

1.Content: My, how nimble you are! Anyone can tell you're very experienced in the kitchen.

2.Content: You flatter me. I'll help you prepare the dinner, and I'd also like to learn a few new recipes.

3.Content: No problem. I have plenty of signature dishes! If you really want to learn, be prepared to stand by the stove for three days and three nights!

0.Content: Heh, is that all? For a Warrior of the Crimson Arena, this is child's play... urgh. Ugh... umm... (hurriedly grabs the railing)

1.Content: See that? That's experience. It took me quite a while to get used to these waves! Now even the biggest waves won't... Ugh... urgh! (suddenly covers his mouth)

2.Content: Haha! The bigger the waves, the more valuable the catch. These waves have brought us a ship full of bounty!

3.Content: Waves train courage. Seasickness trains willpower. Come out a few more times, and you'll eventually level up from "Desert Fighters" to "Warriors of the Sea"!

0.Content: Although its power has slightly increased, I still won't give it any chance to counterattack.

1.Content: As expected of the Temple Warrior renowned throughout the desert! Your strikes are impressively swift and precise!

2.Content: Of course! I've been pulling my weight too! By the way, will we have any other helpers? The feast preparations seem to be moving rather slowly...

3.Content: Don't worry! Before long, some unexpected guests will be joining us to enjoy the festivities of the Spring Spree!

0.Content: The Spring Spree is also a time for family reunions. You all should enjoy this happiness too!

1.Content: We shouldn't be out here among these festive lights, but if it helps Daimon forget about the cold and darkness, even for a moment...

2.Content: Then I must serve you my very best dishes! Little one, would you like to try some too?

3.Content: Hmm, this feeling of warmth... It's been so long... so very long since I've felt this.

0.Content: Easy peasy! Hey! Can you really turn these slimy tentacles into something delicious?

1.Content: With me here, plus the guidance of this recipe, no matter how picky the ingredients are, I'll make a dish that'll win you over completely!

2.Content: I've heard the owner of this recipe has a special connection with "fire"... I'm really looking forward to seeing what kind of delicacies will be created under the blessing of the Lantern's Flame.

3.Content: Who knows, maybe the owner of the recipe will appear next. Let's wait and see.

0.Content: That intense blaze just now evaporated all my cold sweat... I almost thought we'd come back empty-handed today!

1.Content: Hmph. Flames solve everything. Even if fire and seawater are opposites, as long as Talene is here, flames will never lose!

2.Content: Well said! Thanks to all of you, we've finally gathered all the ingredients needed for the Spring Spree feast! Now it's my turn to show off my skills at the stove!

3.Content: Then I'll leave it to you.

0.Content: Great! Thanks to everyone's help along the way, this year's Spring Spree feast has finally come together perfectly!

1.Content: Wow, so it really is possible to make so many different dishes. They smell amazing!

2.Content: Ahem! Speaking of which, Gorren, isn't it time you revealed who the owner of this recipe is?

3.Content: Well... as a chef, I should probably keep that a secret...

4.Content: What secret? It's just a simple recipe. This Mauler fellow is making too big a deal out of it!

5.Content: Wow! Such fire, such energy!

6.Content: I was just passing by and saw you making such a fuss, so I jotted down a few recipes! Well, do they live up to your expectations of the feast?

7.Content: Absolutely! With your recipes, the dishes I've prepared are truly worthy of your stature!

8.Content: Haha, then I won't stand on ceremony! I'm going to dig in first!

9.Content: Mom, look. They've even saved seats for us.

10.Content: Hmm... let's stay for a while then. Just treat it as celebrating the festival with everyone.

11.Content: Let's eat first and talk later. I'll get revenge for my seasickness with this feast!

12.Content: See, Astar. Tonight's flames not only dispel winter's cold and malice, but also burn for this feast and our reunion.

13.Content: Let the Lantern's Flame, along with these warm delicacies, illuminate Esperia!

0.Content: Who are you? Henchmen of the demons, perhaps?

1.Content: 你误会了……

2.Content: Take this!

0.Content: Don't disturb me as I tend to the wounded...
Done! Now, onward to the Capital!
A dragon has invaded the Capital! It must be destroyed!
Arrived at last. First, remove the dragon's magical barrier!
The castle seems to have been overrun by demons. Guess the adventure is only just beginning...
Just one final step remains... Stop this dragon.
Hey! You're just in time! Look what I've brought back! Ta-da! It's a cocoon I rescued from the Dimensional Rift!

1.Content: This Void Cocoon was being eroded by the rift. If left unattended, it would have been swallowed by the Dimension along with whatever lives inside.

2.Content: There's some kind of being inside the cocoon, but its vital signs are extremely weak. It could be devoured by the Dimension at any moment...

3.Content: Ahem! Anyway, we need to protect it! And it's super picky too. It doesn't react to anything ordinary.

4.Content: Plus, we still need to deal with the monsters in the Rift, so we can't keep watch over it ourselves... That's why I've decided to pass this glorious caretaking duty on to you!

5.Content: I apologize, but this is the most practical call. The Celestial and Hypogean power we carry isn't safe around such a fragile young spirit for long periods.

6.Content: Your gentle nature, by comparison, is far better suited to nurturing it.

7.Content: Got it? Then get moving! Look how much it's trembling... Go on, give it a pat and so it can get familiar with your scent!

0.Content: What an incredible resonance. Not only did it accept your soothing touch, it even gave you some... bait? And a blessing?

1.Content: Heh, at least the little thing shows some appreciation! Since it likes you so much, you're in charge of feeding it from here on out!

2.Content: The lingering glow of the sun and moon shining together reveals a mysterious sea on the far side of the ruins. Perhaps these baits can be used there to fish up the "nourishment" the young spirit needs.

3.Content: Exactly! Let's take these baits and blessings and go fish up something useful!

4.Content: Wait... something seems off. The cocoon is trembling... Quick, touch it and sense its condition.

0.Content: It seems cold... Let's head to that sea right away and see if we can fish up something to warm it.
Wow! What a beautiful ocean! Fantastic! It's like my dream summer beach adventure!

1.Content: Stay focused, Lucilla. Don't forget why we're here. We're not on vacation. We need to fish up nourishment for the Void Cocoon as quickly as possible.

2.Content: Ugh, Liberta, you're such a killjoy... Fine, let's start with this Shallow Coast over here. It looks like the easiest spot!

0.Content: Wow, there's so much stuff in these waters! Not just fish, but all sorts of interesting little trinkets too!

1.Content: Indeed. These waters are far from ordinary. The sea has been influenced by Dimensional and celestial forces, resulting in quite a variety of fascinating fish species.

2.Content: Also, there are all sorts of strange objects drifting through the water. These are likely the key materials needed to soothe and nurture the creature in the cocoon... though there may be some less useful ones mixed in as well.

3.Content: Whether it's fish or something else, if it's in the water, we reel it in! Adventurer, with nurturing materials as our goal... Cast your line!

0.Content: Haha! I knew this spot was a winner! Told you we'd pull up something good!

1.Content: This is... a fleece blanket. Hmm, the residual energy on this item is highly compatible with the Void Cocoon. It should be able to remedy its cold condition.

2.Content: What are you standing around for? Hurry back with this thing! I can't wait to see that little creature all warm and cozy!

0.Content: Oh my, the sun's actually coming out over these waters! Nothing but blue skies and good vibes, just the way I like it!

1.Content: This is unusual. Weather changes shouldn't occur in these waters... Could our frequent fishing trips have been causing fluctuations in the energy here?

2.Content: Oh? So if we keep using up our bait and fishing on sunny days, the weather here will keep changing?

3.Content: Most likely. Change often brings opportunity. Let's hope these unknown weather patterns turn out to be a blessing for our fishing.

0.Content: Woohoo! Look, look! The weather changed, just like I said! Told you my instincts are never wrong!

1.Content: A fascinating reaction... This new weather pattern seems to greatly improve our fishing yield. A truly exceptional advantage.

2.Content: But don't celebrate just yet. From what I've observed, this special weather is highly unstable. It seems to fade after only a very limited number of casts.

3.Content: Did you hear that? This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! Every cast is crucial! Make the most of every one, and don't let this chance slip away!

0.Content: Hmm, I have to admit you've got some skills! I was worried you'd mess up from impatience, but you've raised it so well!

1.Content: Since it hatched from the cocoon safe and sound, I'll be gracious enough to give you a 10 out of 10 on this caretaking mission!

2.Content: Please allow me to extend my most sincere gratitude.

3.Content: Without your devoted care and companionship these past days and nights, this fragile little creature could never have been reborn in such radiant glory.

4.Content: Hey, look at it! Its eyes are fixed on you now. Seems like it's completely attached to you!

5.Content: It awakened from an empty cocoon and grew up in the warmth of your care. In its heart, you are already the most irreplaceable family it has in this world.

6.Content: The world beyond is full of unknown storms and trials, but as long as you're by its side, I believe it will face everything with courage.

7.Content: Anyway, I'm leaving this little one in your care! Though it seems to need some time to rest up... It'll take a while before it's ready to join you on adventures!

0.Content: Oh? And who are you? I was expecting someone a little more interesting to find me.
You're back again. I knew it...You couldn't bear to leave me alone out here in the sea, could you?
I've been waiting for you for so long... so long I almost started to think you'd gone off fishing for a different "catch."
I've finally found you! Looks like we were destined for each other! Don't even think about getting away...
Hey! Let me teach you something. When you fish here, you can choose your own luck multiplier!

1.Content: Just use some extra bait, and you'll catch more fish! My advice? Use a high multiplier! Now let's catch a big one!

0.Content: Hey you! Those cursed demons are causing trouble again. We've got to wipe them out!

1.Content: I'm not in this to lose money, though. The guild has put out a hunter's bounty. It's only fair to get paid for your work!

2.Content: Check your ammo, eliminate those scum, and get ready to rake in some cash!

0.Content: The demons are coming in fierce. Don't fight them alone! Your guild mates will fight alongside you on the front lines!

1.Content: As long as everyone contributes some firepower, everybody earns!

0.Content: Look here. The bounties earned by guild members can be combined—and the higher the total goes, the more rewards will be unlocked in Guild Tributes!
Let's see what kind of Bounty Score you can rake in from this Bounty stage!

1.Content: Enough talk—let's get to fighting!

0.Content: Nicely done! This bounty is yours!

1.Content: And remember: if there's anything left in the Bounty pool, you can keep repeating the fight until it's empty!

0.Content: In our business, that's the mark of a top-tier hunter! Take it with you and claim the extra rewards you've earned!
Shh... Listen... There's a dangerous one up ahead.

1.Content: This one's tough... But that's alright. We can always come back later and earn his bounty!

2.Content: Move out! Let's go check it out!

0.Content: Such a strange fluctuation... Looks like a secret portal the demons use to hide their treasures!

1.Content: Don't just stand there—this is a rare opportunity to strike it rich! It's different from other bounties, but the rewards are worth it!

2.Content: Enough talk. Let's go rake in some cash!

0.Content: Now, if you want to prove what you're really made of, then you can try beating stages in a single life!

1.Content: If you can complete a Bounty stage without taking any damage, you'll earn a Superb Starsign.

0.Content: The tide carries an uneasy feeling... This sea has lost its former clarity and peace.

1.Content: Drifting filth, murky currents, damaged coral... This place needs some real restoration.

2.Content: If we let this pollution spread, we'll not only lose the coral—but the very life-breath of the sea.

3.Content: Come, join me in purifying these waters! Let the tides bring back life—and the order it deserves!

0.Content: Thanks to you, the sea is clear again, and the dormant corals have regained their vibrant colors.

1.Content: With the pollution gone and the tide's breath back in balance, this sea has finally found its rhythm again.

2.Content: Today's recovery is not the end. As long as any sea remains polluted or disturbed, our guardianship will not stop.

3.Content: I'll follow the tides onward, watching over more seas that await purification. May you rejoin me when the waves call again!

0.Content: You let me wear these adornments once more... and restored the whip to my grasp.

1.Content: Mortal, you are awakening the old name I buried within this unyielding stone.

2.Content: Stay with me if you will, then shall you see all that I am.

0.Content: Fear not the hissing serpents. They are merely my form now.

1.Content: My gaze is what is truly dangerous... every one of these statues was once a mortal who dared to meet my eyes.

2.Content: And yet you stand before me, not turned to stone, nor having stepped back.

0.Content: Mortal, the Sacred Flame you offer brings the weight of Aegis back to my hand.

1.Content: It was forged to protect order and to reflect judgments I had wished to forget.

2.Content: Are you willing to witness it raised once more?

0.Content: The Triumphant Lance... the Wings of Wisdom...

1.Content: They once fought in the battles of Olympus. They are a part of who I am.

2.Content: Today, they do not rise for Olympus. It is you who brings this long-overdue judgment back into the world.

0.Content: Do you know what I did on that island?

1.Content: I know... I never looked away.

2.Content: Every hero who came for my head became the stone that built your shrine.

3.Content: I never turned away from that temple. It was my hand that brought you to this fate...

4.Content: Your hand? Hundreds of years have passed, yet you've never once tried to explain yourself.

5.Content: I did not come here seeking your forgiveness.

6.Content: Then stop hiding behind your silence.

0.Content: That night, I knelt beneath your statue and prayed.

1.Content: What I sought was not revenge, but for you to deliver justice for me.

2.Content: I heard your prayers. I saw your agony. But my hands were tied.

3.Content: Why? Because I was nothing more than a mortal?

4.Content: Olympus would never go to war with another god... for the sake of a mortal.

5.Content: So you chose to judge me, and turned me into a monster.

0.Content: I used to tell myself that as long as you were still breathing, my judgment was not a total failure.

1.Content: Breathing? As a monster?

2.Content: I know. It does not earn me your forgiveness.

3.Content: You should know this by now... I will never forgive you.

4.Content: I never dared to ask for it. For centuries, I could not even bring myself to look upon you, even across the waters of the Aegean.

5.Content: Is it only because... I am the monster you made with your own hands?

6.Content: No. Every time I look at you, I only see the weight of my own sins.

0.Content: I hated you.

1.Content: And you had every right to.

2.Content: And yet, I survived because of the very curse you placed upon me.

3.Content: That curse was never meant to be your chains.

4.Content: I know. But even chains can be forged into weapons.

5.Content: Your fate should always have been yours to choose... even if you never forgive me.

6.Content: I despise what you did to me... yet I never truly wished to sever our bond.

0.Content: I will not forget the suffering of the past... nor will I absolve you of it.

1.Content: Do you remember the moment we leapt into the rift?

2.Content: The golden dome shattered above us. The threads of fate no longer knew where to lead.

3.Content: For the first time, I was not judged. I chose.

4.Content: I seek no absolution for my sins. But now, I will raise my spear and shield for you.

5.Content: Mortal, the Sacred Flame in your hands bears witness to my name.

6.Content: And to this long-overdue judgment.

7.Content: This time, we walk this path by choice.

8.Content: By the Sacred Flame...

9.Content: The Sacred Pact is sealed.

0.Content: Hey everyone! Welcome to the coast I hand-picked just for us! Today's wind, tide, and sunshine are all perfect for some fun!

1.Content: Sunshine, waves, barbecue, and cold drinks... wait, where's all the stuff we brought?

2.Content: Let's stay calm, everyone. The tide seems to have scattered our drinks and supplies, but they're probably still somewhere near this island.

3.Content: This tide came in strangely, as though it carried traces of Arcana within. If we can pin down where things scattered, we still have a chance to recover them.

4.Content: Once we know where things ended up, I can clear a path along the shore and haul it all back bit by bit. Trouble is, my kart is short on stable power...

5.Content: The Arcana's coming from that Wonder Farm over there. Instead of standing around worrying, let's go take a look.

0.Content: Whoa, a glowing field right by the sea? Could this be the legendary Whimsical Farmstead?

1.Content: I can feel a gentle power running through here. It seems to respond to the wishes in our hearts.

2.Content: That sounds amazing! But here's the problem: there's plenty of dew here, but we don't have anything to plant.

3.Content: Before we left, Pippa asked Princess Peggy to give me a little pouch. I just opened it, and it happens to have some seeds inside.

4.Content: These seeds seem to resonate with the Wonder Farm's energy. Let's plant them and see what happens.

0.Content: Every day you visit the Wonder Farm, you can claim new Magic Seeds and Enchanted Dew. Just don't leave them sitting in your bag!
Go ahead and put the Magic Seeds into the tile. But easy does it, they've got more attitude than your average seed.
Now pour on some Enchanted Dew... and the Magic Flora will grow even faster. It's always a little easier, like reeling in your line with the wind at your back!
They're ripe! Come on, let's see what we reeled in today... I mean, what we grew!
Whoa! The stuff this Wonder Farm's growing can actually make up for our missing supplies? Neat!

1.Content: It even produces Ocean Turbine! Not much, but it's enough to give the kart a little charge.

2.Content: Wishes, remnants of our supplies, tidal Arcana... I suppose the logic of this magic barely holds together.

3.Content: I bet Pippa would be thrilled if she could see this too.

4.Content: Well, maybe she saw this coming all along! Anyway, we've got a lot of stuff now, so we'd better get it organized.

5.Content: Let's sort and log everything first. That way we'll know what's already recovered and what's still out there in the sea.

0.Content: Ta-da! The Midsummer Harvest Almanac makes its shining debut!

1.Content: Each new product you unlock comes with its own reward! Complete a whole category, and you'll score an even bigger bonus!

0.Content: Oh, right! If you want a more reliable harvest of a certain type, you can just choose the tile type directly!

1.Content: Once you pick a type, the tile's appearance will even show what kind of product it'll produce!

2.Content: This'll speed up getting our supplies back... looks like our coastal feast is saved after all!

0.Content: Look, Belinda's come to help out at the Wonder Farm! While she's visiting, your harvests get an extra boost!

1.Content: Right. Helping these Magic Flora grow a little better is the least I can do for this vacation.

2.Content: But her visit and bonus uses are limited. Once her time is up or the uses run out, the bonus disappears.

3.Content: Of course, Belinda won't be the only one dropping by to help... everyone's going to pitch in eventually!

0.Content: If you forget exactly what a visit does, just click here to check!
The better the Magic Flora grow, the more little troubles they attract! But don't worry, ignoring them won't cost you any of your harvest!

1.Content: That said, timely care will raise your odds of earning higher-quality harvests.

2.Content: So no slacking off! Pest Control keeps the Magic Flora free of interference, and Enrichment makes them more likely to yield products you haven't collected yet.

3.Content: The Wonder Farm rewards the attentive. Let's tend to it well for the sake of our coastal getaway!

0.Content: Whew... Ocean Turbine has finally hit the minimum startup threshold! The air's thick with damp sea mist, but the kart can start up now!

1.Content: Wonderful! Does that mean we can finally track down everything the tide carried off?

2.Content: We can bring back a batch of them for sure. The shore's still got plenty of obstacles, so I'll advance gradually, going after the large debris and suspicious crates first.

3.Content: Haha, now that sounds exciting! What are we waiting for? Let's get this big guy moving!

4.Content: I hope your kart's more reliable than those drifting crates.

5.Content: I modified it myself! Of course it's reliable! Unless someone decides to stuff soggy seaweed into the drive shaft...

6.Content: Time to go, Valery! Race the wind and get our beach vacation back!

0.Content: Tap to sprint, and the kart will consume Ocean Turbine to push forward along the coast!
Nice work! Looks like we recovered quite a lot of supplies!

1.Content: How far we go each time depends on the sand, the rocks, and the tide marks. The farther we sprint, the more supplies we can recover.

2.Content: But don't worry. Speed may vary, but we'll never come up empty. Keep sprinting, and every last bit of the supplies will be recovered.

3.Content: Now that's what I like to hear! So where's the next crate of cold drinks?

4.Content: There are still a few suspicious drift spots up ahead. Keep building up Ocean Turbine and the kart can go even farther.

5.Content: If you want to check your reward progress, just take a look at the Sprint Mileage. Either way, we're bound to collect everything!

6.Content: Then let's hurry back to the Wonder Farm and keep at it! Let's build up even more Ocean Turbine!

0.Content: All the main supplies have been recovered! You can still keep sprinting after this, but the rewards will switch to regular supplies.

1.Content: At last, our vacation's finally back on track! From here on, let's just treat the rest of the miles as a joyride along the coast!

0.Content: The breeze feels so nice today! I bet the Magic Flora are stretching out right about now, too.

1.Content: Yeah, the sunlight's so gentle. It's like they're responding to everyone's hopes.

2.Content: Then let's take good care of them! As long as our wishes are sincere, we're bound to see results!

0.Content: Hey, Valery! How far can the kart go today? I've been dreaming about that crate of cold drinks for ages!

1.Content: That depends on Ocean Turbine, sand resistance... and whether you stop piling a third crate of drinks onto the kart.

2.Content: Haha, love the energy! Then I'll leave the recovering to you, and I'll handle the drinking!

0.Content: The Magic Flora's output tendencies have become a lot clearer now. The caretaker really does affect the outcome.

1.Content: Yep, kind of like fishing. It all comes down to wind direction, bait, and a little bit of luck!

2.Content: Your metaphor could use some work, but... I suppose it's catchy enough. Let's keep at it today as well.

0.Content: Drinks and weapons growing right out of Magic Flora... this magic really does whatever it wants.

1.Content: Maybe the Wonder Farm simply remembered what we wanted to get back.

2.Content: Well, it better keep in mind that my patience is running thin.

0.Content: Wow! This batch of Magic Flora looks so full and healthy. They should give us plenty of what we need!

1.Content: Barbecue? Cold drinks? Either one works for me! I really want that big beach feast already!

2.Content: You'll have to wait a bit longer... and first off, no swallowing the ingredients the second we recover them!

0.Content: Oh my, what a lovely little Wonder Farm this is. Wishes, dew, ripening blossoms... sounds like the perfect place to tuck away a little secret.

1.Content: You'd better not hide any secrets in my tile. I'll dig them out, roots and all.

2.Content: Ahem, today's goal is tending to the Magic Flora, not testing each other! ...Wait, why is a Hypogean here on vacation too?

0.Content: There are still a few more debris piles along the coast... the route itself isn't hard, but we'll need more Ocean Turbine.

1.Content: Then we should find a way to boost the Wonder Farm's output before starting the next round of recovery. That'll be more efficient.

2.Content: Right! Same thought here!

0.Content: Oh my, it seems the sea breeze has brought you laughter and a bit of chaos.

1.Content: Great Summer Goddess, this Wonder Farm really does have something to do with you, doesn't it?

2.Content: I merely left a little room for wishes to grow. The rest is a miracle that all of you brought about with your own hands.

0.Content: After all these recovery runs... we've basically memorized this whole coastline by now!

1.Content: At least those crates have finally stopped playing dead in the waves.

2.Content: Whew... once we've got everything back, I really need to give the kart a good cleaning, especially all the sand in the undercarriage!

0.Content: We've recovered almost all the supplies now, and everyone's gotten pretty used to tending the Wonder Farm, too.

1.Content: Haha! So does that mean the real vacation is finally about to begin?

2.Content: That's right! Once the last batch of Magic Flora ripens, we're throwing one big, lively beach party!

3.Content: Yeah, at least it wasn't all for nothing. Time to actually enjoy ourselves.

0.Content: Sailors, new treasure on the horizon! What are you waiting for? Follow me!
Never venture into unfamiliar waters blind, or you're asking for trouble. Ships dock every day, so send them to scout around.

1.Content: Your fleets will return with Wayfinder Compasses, an essential tool for any treasure hunt.

0.Content: Manage your routes wisely. Each one can only accommodate a single fleet.
Pick a good ship and set sail! Better ships can voyage longer and bring back more Compasses.
Need your fleet home faster? Get some help from your Guild!
Lucky you! This one's yours. Open it up!
Seems your friends left you a little something.
It's time for the real treasure hunting!
Oh? A Deepsea Relic. That's a fine find. It can unlock new maritime technologies.

1.Content: That's not the last of it. Onward!

0.Content: You can treasure hunt even faster now. Give it a try!
Keep searching for treasure!
Nice luck! You found a Reserve Hero Fragment!

1.Content: Running low on compasses. Dispatch some fleets to search for more!

0.Content: Where are we...? Weren't we just chasing the kaiju?

1.Content: Look! Kaiju I've never seen are attacking civilians!

2.Content: We can figure that out later. Save them first!

3.Content: Right. Let's move!

0.Content: Well... looks like we are one step too late. The monsters are already gone.

1.Content: Those two strangers must have defeated them.

2.Content: Monsters? Aren't they called kaiju?

3.Content: Kaiju? That's a new one. Here in Esperia, we just call them monsters.

4.Content: Esperia? Never heard of it.

5.Content: Wait... are you saying we've crossed into another world?

6.Content: The residual energy here is highly unusual. Combined with your reactions, it strongly suggests you were swept here through a dimensional rift from another world.

7.Content: That explains it! I knew you two weren't from around here. The uniforms are pretty cool, though.

8.Content: Kafka... those things didn't fight like kaiju.

9.Content: No... but they were giving off energy signatures similar to kaiju. I don't get it.

10.Content: The monsters have turned feral lately, and their attacks are growing more frequent by the day. We are here to investigate both the rift and whatever is driving the monsters berserk.

11.Content: So far, all signs point to an otherworldly energy resonating with a powerful monster nearby. That resonance ripped open dimensional rifts.

12.Content: Which is most likely how the two of you ended up in Esperia.

13.Content: So the powerful monster you mentioned... could be the source of the rift?

14.Content: It's the most plausible theory we have. To get back to your world, you'll need to trace the rift to its source and see whether that monster is keeping it open.

15.Content: So... we find the monster, take it down, and the problem's solved. Simple enough.

16.Content: Haha! I like your style. But before that, maybe we should introduce ourselves.

17.Content: Kikoru Shinomiya. Japan Defense Force.

18.Content: I'm Kafka Hibino. Also with the Japan Defense Force. Nice to meet you!

20.Content: It's the organization that protects our world from kaiju.

21.Content: I see. Name's Raine, Death's Denier! And this serious-looking fellow here is Fawkes. He's a demon hunter.

22.Content: The Guild Master of the Bounty Hunters Guild sent us here to investigate. We've already gathered information on the surrounding terrain and the monsters' movements.

23.Content: The rift signatures diverge in two directions. If we look into only one, we could miss what's happening at the source.

24.Content: Understood. We'll cover more ground if we split up. Kafka, let's go.

25.Content: Hold on. You two are complete strangers to this world. Splitting up now would be too dangerous. Besides, this Quest was commissioned by the Lightbearer Empire.

26.Content: Lightbearer Empire? So you're acting under government orders?

27.Content: That's right. Which means keeping you with us is the best for all of us. Fawkes and I were planning to split up anyway, so why don't each of you come with one of us?

28.Content: Wait. We just got here. We need to have each other's backs.

29.Content: It should be fine. They don't exactly look dangerous.

30.Content: You trust people a little too easily.

31.Content: Your caution is understandable. But your best chance of surviving in an unfamiliar world is to travel with someone who knows the terrain. If anything happens, we'll be there to assist.

32.Content: One of you can come with me, while the other takes the opposite route with Raine. Once we've closed in on the source, we'll regroup and exchange findings. Agreed?

33.Content: Sticking with professionals working under an official commission certainly sounds like a better plan than wandering around blind. We'll cover more ground and reduce the risk of getting lost... I can agree to that.

34.Content: Sounds good to me. We'll trust you on this one. So... who's teaming up with Mr. Fawkes?

0.Content: No time like the present, let's go.
These monsters may not be kaiju... but they're just as eager to attack people.

1.Content: Something is driving them. Every one of these monsters bears traces of the same power.

2.Content: The power that pulled us into this world?

3.Content: Exactly. They're most likely all under the influence of that powerful monster. The rift's energy is converging on its location as well.

4.Content: Got it! If we can find that thing, we might find our way back to our world.

5.Content: That's our strongest lead. Let's clear out the monsters and continue toward the source of the rift.

0.Content: There's a pattern to their movements. They're not just rampaging, but converging on the source of power.

1.Content: They all bear traces of the same energy. I believe they're under the influence of that powerful monster.

2.Content: And the rift's energy is converging on its location as well... correct?

3.Content: Yes. The rift will likely expand even further if the energy is left unchecked.

4.Content: Understood. That monster is now our top priority, then.

5.Content: Stay alert. The closer we get to the source, the stronger its influence over the monsters will become.

6.Content: Got it. Let's keep moving and stop it before the rift grows bigger.

0.Content: Wait. The rift activity here is spiking fast... An elite monster is about to emerge.

1.Content: I can feel the suffocating pressure... It's totally in a different league.

2.Content: Yeah, but it hasn't fully manifested yet. The rift is still gathering energy. It won't appear until the disturbance stabilizes.

3.Content: So... does that mean we still have time?

4.Content: Exactly. Rushing into a fight would only put us at greater risk.

5.Content: Good. We'll prepare while we can, then take it down as soon as it shows up!

0.Content: Wait. The rift activity here is spiking fast... An elite monster is about to emerge.

1.Content: Sounds troublesome. Nothing I can't handle, though.

2.Content: It hasn't fully manifested yet. The rift is still gathering energy. It won't appear until the disturbance stabilizes.

3.Content: Even better. Once I'm ready, the fight won't last long.

4.Content: Yeah. Rushing into a fight would only put us at greater risk.

5.Content: Of course. A stronger opponent is all the more reason not to cut corners on preparation.

0.Content: The rift is still giving it room to maneuver. Just the two of us won't be enough to cut off every escape route.

1.Content: Can we get reinforcements? With enough people, we can surround it and make sure it doesn't escape!

2.Content: I'll send out a Joint Subjugation request to the adventurers nearby. Every additional participant will help close another way of retreat and improve the outcome of the hunt.

3.Content: Good! Let's keep it up and take it down for good!

0.Content: The rift is still giving it room to maneuver. Just the two of us won't be enough to cut off every escape route.

1.Content: Then we seal every route it could use. Can you call in reinforcements?

2.Content: I'll send out a Joint Subjugation request to the adventurers nearby. Every additional participant will help close another way of retreat and improve the outcome of the hunt.

3.Content: Good. Then it won't have anywhere left to run.

0.Content: Kikoru, over here!

1.Content: Looks like things went pretty smoothly on your end, Kafka.

2.Content: Well... I wouldn't say it was easy. Those monsters didn't make getting here easy.

3.Content: Look at you two! Impressive! See that big one up ahead? That's our target.

4.Content: It appeared right where the two trails converge... So it really is the source.

5.Content: Frenzied monsters, the rift's continued expansion... Both lead back to it.

6.Content: It has absorbed energy from your world and is still evolving. If we don't defeat it here, the rift will only continue to spread.

7.Content: No way! Who knows how many people will get hurt if this keeps spreading?

8.Content: Target confirmed. There's only one thing to do.

9.Content: Once it's defeated, the rift will stabilize for a short time. That will be your best chance to return to your own world.

10.Content: Win this fight, and you're going home. That's all the motivation you need, right?

11.Content: Absolutely! We didn't come all this way just to stop here!

12.Content: I'll make sure this operation ends perfectly.

13.Content: All right... let's finish this!

0.Content: The rift is closing... The passage has stabilized.

1.Content: We did it! We can finally go home, Kikoru!

2.Content: Something's wrong... The rift's energy is still lingering. I'm... feeling a little dizzy.

3.Content: Yeah. I'm starting to feel it too...

4.Content: Fawkes! Don't tell me they were hurt in the fight?

5.Content: No. There's nothing physically wrong with them. Space is correcting the anomaly.

6.Content: You don't belong in Esperia. Now that the passage has stabilized, it is drawing you back to where you came from.

7.Content: Then this dizziness...

8.Content: It's most likely because your memories of this world are beginning to fade.

9.Content: We're going to forget everything that happened here?

10.Content: If memories of another world stay with you, they could serve as a pivot and tear open another rift.

11.Content: So forgetting this place is necessary to prevent another rift from opening.

12.Content: Awww! What a shame! We just fought an incredible battle together.

13.Content: Yeah... Still, knowing we made a difference is enough for me.

14.Content: If this is the only way to stop it from spreading, then the choice is obvious.

15.Content: If anyone ever asks about this hunt, I'll make sure they hear all about the two of you!

16.Content: Esperia will remember what you've done for us. You have our gratitude.

17.Content: Thank you... I'm really glad to have met you.

18.Content: Thank you. Come on, Kafka. Let's go back... to where we're needed.
